|  **[Бзиала шәаабеит](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B0:%D0%91%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B0_%D1%88%D3%99%D0%B0%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%B8%D1%82 "Авикипедиа:Бзиала шәаабеит") [Авикипедиаҿы!](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B0 "Авикипедиа")** [Авикипедиа](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B0 "Авикипедиа") — зхы иақәиҭу интернет-енциклопедиоуп дарбанзаалак дҭалар ҟалоит.  Иахьа [ҩашоуп](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%A9%D0%B0%D1%88%D0%B0 "Аҩаша"), [2025](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025 "2025") шықәса [ԥхынҷкәынмза 9](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D4%A4%D1%85%D1%8B%D0%BD%D2%B7%D0%BA%D3%99%D1%8B%D0%BD%D0%BC%D0%B7%D0%B0_9 "Ԥхынҷкәынмза 9"). ##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a9/HSVissteduatt.svg/40px-HSVissteduatt.svg.png) Шәара ижәдыруама?
  * **[Аҟәа](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%9F%D3%99%D0%B0 "Аҟәа")** ақалақь иамоу астатус 1848-тәи ашықәс аахыс иаауеит. Иара атәыла агәҭаны, [Урыстәыла](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%81%D1%82%D3%99%D1%8B%D0%BB%D0%B0 "Урыстәыла") аҳәааҟнытә 107 км ахьыбжьоу, [Амшын Еиқәа](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BC%D1%88%D1%8B%D0%BD_%D0%95%D0%B8%D2%9B%D3%99%D0%B0 "Амшын Еиқәа") агаҟны ишьҭоуп. Ақалақь иалсны ицоит. Аӡиасқәа [Кьалашәыр](https://ab.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%9A%D1%8C%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%88%D3%99%D1%8B%D1%80&action=edit&redlink=1 "Кьалашәыр \(ари адаҟьа иҟаӡам\)"), [Басла](https://ab.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%91%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B0&action=edit&redlink=1 "Басла \(ари адаҟьа иҟаӡам\)"), [Ҳакьыԥсы](https://ab.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D2%B2%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%8C%D1%8B%D4%A5%D1%81%D1%8B&action=edit&redlink=1 "Ҳакьыԥсы \(ари адаҟьа иҟаӡам\)").
  * **[Урыстәыла](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%81%D1%82%D3%99%D1%8B%D0%BB%D0%B0 "Урыстәыла")** ([аур.](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%81_%D0%B1%D1%8B%D0%B7%D1%88%D3%99%D0%B0 "Аурыс бызшәа") Россия) ахьʒ **Урыстәылатәи Афедерациа** ([аур.](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%81_%D0%B1%D1%8B%D0%B7%D1%88%D3%99%D0%B0 "Аурыс бызшәа") Российская Федерация). Аҵакыра — 17 125 400 км². Ауааԥсыра — 146 267 288-ҩык. (2015 ш.). [Аурысцәа](https://ab.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%90%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%81%D1%86%D3%99%D0%B0&action=edit&redlink=1 "Аурысцәа \(ари адаҟьа иҟаӡам\)") — 81,83 %.


##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/39/HSDagensdatum.svg/40px-HSDagensdatum.svg.png)[Ԥхынҷкәынмза 9](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D4%A4%D1%85%D1%8B%D0%BD%D2%B7%D0%BA%D3%99%D1%8B%D0%BD%D0%BC%D0%B7%D0%B0_9 "Ԥхынҷкәынмза 9") — иахьатәи ахҭысқәа...
[![Замок Аренберг близ Лёвена](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0e/Castle_Arenberg%2C_Katholieke_Universiteit_Leuven_adj.jpg/250px-Castle_Arenberg%2C_Katholieke_Universiteit_Leuven_adj.jpg)](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%84%D0%B0%D0%B8%D0%BB:Castle_Arenberg,_Katholieke_Universiteit_Leuven_adj.jpg "Замок Аренберг близ Лёвена")Замок Аренберг близ Лёвена
  * [1425](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1425 "1425") — папа римский Мартин V учредил Католический университет Лёвена (на илл.), старейший в Бельгии.
  * [1824](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1824 "1824") — победа повстанцев при Аякучо обеспечила независимость Перу.
  * [1903](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1903 "1903") — французский парламент единогласно отверг законопроект о предоставлении женщинам права голосовать на выборах.
  * [1905](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1905 "1905") — по инициативе Аристида Бриана во Франции принят закон об отделении церкви от государства.
  * [1968](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1968 "1968") — Дуглас Энгелбарт продемонстрировал изобретенную в его лаборатории компьютерную мышь.
  * [1987](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987 "1987") — начало первой интифады.
  * [1990](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990 "1990") — первым всенародно избранным президентом Польши стал Лех Валенса.
  * [2016](https://ab.wikipedia.org/wiki/2016 "2016") — парламент Южной Кореи приостановил президентские полномочия Пак Кын Хе.

## Ostorariya  
---  
O ngangan nona kitakit ’i, **[Ostorariya](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ostorariya "Ostorariya")** (Ikiris sowal: Commonwealth of Australia) ano ca. Australia; Holam a sowal: 澳洲. I satimolan riyar ko aro’ nona kitakit, adihayay ko kanatanatal a misakapotay patireng to kitakit, o ’icel no mikowanay o kinpo ko pido’edoan. O Tatapangan a niyaro’ o Kyanpira, o satata’angay a niyaro’ o Sitoni, Sieli hananay no kaping a sowal. Ona kitakit toniniam ’i, caayay ka laliting to roma a karoapw (陸地), o taliyok sahetoay o riyar, sa caay ko recep no pinangan no roma a kitakit, caay ka siwar no roma a finacadan ko nika’orip, yo sa’aloman sa to ko tata’angay a tamina nani Yoropa a tayni ta sa ’aloman sato ko mafana’ay to kairay nona palapalaan no Yincumin. I sa’ayaw ’i, o pipasonolan to ciraraway tamdaw, iikor ira ko pakaheraay to tada ’ekim, sano riri’ sato a masafelengaw a tayni ko kohecalay tamdaw a mili’ekim, ititi to a ma’eco ko kamaro’an no itinitiniay aca a maro’ a Yincumin.

## Maysang Kalimud  
---  
  * [![I 1933 a miheca\(年\) saka 7 folad saka 10 a romi’ad masofoc\(出生\) ci Maysang Kalimud](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e8/C_K_Yang_-_Southern_Campus_1960_crop.jpg/250px-C_K_Yang_-_Southern_Campus_1960_crop.jpg)](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faylo:C_K_Yang_-_Southern_Campus_1960_crop.jpg "I 1933 a miheca\(年\) saka 7 folad saka 10 a romi’ad masofoc\(出生\) ci Maysang Kalimud") I 1933 a miheca(年) saka 7 folad saka 10 a romi’ad masofoc(出生) ci [Maysang Kalimud](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maysang "Maysang")

**[Maysang Kalimud](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maysang "Maysang")** (kuwaping a sowal: 楊傳廣, 1933 miheca 7 folad 10 romi’ad - 2007 miheca 1 folad 28 romi’ad) kananaman no niya a mitilid to ngangan Misun saan ko pangangan. Masofoc i no Dipong pikowan Taywan Posong kofa, niyaro’ no Falangaw a ’Amis a tamdaw. Na o dayhiw maocor no kitakit (ROC) mikihatiya to Olimpiko mo^etepay a kalalifet, pakaala 1960 mihecaan Loma Olimpiko saka tosa a kompay, o sakacecay no Taywan pakaalaay to kompay no Olimpiko, ato i likisi sakacecay pakaalaay to kompay no Olimpiko Taywan a tamdaw, onini haw i o sakacecay a kompay no kitakit (ROC) Olimpiko a kompay. Maysang, i mo^etepay a kalalifet pakata’elifay mirocokay to 9000 tinso, mapangangan to “Asiya a ’ekeng fainayan” (Asian Iron Man). Itiya ci ’Atongol (Ciong-kay-sik) a contong kina 7 matahidang, o sakacecay no Taywan a ontoing. Nanoya, ikor pakaala cingra to kompay no Olimpiko, Faladaw a niyaro’ fa^elohay selal a kapah panganganen to “Latingko” a han, oni a selal i 2005 miheca mapacakat i kalas no niyaro’ o “Isefi’ay” a han. I 2000 mihecaan ci Maysang mapatireng no kakalas no niyaro’ to Tomok no Falangaw niyaro’.

## Codad  
---  
O sowal no Sawaliay ’Amis a Finacadan to **[codad](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Codad "Codad")** , o ohong hananay. O citodotodongay iparo no kadopak, o citiliday ato sasing, o pitilidan to masamaamaanay a taneng, matiyaay o citing. Itini i pasawalian no Taywan a ’Amis a tamdaw i, o tilid hananay nangra ko ohong, mahecaday ko imi nona tosa a tilid. O tanengnengan no tamdamdaw a ohong, o pitongalan to taneng no tamdaw. O ohong hananay i, adihay ko kasaromaroma no tilid. Ira ko kongkoan a ohong, ira ko tanengnengan no ka’emangay a ohong, Cilamlamay to masamaamaanay tilid a Cace (雜誌). Saheto sa o kaolahan no tamdamdaw a ohong. O pipahacean to ohong i, o pa’acaay to ohong a patiyamay (書店) hananay. O ’ariri no ohong (圖書館) i, opicaliwan to ohong. 2010 a mihecaan mikisang ko Kuko (谷歌) a kosi i, mi insaco kingkiw tangasa tahanini.
  * [![o pa’acaay to ohong a patiyamay.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2c/Eslite_Bookstore_Dunnan_Interior_201507.jpg/500px-Eslite_Bookstore_Dunnan_Interior_201507.jpg)](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faylo:Eslite_Bookstore_Dunnan_Interior_201507.jpg "o pa’acaay to ohong a patiyamay.") o pa’acaay to ohong a patiyamay.

---  
Ｏ kimad itiya ho, o sa’ayaway a tayni ko Ciporan a ngasawan. pakayni i Sanasay milacal to riyar tangasa i posong. saikor, tangasa to i **[La’eno (大港口部落)](https://ami.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laeno "Laeno")** no cepo’ ato Makotaay paloma’ ko Ciporan ngasaw. Nikawria ikarira, yo kasakapingan ho i, ira ko Karawrawan a demak no Cepo’ hananay, misalalan ko kaping no kasakapingan, mari'angay ko kaping to finawlan. sa linahen ngara ko kamaro’an tayra i katimol no sa’etip a (sowal no holam) Cekongsan (赤公山) tokos a makotaay ’alo. kirami i (1924-1925), sąadihaysa to ko tamdaw i Makotaay a niyaro’. linah saan to ko finawlan tayra i la’eno no Makotaay, sa La’eno a niyaro’ han ngara.

##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fd/HSutvald2.svg/40px-HSutvald2.svg.png) لأرتيكل لمزيانة ديال ليوم 
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/42/Football_in_Bloomington%2C_Indiana%2C_1995.jpg/250px-Football_in_Bloomington%2C_Indiana%2C_1995.jpg)](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A:Football_in_Bloomington,_Indiana,_1995.jpg)
**كورة** ؤلا **لفوت** ([بلعربية](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9 "لعربية"): **كرة القدم** ، [بالنݣليزية](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%86%DD%A3%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%A9 "نݣليزية"): **Soccer** أولّا **Association Football**)، كاتكنّى ب**اللعبة الزوينة** أولّا **رياضة لعالام** ([بالنݣليزية](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%86%DD%A3%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%A9 "نݣليزية"): **World Game**) هي [رياضة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B6%D8%A9 "رياضة") جماعية كيلعبوها جوج ديال لفراقي ضد بعضياتهم. كل فرقة د لكورة تيكونو فيها 11 لعّاب تيلعبو برجليهم [بكورة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9_\(%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9\) "كورة \(كورة\)") [مكوّرة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9 "كورة"). تاتّعتابر لكورة هي الرياضة اللي شعبية ݣاع فلعالم حيتاش كايقصرها كتر من 250 مليون د [بنادم](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AF%D9%85 "بنادم") ف 200 بلاد.

مقالات مزيانين خرين: [كمال الودغيري](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%83%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84_%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%AF%D8%BA%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%8A "كمال الودغيري") • [دير تومليلين](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%B1_%D8%AA%D9%88%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%86 "دير تومليلين") • [تݣلمامين](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%AA%DD%A3%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86 "تݣلمامين") • [عنتي](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%B9%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%8A "عنتي") • [جورج سيرافان كولان](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%AC%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%AC_%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%86_%D9%83%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86 "جورج سيرافان كولان") • [پاكيطا ݣورونيو](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%BE%D8%A7%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7_%DD%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%88 "پاكيطا ݣورونيو") • [أدب تشلحيت](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A3%D8%AF%D8%A8_%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%AA "أدب تشلحيت") • [أمامة عواد لحرش](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A9_%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AF_%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%B4 "أمامة عواد لحرش") • [1984](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/1984_\(%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A9\) "1984 \(رواية\)") • [بوݣود](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A8%D9%88%DD%A3%D9%88%D8%AF "بوݣود") • [لجامعة د مالطا](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A9_%D8%AF_%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7 "لجامعة د مالطا")

##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8d/HS_exclamationmark.svg/40px-HS_exclamationmark.svg.png) ربط سلوݣية
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8a/Loudspeaker.svg/20px-Loudspeaker.svg.png)](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A:%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88_%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%B7_%D8%B3%D9%84%D9%88%DD%A3%D9%8A%D8%A9.ogg "About this sound")[سمع](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/54/%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88_%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%B7_%D8%B3%D9%84%D9%88%DD%A3%D9%8A%D8%A9.ogg "%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88 %D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%B7 %D8%B3%D9%84%D9%88%DD%A3%D9%8A%D8%A9.ogg")([معاونة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%BE%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7:%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86%D8%A9_%D8%AF_%D9%84%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA?action=edit&redlink=1 "ويكيپيديا:معاونة د لفيشيات \(الصفحة ما كايناش\)")·[معلومات](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A:%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88_%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%B7_%D8%B3%D9%84%D9%88%DD%A3%D9%8A%D8%A9.ogg "فيشي:أوديو ربط سلوݣية.ogg"))  

  * الساحل لأطلسي ديال **لمغريب غادي من "طنجة ل لݣويرة"** ([شوف واش صحيحة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%DD%A3%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A9 "لݣويرة"))
  * [**لملوك د لمغريب**](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%AA%D8%B5%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%81:%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B3_%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%85%D9%88_%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8 "تصنيف:ناس حكمو لمغريب") ف النص اللول ديال لقرن لعشرين **كانو كاملين** **ضد لستيعمار** ([شوف واش صحيحة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A5%D9%86%D8%B2%D8%A7%D9%84_%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9 "إنزال لحسيمة"))
  * كاينين **9** دلكواكب ف النظام الشمسي ([شوف واش صحيحة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A "النضام الشمسي"))
  * محمد لخامس **بان ف لقمر** ([شوف واش صحيحة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%BE%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7_%D9%82%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9 "پاريدوليا قمرية"))
  * لمغريب حكموه كثر من 120 سلطان وملك من [لأدارسة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B3%D8%A9 "لأدارسة") ل [لعلويين](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86 "لعلويين") ([شوف واش صحيحة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%AE_%D8%AF_%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8 "تاريخ د لمغريب"))
  * السلطان لمغريبي سماعيل بن شريف ولد كثر من 1000 ولد وعندو كثر من 500 جارية و 5 ديال العيالات ([شوف واش صحيحة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8A_%D8%B3%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%84 "مولاي سماعيل"))

##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7f/HSWPedia.svg/40px-HSWPedia.svg.png) ويكيپيديا دارجة
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8a/Loudspeaker.svg/20px-Loudspeaker.svg.png)](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A:%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88_%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%BE%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7_%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9_-_%D8%AF%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%A8%D8%B1_2023.ogg "About this sound")[سمع](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7c/%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88_%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%BE%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7_%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9_-_%D8%AF%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%A8%D8%B1_2023.ogg "%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88 %D9%88%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%BE%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7 %D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9 - %D8%AF%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%A8%D8%B1 2023.ogg")([معاونة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%BE%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7:%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86%D8%A9_%D8%AF_%D9%84%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA?action=edit&redlink=1 "ويكيپيديا:معاونة د لفيشيات \(الصفحة ما كايناش\)")·[معلومات](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A:%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%88_%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%BE%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7_%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9_-_%D8%AF%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%A8%D8%B1_2023.ogg "فيشي:أوديو ويكيپيديا دارجة - دجنبر 2023.ogg"))  
مشروع تشاركي باش نّتجو إنسيكلوپيديا حورة، فابور، ؤ متكاملة. هادا سيت ختيباري باش نشوفو واش لإنسيكلوپيديا واجدة ؤ لإقبال عليها كاين، دابا وصلنا لـ **10,923** أرتيكل. لهدف ديالنا نوصلو لـ 100.000 أرتيكل باش نزيدو نطوّرو لموسوعة. لمحتوى ديال ويكيپيديا منشور تحت [رخصة ڭنو ل لوثائق لحورة](https://www.gnu.org/copyleft/fdl.html)، شي لّي كايعني بلي حور باش يتعاود يتستعمل.
##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/10/Datum10.svg/40px-Datum10.svg.png) حوايج وقعو نهار 10 دجنبر

  * 1896: وفاة [ألفريد نوبل](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A3%D9%84%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%AF_%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%84 "ألفريد نوبل")
  * 1898: تأسيس ديال [كوبا](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%83%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%A7 "كوبا")
  * 1962: خرج فيلم [لورنس الدزيرة لعربية](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%86%D8%B3_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A9_%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9 "لورنس الدزيرة لعربية")

##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6d/HSAktuell.svg/40px-HSAktuell.svg.png) أش طاري ؟ 
[خبار قدام](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B6%D9%8A%D9%84:%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1_%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%81%D8%AD%D8%A9_%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7/%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%86%D9%88%D9%84%D9%88%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A7 "موضيل:لخبار ديال الصفحة اللولا/كرونولوجيا") - [قتارح خبار](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B6%D9%8A%D9%84:%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1_%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%81%D8%AD%D8%A9_%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7/%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AA "موضيل:لخبار ديال الصفحة اللولا/قتيراحات") [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/ary/thumb/b/bc/2024_WAFCON_%28logo%29.png/120px-2024_WAFCON_%28logo%29.png)](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A:2024_WAFCON_\(logo\).png)
  * [31 أكتوبر](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/31_%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1 "31 أكتوبر"): [مجلس لأمن](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3_%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%86_%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84_%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85_%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9?action=edit&redlink=1 "مجلس لأمن ديال لأمم لمتحدة \(الصفحة ما كايناش\)") ديال [لأمم لمتحدة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85_%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9 "لأمم لمتحدة") صوّت على قرار كيقضي باش جميع لأطراف ف النزاع على [الصحرا لمغريبية](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A7_%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9_%D9%84%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9 "الصحرا لمغريبية لغربية") يتفاوضو على أساس مقترح لحكم الداتي لي دارو [لمغريب](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%84%D9%85%D8%BA%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A8 "لمغريب").

##  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/69/HSEditor.svg/40px-HSEditor.svg.png) كيفاش تساهم ف ويكيپيديا ؟ 
أي واحد يقدر يكتب أرتيكل، ولا يوسعها، و يقدر يكتب شوية ولا بزاف. باش تلقى معلومات على كيفاش تقدر تكتب، تبدل، و بزاف د لحوايج خرة زور صفحة [لمعاونة](https://ary.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86%D8%A9:%D8%B5%D9%81%D8%AD%D8%A9_%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86%D8%A9 "معاونة:صفحة لمعاونة"). يلا بغيتي تكتب أرتيكل جديدة كتب لعنوان ديالها ف هاد لبلاصة لخاوية و تبع التعليمات.

[![Къэплъан](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a3/Tiger_in_the_snow_at_the_Detroit_Zoo_March_2008_pic_2.jpg/250px-Tiger_in_the_snow_at_the_Detroit_Zoo_March_2008_pic_2.jpg)](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Tiger_in_the_snow_at_the_Detroit_Zoo_March_2008_pic_2.jpg "Къэплъан")Къэплъан **Къэплъаныр** , мэзчэтыу псэушъхьэхэмэ а щыщ. ПстэумкIи ионтэгъугъэ кг 270 мэхъуы, зырызхэри кг 300-ым ехъуых, ыкІхьагъэ м 4-ым нэсы. НэхьбэрэмкІэ къэплъаным лъэныкъо джадэ къзэрегъуэтзы шъхьэзакъоу ащ шэпсэуы. Непэ къэплъан лъэпкъыр зэрэщытэу кодыжынкІэ щынагъу траубытагъ! Пасэм Кэфказым щегъэджагъэу Іэндунесям нэсэ къэплъанхэр къэбгъотынэу щытыгъ, ау непэ пэкІэ-пакІэу зэбгырызыгъэу къэнагъэх. Къэплъаныр псэушъхьэшх, мэзпщэнхэр, мэзщыдхэр, мэзпсэцухэр, тхьакІумкІыхьэхэр ещхых. _([Къэплъан...](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%8A%D1%8D%D0%BF%D0%BB%D1%8A%D0%B0%D0%BD "Къэплъан"))_ |  |  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c1/Kfar_Kama_mosque.jpg/120px-Kfar_Kama_mosque.jpg) **Кфар Кама** ([инджылызыбзэгьэ](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B6%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%8B%D0%B7%D1%8B%D0%B1%D0%B7%D1%8D "Инджылызыбзэ"):Kfar Kama; [арапыбзэгьэ](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BF%D1%8B%D0%B1%D0%B7%D1%8D "Арапыбзэ"):كفر كما; [джуртыбзэгьэ](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B6%D1%83%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%B1%D0%B7%D1%8D "Джуртыбзэ"):כפר כמא) — адыгэ къуаджэу [Исраилым](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D1%81%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B8%D0%BB "Исраил") ит. Адыгэмэ ащыщэу [шапсыгъэх](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D0%B0%D0%BF%D1%81%D1%8B%D0%B3%D1%8A%D1%8D "Шапсыгъэ") дэсхэр, шапсыгъабзэкIэ щэгушаIэх. Кфар Камар адыгэу [Кавказ заом](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B7_%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%BE?action=edit&redlink=1 "Кавказ зао \(нэкӀубгъор щыӀэп\)") хэкужъым кърафыгъэхэмэ [1876](https://ady.wikipedia.org/wiki/1876?action=edit&redlink=1 "1876 \(нэкӀубгъор щыӀэп\)") илъэсым ягъэтIысэгъ. Ар загъэтIысым Арапэу ягъунэгъухэр къазэотгъэхгьи, яшIотыгъотгъэхгьи. Ащ фэшIыгьэ Адыгэмэ яунэхэр къэлашъхьэ атгъэгьэ къагъэуцохьгъэх. Нэпэ нэпэгьэ а Iофым хэтыжьхэп. Арапхэр къазэожьхэрэм, я ягъэ къарагъэкIыжьрэп.Нэпэ Кфар Камам 3,000 ...

**Адыгэ Нып** (Адыгэ бракъ, Адыгэ лъэпкъым и Нып) — джырэ зэманым Хасэхэм, лъэпкъыгъохэм, Адыгеем джоуэ я ныпэу щыт. 2011 гъэм щегъэжьагъэу адыгэ лъэпкъым мэлыжъыхьым и 25 мафэр адыгэ ныпым и мафэу траӀуагъ. Ныпым и теплъэр плӀэмый фэкӀыхь уцышъоу щыт, бгъуагъэмрэ кӀыхьагъэмрэ зэрэзэфыщытыр — 2:1. Ежь ныпым ыкӀцӀым дышъэ жъуагъо 12 чищ зэтелърэ апэхэмкӀэ дэгъэзыягъэу тетых.

## Atikulu òsibi esese chereyi  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/94/Fire_ants_01.jpg/250px-Fire_ants_01.jpg)](https://ann.wikipedia.org/wiki/Failu:Fire_ants_01.jpg)Ebi kè atat **Atat** ìre [mwuwu](https://ann.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mwuwu "Mwuwu") òkigbaan̄ iluk me ogbọn̄ [colonies].  Me owuwa oniin̄, ebi kè atat ebelek ebi kè [akwọọk](https://ann.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akw%E1%BB%8D%E1%BB%8Dk "Akwọọk") mè àtaak [wasps]. Atat îwa lek enenen. Otu-ifuk esese esese lek atat ekọtbe iweek imun̄ ìre 12,500 me ibebieen̄ iriaak. **([Fuk òjot òjot...](https://ann.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atat "Atat"))**

|  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/97/Bluebg.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7f/HSWPedia.svg/20px-HSWPedia.svg.png) **D Alemannische Wikipedia** ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/als/c/c5/Houptsyte-Karte-Regiolekte-235px.png) D **alemannische Wikipedia** isch a Enzyklopedi i dr Dialekt vom [alemannische Sprochroum](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alemannisch "Alemannisch"), also vo der Dütschschwyz, vom Elsass, vo Liachtastua, vo Oberbade, vom Schwobaland und vo Voradlberg. 
  * Dia Enzyklopedi wachst durch d freiwillige Hilf vo allna, wo eappas in irer Mundard beiträga wänd. Yträg künnand vo allna Bsuechar gschriba und gändrat wörra. Alle siand härzlich yglade mitzmacha. Bringand öüar Wiassa i und healfand so mit, s Alemannische z pfleaga, ufzumwearta und z erhalta. Di [erschta Schritt](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Willkommen "Wikipedia:Willkommen") siand ganz uafach!


  * Wer mir vo dr Alemanische Wikipedia siand und was mir wänd, fiandasch in üsrem [Profil](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Profil "Wikipedia:Profil").


  * D Inhalt vo dr Wikipedia dürfand [frei kopiert und verbreitet](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Lizenzbestimmungen "Wikipedia:Lizenzbestimmungen") wörra.


  * Bis jetz git s bi dr alemannische Wikipedia [31.413 Artikel](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Statistik "Wikipedia:Statistik").

**Artikel vo dr Wocha:[Neapel](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neapel "Neapel")**
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/88/Napoli_-_Maschio_Angioino_-_202209302342_3.jpg/250px-Napoli_-_Maschio_Angioino_-_202209302342_3.jpg)](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neapel "Neapel") **Neapel** ([italienisch](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italienische_Sprache "Italienische Sprache"): _Napoli_ [ˈnaːpoli], [neapolitanisch](https://als.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neapolitanisch&action=edit&redlink=1 "Neapolitanisch \(Syte nid vorhande\)"): _Napule_ [ˈnaːpulə] odder au [ˈnaːpələ]; vo [Griechisch](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Griechische_Sprache "Griechische Sprache") _nea polis_ „neui Schtadt“) isch noch [Rom](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rom "Rom") und [Mailand](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mailand "Mailand") die drittgröschti Schtadt vo [Idalie](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italien "Italien") und die gröschti Schtadt vo Süditalie. S isch d Hauptschtadt vo der Region [Kampanie](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kampanien "Kampanien") und der Provinz Neapel. D Schtadt sälber het öbbe 1 Million Iiwohner mit erä hoche Dunkelziffre vo Persone, wo nit amtlig regischtriert si, zsämme mit de Vorört het d [Agglomeration](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agglomeration "Agglomeration") über 4,4 Millione Iiwohner.  Neapel litt am [Vesuv](https://als.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Vesuv&action=edit&redlink=1 "Vesuv \(Syte nid vorhande\)") im Golf vu Neapel. D'Aafäng vu de Stadt lige an de Chüste, wu de erscht Stadtchärn entstande-n-isch. Dört sin di griechische Koloniie gläge, wu de Aafang vum Handel bedütet un dodemit zur Entwicklig vu de hüttige Stadt biidrage hänn. S Stadtgebiet isch vu Hügel brägt, wu di meiste devuu e Höchi zwüsche 150 un 452 Meter hänn un wu eigeni Stadtdeil un Quartier druff entstande sin, dezüe chömme no mehreri Insle, Halbinsle un Buchte. Geologisch gseh hät Neapel e kumpläxi Gschicht, di letschti Schicht bstoht vor allem us Gröll mit vulkanischem Ursprung. 10 km vo Neapel liit dr [Vulkan](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vulkan "Vulkan") Vesuv. Us däm Grund hebt si Aaschpruch uf e zweete [Bundesrot](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bundesrat_\(Schweiz\) "Bundesrat \(Schweiz\)"). Des sprängt d „[Zauberformle](https://als.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zauberformel "Zauberformel")“, wu s syt 1959 bstoht.

**10.** : **[Manrihtdæg](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manrihtd%C3%A6g?action=edit&redlink=1 "Manrihtdæg \(nā gīet gewriten\)")** ; [Constitution Day](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution_Day?action=edit&redlink=1 "Constitution Day \(nā gīet gewriten\)") in **[Thailand](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution_of_Thailand?action=edit&redlink=1 "Constitution of Thailand \(nā gīet gewriten\)")** ([1932](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/1932?action=edit&redlink=1 "1932 \(nā gīet gewriten\)"))
[![Edmond Halley](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/df/Edmond_Halley_072.jpg/120px-Edmond_Halley_072.jpg)](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ymele:Edmond_Halley_072.jpg "Edmond Halley")Edmond Halley
  * [1508](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/1508?action=edit&redlink=1 "1508 \(nā gīet gewriten\)") – Þā [Papan Rīcu](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papan_R%C4%ABcu?action=edit&redlink=1 "Papan Rīcu \(nā gīet gewriten\)"), [Francland](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Francland "Francland"), [Aragon](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aragon?action=edit&redlink=1 "Aragon \(nā gīet gewriten\)") and þæt [Hālige Rōmānisce Rīce](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/H%C4%81lige_R%C5%8Dm%C4%81nisce_R%C4%ABce "Hālige Rōmānisce Rīce") ætgædre wrōhtedon þone **[Cambrai Geþoftscipe](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cambrai_Ge%C3%BEoftscipe?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cambrai Geþoftscipe \(nā gīet gewriten\)")** wiþ [Uenitie](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uenitia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Uenitia \(nā gīet gewriten\)") þā Cynewīsan.
  * [1684](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/1684?action=edit&redlink=1 "1684 \(nā gīet gewriten\)") – [Edmond Halley](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edmond_Halley?action=edit&redlink=1 "Edmond Halley \(nā gīet gewriten\)") _(on biliþ)_ aswutelode his gewrite be naman _**[De motu corporum in gyrum](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_motu_corporum_in_gyrum?action=edit&redlink=1 "De motu corporum in gyrum \(nā gīet gewriten\)")**_ æt þæm [Cynelican Ferscipe](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynelica_Ferscip?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cynelica Ferscip \(nā gīet gewriten\)"), and þærin wæs [Isaac Newtones](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_Newton "Isaac Newton") geweorc [Kepler's lagu](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kepler's_lagu?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kepler's lagu \(nā gīet gewriten\)") of his aþoht of [gravity](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravity?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gravity \(nā gīet gewriten\)").
  * [1861](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/1861?action=edit&redlink=1 "1861 \(nā gīet gewriten\)") – Þrēat þærof wæs **[Nguyen Trung Truc](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nguyen_Trung_Truc?action=edit&redlink=1 "Nguyen Trung Truc \(nā gīet gewriten\)")** heretoga, sencte _L'Esperance_ , se Frencisc cnearr.
  * [1898](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/1898?action=edit&redlink=1 "1898 \(nā gīet gewriten\)") – Se [Speonisc–Americanisc Gewinn](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speonisc%E2%80%93Americanisc_Gewinn?action=edit&redlink=1 "Speonisc–Americanisc Gewinn \(nā gīet gewriten\)") endede þæn onsiglode begen healfas þone **[Paris Foremæl](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paris_Forem%C3%A6l_\(1898\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Paris Foremæl \(1898\) \(nā gīet gewriten\)")** , þærbe oncneow Spēna rīce [Cuban](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuba "Cuba") sundorrīcedōm; and ageaf [Guam](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guam "Guam"), þa [Philippines](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippines "Philippines"), and [Puerto Rico](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Puerto_Rico "Puerto Rico") þara Geānedan Rīcum.
  * [1941](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/1941?action=edit&redlink=1 "1941 \(nā gīet gewriten\)") – [Ōðru Woruldgūþ](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%8C%C3%B0ru_Woruldg%C5%AB%C3%BE "Ōðru Woruldgūþ"): [Torpedo bombers](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torpedo_bomber?action=edit&redlink=1 "Torpedo bomber \(nā gīet gewriten\)") þæs [Cāserlican Iapaniscan Scipheres](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C4%81serlica_Iapanisca_Sciphere?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cāserlica Iapanisca Sciphere \(nā gīet gewriten\)") sencte _HMS Prince of Wales_ and _HMS Repulse_ þæs [Cynelican Scipheres](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynelica_Sciphere "Cynelica Sciphere") heafodscipu ēastweard of [Malægan](https://ang.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mal%C3%A6ga?action=edit&redlink=1 "Malæga \(nā gīet gewriten\)").

> **"Ki tci kaskeritakik iriniwok nikanik tan ka ki pe aisparinik otananik, tato kaki pe takickakotcik, tan ka ki ici takickakotcik, kekwariw ka pe irakonikaniwonik. Owe tca masinahikan ki tci witcihikotcik ke ici mickowisiwaketcik, ki tci kaskeritakik tan nte ke ici matcatcik, kecpin kekwariw e nakickakik, arimisiwiniw. Aka minawatc neta ki tci wi motatakik kekwariw kecpin aka e mirwacinik." — Gilles Ottawa**
[](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:LL-Q56590_\(atj\)-Missatikamekw-Atisokan.wav "Lire")Durée : 2 secondes.0:02[](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:LL-Q56590_\(atj\)-Missatikamekw-Atisokan.wav)Atisokan[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/08/Notcimik_e_pipok_8.jpg/250px-Notcimik_e_pipok_8.jpg)](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:Notcimik_e_pipok_8.jpg)Awacak e atisokowakaniwitcik
Weckatc esko pe atisokaniwok kekwan. Kotc ka pe kackitatc nictam [iriniw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iriniw "Iriniw") kitci arimwetc, ekoni aspin esko ki pe tipatcimotc. Weckatc tca esko pe atisokaniwok kekwan. Nama mia kaskeritakon apitc ka matceparik **atisokan**. Takono tca kekwan ka atisokatcikateki, Kitci atisokan kirika atisokancic, keki itwaniwokipan. Kitci Atisokan e tipatcimonaniwok pimatisiwinik napitc. Atisokancica, nootc e kiskinohomakaniwok tan ke iti icinakok nikanik itekera pimatisiwinik.   

Apitc ka matceparinik ot arimwewin [Iriniw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iriniw "Iriniw"), ki petako kotakihi witci iriniwa, ki kakeskinotako ani kaki mamo witci tacikemikotc. Nac eki iti kackitatcik kaskina e arimwetcik. Wipatc tca neta ki nokoniw, irikik kaki ici tatak, kitci ki arimwetc, kitci kiskinohomaketc kekwariw kecpin e tipatcimotc kekwariw. Mocak tca ki mina aitotam aka arotcikotc kitci itetc, kitci kaie maia witak kekwariw, aka kitci wi kiraskimatc awia, aka kaie kitci matci itatc ka witci icinakosimatc. Kekwariw ka itetc, ekoni tarasak e icinakonik, nama pitoc. Arimwewin, enko tca tepirak kaki tatok kitci ki kiskinohomakaniwok kekwan kaki pe aisparik weckatc, apitc kaki pe iciwepak, tan kaki pe icinakok kekwan, kaskina neta ki iti takoniw ke ici iti tipatcimotc iriniw, ot atisokan.   

Wisaketcakw atisokan, Kokotce kekotc Witiko (Windigo) atisokan, Kinoce atisokan, Pitciw atisokan, Niketcotcinehon atisokan, Cikipic atisokan, Waskomiko iriniw atisokan, Awesis atisokan, Manito atisokan, Nictam pimatisiwin atisokan, Nipinatcac acitc Kiwetinisiw atisokan, Memekweciw atisokan, Namepirtehesiw atisokan, kirika kotakihi, mitceno.   

### Awin ka atisoketc
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ea/A_la_rencontre_de_deux_generations.jpg/250px-A_la_rencontre_de_deux_generations.jpg)](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:A_la_rencontre_de_deux_generations.jpg)Iriniw nikickowew awaca 
Kitawok iriniwok kaie iskwewok e tipatcimotcik, ki atisokewok. Ani e tacitcik, nama kata ki itwaniwon, enko anowe ka mirowacinik ka itetc, ka acterik kitci atisoketc. Iskwew, okawinan, nictam e acterik kitci petakositc, apiciciriwa onitcanica acitca kotc e aiamiatc. Patoc wiskata, wir iriniw, otawinan, acteriw kitci aiamihatc onitcanica. Ekoni e ici nicitcik, okawinan acitc otawinan, nictam ke aiamihatcik, ke kiskinohomowatcik onitcaniciwawa. Kotakihi wirata awia tca matci kata ki iti kiskinohomako anowe awacic, irikik ke iti matceatisitc. E ici tcirowetotc, e ici ot otenowesimatc awia kata ki atisokako. Atisokaniw tca ki takoniw, tan kotc e iti tato piponesitc. Enkweriw ke nosonehokotc irikik ke iti matisitc, kaki ici kiskinohomowakaniwitc, aka soka kitci waneritak nakickake arimisiwiniw pimatisiwinik itekera. Picicikw e ki pitci witak kekwariw Iriniw, ki takoniw kaie e ki itasinahak kitci ki tipatcimotc, kitci kanaweritakonik atisokanik itekera. Asiniwa ki masinawapiskowew, wikwasik ki ici masinaham kekwariw kaki wi ici tipatcimotc, kinec kitci miparinik, warowik kitci icamakanik. Matcitaw tarasak ot atisokan kecpin e pitci tipatcimotc, posoweritam meka mocak kitci miparinik. Enkweriw ka apatcitatc witci iriniwa, onitcanica acitc awaca otci ke apatcitaritci. Ekota neta ot itewinik kaki ici nahikak, otitatisiwin, omitoneritcikan, ot asperimowin acitc ot irisowin. Enko okawinan ka atisokowatc onitcanica, otawinan ka witamowatc wi ockinima. Okominan kirika Omocominan ka kiskinohomowatcik osimiwawa. Otosinan, omicomecinan acitc otcirowemakanan, ka miwitatcik kiskinohomakewiniw acitc atisokaniw. Papie e tato otenowesinaniwok, ki tawok e ki micta kackitatcik e atisoketcik. Cakotc, ekoni kaie wirowaw kaki ici coweritakositcik. Aric ma, nictam onikihikonanak acteriw kitci atisokwatcik onitcaniciwawa. Irikik ke atisokwakaniwitc awacic, kirowe kata miro matcepariniw omitoneritcikan. Ekota ke otci matceparinik ite ke ici matawe iteritak. Kata miro witcihiko mocak atisokaniw. Nama soka tapickotc aicinakono atisokana, nama nikot, kirakec tapickotc icinakoke kiskinohamakewin neta ka actek. Atita pitoc icinikatakaniwiwok neta ka atisokasotcik, mitowi «Pitciw atisokan» acitc «Ahac atisokan».   

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9f/Pygargue_manawan.jpg/250px-Pygargue_manawan.jpg)](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:Pygargue_manawan.jpg)Takon awesis atisokan
### Kekwan ka ki atisokaniwok
Kitci atisokan ka itwaniwok, irin pimatisiwinik itekera tipatcimonaniwon. Ka kicapewitcik acitc peikon ka iti matceatisitcik, ockinikiwok, atisokatakaniwiwok. Awesisa kitci kiskerimatcik, tan e itatikosiritci, e aicinikateki askik kekwan aka kitci onicinitcik notcimik, tan ke ici nanakatcitatcik e ici rowerik, ite otci rowerik. Onimiskiwa e kitoritci, atcokoca ite e itokotciniritci, pisimwa, tipiskipisimwa. Mictai mitceniw kekwariw ke atisokwakaniwitcik ockinikiwok.   
Takon kaie kotak, Atisokanicic keki icinikatekipan, ka apicicitcik aniheriw witamowakaniwiwok. Takon neta e witcikatek tan ke ici aiekwamanictak ockinikiw, kekwariw ke nikan kiskeritamotarakaniwitc, pimatisiwinik itekera. Pitoc kaie iti icinakon atisokan, ka micta apicicitc awacic otci e atisokwakaniwitcik. Weckatc meka esko pe atisokaniwok, mocak kaie ki pe miparin anihe arimwewin. Awacicak, awacak, ockinikiwok, ka kicapewitcik, nac ka kiceatisitcik e atisokwakaniwitcik.  
Irikik ke pe ici tipatcimonaniwok, tan ke iskwapekak atisokan, mocak kata apatcitaw aniheriw iskwew kaie iriniw. Kekwariw ke nakickak, ke arimiparitc opimatisiwinik, mocak kata ici mikowiw tan kaki pe ici tipatcimoctowakaniwitc, tan kaki pe it atisokwakaniwitc esko pe pimatisitc. Ekota ke otci mickowisitc, ekota ke otci sokatisitc opimatisiwinik, nama wiskat kata wi waneritam. Mocak kata kiskeritam ite ke ici naskwatc kecpin e arimiparitc. Kaskina wiec ki it atisokew Iriniw, tan kaki iciwepisitc e atosketc, e ntohotc, tan kaki icinikatak askiriw, tan e it atisokatcikatek aski kaie kaskina notcimik ka takok kekwan. Nama onikew kitci atisoketcik irikik kaki pe ici rikihotc, tato awaca kaki pe nitawkiritci, awin kaki pe nakatikotcik. Tipatcimo ke ici nanakatcitakaniwonik ke iti icikicikarik, tan e icirowerik, tan e ititakosiritci onimiskiwa, tan e ici waskorehimoritci. Nama onikew kitci atisoketc tan e icinak kekwariw ka nitawkimakanik, mictikowa, wapikoniriw. Tan e ici ntokohotc, kekwariw ka mackikiwaketc.   

### Kekwan wetci atisokaniwok
Awacic kekotc kotak awik otci, kitci miro nisahihakaniwitc opimatisiwinik, kitci miro pimatisitc, kitci sokatisitc nikanik itekera. Tarasak matceparitwakaniwoniw omitoneritcikan awacic kecpin e atisokwakaniwitc, kitci miro kakitaweritak. Tan ke ici miro nanakatcitatc kekwariw, kitci wi nespitowinak ka mirowacinik pimatisiwinik. Ot irisowinik kitci ici mackowisierimotc. Kitciwe itatisiwiniw, ke mirerimowaketc kitci mirakaniwitc. Kitci miro kiskerimitisotc tan e ici iriniwitc, acitc kaskina e ici miro mitoneritak Nehirowisiw. E atisokwakaniwitc awik, mirakaniwiw tarasak miro iterimowiniw, aiterimowiniw, kitci kaie miro kiskeritak kekwariw ka waskackakotc. Kitci miro nespitowinak, kitci kiskeritak, kitci nikani kiskeritak, irin ka icinakonik kekwariw, aka kitci wi onactatc. Kitciwe kekwariw mirakaniwiw kitci nespitowinak irikik ke pimatisitc, tan kaki pe ici matcamakanik esko pe iriniskak. Kata meka tca kiskeritam, kata nespitotam, kirika kitci ici naheritak pimatisiwiniw. Kata nespitotam kekwariw waska ka pe icinakonik, ka icinakonik, ke icinakonik nikanik.  
  

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/18/Picakitikecawan.jpg/250px-Picakitikecawan.jpg)](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:Picakitikecawan.jpg)Atisokotatinaniwon e tcipakwaniwokw mekwata
Ite kotc e ici mirerimonaniwok atisokaniwon, mitowi pecotcik ickotek, e miro otakocik, e arowactik, pitakamik rikasimonikiwamik. Irinikotc tarasak kitci miro nespitotak awik e atisokowakaniwitc. Ki waska apiwok weckatc kaki pe matisitcik e atisokotatotcik, e nipinik, e ickwa piponcitcik. Tipatcimowakopan tan ka pe icinakonik opimatisiwiniwak, tato awaca kaki nitawkiritci, awin kaki pe nakatikotcik, tan ka pe aiciwepisitcik mekwatc ka pe taciketcik otitawiniwak, ka apitc pakatewakwen, akosiwakwen, ka apitc miro atoskewakwen notcimik, mitcet ki takoniw e tipatatakik Nehirowisiw.   

### Kekwan wetci ki nokiparik aniske atisokan
Esko ki pe takok ocki kiskinohamakewin, ekoni apitc ka ki pe pitoc icinakok kiskinohamakewin. Ka wapisitc okiskinohamakewin nictam tarasak e ki miparinik. Enkweriw pitama ka wi kiskinohamowakaniwitc awacic. Aka tca pitama wirowaw ot atisokaniwaw wi witamowakaniwitcik. Ekota neta e ici iti onitik ot irisowin anotc. Mictahi tca ni e kicteritakok kitci miparik anihe Nehiro atisokan, kitci ki miro matcawaketc opimatisiwinik awacic, omitoneritcikanik. Kitci otci kotc tarasak wecipamatc anihi ka atisokatakaniwiritci. Anotc kaskina wapatahakaniwiw awacic, nama pakitinakaniwiw kitci otci nanto icinowatc anihi ka atisokatakaniwiritci. Anotc tca petawok kotakeriw kitci wapatahakaniwitcik. Osam kotakihi iriniwa ot atisokaniw e ki wapatakik.

    Ickwecic aka e sakihakopanen ockinikicica, aka kitci ntowamatc aka kaskerimatc iriniwa. 

[Memekweciw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memekweciw "Memekweciw") atisokan
    Iriniwok kaki witci tacikematcik Nehirowisiwa, atamapisk ki tacikewok, ki takoniw e ici maskisitcik kaie wirowaw (nama takoniw okotiwaw). 

[Mikisiw atisokan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikisiw_atisokan "Mikisiw atisokan")
    Iriniokw ka iti orakonatcik mikisiwa ke irapitisiritci otci iriniwa. 

[Namepirtehesiw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namepirtehesiw?action=edit&redlink=1 "Namepirtehesiw \(nama takon kekwcic\)") atisokan
    Iriniwok kaki witci tacikematcik Nehirowisiwa, notcimik ki pa tacikewok, nama orina ki otci kaseritakosiwok, e ki maskisitcik kaie wirowaw (nama ki otci takoniw taci ke otci wepinakik kaki mitcitcik). 

[Natcoskonowan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natcoskonowan?action=edit&redlink=1 "Natcoskonowan \(nama takon kekwcic\)") atisokan
    Ka nosonetatc awik kotakihi omeskanamiriw. Kitci miro aiekwaminitisonaniwok, miro meskano kitci wi mitimehin. 

Nictam pimatisiwin atisokan
    Kaki pe icinakonokwen nictam ka iti takok pimatisiwin, eki rikiparinokwen (évolution), [Nehirowisiwok](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nehirowisiw "Nehirowisiw") kaki icinamowakwen. 

Niketcotcinehon atisokan
    Awacak otci e kakwetci koctatcihakaniwitcik. 

[Nikikw atisokan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nikikw_atisokan?action=edit&redlink=1 "Nikikw atisokan \(nama takon kekwcic\)")
    Witcikatew neta kekwan wetci icinakositc [Nikikw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nikikw "Nikikw"), ka papikwerinakositc. E ki kimotc papihatc awia, ekotca ni wetci icitonetc. 

[Nipinatcac acitc Kiwetinisiw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nipinatcac_acitc_Kiwetinisiw "Nipinatcac acitc Kiwetinisiw") atisokan
    Nictam kotc ka pe icinakok, pimatisiwin kitci takok, apitc ka pe asitakok (Nipin otcatcakoc) kirika ite ke pe otci nokok pimatisiwin, Kiwetinok (Kiwetinisiw, irin matisiwin).  


[Ohomisiw atisokan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ohomisiw_atisokan "Ohomisiw atisokan")


[Otcockw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otcockw?action=edit&redlink=1 "Otcockw \(nama takon kekwcic\)") atisokan
    Ke ici miro irapatisitc awik kitci ki miro witcihihetc. [Otcockw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otcockw?action=edit&redlink=1 "Otcockw \(nama takon kekwcic\)") ki nta kimostam e iteritci iriniwa. 

[Pitciw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pitciw?action=edit&redlink=1 "Pitciw \(nama takon kekwcic\)") atisokan (Ahac atisokan)
    Awacic kitci kaskeritak kitci takonik kekwariw ke arimanik ke nakickak nikanik opimatisiwinik. 

[Waskomiko iriniw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waskomiko_iriniw?action=edit&redlink=1 "Waskomiko iriniw \(nama takon kekwcic\)") atisokan
    E kaskerimatcik awia icpimik e otciritci, pitoc e ici kackitaritci matisiwinik itekera. 

[Weckatc atisokan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wekatc_atisokan "Wekatc atisokan")


[Wisaketcakw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wisaketcakw "Wisaketcakw") atisokan
    Enko kaki oractatc kaskina kekwariw ota [askik](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aski "Aski"), e itaskamikak, [awesisik](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Awesis "Awesis") acitc [iriniwa](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iriniw "Iriniw") ke iti taritci ki kiskeritamokopan. Enko ka ki oreritak tan ke icinikasoritci [mictikwa](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mictikw "Mictikw"), notcimik ka nitawikimakanik, kirika [awesisa](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Awesis "Awesis").  
; [Gilles Ottawa](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gilles_Ottawa "Gilles Ottawa") ka ki witcihietc[Jean-Pierre Ottawa](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jean-Pierre_Ottawa "Jean-Pierre Ottawa") atisokaniciciriw e ki wawitak) 27022009.
## Opitciwan 

[Kinocew atisokan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinocew_atisokan "Kinocew atisokan")
    E aiterimitisotcik Ocicenan acitc onahakiciminan, askowi matci icinakon aka e miro paritcik e witci tacikemitotcik. 

[Noceskw](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noceskw "Noceskw")

## Bruxelles
Du 6 au 9 septembre, une délégation du projet atikamekw s'est rendue à Bruxelles en Belgique, afin de présenter Wikipetcia Atikamekw Nehiromowin à la **[WikiConvention francophone 2019](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/WikiConvention%20francophone/2019 "meta:WikiConvention francophone/2019")** et échanger avec d'autres groupes et partenaires internationaux.

Du 29 juillet au 9 août 2019, avait lieu le Projet expédition Tapiskwan sipi en canot sur le territoire Atikamekw pour les jeunes de 15 à 25 ans. Départ d'[Opitciwan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opitciwan "Opitciwan"), en passant par [Wemotaci](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wemotaci "Wemotaci") et se terminant à [Manawan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manawan "Manawan").

Le 13 août 2017, lors de la conférence internationale Wikimania 2017 à Montréal, Antony Dubé, Thérèse Ottawa, Jeannette Coocoo, Christian Coocoo, Cécile Niquay-Ottawa présentent les étapes et les leçons de la création de Wikipetia Atikamekw Nehiromowin.
[](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:Indigenous_Knowledge_on_Wikipedia-_Lessons_Learned_from_the_Project_Wikipetia_Atikamekw_Nehiromowin.webm "Lire la vidéo")Durée : 59 minutes et 34 secondes.59:34[](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natisinahikaniwoc:Indigenous_Knowledge_on_Wikipedia-_Lessons_Learned_from_the_Project_Wikipetia_Atikamekw_Nehiromowin.webm)Vidéo de la présentation sur la création de Wikipetcia Atikamekw Nehiromowin (1 heure). ## Ocki tipatcimowin
  * 31 octobre au 3 novembre 2024, WikiConférence francophone à Québec. Deux jeunes de Manawan du Cégep de Trois-Rivières participeront grâce à leur contribution de l’année scolaire de 23-24.


  * du 9 au 12 novembre 2023, a eu lieu la WikiConvention North America à Toronto. Trois jeunes du secondaire 5 ont pu participer à cette convention accompagnés de Thérèse Ottawa et Luc Patin ainsi que la délégation de Wikimédia Canada. Ils ont qualifiés de cette expérience très enrichissante pour eux.
  * 24 et 25 Janvier 2023 a eu lieu deux visionnements du film _Les six saisons atikamekw_ de Pierre Dinel et Pierre Hivon à la maison des aînés Cikowic suivi des descriptions des photos du tournage par les aînés et à l'école primaire Simon.P.Ottawa. Par la suite, le deux réalisateurs ont pu visiter la classe d'informatique et ainsi les élèves ont pu leur poser des questions. À noter que quelques 900 photos ont été numérisées et téléversées dans Wikimedia Commons, ce qui a permis de nourrir grandement les images provenant du territoire atikamekw.
  * 26 novembre 2020: Le Projet Matakan, organise un CONCOURS DE LOGO afin d’avoir un design qui représentera ce projet; reflétant sa vision et ses forces. Le concours est ouvert aux étudiants du secondaire 3 de l’école Secondaire Otapi.


Le logo sera affiché sur le site [Wikipetcia](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipetcia "Wikipetcia"), ainsi que sur des t-shirts et autres articles promotionnels, afin de s’identifier et renforcer son appartenance à ce projet. L’œuvre peut être de n’importe quel format, pas plus grand que 8,5 X 11. Le logo gagnant sera utilisé uniquement aux objets mentionnés plus haut. 3 prix seront attribués pour ce concours. 1er prix
  * 1er février au 29 mars**[Wikipetcia:Nanto masinatcikan 2018-2019](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipetcia:Nanto_masinatcikan_2018-2019 "Wikipetcia:Nanto masinatcikan 2018-2019")**. Amenez vos photos de famille afin de le numériser
  * 19 octobre 2018**[Wikipetcia:Ke nanakatisitc](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipetcia:Ke_nanakatisitc "Wikipetcia:Ke nanakatisitc")**.


  * 11 juillet 2018**wikipetcia atikamekw nehiromowin** en collaboration avec **Wikimedia Canada** a organisé une compétition photographique du 22 mai au 22 juin 2018 sous le thème **Nitaskinan en Photos 2018** , ce concours visait à enrichir la banque d’images afin d’illustrer les articles du Wikipetcia Atikamekw Nehiromowin à propos de son territoire et de sa culture. 13 participants de [Manawan](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manawan "Manawan") se sont inscrits et 103 photos ont été rajoutées dans le Wikimedia Commons. Les lauréats, au nombre de 6, ont reçu un prix, par tirage au sort, d’une carte cadeau d’une valeur de 100$ de différents magasins. Les gagnants sont[Josianerobertson](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josianerobertson?action=edit&redlink=1 "Josianerobertson \(nama takon kekwcic\)"), [Iskwew](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iskwew "Iskwew"), [Erikabegin](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erikabegin?action=edit&redlink=1 "Erikabegin \(nama takon kekwcic\)"), [Natalie Clark](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natalie_Clark?action=edit&redlink=1 "Natalie Clark \(nama takon kekwcic\)"), [gilbertfilion](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gilbertfilion?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gilbertfilion \(nama takon kekwcic\)"), [Guime99](https://atj.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guime99?action=edit&redlink=1 "Guime99 \(nama takon kekwcic\)"). Félicitations aux participants!

Trois prix de participation seront tirés au sort (cartes cadeaux d'une valeur de 100$ sur plateformes Web). Les photos seront téléversées sur Wikimedia commons/rubrique: **Nistaskinan en photos 2018**

  * 23 janvier 2017**[la demande de création d'une Wikipedia en atikamekw](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Requests%20for%20new%20languages/Wikipedia%20Atikamekw "metawiki:Requests for new languages/Wikipedia Atikamekw") a été marquée comme étant éligible** _atj.wikipedia.org_ pourra être créée lorsque les autres conditions seront satisfaites, c'est-à-dire avoir un niveau d'activité assez élevé et avoir traduit les messages les plus importants du logiciel MediaWiki.
  * 19 décembre 2016**[réouverture de la demande](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Requests%20for%20new%20languages/Wikipedia%20Atikamekw "metawiki:Requests for new languages/Wikipedia Atikamekw")** effectuée par [Nastasia](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Nastasia~metawiki "metawiki:User:Nastasia~metawiki") en 2013 auprès du [Comité des langues de la Fondation Wikimédia](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Language_committee/fr "metawiki:Language committee/fr") pour la création de la Wikipédia en Atikamekw.

Википедия сайттаҥ
|  ![Алтай мааны](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/ff/Flag_of_Altai_Republic.svg/120px-Flag_of_Altai_Republic.svg.png)Алтай мааны[Алтай](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%B9_%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BB "Алтай тил") [Википедияга](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F?action=edit&redlink=1 "Википедия \(мындый бӱк јок\)") кӱӱнзеп киригер,  
бу [јайым энциклопедияда](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%88%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%8B%D0%BC_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82?action=edit&redlink=1 "Јайым контент \(мындый бӱк јок\)") кажы ла кижи тӱзедӱ эдер аргалу. |  [јаҥар айдыҥ 9 кӱни](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%88%D0%B0%D2%A5%D0%B0%D1%80_%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%B4%D1%8B%D2%A5_9_%D0%BA%D3%B1%D0%BD%D0%B8 "Јаҥар айдыҥ 9 кӱни"), [2025 јыл](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_%D1%98%D1%8B%D0%BB?action=edit&redlink=1 "2025 јыл \(мындый бӱк јок\)"), Вторник, 16:29 [UTC](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTC?action=edit&redlink=1 "UTC \(мындый бӱк јок\)")  
Эмди Википедияда алтай тилле **[1102 бӱк](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%A5%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%83:%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Аҥылу:Статистика")**.  
[Мобильный версиязы](http://alt.m.wikipedia.org)**·** [Кешин арчырга](https://alt.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%A2%D3%A7%D1%81_%D0%B1%D3%B1%D0%BA&action=purge)  
---|---  
[Бастыра бӱктер](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%A5%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%83:%D0%92%D1%81%D0%B5_%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%86%D1%8B "Аҥылу:Все страницы")**·** [Бастыра категориялар](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%A5%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%83:%D0%A3%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%87%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%83_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F?namespace=14)**·** [Бастыра ӱлекерлер](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%A5%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%83:%D0%A3%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%87%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%83_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F?namespace=10)**·**  
  
|  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fd/HSutvald2.svg/40px-HSutvald2.svg.png) Талдама бичимел [![Ай \(22.10.2010\)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e1/FullMoon2010.jpg/250px-FullMoon2010.jpg)](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:FullMoon2010.jpg "Ай \(22.10.2010\)")Ай (22.10.2010) **[Ай](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B9_\(%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%83%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA\) "Ай \(спутник\)")** — [Јердиҥ](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%88%D0%B5%D1%80?action=edit&redlink=1 "Јер \(мындый бӱк јок\)") спутниги. Ол јерди айландыра эбирет. [Кӱнге](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D3%B1%D0%BD?action=edit&redlink=1 "Кӱн \(мындый бӱк јок\)") эҥ ле јуук спутник, [Меркурий](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B9?action=edit&redlink=1 "Меркурий \(мындый бӱк јок\)") ле [Венерада](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0?action=edit&redlink=1 "Венера \(мындый бӱк јок\)") спутник јок. Јаркындузыла экинчи јерде. Ай бойыныҥ кемиле Кӱнниҥ системазында бежинчи јерде турат, Јер ле Айдыҥ ӧзӧгиниҥ ортозы — 384 467 (0,00257[а.е.](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B0?action=edit&redlink=1 "Астрономическая единица \(мындый бӱк јок\)"), Јердиҥ ~30 диаметри). Јердиҥ теҥеризинде Айдыҥ кӧрӱнип турар кеми — −12,71m. Айдыҥ _јарыгы_ айаста — 0,25 — 1 [лк](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D1%8E%D0%BA%D1%81?action=edit&redlink=1 "Люкс \(мындый бӱк јок\)"). Ай Јер планетаныҥ јаҥыс спутниги. Кӱнге эҥ ле јуук спутник, не дезе Кӱнге јуук Меркурий ле Венера деген планеталарда спутник јок. Ай јаркыныла экинчи јерде турат, нениҥ учун дезе ол јерге јуук. Јердиҥ јуугында Айдыҥ јылдыстык кеми 12,71m. Ай 4,51 млрд јыл кайра бӱткен. Је мындый гипотеза база бар: «Јер ле Тейя деп планета (кеми кайда да [Марс](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%81?action=edit&redlink=1 "Марс \(мындый бӱк јок\)") кире) сӱзӱжип, табарышканынаҥ улам оодыгынаҥ Ай бӱткен». Ай — кижи барып јӱрген јаҥыс _астроном объект_ болуп јат. [Алтай](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%B9_%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8B%D0%BA "Алтай калык") улуста айла колбулу кӧп куучындар, соојындар, чӧрчӧктӧр бар. _([тӱзедер…](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B9_\(%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%83%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA\) "Ай \(спутник\)"))_ [Талдама бичимелдер (**2**)](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F:%D0%A2%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B0_%D0%B1%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B4%D0%B5%D1%80 "Википедия:Талдама бичимелдер") | [Тӱзедер](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D3%B0%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B5%D1%80:%D0%A2%D3%A7%D1%81_%D0%B1%D3%B1%D0%BA/featured_article "Ӱлекер:Тӧс бӱк/featured article") ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/ce/HS_Korganizer.svg/40px-HS_Korganizer.svg.png) Болуш **Алтай Википедияга кӱӱнзеп келигер!** Камаанар јетиргенеерге быйан. [Алтай тилди](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%B9_%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BB "Алтай тил") јазап билбес те болзоор, јалтанбагар. Болуш керек болзо, [Форумга](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F:%D0%9A%D1%83%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BB%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%B9 "Википедия:Курултай") эмезе [администраторлорго](https://alt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D2%A5%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%83:%D0%A1%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BA_%D1%83%D1%87%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2/sysop "Аҥылу:Список участников/sysop") баштангар. Олор аргазы јеткенче болужар. Кӱӱнзеп келигер. Алтай тилди јакшы билер туружаачылар канча кире кӧп чыҥдыйы бийик статьялар бичиген болзо, талдама болор!

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/97/Bluebg.png) [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c5/Cscr-featured_with_ring.svg/40px-Cscr-featured_with_ring.svg.png)](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Voorbladartikel "Wikipedia:Voorbladartikel") **Voorbladartikel** **[Daniel Sleigh](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dan_Sleigh "Dan Sleigh")** (1938–2023) was 'n geskiedkundige en [Afrikaanse skrywer](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lys_van_Afrikaanse_skrywers "Lys van Afrikaanse skrywers") van [gedigte](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gedig "Gedig"), jeugverhale, [romans](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman "Roman") en historiese werke. Met sy skryfwerk het hy benewens ander toekennings ook die [W.A. Hofmeyr-prys](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/W.A._Hofmeyr-prys "W.A. Hofmeyr-prys"), die Universiteit van Johannesburg-prys, die M-Net-prys, die [Helgaard Steyn-prys](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helgaard_Steyn-prys "Helgaard Steyn-prys"), die Suid-Afrikaanse Letterkundetoekennings se K. Sello Duiker-prys en die [ATKV-Prosaprys](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/ATKV-Prosaprys "ATKV-Prosaprys") verower. Hy het ook verskeie romankompetisies gewen. Sleigh se _Eilande_ , in Engelse vertaling (_Islands_), word gelys as een van die "1001 Boeke om te Lees Voordat Jy Sterf." Dan het vele pryse vir sy skryfwerk ontvang, onder andere die C. Louis Leipoldt-prys van die departement van nasionale opvoeding, vir sy digbundel _Duif oor die Water_ , die 2de prys in Van der Walt se wedstryd vir oorspronklike jeugverhale vir _Anselm en die jut_. Sy roman, _Eilande_ wat in 2002 verskyn, wen die Sanlam/Insig/Kwêla Groot Romanwedstryd, [W.A. Hofmeyr-prys](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/W.A._Hofmeyr-prys "W.A. Hofmeyr-prys"), RAU-prys vir Skeppende Skryfwerk, M-Net-Prys vir Skeppende Werk in Afrikaans en die [Helgaard Steyn-toekenning](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helgaard_Steyn-toekenning "Helgaard Steyn-toekenning"). Hy wen die [ATKV-Prosaprys](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/ATKV-Prosaprys "ATKV-Prosaprys") in 2012 vir _Wals met Matilda_. Eilande is in [Engels](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engels "Engels") (deur [André P. Brink](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9_P._Brink "André P. Brink")) en [Nederlands](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nederlands "Nederlands") (deur Riet de Jong-Goosssens) vertaal  In 1998 ontvang hy ’n goue ere-penning van die Stigting Simon van der Stel en in 2002 ’n Molteno-goue medalje van die Kaap 300-Stigting vir uitnemendheid en lewenslange prestasie in die literêre, visuele en uitvoerende kunste. Die [Suid-Afrikaanse Akademie vir Wetenskap en Kuns](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suid-Afrikaanse_Akademie_vir_Wetenskap_en_Kuns "Suid-Afrikaanse Akademie vir Wetenskap en Kuns") ken in 2007 ’n erepenning aan hom toe vir sy bevordering van Geskiedenis. In 2011 word hy spesiaal vermeld by die Woordkunstenaar van die vorige jaar toekenning by die Stellenbosse Woordfees en in dieselfde jaar word hy deur die Wes-Kaapse regering gehuldig met ’n Spesiale Prys van die Departement van Kultuursake en Sport. Op 30 April 2012 word hy in ’n plegtigheid wat in die [Kasteel](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasteel_die_Goeie_Hoop "Kasteel die Goeie Hoop") in Kaapstad plaasvind met die koninklike Nederlandse onderskeiding Ridder in die Orde van Oranje-Nassau vereer. Hierdie orde word deur David de Waal, die konsul-generaal van Nederland, aan hom oorhandig. In 2014 word hy weer by die Stellenbosch Woordfees gehuldig wanneer ’n profielaanbieding oor hom deel van die program is.      _[...lees verder](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dan_Sleigh "Dan Sleigh")_ ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/97/Bluebg.png) [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6d/HSAktuell.svg/40px-HSAktuell.svg.png)](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sjabloon:Aktueel "Sjabloon:Aktueel") **In die nuus** [![Lando Norris in 2025](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/70/2024-08-25_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_4016_by_Stepro_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-2024-08-25_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_4016_by_Stepro_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C3%AAer:2024-08-25_Motorsport,_Formel_1,_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_4016_by_Stepro_\(cropped\).jpg "Lando Norris in 2025")Lando Norris in 2025
  * Tydens die [2025 Formule Een-seisoen](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Formule_Een-seisoen "2025 Formule Een-seisoen") wen **[Lando Norris](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lando_Norris "Lando Norris")** sy eerste [Formule Een](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formule_Een "Formule Een")-wêreldbestuurderskampioenskapstitel, terwyl sy [McLaren](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren "McLaren")-span reeds in Oktober by die [Singapoerse Grand Prix](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Singapoerse_Grand_Prix "2025 Singapoerse Grand Prix") as die wêreldvervaardigerskampioen vir 2025 gekroon is.
  * Binne enkele dae is die groepsloting vir drie vername, toekomstige sporttoernooie gehou: die [T20I-wêreldbeker 2026](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/T20I-w%C3%AAreldbeker_2026 "T20I-wêreldbeker 2026") in [Indië](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indi%C3%AB "Indië") en [Sri Lanka](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sri_Lanka "Sri Lanka"), die [FIFA Sokker-Wêreldbekertoernooi in 2026](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIFA_Sokker-W%C3%AAreldbekertoernooi_in_2026 "FIFA Sokker-Wêreldbekertoernooi in 2026") in [Kanada](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanada "Kanada"), [Meksiko](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meksiko "Meksiko") en [Amerika](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/VSA "VSA"), asook die [Rugbywêreldbeker 2027](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rugbyw%C3%AAreldbeker_2027 "Rugbywêreldbeker 2027") wat in [Australië](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australi%C3%AB "Australië") sal plaasvind.
  * Ná die afsluiting van die [30ste G20-spitsberaad](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/G20-spitsberaad_in_Johannesburg_2025 "G20-spitsberaad in Johannesburg 2025") in [Johannesburg](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johannesburg "Johannesburg") het [Suid-Afrika](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suid-Afrika "Suid-Afrika") sy G20-voorsitterskap aan die [Verenigde State](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verenigde_State_van_Amerika "Verenigde State van Amerika") oorhandig.
  * Die voormalige [Bangladesjiese](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangladesj "Bangladesj") eerste minister [Sjeikh Hasina](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sjeikh_Hasina "Sjeikh Hasina"), wie haar in ballingskap in [Indië](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indi%C3%AB "Indië") bevind, is weens haar onderdrukking van die 2024-proteste in afwesigheid skuldig bevind aan [misdade teen die mensdom](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Misdade_teen_die_Mensdom "Misdade teen die Mensdom") en die [doodstraf](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doodstraf "Doodstraf") opgelê.
  * In die eindstryd van die [13de Vrouekrieketwêreldbekertoernooi](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vrouekrieketw%C3%AAreldbeker_2025 "Vrouekrieketwêreldbeker 2025") op die DY Patil-stadion in [Navi Mumbai](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navi_Mumbai "Navi Mumbai") verslaan die medegasheer [Indië](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiese_nasionale_vrouekrieketspan "Indiese nasionale vrouekrieketspan") [Suid-Afrika](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suid-Afrikaanse_nasionale_vrouekrieketspan "Suid-Afrikaanse nasionale vrouekrieketspan") met 52 lopies en palm sodoende sy eerste [vrouekrieketwêreldbekertitel](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vrouekrieketw%C3%AAreldbeker "Vrouekrieketwêreldbeker") in. Die verdedigende kampioen [Australië](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australiese_nasionale_vrouekrieketspan "Australiese nasionale vrouekrieketspan") en [Engeland](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engelse_nasionale_vrouekrieketspan "Engelse nasionale vrouekrieketspan") was die ander twee semi-finaliste.

**Voortdurend:** [Russiese inval in Oekraïne sedert 2022](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russiese_inval_in_Oekra%C3%AFne_sedert_2022 "Russiese inval in Oekraïne sedert 2022") • [Israel-Hamas-oorlog](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel-Hamas-oorlog "Israel-Hamas-oorlog") • [Soedanese burgeroorlog](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soedanese_burgeroorlog_\(2023-hede\) "Soedanese burgeroorlog \(2023-hede\)")  
**[Onlangs oorlede](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kategorie:Sterftes_in_2025 "Kategorie:Sterftes in 2025"):** [Adriaan Snyman](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adriaan_Snyman "Adriaan Snyman") • [Tom Stoppard](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Stoppard "Tom Stoppard") • [Evelyn Dalberg](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evelyn_Dalberg "Evelyn Dalberg") • [Pops Mohamed](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pops_Mohamed "Pops Mohamed") • [Frank Gehry](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Gehry "Frank Gehry") ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/97/Bluebg.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a9/HSVissteduatt.svg/40px-HSVissteduatt.svg.png) **Het u geweet...** ... dat [varke](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vark "Vark") uiters intelligente diere is? Hulle is ook skoner as die meeste troeteldiere en lê slegs in modder omdat hulle nie sweetkliere het nie en modder of water nodig het om af te koel.  
  
... dat sedert die toetrede van [Finland](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finland "Finland") en [Swede](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swede "Swede") tot [NAVO](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/NAVO "NAVO") in onderskeidelik 2023 en 2024 al die [Skandinawiese](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skandinawi%C3%AB "Skandinawië") lande weer lede van een (en dieselfde) militêre alliansie is? Dit was laas die geval tydens die [Kalmarunie](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalmarunie "Kalmarunie") wat in 1523 ontbind is.  
  
... dat die Normandiese dialek [Jèrriais](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais "Jèrriais") nog steeds op die [Kanaaleiland](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanaaleilande "Kanaaleilande") [Jersey](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jersey "Jersey") as omgangstaal gepraat word, alhoewel die eiland reeds sedert [1066](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/1066 "1066") onder die Britse Kroon val? [Jersey](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jersey "Jersey") vorm egter nie deel van die [Verenigde Koninkryk](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verenigde_Koninkryk "Verenigde Koninkryk") of die [Europese Unie](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europese_Unie "Europese Unie") nie.  
  
... dat die [chemiese element](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chemiese_element "Chemiese element") en radioaktiewe edelgas [radon](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radon "Radon"), wat natuurlik uit die grond vrygestel word, beskou word as die belangrikste oorsaak van longkanker naas sigaretrook? Jaarliks sterf meer as 40 000 mense wêreldwyd aan longkanker wat deur radon veroorsaak is.  
  
... dat die [Groot](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Groot_Magellaanse_Wolk "Groot Magellaanse Wolk") en die [Klein Magellaanse Wolk](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klein_Magellaanse_Wolk "Klein Magellaanse Wolk") na [Ferdinand Magellaan](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferdinand_Magellaan "Ferdinand Magellaan") vernoem is, maar dat [Al Soefi](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al_Soefi "Al Soefi") dit reeds meer as 500 jaar voor hom opgeteken het? Hy verwys daarna in sy "Boek van sterre" wat uit [964](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/964 "964") dateer.  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/97/Bluebg.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/39/HSDagensdatum.svg/40px-HSDagensdatum.svg.png) **Vandag in die geskiedenis** **[9 Desember](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_Desember "9 Desember")** :  [![Paul Kruger](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/95/Paul_Kruger.jpg/250px-Paul_Kruger.jpg)](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C3%AAer:Paul_Kruger.jpg "Paul Kruger")Paul Kruger
  * [1897](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/1897 "1897") – [Marguerite Durand](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marguerite_Durand "Marguerite Durand"), [Franse](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankryk "Frankryk") verhoogaktriese, [joernalis](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joernalis "Joernalis"), en bekende suffragette, stig die [feminitiese](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feminisme "Feminisme") [dagblad](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koerant "Koerant") _[La Fronde](https://af.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=La_Fronde&action=edit&redlink=1 "La Fronde \(bladsy bestaan nie\)")_.
  * [1900](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/1900 "1900") – [Tweede Vryheidsoorlog](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tweede_Vryheidsoorlog "Tweede Vryheidsoorlog"): Die [Russiese](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rusland "Rusland") [tsaar](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsaar "Tsaar") [Nikolaas II](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nikolaas_II_van_Rusland "Nikolaas II van Rusland") verwerp **[Paul Kruger](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Kruger "Paul Kruger")** se pleidooi om amptelike hulp teen die [Britse](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verenigde_Koninkryk "Verenigde Koninkryk") weermag, alhoewel baie Russiese vrywillgers aan die [Boere](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boere "Boere") se kant veg.
  * [1950](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/1950 "1950") – Gebore: Die [Suid-Afrikaanse](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suid-Afrika "Suid-Afrika") [bokskampioen](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boks "Boks") [Mike Schutte](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_Schutte "Mike Schutte").
  * [1958](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/1958 "1958") – Die [John Birch Society](https://af.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=John_Birch_Society&action=edit&redlink=1 "John Birch Society \(bladsy bestaan nie\)") word gestig om die oënskynlike bedreiging van [kommunisme](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kommunisme "Kommunisme") in die [Verenigde State van Amerika](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verenigde_State_van_Amerika "Verenigde State van Amerika") te bekamp.
  * [1961](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/1961 "1961") – [Tanganjika](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanganjika "Tanganjika") word van die [Verenigde Koninkryk](https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verenigde_Koninkryk "Verenigde Koninkryk") onafhanklik.

#  **Bienveniu a [Biquipedia](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biquipedia "Biquipedia")**
**A enciclopedia libre en[aragonés](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idioma_aragon%C3%A9s "Idioma aragonés").** |  Somos treballando en [**50 798**](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Especial:Estatisticas "Especial:Estatisticas") articlos en [aragonés](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idioma_aragon%C3%A9s "Idioma aragonés"):  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ed/Pix.gif)](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imachen:Pix.gif)  
[Como rechistrar-se](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aduya:Como_rechistrar-se "Aduya:Como rechistrar-se") · [FAQ](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aduya:FAQ "Aduya:FAQ") · [Citar Wikipedia](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Especial:Citar "Especial:Citar") · [Aviso legal](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Alvertencias_chenerals "Wikipedia:Alvertencias chenerals")   
[Pachina de Prebatinas](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pachina_de_Prebatinas "Wikipedia:Pachina de Prebatinas") · [A Tabierna](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Tabierna "Wikipedia:Tabierna") · [Portals](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Portalada "Portal:Portalada") · [Donacions](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Donate "foundation:Donate")   
[Facebook oficial](http://www.facebook.com/Biquipedia) · [Twitter oficial](http://twitter.com/#!/Biquipedia) |  |

[![Variedaz dialectals](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a7/Emblem-fun.svg/40px-Emblem-fun.svg.png)](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imachen:Emblem-fun.svg "Variedaz dialectals") |  [editar](https://an.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Plantilla:Portalada/Variedaz&action=edit)**Bienvenida y[variedaz dialectals](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Variedaz_dialectals "Wikipedia:Variedaz dialectals")**  
Si charras [aragonés](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idioma_aragon%C3%A9s "Idioma aragonés") y te faría goyo de tener una Enciclopedia libre en a tuya luenga, alavez tu puez aduyar a fer-la.  
Pa trobar mas información, ves ta la pachina d'[Aduya](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Aduya "Wikipedia:Aduya") u deixa un mensache en [a Tabierna](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Tabierna "Wikipedia:Tabierna").  Tamién puez veyer a portalada y colaborar con Biquipedia escribindo en a tuya variedat dialectal: [ansotano](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Ansotano "Portalada/Ansotano") · [belsetán](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Belset%C3%A1n "Portalada/Belsetán") · [benasqués](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Benasqu%C3%A9s "Portalada/Benasqués") · [cheso](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Cheso "Portalada/Cheso") · [chistabín](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Chistab%C3%ADn "Portalada/Chistabín")   
[fovano](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Fobano "Portalada/Fobano") · [ribagorzano](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Ribagorzano "Portalada/Ribagorzano") · [sobrarbés](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Sobrarb%C3%A9s "Portalada/Sobrarbés") · [tensino](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portalada/Tensino "Portalada/Tensino") Pa mas información, se veiga **[Variedaz dialectals](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Variedatz_dialectals "Wikipedia:Variedatz dialectals")**

[![Comunidat](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0f/Nuvola_apps_kuser.png/40px-Nuvola_apps_kuser.png)](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imachen:Nuvola_apps_kuser.png "Comunidat") |  [editar](https://an.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Plantilla:Portalada/Comunidat&action=edit)**[Comunidat](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Comunidat "Wikipedia:Comunidat")**  
  * _**[Not Aragonese? an-0? - Click here](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Embaixada "Wikipedia:Embaixada")**_.
  * Si tiens mas dandalos sobre cuestions lingüisticas, puez preguntar-los en **[uso d'a luenga](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Uso_d'a_luenga "Wikipedia:Uso d'a luenga").**
  * Tamién puez veyer as convencions consensuadas por os miembros d'a comunidat en **[ortografía consensuada](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Ortograf%C3%ADa_consensuada "Wikipedia:Ortografía consensuada")**.
  * Os [correctors](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Colla_de_correutors "Wikipedia:Colla de correutors") aduyan a que toz os articlos sían correctos.
  * Pasa-te tamién por o portal d'a [comunidat](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Comunidat "Wikipedia:Comunidat") y a [tabierna](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Tabierna "Wikipedia:Tabierna") ta comentar cosas con a resta d'a comunidat.
  * **No sabes por a on prencipiar?** ves ta a **[lista d'articlos que toda Wikipedia habría de tener](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Lista_d'articlos_que_toda_Wikipedia_habr%C3%ADa_de_tener "Wikipedia:Lista d'articlos que toda Wikipedia habría de tener")** y prencipia a editar os articlos que veigas en royo, u bien enampla os que que veigas que pueden estar amilloraus. Si quiers saber-ne mas, puez vesitar a pachina d'[aduya](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Aduya "Wikipedia:Aduya").
  * Vesita os **[Portals](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Portalada "Portal:Portalada")** tematicos.
  * Si quiers aprender o funcionamiento d'a wikipedia, puez fer prebatinas en a **[pachina de prebatinas](https://an.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pachina_de_Prebatinas "Wikipedia:Pachina de Prebatinas")**.
  * [Aquí](https://stats.wikimedia.org/#/an.wikipedia.org) puez veyer as estatisticas actualizadas de Biquipedia.
  * **Acceso WAP** : [Wapedia.mobi en aragonés](http://wapedia.mobi/an/Portalada).
