## Aram daw nindo...  
---  
_Gikan sa[mga pinakabàgong artikulo](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Espesyal:RecentChanges "Espesyal:RecentChanges") kan Wikipedia_:
  * ... na an inot na Filipino na nakakua nin Bulawan na Medalya sa Olimpiko iyo si **[Hidilyn Diaz](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hidilyn_Diaz "Hidilyn Diaz")**?
  * ... na pigtutubudan na piggamit bilang sarong pangkalkula kan mga simpleng operasyon sa matematika an **[Tulang nin Ishango](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulang_nin_Ishango "Tulang nin Ishango")**?

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/58/Hiroshima_Dome_1945.gif/120px-Hiroshima_Dome_1945.gif)](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ladawan:Hiroshima_Dome_1945.gif)
  * ...na sa **[Alpabetong kan Hapon](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tataramon_na_Hapones "Tataramon na Hapones")** , **[dakuten](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dakuten "Dakuten")** an apod sa markang **(** na mahihiling sa ibabaw, arog kan び, samantalang **[handakuten](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Handakuten "Handakuten")** an apod sa markang **(** na mahihiling sa ibabaw, arog kan ぴ?
  * ...na an **[Product Exhibition Hall](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hiroshima_Peace_Memorial "Hiroshima Peace Memorial")** kan Hiroshima na pigdisenyo ni **[Jan Letzel](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jan_Letzel "Jan Letzel")** (yaon sa ladawan), an solo-solong establishimentong nakatindog pagkatapos kan pagsabog kan bombang atomiko sa Hiroshima na haraní sa Hypocenter o pinagsabugan kaini?
  * ... na inot na ginibo an **[Better Living Through Xeroxography](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Better_Living_Through_Xeroxography_Naga "Better Living Through Xeroxography Naga")** sa [syudad nin Naga](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syudad_nin_Naga "Syudad nin Naga") _kan Hulyo 30, 2016?_
  * ... na gikan sa antigong kawat na **[pirilawan](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pirilawan "Pirilawan")** an terminong "napilawan"?
  * ... na ipapasali sa Cultural Center of the Philippines para sa Virgin Labfest 2016 an isinurat na dula ni **[Maki de la Rosa](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maki_de_la_Rosa "Maki de la Rosa")**?
  * ...na an **[Taumatawhakatangihangakoauauotamatea  
turipukakapikimaungahoronukupokaiwhenuakitanatahu](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taumatawhakatangihangakoauauotamateaturipukakapikimaungahoronukupokaiwhenuakitanatahu "Taumatawhakatangihangakoauauotamateaturipukakapikimaungahoronukupokaiwhenuakitanatahu")**, an pinakahalabang pangaran kan lugar sa [New Zealand](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Zealand "New Zealand") na ipinangaran sa saróng burol?
  * ... na **[lukot](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lukot "Lukot")** iyo an apod sa alimbubuyog na dai nin pantudok?
  * ... na Leila Norma Eulalia Josefa Magistrado de Lima an bilog na ngaran ni **[Senadora](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senado_kan_Filipinas "Senado kan Filipinas") [Leila de Lima](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leila_de_Lima "Leila de Lima")**?
  * ... na an paradalagan gikan [Sur na Aprika](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sur_na_Aprika "Sur na Aprika") na si **[Oscar Pistorius](https://bcl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscar_Pistorius "Oscar Pistorius")** putol an duwang tabay?

**[Уикипедия](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F "Уикипедия")** е [свободна](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%BE_%D1%81%D1%8A%D0%B4%D1%8A%D1%80%D0%B6%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5 "Свободно съдържание") енциклопедия, която всеки може да редактира, развива и обогатява. Ако не знаете откъде да започнете, препоръчваме ви да прочетете **[помощната страница](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F:%D0%9F%D1%8A%D1%80%D0%B2%D0%B8_%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8A%D0%BF%D0%BA%D0%B8 "Уикипедия:Първи стъпки")**.  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/37/Papapishu-Wizard-in-blue-hat.svg/20px-Papapishu-Wizard-in-blue-hat.svg.png)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Papapishu-Wizard-in-blue-hat.svg) Ако не сте сигурни как да започнете нова статия – опитайте помощта на нашия [Вълшебник](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F:%D0%92%D1%8A%D0%BB%D1%88%D0%B5%D0%B1%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA "Уикипедия:Вълшебник")! **„[Джонас Брадърс](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%81_%D0%91%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B4%D1%8A%D1%80%D1%81 "Джонас Брадърс")“** е [американска](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%90%D0%A9 "САЩ") момчешка [поп](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BF "Поп") [група](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D1%83%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B3%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BF%D0%B0 "Музикална група"). Оригиналният състав на групата включва тримата братя [Кевин](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%BD_%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%81 "Кевин Джонас"), [Джо](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE_%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%81 "Джо Джонас") и [Ник Джонас](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BA_%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%81 "Ник Джонас"). Те са от [Ню Джързи](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D1%8E_%D0%94%D0%B6%D1%8A%D1%80%D0%B7%D0%B8 "Ню Джързи") и стават популярни чрез детския канал [Дисни](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disney_Channel "Disney Channel"). През лятото на 2008 участват в оригиналния филм на Дисни – „[Кемп Рок](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BF_%D0%A0%D0%BE%D0%BA "Кемп Рок")“, а през 2010 и в продължението му „[Кемп Рок 2: Последният концерт](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BF_%D0%A0%D0%BE%D0%BA_2:_%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F%D1%82_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82 "Кемп Рок 2: Последният концерт")“. Това е една от най-популярните тийнейджърски групи за първото десетилетие на 21. век.  Групата има издадени четири албума: _[It's About Time](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/It%27s_About_Time "It's About Time")_ , _[Jonas Brothers](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonas_Brothers_\(%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B1%D1%83%D0%BC\) "Jonas Brothers \(албум\)")_ , _[A Little Bit Longer](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Little_Bit_Longer "A Little Bit Longer")_ и _[Lines, Vines and Trying Times](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lines,_Vines_and_Trying_Times "Lines, Vines and Trying Times")_. През 2008 г., на 51-вите награди „[Грами](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B8 "Грами")“, е номинирана за „Най-добър млад изпълнител“, а на „Американските музикални награди“ групата печели наградата за „Дебютиращ изпълнител“. През 2009 г. братята са избрани категорично и единодушно за най-лоши актьори на 2009 г. във филма концерт „[Джонас Брадърс: 3D концертът](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%81_%D0%91%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B4%D1%8A%D1%80%D1%81:_3D_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8A%D1%82 "Джонас Брадърс: 3D концертът")“ на наградите „[Златна малинка](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%97%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Златна малинка")“ (контрапункт на наградите „[Оскар](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B8_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D1%84%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%A1%D0%90%D0%A9 "Награди на филмовата академия на САЩ")“), обявен и за един от най-лошите филми на годината.  След като през 2010 и 2011 г. груповите проекти са в застой за сметка на личните им странични дейности, братята се събират за създаването на нов, пети студиен албум през 2012 г. На [29 октомври](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/29_%D0%BE%D0%BA%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B2%D1%80%D0%B8 "29 октомври") 2013 г. той е отменен, когато групата обявява окончателното си разделяне.  „Джонас Брадърс“ води началото си от поредица самостоятелни участия в представления на Бродуей на Ник Джонас, когато той е седемгодишен. Играе в няколко пиеси, включително „[Коледна песен](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BD_\(%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0\) "Коледна песен \(новела\)")“ (през [2000](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/2000 "2000") г. като Тим и малкия Скрудж), „[Красавицата и звярът](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%B8_%D0%B7%D0%B2%D1%8F%D1%80%D1%8A%D1%82 "Красавицата и звярът")“ (през [2002](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/2002 "2002") г. като Чип) и „[Клетниците](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5 "Клетниците")“ (през [2003](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/2003 "2003") г. като Гаврош), а по-късно участва и в „Звукът на музиката“ (като Кърт) в театър „Пейпър Мил“. _[Вижте още »](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%81_%D0%91%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B4%D1%8A%D1%80%D1%81 "Джонас Брадърс")_ [Още избрани статии](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BB:%D0%98%D0%B7%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B8 "Портал:Избрани статии") [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/67/Sanae_Takaichi_October_2025_%283x4_cropped%29.jpg/250px-Sanae_Takaichi_October_2025_%283x4_cropped%29.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%B5_%D0%A2%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B8 "Санае Такаичи")
  * … коя е **[първата жена министър-председател на Япония](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%B5_%D0%A2%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B8 "Санае Такаичи")** , която се определя като ултраконсервативна политичка?
  * … кой е **[фаворитът](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%81_%D0%94%D1%8E%D0%B8 "Томас Дюи")** за [президентския пост](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%A1%D0%90%D0%A9 "Президент на САЩ") през 1948 г. в [САЩ](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%90%D0%A9 "САЩ") срещу когото [Труман](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD "Труман") води яростна кампания и успява да нанесе едно от най-неочакваните поражения и така печели свой собствен мандат?
  * … кой [маврициански](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%B2%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%B9 "Мавриций") [неоиндуистки](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%B8%D0%B7%D1%8A%D0%BC "Индуизъм") **[гуру](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%B0%D0%BC%D1%81%D0%B0_%D0%92%D0%B8%D1%88%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B0 "Парамахамса Вишвананда")** съчетава компоненти на [индуистките традиции](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Индуизма") с влияния на други религии, особено на [православното християнство](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE_%D1%85%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%8F%D0%BD%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%BE "Православното християнство")?
  * … че **[най-гледаният филм в историята на Латвия](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BF_\(%D1%84%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BC,_2024\) "Потоп \(филм, 2024\)")** е анимация?
  * … кога танк **[блъска група хора](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%94%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BF%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B2%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B9%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%84%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7_1950_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Инцидент на Деветосептемврийската манифестация през 1950 година")** на [Жълтите павета](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%96%D1%8A%D0%BB%D1%82%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%B0 "Жълти павета") в София?
  * … как съветски войник допринася за **[един от най-големите пожари](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%B6%D0%B0%D1%80_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%89%D0%B5_%E2%80%9E%D0%91%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%81%E2%80%9C "Пожар на Пристанище „Бургас“")** в България?
  * … кога настъпва **[прегряване на икономиката](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B3%D1%80%D1%8F%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B5_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0 "Прегряване на икономиката")**?
  * … колко [часа](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B0%D1%81 "Час") [годишно](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Година") е [**слънчевото греене**](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BB%D1%8A%D0%BD%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%BE_%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5_%D0%B2_%D0%91%D1%8A%D0%BB%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F "Слънчево греене в България") в [България](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%8A%D0%BB%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F "България")?

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/74/20140615_Sofia_047.jpg/120px-20140615_Sofia_047.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82_%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%B8%D1%82_%D0%BA%D1%8A%D0%BC_%D0%B6%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%B8%D0%BC "Ден на признателност и почит към жертвите на комунистическия режим")
  * … кога в България официално **[се отдава почит](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82_%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%B8%D1%82_%D0%BA%D1%8A%D0%BC_%D0%B6%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%B8%D0%BC "Ден на признателност и почит към жертвите на комунистическия режим")** на жертвите на [комунистическия режим](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%91%D1%8A%D0%BB%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F "Народна република България")?
  * … кое **[предприятие в Стара Загора](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B7%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2_%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B4_%E2%80%93_%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0_%D0%97%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0 "Азотноторов завод – Стара Загора")** е сред десетте най-големи в света от този вид при откриването си през 1963 година?
  * … кой е [**най-старият все още съществуващ международен спортен турнир в света**](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%83%D0%BF%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%90%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Купа на Америка"), който държи рекорда и за най-дълга победна серия във всеки спорт?

  
[Архив](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F:%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BF%D1%8A%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F#%D0%90%D1%80%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%B2 "Уикипедия:Последни попълнения")   
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/28/%D0%A1%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%D1%82-%D0%9F%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B1%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3%2C_%D0%A7%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_46%2C_%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B5%D1%84.jpg/500px-%D0%A1%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%D1%82-%D0%9F%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B1%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3%2C_%D0%A7%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_46%2C_%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B5%D1%84.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:%D0%A1%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%D1%82-%D0%9F%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B1%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3,_%D0%A7%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_46,_%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B5%D1%84.jpg)  
Барелеф, символизиращ единството на [хуманитарните](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A5%D1%83%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B8_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%83%D0%BA%D0%B8 "Хуманитарни науки") и [техническите науки](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D0%B6%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%83%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Инженерна наука"), в Санкт Петербург, Русия [Проблем с картинката?](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD:%D0%9A%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8F_%D0%B2_%D0%9E%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F#%D0%92%D1%8A%D0%B7%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B6%D0%BD%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B8 "Шаблон:Картинка на деня в Общомедия") [Още избрани картинки](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:Featured_pictures "commons:Commons:Featured pictures") [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ef/Afonso_de_Albuquerque.jpg/120px-Afonso_de_Albuquerque.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Afonso_de_Albuquerque.jpg)
  * [1510](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1510 "1510") г. – [Португалско завладяване на Гоa](https://bg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82%D1%83%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE_%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B4%D1%8F%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B5_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%93%D0%BEa&action=edit&redlink=1 "Португалско завладяване на Гоa \(страницата не съществува\)"): [португалски](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82%D1%83%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%8F "Португалия") военноморски сили под командването на адмирал **[Алфонсу де Албукерке](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%84%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%81%D1%83_%D0%B4%D0%B5_%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B1%D1%83%D0%BA%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BA%D0%B5 "Алфонсу де Албукерке")** , Португалският [Марс](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%81 "Марс") (_на картината_) и местни наемници превземат [Гоа](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%BE%D0%B0 "Гоа"), [Индия](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F "Индия") от [Биджапурския султанат](https://bg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%91%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B6%D0%B0%D0%BF%D1%83%D1%80%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D1%81%D1%83%D0%BB%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82&action=edit&redlink=1 "Биджапурски султанат \(страницата не съществува\)"), което поставя началото на 451 години португалско колониално управление.

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/bc/Burlington_House.jpg/250px-Burlington_House.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Burlington_House.jpg)
  * [1768](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1768 "1768") г. – в [Лондон](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD "Лондон") е основана **[Кралската академия по изкуствата](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0 "Кралска академия по изкуствата")**. (_на снимката_)
  * [1799](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1799 "1799") г. – [Франция](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F "Франция") става първата страна в света, която въвежда **[метричната система](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Метрична система")** , основана на [метъра](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D1%82%D1%8A%D1%80 "Метър") и [килограма](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC "Килограм").

[![Превземането на редута Гривица](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e5/Grivita_1877.jpg/250px-Grivita_1877.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Grivita_1877.jpg "Превземането на редута Гривица")Превземането на редута Гривица
  * [1877](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1877 "1877") г. – [Руско-турската война (1877 – 1878)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE-%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0_\(1877_%E2%80%93_1878\) "Руско-турска война \(1877 – 1878\)"): [руските войски](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%8F "Руска армия") **[освобождават Плевен](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B1%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD "Обсада на Плевен")** (_на картината превземането на[Гривишкия](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B0 "Гривица") редут_) след 5-месечна обсада. Гарнизонът от 25 000 оцелели [турци](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D1%83%D1%80%D1%86%D0%B8 "Турци") капитулира. Победата има решително значение за изхода на войната и [Освобождението на България](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D1%81%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%B6%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%91%D1%8A%D0%BB%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F "Освобождението на България").

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/63/National_Library%2C_Sofia%2C_Bulgaria.jpg/250px-National_Library%2C_Sofia%2C_Bulgaria.jpg)](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:National_Library,_Sofia,_Bulgaria.jpg)
  * [1878](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1878 "1878") г. – в [София](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BE%D1%84%D0%B8%D1%8F "София") е създадена _Публична библиотека_ , която по-късно прераства в **[Национална библиотека „Св. св. Кирил и Методий“](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B1%D0%B8%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B0_%E2%80%9E%D0%A1%D0%B2._%D1%81%D0%B2._%D0%9A%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BB_%D0%B8_%D0%9C%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B9%E2%80%9C "Национална библиотека „Св. св. Кирил и Методий“")**. (_на снимката_)
  * [1898](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1898 "1898") г. – **[Испано-американската война](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D1%81%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE-%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Испано-американска война")** приключва с Парижкия договор, с който [Испания](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D1%81%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F "Испания") признава независимостта на [Куба](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%B0 "Куба") и отстъпва [Гуам](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D1%83%D0%B0%D0%BC "Гуам"), [Филипините](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8 "Филипини") и [Пуерто Рико](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%83%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82%D0%BE_%D0%A0%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE "Пуерто Рико") на [САЩ](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%90%D0%A9 "САЩ").
  * [1936](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1936 "1936") г. – британският крал [Едуард VIII](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%95%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4_VIII "Едуард VIII"), все още желаейки да се ожени за американката [Уолис Симпсън](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%81_%D0%A1%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%BF%D1%81%D1%8A%D0%BD "Уолис Симпсън") срещу широка опозиция, **[абдикира трона](https://bg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%95%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4_VIII&action=edit&redlink=1 "Криза по абдикацията на Едуард VIII \(страницата не съществува\)")** , единственият британски монарх, направил това от [англосаксонския](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%BB%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%90%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%8F "Англосаксонска Англия") период насам.
  * [1943](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1943 "1943") г. – [Втората световна война](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0_%D1%81%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Втората световна война"): трета **[бомбардировка на София](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%A1%D0%BE%D1%84%D0%B8%D1%8F "Бомбардировки на София")** от [британско](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F "Великобритания")-[американската](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D1%8A%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8_%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D1%89%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8 "Съединени американски щати") [авиация](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F "Авиация").
  * [1947](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1947 "1947") г. – VI [велико народно събрание](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%BE_%D1%81%D1%8A%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5 "Велико народно събрание") избира за [министър-председател](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8A%D1%80-%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B4%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB "Министър-председател") **[Георги Димитров](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B8_%D0%94%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2 "Георги Димитров")** и му възлага да състави [правителство](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%BE "Правителство") на [Отечествения фронт](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D1%84%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%82 "Отечествен фронт").
  * [1948](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1948 "1948") г. – [Общото събрание на ООН](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%BE_%D1%81%D1%8A%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%9E%D0%9E%D0%9D "Общо събрание на ООН") приема **[Всеобщата декларация за правата на човека](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B0_%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%B7%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D1%87%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Всеобща декларация за правата на човека")**.
  * [1968](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1968 "1968") г. – най-големият обир в [Япония](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%AF%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F "Япония") – **[обирът на 300 милиона йени](https://bg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%9E%D0%B1%D0%B8%D1%80_%D0%BD%D0%B0_300_%D0%BC%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B9%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8&action=edit&redlink=1 "Обир на 300 милиона йени \(страницата не съществува\)")** , е извършен в [Токио](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BE "Токио"). Той е все още неразкрит.
  * [1989](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/1989 "1989") г. – начало на **[Монголската революция](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8E%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F_\(1990\) "Монголска революция \(1990\)")** : на първата открита продемократична публична демонстрация, [Цахиагийн Елбегдорж](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A6%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%B9%D0%BD_%D0%95%D0%BB%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%B3%D0%B4%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B6 "Цахиагийн Елбегдорж") обявява създаването на [Монголския демократичен съюз](https://bg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%9C%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D1%81%D1%8A%D1%8E%D0%B7&action=edit&redlink=1 "Монголски демократичен съюз \(страницата не съществува\)").

Napi nika Wikipédia?  
napi​nika​wikipediya​  
---  
Wikipédia puniki wantah silih tunggil proyék mitra kriya sané ageng, santukan makasami daging sané wentén ring énsiklopédi puniki kasurat nganggén sakancan basa miwah kauah olih parajanané makasami. Nika mawinan sameton prasida ngalimbakang kaweruhan sané kadruwénang.  Situs puniki kasayagayang olih Wikimédia Foundation tur bebas cingakin olih parajanané makasami. [Wikimédia Foundation](https://wikimediafoundation.org/ "foundationsite:") utawi ring Indonésia, [Yayasan Wikimédia Indonésia](https://wikimedia.or.id/) inggih punika silih situnggil organisasi nirlaba sané ngamargiang makudang-kudang proyék sané nganggén sakancan basa sané wentén ring guminé.  
Nyuratang suratan anyar  
ñurataŋsuratanhañaŕ.​  
_Ragané prasida mabasa Bali?_  
Ngiring sarengin proyék wikipédia. Proyék puniki kasayagayang ring sajeroning makudang-kudang basa ring guminé. Ring galahé puniki, sampun wénten wikipédia sané mabasa Bali. Tinutin uger-uger utawi pedoman sané mamargi iriki, nanging sampunang marasa méweh ring sajeroning uger-uger utawi pedoman iriki.    
  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0e/SanglahER.jpg/500px-SanglahER.jpg)](https://ban.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rumah_Sakit_Prof_Ngoerah "Rumah Sakit Prof Ngoerah")
**Rumah Sakit Prof Ngoerah** (jangkep: Rumah Sakit Umum Pusat Prof. dr. I.G.N.G. Ngoerah) punika rumah sakit pinih ageng ring [Bali](https://ban.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bali "Bali"). Magenah ring wawidangan Margi Diponegoro, desa [Dauh Puri Klod](https://ban.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dauh_Puri_Klod,_D%C3%A9npasar_Barat,_D%C3%A9npasar "Dauh Puri Klod, Dénpasar Barat, Dénpasar"), kecamatan [Dénpasar Barat](https://ban.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C3%A9npasar_Barat,_D%C3%A9npasar "Dénpasar Barat, Dénpasar"), [Kota Dénpasar](https://ban.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kota_D%C3%A9npasar "Kota Dénpasar").

Deri Wikipédi, ènsiklopédi perdèo
  

اهلا وسهلا دويكيفيدى بهاس بتاوى
بندا علم فرديو ڽڠ كنا دكجا ام دفرمق ام ساف اج
Ahlan wasahlan di **[Wikipédi basa Betawi](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikip%C3%A9di_basa_Betawi "Wikipédi basa Betawi")**
[Banda èlmu](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banda_%C3%A8lmu "Banda èlmu") perdèo nyang [kena dikeja ama dipermak ama sapa aja](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/id:Wikipedia:Pengantar "w:id:Wikipedia:Pengantar").
Ampé wayah gini, udah ada **[3.087](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Istim%C3%A8wa:Statistik "Istimèwa:Statistik")** makalah maké [basa Betawi](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basa_Betawi "Basa Betawi") di mari.
[Alam](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Alam "Bangsaan:Alam") |  [Basa](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Basa "Bangsaan:Basa") |  [Betawi](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Betawi "Bangsaan:Betawi") |  [Gending](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Gending "Bangsaan:Gending") |  [Gerak](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Gerak_badan "Bangsaan:Gerak badan") |  [Indonésia](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Indon%C3%A9sia "Bangsaan:Indonésia") |  [Makanan](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Makanan "Bangsaan:Makanan") |  [Pulitik](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Pulitik "Bangsaan:Pulitik") |  [Sejarah](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Sejarah "Bangsaan:Sejarah") |  [Sastra](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Sastra "Bangsaan:Sastra") |  [Riwayat](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:Riwayat "Bangsaan:Riwayat") |  [Tèhnolohi](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangsaan:T%C3%A8hnolohi "Bangsaan:Tèhnolohi")  
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e7/Cscr-featured.svg/20px-Cscr-featured.svg.png) [Makalah gacoan](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikip%C3%A9di:Makalah_gacoan "Wikipédi:Makalah gacoan")
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/14/Bir_Pletok_%28closeup%2C_bg_removed%29.png/120px-Bir_Pletok_%28closeup%2C_bg_removed%29.png)](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gepokan:Bir_Pletok_\(closeup,_bg_removed\).png) **[Bir pletok](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bir_pletok "Bir pletok")** entu [orang Betawi](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orang_Betawi "Orang Betawi") punya minuman nyegerin awak nyang kebikin deri [jahé](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jah%C3%A9 "Jahé"), [secang](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Secang&action=edit&redlink=1 "Secang \(halaman kaga' ada\)"), ama laèn-laèn ragem [rempah](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Rempah&action=edit&redlink=1 "Rempah \(halaman kaga' ada\)"). Bir pletok punya cara bikin entu bahannya pada disiapin, di[godog](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Godog&action=edit&redlink=1 "Godog \(halaman kaga' ada\)") breg ampé mantep, terus ditapis. Sebelonnya ditanjain anget atawa dingin, bir pletok juga' bisa dikocok-kocok ampé merusmus. Sanonya ni minuman entu mentak udah nongol semprakan [jaman normal](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Jaman_normal&action=edit&redlink=1 "Jaman normal \(halaman kaga' ada\)"), bahna orang Betawi gedongan mantengin [orang Welanda](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orang_Welanda "Orang Welanda") pada atoh banget nenggak [bir](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bir "Bir"). Cuman lantaran orang Betawi punya igama [Selam](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Selam "Selam") entu [kaga' boléin minum tèlèr](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Minum_t%C3%A8l%C3%A8r_dalem_Selam&action=edit&redlink=1 "Minum tèlèr dalem Selam \(halaman kaga' ada\)"), dikeja, dah, entu bir pletok—nyang dia punya tampang kaya' bir, tapi kaga' ada [alkoholnya](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Alkohol&action=edit&redlink=1 "Alkohol \(halaman kaga' ada\)") acan. Kapan orang Betawi punya hajatan bakal pengantèn [sunat](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Sunat&action=edit&redlink=1 "Sunat \(halaman kaga' ada\)"), [kawinan](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kawinan&action=edit&redlink=1 "Kawinan \(halaman kaga' ada\)"), atawa laèn-laèn keriaan, ni minuman, mah, kudu ada—mingkinan mbelèbèr, mingkin mantep dah. Wayah gini, ni minuman udah aci jadi Indonésia punya [budèl bukanbenda](https://bew.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bud%C3%A8l_bukanbenda&action=edit&redlink=1 "Budèl bukanbenda \(halaman kaga' ada\)"), juga' jadi atu deri lambang budaya orang Betawi punya. **([Lengkepnya...](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bir_pletok "Bir pletok"))**
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e7/Cscr-featured.svg/20px-Cscr-featured.svg.png) [Gambar gacoan](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikip%C3%A9di:Gambar_gacoan "Wikipédi:Gambar gacoan")
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/82/Pertandingan_loncat_api_indah_di_ujian_pencak_silat.jpg/500px-Pertandingan_loncat_api_indah_di_ujian_pencak_silat.jpg)](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gepokan:Pertandingan_loncat_api_indah_di_ujian_pencak_silat.jpg)

  * ... kalo **[lebak](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lebak "Lebak")** bisa kebikin deri tana nyang boak terus-terusan kena aèr ama angin?
  * ... kalo banyakan, hata kabèhan, puser [jula-juli](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jula-juli "Jula-juli") pada nyang diancer-ancer gableg **[lobang item gedé gambrèng](https://bew.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lobang_item_ged%C3%A9_gambr%C3%A8ng "Lobang item gedé gambrèng")**?

**Hispanohablantes**
[![Ubicación de los hablantes de aymara](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1a/Aymara-language-domain-en-001.svg/250px-Aymara-language-domain-en-001.svg.png)](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archivo:Aymara-language-domain-en-001.svg "Ubicación de los hablantes de aymara")Ubicación de los hablantes de aymara
**¡Bienvenido a la Wikipedia en Aymara!** La enciclopedia libre en idioma aymara, una lengua sudamericana hablada por alrededor de 2 millones de personas. Actualmente este proyecto cuenta con **5246** artículos en aymara.
[![Wikipedistas aymaras](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/73/Aymar_Wikipirya%2C_yatiqirinakampi3.jpg/250px-Aymar_Wikipirya%2C_yatiqirinakampi3.jpg)](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archivo:Aymar_Wikipirya,_yatiqirinakampi3.jpg "Wikipedistas aymaras")Wikipedistas aymaras
Si sabes al menos un poco de idioma aymara y te gustaría contribuir en este proyecto, ¡eres bienvenido! Tal vez sepas poco o nada de aymara. Entonces, puedes informarte más sobre cómo colaborar en: [**Hispanohablantes**](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipidiya:Hispanohablantes "Wikipidiya:Hispanohablantes"), [**Contribuir efectivamente**](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipidiya:Contribuir_efectivamente "Wikipidiya:Contribuir efectivamente"), [**Frases útiles**](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipidiya:Frases_%C3%BAtiles "Wikipidiya:Frases útiles") y [**Ayuda en castellano**](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipidiya:Ayuda_en_castellano?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wikipidiya:Ayuda en castellano \(la página no existe\)"). Si deseas mayor información de este proyecto puedes escribir a: marco_carrasco@hks.harvard.edu y ted.pari@unmsm.edu.pe
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d7/Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png)](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archivo:Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png)

[![Saikat rambai](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/78/Baccaurea_motleyana.jpg/250px-Baccaurea_motleyana.jpg)](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barakas:Baccaurea_motleyana.jpg "Saikat rambai") **Rambai** yaitu salah sabuting buah nang ada di hutan [Kalimantan](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pulau_Kalimantan "Pulau Kalimantan"), dalam bahasa Indunisia urang manyambatnya tatap mamakai ngaran buah Rambai, buah nang bangaran latin _Baccaurea motleyana_ ini rasanya manis bacampur masam. Buah Rambai tamasuk buah nang kalah saing lawan buah-buahan lain nang kaya [langsat](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Langsat?action=edit&redlink=1 "Langsat \(laman baluman ada\)"), mangga, manggis, atawa [durian](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Durian "Durian"), maraga rambai kada samanis kaya buah-buahan lain, lawan jua buah rambai dianggap buah hutanan, imbahnya buah rambai kada talalu banilai ikunumis gasan masyarakat. **([Salangkapnya...](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rambai "Rambai"))**

  * **[Karusuhan](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karusuhan_Nz%C3%A9r%C3%A9kor%C3%A9_2024?action=edit&redlink=1 "Karusuhan Nzérékoré 2024 \(laman baluman ada\)")** wayah batanding bal di [Nzérékoré](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nz%C3%A9r%C3%A9kor%C3%A9?action=edit&redlink=1 "Nzérékoré \(laman baluman ada\)"), Guinea maniwasakan 56 urang.
  * Pasukan [oposisi Suriah](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oposisi_Suriah?action=edit&redlink=1 "Oposisi Suriah \(laman baluman ada\)") mamasuki [Aleppo](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aleppo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Aleppo \(laman baluman ada\)") dalam **[sarangan panambaian](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarangan_Suriah_Barat_Laut_\(2024\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sarangan Suriah Barat Laut \(2024\) \(laman baluman ada\)")** tumatan gancatan sanjata tahun 2020.
  * [Israel](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel?action=edit&redlink=1 "Israel \(laman baluman ada\)") wan [Lebanon](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lebanon?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lebanon \(laman baluman ada\)") mupakat gasan **[gancatan sanjata 60 hari](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pajanjian_gancatan_sanjata_Israel%E2%80%93Lebanon_2024?action=edit&redlink=1 "Pajanjian gancatan sanjata Israel–Lebanon 2024 \(laman baluman ada\)")** gasan maampihakan [perang di Lebanon](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Invasi_Lebanon_ulih_Israel_2024?action=edit&redlink=1 "Invasi Lebanon ulih Israel 2024 \(laman baluman ada\)").
  * [Yamandú Orsi](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yamand%C3%BA_Orsi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Yamandú Orsi \(laman baluman ada\)") _(gambar)_ **[tapilih](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pamilihan_umum_Uruguay_2024?action=edit&redlink=1 "Pamilihan umum Uruguay 2024 \(laman baluman ada\)")** sabagai [Parisidin Uruguay](https://bjn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parisidin_Uruguay?action=edit&redlink=1 "Parisidin Uruguay \(laman baluman ada\)").

Зьвесткі зь Вікіпэдыі — вольнай энцыкляпэдыі
Вітаем у [Вікіпэдыі](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F "Вікіпэдыя"), 
вольнай энцыкляпэдыі, якую можа [рэдагаваць](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%AF%D0%BA_%D1%80%D1%8D%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%86%D1%8C_%D1%96%D1%81%D0%BD%D1%8B_%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BA%D1%83%D0%BB "Вікіпэдыя:Як рэдагаваць існы артыкул") кожны. 
[Беларуская Вікіпэдыя](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F "Беларуская Вікіпэдыя") працуе з 12 жніўня 2004 году.  
Чытайма **[90 124 артыкулы](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BF%D1%8D%D1%86%D1%8B%D1%8F%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8B%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Спэцыяльныя:Статыстыка")** [клясычным правапісам](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D1%96_%D0%BA%D0%BB%D1%8F%D1%81%D1%8B%D1%87%D0%BD%D1%8B_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BF%D1%96%D1%81 "Беларускі клясычны правапіс")! 
[**Стварыць артыкул**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%AF%D0%BA_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%86%D1%8C_%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B_%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BA%D1%83%D0%BB "Вікіпэдыя:Як стварыць новы артыкул") · [Дапамога](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B0%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B0:%D0%97%D1%8C%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82 "Дапамога:Зьмест")

"Вікіпэдыя:Абраныя артыкулы") [![Шэсьць губэрняў Паўночна-Заходняга краю Расейскай "Шэсьць губэрняў Паўночна-Заходняга краю Расейскай імпэрыі")Шэсьць губэрняў Паўночна-Заходняга краю Расейскай імпэрыі **[Паўночна-Заходні край](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D1%9E%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%B0-%D0%97%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D1%96_%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B9 "Паўночна-Заходні край")** , альбо **паўночна-заходнія губэрні** ([па-расейску](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%B9%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0 "Расейская мова"): _Северо-Западный край_) — размоўная, публіцыстычная і афіцыйна-бюракратычная назва шасьці губэрняў [Расейскай імпэрыі](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%B9%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%96%D0%BC%D0%BF%D1%8D%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%8F "Расейская імпэрыя") ([Віленская](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%8F "Віленская губэрня"), [Ковенская](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%8F "Ковенская губэрня"), [Гарадзенская](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B7%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%8F "Гарадзенская губэрня"), [Менская](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%8F "Менская губэрня"), [Магілёўская](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%B3%D1%96%D0%BB%D1%91%D1%9E%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%8F "Магілёўская губэрня") і [Віцебская губэрні](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D1%86%D0%B5%D0%B1%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%8F "Віцебская губэрня")).  Тэрмін «Паўночна-Заходні край» («паўночна-заходнія губэрні») пачаў першапачаткова ўжывацца ва ўрадавай тэрміналёгіі ў адносінах да [Віленскага ваеннага генэрал-губэрнатарства](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D1%96%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%9E%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B5_%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB-%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B0 "Літоўскае генэрал-губэрнатарства") пасьля скасаваньня ў Расейскай імпэрыі [ўніяцтва](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%BD%D1%96%D1%8F%D1%86%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B0 "Уніяцтва") ([1839](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1839 "1839")) як жаданьне паказаць ня толькі спадчынна-дынастычны, але і этнаканфэсійна «рускі» характар гэтых зямель (Віленскай, Гарадзенскай, Менскай і Ковенскай губэрняў). Аднак да пачатку [сялянскай рэформы](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%A1%D1%8F%D0%BB%D1%8F%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%80%D1%8D%D1%84%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%B0_%D1%9E_%D0%A0%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B5%D1%96&action=edit&redlink=1 "Сялянская рэформа ў Расеі \(старонка не існуе\)") ([1861](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1861 "1861")) і асабліва да [паўстаньня 1863—1864 гадоў](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D1%9E%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5_1863%E2%80%941864_%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%BE%D1%9E "Паўстаньне 1863—1864 гадоў") тэрмін «Паўночна-Заходні край» выкарыстоўваўся вельмі рэдка і не распаўсюджваўся на Віцебскую і Магілёўскую губэрні. Да пачатку 1860-х часьцей за ўсё ў расейскай урадавай тэрміналёгіі «паўночна-заходнія губэрні» не вылучаліся асобна, а разам зь «беларускімі» (Віцебскай і Магілёўскай губэрнямі) і «паўднёва-заходнімі губэрнямі» ([«Паўднёва-Заходнім краем»](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D1%9E%D0%B4%D0%BD%D1%91%D0%B2%D0%B0-%D0%97%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D1%96_%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B9 "Паўднёва-Заходні край") — Кіеўскім вайсковым генэрал-губэрнатарствам) прадстаўляліся сукупна і фігуравалі пад агульнай назвай [«заходнія губэрні» (ці «Заходні край»)](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%97%D0%B0%D1%85%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D1%96_%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B9 "Заходні край").  Падпарадкаваньне ў [1863](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1863 "1863") годзе (праз пачатак паўстаньня 1863—1864 гадоў) Віцебскай і Магілёўскай губэрняў уладзе віленскага ваеннага генэрал-губэрнатара распаўсюдзіла тэрмін «Паўночна-Заходні край» і на гэтыя («беларускія») губэрні, што захавалася нават пасьля выхаду ў [1869](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1869 "1869") годзе Віцебскай і Магілёўскай губэрняў з-пад улады віленскага генэрал-губэрнатара.

траўня 1994 г. да 12 траўня 1998 г., і ад 6 ліпеня 2006 г. да 23 лістапада 2007 г. Адзін з заснавальнікаў [Сацыялістычнай Партыі Ўкраіны](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B0%D1%86%D1%8B%D1%8F%D0%BB%D1%96%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%9F%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8B%D1%8F_%D0%8E%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%96%D0%BD%D1%8B "Сацыялістычная Партыя Ўкраіны"), да 2010 зьяўляўся старшынём партыі. Чатыры разы ўдзельнічаў ў выбарах прэзыдэнта Ўкраіны, найлепшы вынік атрымаў на выбарах 1994 году — 13,33% і трэцяе месца. Адзін з галоўных фігурантаў у «[справе Ґанґадзэ](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%A1%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B7%D1%8D&action=edit&redlink=1 "Справа Гангадзэ \(старонка не існуе\)")».

Гэты дзень у гісторыі  [![Максім Багдановіч](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ed/Bagdanovich_M_4.jpg/120px-Bagdanovich_M_4.jpg)](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Bagdanovich_M_4.jpg "Максім Багдановіч")Максім Багдановіч **[9 сьнежня](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%BD%D1%8F "9 сьнежня")** : [Міжнародны дзень барацьбы з карупцыяй](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%9C%D1%96%D0%B6%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D1%8B_%D0%B4%D0%B7%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C_%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D1%8C%D0%B1%D1%8B_%D0%B7_%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BF%D1%86%D1%8B%D1%8F%D0%B9&action=edit&redlink=1 "Міжнародны дзень барацьбы з карупцыяй \(старонка не існуе\)")
* [1884](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1884 "1884") — у [Чыкага](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D1%8B%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B0 "Чыкага") запатэнтавалі першыя [ролікавыя канькі](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%A0%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%96%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B2%D1%8B%D1%8F_%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%8C%D0%BA%D1%96&action=edit&redlink=1 "Ролікавыя канькі \(старонка не існуе\)")
* [1891](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1891 "1891") — нарадзіўся [Максім Багдановіч](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%81%D1%96%D0%BC_%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%96%D1%87 "Максім Багдановіч") (_на выяве_) 
* [1948](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1948 "1948") — [Генэральная Асамблея ААН](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%90%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%8F_%D0%90%D0%90%D0%9D "Генэральная Асамблея ААН") ухваліла Міжнародную канвэнцыю пра папярэджваньне злачынства [генацыду](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%86%D1%8B%D0%B4 "Генацыд") і пакараньня за яго 
* [1968](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1968 "1968") — у [Сан-Францыска](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B0%D0%BD-%D0%A4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%86%D1%8B%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Сан-Францыска") на прафэсійнай канфэрэнцыі [Дуглас Энгельбарт](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%94%D1%83%D0%B3%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%81_%D0%AD%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82&action=edit&redlink=1 "Дуглас Энгельбарт \(старонка не існуе\)") упершыню публічна прадэманстраваў вынайдзеныя ім ці ў ягонай лябараторыі [кампутарную мыш](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%BF%D1%83%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BC%D1%8B%D1%88 "Кампутарная мыш") і [гіпэртэкст](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8D%D0%BA%D1%81%D1%82 "Гіпэртэкст")
* [1976](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1976 "1976") — заснаваньне [Беларускага дзяржаўнага музэю народнага архітэктуры і побыту](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D1%96_%D0%B4%D0%B7%D1%8F%D1%80%D0%B6%D0%B0%D1%9E%D0%BD%D1%8B_%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%B7%D1%8D%D0%B9_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%B9_%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%85%D1%96%D1%82%D1%8D%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8B_%D1%96_%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%8B%D1%82%D1%83 "Беларускі дзяржаўны музэй народнай архітэктуры і побыту")
* [1981](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1981 "1981") — у [Менску](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA "Менск") адкрыўся помнік клясыку беларускай літаратуры [Максіму Багдановічу](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%81%D1%96%D0%BC_%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%96%D1%87 "Максім Багдановіч")
* [1990](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990 "1990") — [Лех Валэнса](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D0%B5%D1%85_%D0%92%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8D%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%B0 "Лех Валэнса") атрымаў перамогу на прэзыдэнцкіх выбарах у [Польшчы](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%88%D1%87%D0%B0 "Польшча")
Болей угодкаў: [8 сьнежня](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/8_%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%BD%D1%8F "8 сьнежня") — **[9 сьнежня](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%BD%D1%8F "9 сьнежня")** — [10 сьнежня](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%BD%D1%8F "10 сьнежня") **[Архіў](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%94%D0%B7%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C_%D1%83_%D0%B3%D1%96%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%96/%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%8C "Вікіпэдыя:Дзень у гісторыі/сьнежань")** · Сёньня [9 сьнежня](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%BD%D1%8F "9 сьнежня") [2025](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025 "2025") году · [Абнавіць гэтую старонку](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE%D1%9E%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B0&action=purge) Ці ведаеце вы...  _[З новых артыкулаў](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BF%D1%8D%D1%86%D1%8B%D1%8F%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%9D%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B%D1%8F_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BA%D1%96 "Спэцыяльныя:Новыя старонкі") (1—31 сакавіка)_
  * … які [**банк**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BA_%D0%91%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%81 "Ак Барс") у 2013 годзе выпусьціў [наручны гадзіньнік](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D1%87%D0%BD%D1%8B_%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B7%D1%96%D0%BD%D1%8C%D0%BD%D1%96%D0%BA "Наручны гадзіньнік") з убудаванай аплатнай карткай „Мастэркард“? 
  * … з дапамогай [**чаго**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows-1251 "Windows-1251") мовы на аснове [кірыліцы](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%96%D1%80%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%96%D1%86%D0%B0 "Кірыліца") кадуюцца ў [Windows](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows "Windows")? 
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1f/Pesto_being_made_in_a_pestle_and_mortar.jpg/120px-Pesto_being_made_in_a_pestle_and_mortar.jpg)](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Pesto_being_made_in_a_pestle_and_mortar.jpg)
  * … у [**які соўс**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%8D%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0 "Пэста") [асноўны інгрэдыент](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%B7%D1%8B%D0%BB%D1%96%D0%BA "Базылік") быў дададзены значна пазьней стварэньня соўса? (_на выяве_) 
  * … як нямецкая міжнародная сетка супэрмаркетаў [**здолела захаваць сваю назву**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lidl "Lidl")? 
  * … мэдалі, прысьвечаныя [**якой вайне**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%8D%D0%B9%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Рэйкавая вайна"), выдаваліся ў [Менску](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA "Менск") ў 1944—1945 гадох? 
  * … былы [лідэр](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BA_%D0%A0%D1%83%D1%82%D1%8D "Марк Рутэ") [**якой партыі**](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BF%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8B%D1%8F_%D0%B7%D0%B0_%D1%81%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%B4%D1%83_%D1%96_%D0%B4%D1%8D%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8B%D1%8E "Народная партыя за свабоду і дэмакратыю") занімаў пасаду [прэм’ер-міністра Нідэрляндаў](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D1%8D%D0%BC%E2%80%99%D0%B5%D1%80-%D0%BC%D1%96%D0%BD%D1%96%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80_%D0%9D%D1%96%D0%B4%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%BB%D1%8F%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B0%D1%9E "Прэм’ер-міністар Нідэрляндаў") 14 гадоў? 

**[Архіў](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82:%D0%A6%D1%96_%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%B5%D1%86%D0%B5_%D0%B2%D1%8B/%D0%90%D1%80%D1%85%D1%96%D1%9E "Вікіпэдыя:Праект:Ці ведаеце вы/Архіў")** · [Распачаць артыкул](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%96%D0%BA%D1%96%D0%BF%D1%8D%D0%B4%D1%8B%D1%8F:%D0%AF%D0%BA_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%8B%D1%86%D1%8C_%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B_%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BA%D1%83%D0%BB "Вікіпэдыя:Як стварыць новы артыкул") · [Прапанаваць артыкул](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B1%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5_%D1%88%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BB%D1%91%D0%BD%D1%83:%D0%A6%D1%96_%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%B5%D1%86%D0%B5_%D0%B2%D1%8B "Абмеркаваньне шаблёну:Ці ведаеце вы")  
---|---|---  
Гэта разьдзел Вікіпэдыі на [беларускай мове](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0 "Беларуская мова") [клясычным правапісам](https://be-tarask.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D1%96_%D0%BA%D0%BB%D1%8F%D1%81%D1%8B%D1%87%D0%BD%D1%8B_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BF%D1%96%D1%81 "Беларускі клясычны правапіс"). [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c9/Soybeans.jpg/250px-Soybeans.jpg)](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abruozdielis:Soybeans.jpg)_Glycine max_ **Suojė** (muokslėškā _Glycine max_) īr [popėniu](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Pop%C4%97n%C4%93&action=edit&redlink=1 "Popėnē \(poslapis da neparašīts\)") šeimīnas [suoju](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Suoj%C4%97s&action=edit&redlink=1 "Suojės \(poslapis da neparašīts\)") gėntėis [augalū](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Augals "Augals") rūšis. Augalā vėinmetē. Popas īr vertėnamas diel maistėngoma.  Suojės īr nauduojamas žmuoniū [jiediou](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jiedis "Jiedis"), ale tonkiausē - [gīvuoliū](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C4%ABvis "Gīvis") pašarou. Suojės popelės jiedamas jau do tūkstontiu metu - onkstiausē anū savībės pastebiejė ė tonkē nauduotė jiemė [Kėnėjuo](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/K%C4%97n%C4%97j%C4%97s_LR "Kėnėjės LR"), [Japuonėjuo](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japuon%C4%97j%C4%97 "Japuonėjė"). Vakarū šalīsė ėšplėta [XX o.](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/XX_o. "XX o."), Lietovuo ė Žemaitėjuo - jau [XXI o.](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/XXI_o. "XXI o.") Suoju sieklas baguotas [amėnorūgštėm](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Am%C4%97nor%C5%ABg%C5%A1t%C4%ABs&action=edit&redlink=1 "Amėnorūgštīs \(poslapis da neparašīts\)"), [lōstelīna](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=L%C5%8Dstel%C4%ABna&action=edit&redlink=1 "Lōstelīna \(poslapis da neparašīts\)"), [baltīmās](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balt%C4%ABms "Baltīms"), [gelžėm](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gel%C5%BE%C4%97s "Gelžės"), [mangano](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Mangans&action=edit&redlink=1 "Mangans \(poslapis da neparašīts\)"), [fuosfuoro](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fuosfuors&action=edit&redlink=1 "Fuosfuors \(poslapis da neparašīts\)") ė kai katrās [B gropės vitaminās](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Vitamins_B&action=edit&redlink=1 "Vitamins B \(poslapis da neparašīts\)"), nemaža [magnė](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Magnis&action=edit&redlink=1 "Magnis \(poslapis da neparašīts\)"), [cina](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Cinks&action=edit&redlink=1 "Cinks \(poslapis da neparašīts\)") ė [kalė](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kalis&action=edit&redlink=1 "Kalis \(poslapis da neparašīts\)") kėikībė. [Daigūs](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Daigs&action=edit&redlink=1 "Daigs \(poslapis da neparašīts\)") kaupias [vitamins C](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Vitamins_C&action=edit&redlink=1 "Vitamins C \(poslapis da neparašīts\)").    
**[truopniau](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suoj%C4%97 "Suojė")...** [Keistė](https://bat-smg.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%C5%A0abluons:NedielesStr&action=edit)

**[Vanuatu](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vanuatu "Vanuatu")** i wan [kaontri](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaontri "Kaontri") long [pasifik](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pasifik "Pasifik") we olgeta save tok tok long [Bislama](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bislama "Bislama"). Ol tu narafala ofisol langwis blong kantri em i inglis mo franis. I gat klosap 115 aelan langwis we manples blong Vanuatu i toktok oltaem. [Kapital](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kapital "Kapital") blong hem i [Port Vila](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port_Vila "Port Vila"). Hemi independent aot blong British mo [Franis](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franis "Franis") long 30 July 1980.

**[Wikipedia](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia")** ye [ansiklopedi](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ansiklopedi "Ansiklopedi") sarabɔbali ye aw bɛɛ jɔyɔrɔ bɛ min dilanni na. Walasa k'o waleya, an bɛɛ ka sɛbɛni k'a la. Sisan **ɲɛ[921](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sp%C3%A9cial:Toutes_les_pages "Spécial:Toutes les pages")** bɛ Bamanankan Wikipedia kɔnɔ. Aw ni ce yɛrɛ-ko kɛko ɲuman na! Aw bɛsɛ ka Faransikan walima kan wɛrɛ bayɛlɛma kata [bamanankan](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bamanankan "Bamanankan") na! [Wikipedia: Bamanankan sigini bɛ katimu duguma k'aw dɛmɛ aka baara la](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Bamanankan_sigini_b%C9%9B_katimu_duguma_k'aw_d%C9%9Bm%C9%9B_aka_baara_la "Wikipedia:Bamanankan sigini bɛ katimu duguma k'aw dɛmɛ aka baara la"). Ka kunnafoni wɛrɛw sɔrɔ, [faransikan Wikipedia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "fr:") lajɛ. Ka fara [bamanankan daɲɛ 1000](http://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/Cat%C3%A9gorie:bambara) bɛ Wiktionnaire kɔnɔ!   
  
Le contenu du Wikipedia est réutilisable selon les conditions de la [Licence de documentation libre GNU](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Licence%20de%20documentation%20libre%20GNU "fr:Licence de documentation libre GNU"). Vous pouvez librement éditer les articles. Les pages [mode d'emploi](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aide:Comment_modifier_une_page "Aide:Comment modifier une page"), et [syntaxe](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aide:Syntaxe "Aide:Syntaxe") sont là pour vous aider. Faites des tests dans le [bac à sable](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Bac_%C3%A0_sable "Wikipedia:Bac à sable"). Pour en savoir plus, lire [foire aux questions](https://bm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aide:FAQ "Aide:FAQ"). [yɛlɛma](https://bm.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Mod%C3%A8le:Acceuil-Introduction&action=edit)

⁠ Onan iyono Wikipedia Bajau Sama
     **Bajau Sama** antawa **Bajau Pantai Barat** iyono kumpulan jomo yang asal ni tekule’ ta [Sabah](https://bdr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabah "Sabah"), [Malaysia](https://bdr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysia "Malaysia") ta pulau [Borneo](https://bdr.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Borneo&action=edit&redlink=1 "Borneo \(nyaun laman\)"). 

This is Bajau Sama Wikipedia.
     **Bajau Sama** or **West Coast Bajau** is an indigenous language spoken at Sabah, Malaysia in the Borneo island.

အပွိုင်အငုဲင်ꩻ
ဘေးဘားသို့ရွှေ့ပါ အွဉ်ႏပလို့ꩻ
အဝ်ႏ ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား ကို
လွူꩻထွားလိတ်မဲ့ငါယိုကို လိတ်ဖြုံႏထီႏမဲဉ်ႏတောဝ်းဖုံႏ ကျုံႏခွဲးအယပ်ꩻခုဲင်ႏအောဝ်ႏဟောင်း? လိတ်ဖြုံႏမဲဉ်ႏ ဖောင့်လꩻနွောင်ꩻခင်ႏလမ်း [နျꩻသွော့ယိုကို](https://mcf.org.mm/pyidaungsu-font/)

#  **[ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8 "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား")** ယို ကျိုႏဆွုမ်ႏဒျာႏဩ။
ဝီခီယိုနောဝ်ꩻ လိုꩻတွိုင်ꩻ လွစ်လွစ်တခြင်ခြင်  
နွို့ထွားထဲမ်ဖျင်နွောင်ꩻဒါႏ အငိုꩻလို့တဝ်း [ကျမ်ꩻပေါင်ꩻစွုမ်ႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%80%E1%80%BB%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%95%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AB%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%85%E1%80%BD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F "ကျမ်ꩻပေါင်ꩻစွုမ်ႏ") ဒျာႏသွူဩ။
အကျောင်ꩻခရာႏ **[၂၉၀၉](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%90%E1%80%B2%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AB%E1%80%B8:%E1%80%85%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9B%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%A1%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%96%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B6%E1%82%8F "တဲးဝါး:စာႏရင်ꩻအင်ꩻဖုံႏ")** ဗာႏယို ဟော်ꩻထွားနွောင်ꩻလဲဉ်း တောမ်ႏ [ပအိုဝ်ႏဘာႏသာႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9D%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%98%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9E%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F "ပအိုဝ်ႏဘာႏသာႏ") သွူဩ။

## ဟန်ႏနီꩻအဖြုဲင်ꩻအဆန်ꩻ
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/61/Miliziani_birmani_dell%27etnia_Pao.jpg/250px-Miliziani_birmani_dell%27etnia_Pao.jpg)](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%96%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B2%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA:Miliziani_birmani_dell'etnia_Pao.jpg) [စဲ့ꩻပအိုဝ်ႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/PNA "PNA")ကရီးခါပုင်ႏ
**[ပအိုဝ်ႏအာႏဇာႏနီႏမွူးနီꩻ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9D%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%87%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%94%E1%80%AE%E1%82%8F%E1%80%99%E1%80%BD%E1%80%B0%E1%80%B8%E1%80%94%E1%80%AE%EA%A9%BB "ပအိုဝ်ႏအာႏဇာႏနီႏမွူးနီꩻ")** ကရိုꩻနဝ်ꩻ ထွာဒျာႏ ထူႏဂုဏ်ႏလွေꩻ ကလဲဉ်းခိုႏချာ မဟာမစာႏ [ပအိုဝ်ႏလိုꩻမျိုꩻ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9D%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9C%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%81%E1%80%BD%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%EA%A9%BB "ပအိုဝ်ႏလိုꩻခွိုꩻ") အောဝ်ႏအတိက်ꩻနျꩻခံႏဘဝ ဖေႏကလွစ်ထန်ႏလꩻနောဝ်ꩻ တခေတ်ထွူတခေတ် တစွုပ်ထွူတစွုပ် ရက်ခွိုꩻသꩻဓာတ်ကအောဝ်ႏဒါႏ အာႏဇာႏနီႏပုဂ္ဂိုလ်ႏ လိုꩻယံလိုꩻကျ ကထွာဒါႏအွဉ်ငါ ခေါင်းဆောင်ပေႏတန် အရန်းရန်းတွမ်ႏ သွꩻဟောဝ်ထာꩻမာꩻဖက် ပအိုဝ်ႏအာႏဇာႏနီႏပုဂ္ဂိုလ်ႏသီး ကားကအဝ်ႏဒျာႏနောဝ်ꩻသွူ။ မဉ်ႏအွော့ꩻလန်ႏချာဗာႏ သမဲင်ꩻလိတ်လာႏ မဲ့ငါလောင်းကို အအဲဉ်ႏနောဝ်ꩻ ခြဲ့ꩻနယ်ႏလွိုဆန်ရေꩻစိုးကို ဗွေႏဆရာႏတောႏ မရမ်းချောင်တွမ်ႏ ပိုလ်ႏခံꩻ (ခမ်းဒွမ်)သီးလဲ့သင်၊ ခမ်းကောင်ဖဲ့ꩻ ခွန်အိုးတွမ်ႏ ပိုလ်ႏပန္တထွဉ်ꩻသီးလဲ့သင်၊ ခြဲ့ꩻနယ်ႏလွိုဆန်ရေꩻ တွိုက်ꩻပွယ်ꩻကို ထွာအာႏဇာႏနီႏခေါင်းဆောင်တန်ဖုံႏဒျာႏနောဝ်ꩻသွူ။ ပဒေႏသရာဇ်လွိုဆန်ရေꩻ တွိုက်ꩻပွယ်ꩻကို ဖြားတန်ကျောင်ꩻတိယွုံꩻ(ဟဲ့ꩻ) [ဖြားတန်ကောင်ခယ်ႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%96%E1%80%BC%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8%E1%80%90%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%80%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%80%81%E1%80%9A%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F "ဖြားတန်ကောင်ခယ်ႏ")၊ ဖြားတန်ကောင်ပြုဲင်၊ ဖြားတန်နာꩻစေတ်သောက်၊ [စောက်ꩻဖါးခွန်စီ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%85%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%80%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%96%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8%E1%80%81%E1%80%BD%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%85%E1%80%AE "စောက်ꩻဖားခွန်စီ")၊ ဖြားဗွာဦးဖြူ(တောင်ႏကီꩻ)၊ [အမတ်အောင်ႏသာႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%A1%E1%80%99%E1%80%90%E1%80%BA%E1%80%A1%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9E%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F "အမတ်အောင်ႏသာႏ")၊ [ဗိုလ်ချန်ဇုံ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9C%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%81%E1%80%BB%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%87%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B6\(%E1%80%95%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9C%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%90%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B6\) "ပိုလ်ႏချန်ဇုံ\(ပိုလ်ႏတုံ\)")၊ [ဗိုလ်ဟိန်မောင်](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9C%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9F%E1%80%AD%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%99%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA "ပိုလ်ႏဟိန်မောင်")၊ [ဖြားဗွာလှဖေ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%96%E1%80%BC%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8%E1%80%97%E1%80%BD%E1%80%AC%E1%80%9C%E1%80%BE%E1%80%96%E1%80%B1 "ဖြားဗွာလှဖေ")၊ [ဗိုလ်ချုပ်စံသိန်း](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9C%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%81%E1%80%BB%E1%80%AF%E1%80%90%E1%80%BA%E1%80%85%E1%80%B6%E1%80%9E%E1%80%AD%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8 "ပိုလ်ႏချုတ်စံသိန်း") စတဲင် အွဉ်ငါခေါင်းဆောင်တန်ဖုံႏနောဝ်ꩻ နွို့သမဲင်ꩻအာႏဇာႏနီႏပုဂ္ဂိုလ်ႏတန်ဖုံႏဒျာႏနောဝ်ꩻသွူ။ နေင်ႏ ၁၉၇၆-ဗာႏ၊ လာဇန်နဝါရီကို [ဝေင်ꩻနယ်ႏသီႏသဲင်ႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%B1%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%94%E1%80%9A%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9E%E1%80%AE%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9E%E1%80%B2%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F "ဝေင်ꩻနယ်ႏသီႏသဲင်ႏ")၊ အွိုင်ႏနာꩻသံ၊ ဒုံလုံးဒါ ဗွေႏဗွန်ကျောင်ꩻကို ကမာꩻလွေꩻဒါႏ ပအိုဝ်ႏစွိုးခွိုꩻအစွိုꩻ(PNO) ပထမလဲင်ႏ ပွယ်ꩻညီႏလာႏခံႏတန်ကို အီႏအွဉ်ႏထွော့ အာႏဇာႏနီႏမွူးနီꩻတာႏ ဒင်ႏသွင်ꩻလွေꩻ စွိုးခွိုꩻအွဉ်ငါ ခေါင်းဆောင်တန် ဖြားဗွာလှဖေ အနိစ္စခန္ဓာႏကပြောင်ꩻထိုꩻဒါႏမွူးနီꩻနဝ်ꩻ ကကျွꩻထင်ႏလွဉ်ဒါႏ ပုဂ္ဂိုလ်ႏကားကအောဝ်ႏ (ကန့်ကွက်)သားအဲဉ်ထောဝ်းတဲင် အွဉ်ႏထွော့လွေꩻ **ပအိုဝ်ႏမွူးနီꩻအာႏဇာႏနီႏ"နီꩻ"** နောဝ်ꩻသွူ။...[ဟော်ꩻထွားထဲင်းအသွုပ်](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9D%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%87%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%94%E1%80%AE%E1%82%8F%E1%80%99%E1%80%BD%E1%80%B0%E1%80%B8%E1%80%94%E1%80%AE%EA%A9%BB "ပအိုဝ်ႏအာႏဇာႏနီႏမွူးနီꩻ")
## ဟန်ႏနီꩻဓာတ်ပုင်ႏဆန်ꩻ
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f2/International_Space_Station_star_trails_-_JSC2012E039800.jpg/500px-International_Space_Station_star_trails_-_JSC2012E039800.jpg)](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%96%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B2%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA:International_Space_Station_star_trails_-_JSC2012E039800.jpg) |   
---|---  
[ခမ်းစွုမ်ႏနုဲင်ငံတကာ အာကာသစခန်ꩻ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%81%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8%E1%80%85%E1%80%BD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%94%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B2%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%80%84%E1%80%B6%E1%80%90%E1%80%80%E1%80%AC_%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%80%E1%80%AC%E1%80%9E%E1%80%85%E1%80%81%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB "ခမ်းစွုမ်ႏနုဲင်ငံတကာ အာကာသစခန်ꩻ") [ထောင်ထွားရေꩻ ၃၀](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%91%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%80%91%E1%80%BD%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9B%E1%80%B1%EA%A9%BB_%E1%81%83%E1%81%80?action=edit&redlink=1 "ထောင်ထွားရေꩻ ၃၀ \(လိတ်မဲ့ငါ အဝ်ႏတဝ်းဒွိုန်း\)") (International Space Station Expedition 30) အစွိုꩻသားတဖြာꩻ [Donald Pettit](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Pettit?action=edit&redlink=1 "Donald Pettit \(လိတ်မဲ့ငါ အဝ်ႏတဝ်းဒွိုန်း\)") ကဖန်ဆင်ꩻခါꩻဒါႏ ဆာႏ(ကြယ်တာရာ)တဖူꩻရဲဉ်ႏဖုံႏတောမ်ႏ ကမ္ဘာႏလောင်း ထာꩻလေ(အလင်းတန်း)ရဲဉ်ႏဖုံႏ စပ်ခြွဉ်းဝင်ꩻပုင်ႏ ဓာတ်ပုင်ႏ။ [NASA](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA")/[Don Pettit](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don_Pettit?action=edit&redlink=1 "Don Pettit \(လိတ်မဲ့ငါ အဝ်ႏတဝ်းဒွိုန်း\)")  
  
## ဝီခီပီးဒီးယားခရာႏ
![ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c1/Wikipedia_logo_for_Myanmar.png/200px-Wikipedia_logo_for_Myanmar.png)**ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား** နဝ်ꩻ လိုꩻကေားသုင်ꩻသားဖုံႏ ခြွဉ်းဗူႏဝင်ꩻတွော့ꩻ နွို့တဲမ်းထဲမ်ဖျင်ညီꩻဒါႏ ကျမ်ꩻပေါင်ꩻစွုမ်ႏဒျာႏသွူ၊၊ ထူႏသုင်ꩻတွမ်ႏ ဝီခီကဟဲ့ꩻဒါႏ လိတ်မဲ့ငါဝဲက်သုဲက်(Website)ယိုတဲင် နွို့တဲမ်းထဲမ်ဖျင်သော့ꩻ အဆင်ႏဖေႏကလ့ꩻ ဖန်ဆင်ꩻမာꩻခါꩻဒျာႏသွူ။ ဝီခီလိတ်မဲ့ငါ ယံကဗွေစွုမ်ႏထဲင်း ယံကဟဝ်ထဲင်းတာႏ ကေားသုင်ꩻသားဖုံႏ အခိန်ႏနားရီႏအလွောက်ꩻ အဝ်ႏနွို့တဲမ်းထဲမ်ဖျင်ကိုဒျာႏဝင်ꩻသွူ။ ပအိုဝ်ႏဝီခီပီးဒီးယားကိုနဝ်ꩻ ကလွောက်ꩻနာႏကဲက်ညီႏဒါႏ ယူနီကိုဒ်(Unicode)(၅.၂)စံနိုန်း လိတ်ဖြုံႏအမျိုꩻမုဲင်ꩻတယဝ်း နွို့တဲမ်းဖျင်၊ နွို့ဟော်ꩻထွား စတဲင်ဖုံႏ မာꩻနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏဝင်ꩻသွူဩ။
## အကူႏညီႏ
  * ဝီခီပီးဒီးယားယိုနဝ်ꩻ တွမ်ႏယူနီကိုဒ်ဖောင့်မုဲင်ꩻတရိုꩻတဝ်း ဟော်ꩻထွား သွုံꩻတဲမ်းသော့ꩻ လꩻနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏနဝ်ꩻသွူ။
  * ချာႏပြန်ႏဘာႏသာႏသားအတာႏ ဖဲ့ꩻထွေအခဝ်ကီစဲင်ႏကို ကအဝ်ႏဒါႏ "ခွုမ်မာꩻချက်ဖုံႏ"၊ ဆꩻလ့ကိုအဝ်ႏဒါႏ "ဘာႏသာႏပြန်ႏဖုံႏ"ယို ထူႏသွုံꩻထွူတဲင် ထူႏပါ [Translation Tool](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%90%E1%80%B2%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AB%E1%80%B8:ContentTranslation "တဲးဝါး:ContentTranslation") အကူႏညီႏတဲင် ပြန်ႏနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏ ဘာႏသာႏသွူ။
  * [သတ်ပုံကျမ်ꩻ](https://my.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:%E1%80%9E%E1%80%90%E1%80%BA%E1%80%95%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B6)ကိုနဝ်ꩻ စဲစ်ဆေꩻနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏ လိတ်ဖြုံႏဖုံႏ၊ ယီးနယ်သတ်ပုံနယ်ꩻဖုံႏ လꩻလို့ဒျာႏသွူ။
  * နွို့ထွားနမူႏနာႏတာႏ တွမ်ႏ ဖေႏကသေနာႏယိုꩻတာႏ ထွားရီးသွော့ ဟော်ꩻထွားရီးတာႏ[နိဒါန်း](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8:%E1%80%94%E1%80%AD%E1%80%92%E1%80%AB%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8 "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား:နိဒါန်း")ယိုသြ။
  * ပအိုဝ်ႏဝီခီပီးဒီးယားနဝ်ꩻ မူဝါဒ[မဏ္ဍိုင်](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8:Five_pillars "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား:Five pillars") (နိယာမ)အဝ်ႏ ငတ်ꩻဗာႏနဝ်ꩻသွူ။
  * ရီခရာႏမိဉ်ႏအဝ်ႏ ရီသွော့[လိတ်မဲ့ငါယို](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8:Questions "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား:Questions")ကိုသြ။
  * မိဉ်ႏအဝ်ႏလိုႏ အကူႏညီႏဖုံႏနဝ်ꩻ လွေꩻသွော့ [အကူႏညီႏလိတ်မဲ့ငါယို](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%85%E1%80%BD%E1%80%B2%E1%80%B8%E1%80%80%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8%E1%80%80%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF:Contents "စွဲးကမ်းကို:Contents")ကိုသြ။
  * မိဉ်ႏမဲဉ်ခြပ်ချော်ꩻ၊ မွဉ်းဖျင်အအဲဉ်ႏနဝ်ꩻ ထွားသွော့ [ခြပ်ချော်ꩻမွဉ်းဖျင်နယ်ꩻ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8:Cheatsheet "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား:Cheatsheet")အအဲဉ်ႏယိုနဝ်ꩻသြ။
  * မိဉ်ႏမဲဉ်စံꩻထွားစိမ်ꩻနဝ်ꩻ သွုံꩻလိတ်မဲ့ငါယိုတဲင် စံꩻနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏ ခြပ်ချော်ꩻမွဉ်းဖျင် [လိတ်မဲ့ငါဖုံႏနဝ်ꩻ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8:Sandbox "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား:Sandbox")သွူ။
  * မိဉ်ႏမဲဉ်လွူꩻထွားစဲင်းစဲ့ ခြပ်ချော်ꩻမွဉ်းဖျင်ရောမ်ဖြုဲင်ꩻ အခရာႏနဝ်ꩻ ဟော်ꩻထွားသွော့ [လိတ်မဲ့ငါယို](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%95%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC%E1%80%B8:%E1%80%99%E1%80%BD%E1%80%89%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8%E1%80%96%E1%80%BB%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%80%9B%E1%80%BD%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%E1%80%96%E1%80%BC%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B2%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%81%E1%80%9B%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F "ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား:မွဉ်းဖျင်ရွမ်ဖြုဲင်ꩻခရာႏ")သြ။
  * ဖေႏကျံႏညဏ်ႏ၊ အုံကွံဒေါ့ꩻရီထဲင်း အလင်ဖုံႏတာႏ နွို့ထွားဒေါ့ꩻရီလွေꩻနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏ [ပအိုဝ်ႏဝီခီပီးဒီးယား](https://web.facebook.com/groups/406204427603066/)ဖေ့ဗိုတ်ကိုသွူသြ။


## ယီးနယ်အကဏ္ဍဖုံႏ
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/86/Flag_map_of_Myanmar.svg/40px-Flag_map_of_Myanmar.svg.png)](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%80%E1%80%8F%E1%80%B9%E1%80%8D:%E1%80%99%E1%80%BB%E1%80%94%E1%80%BA%E1%80%99%E1%80%AC%E1%80%81%E1%80%99%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8%E1%80%91%E1%80%AE "ကဏ္ဍ:မျန်မာခမ်းထီ") | ## ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား ပရောစဲစ်ထာꩻမာꩻအလင်ဖုံႏ
ဝီခီပီးဒီးယားယိုနဝ်ꩻ [ဝီခီမီဒီယာ ဖောင်ဒေးသိဉ်း](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%99%E1%80%AE%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC_%E1%80%96%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%E1%80%92%E1%80%B1%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9E%E1%80%AD%E1%80%89%E1%80%BA%E1%80%B8 "ဝီခီမီဒီယာ ဖောင်ဒေးသိဉ်း") ပရဟိတအစွိုꩻအဗူႏ တထူႏတဝ်းအကျိုꩻအမျတ် ဗွောင်လွေꩻဖေႏခါꩻဒျာႏတဲင် စေႏတနာႏဝွန်ႏထံꩻ(ပရဟိတ)သားဖုံႏ နွို့တဲမ်းထဲမ်ဖျင်လွေꩻဖေႏဒျာႏသွူ။ [ဝီခီမီဒီယာ ပရောစဲစ်ထာꩻမာꩻအလင်ဖုံႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AE%E1%80%81%E1%80%AE%E1%80%99%E1%80%AE%E1%80%92%E1%80%AE%E1%80%9A%E1%80%AC_%E1%80%95%E1%80%9B%E1%80%B1%E1%80%AC%E1%80%85%E1%80%B2%E1%80%85%E1%80%BA "ဝီခီမီဒီယာ ပရောစဲစ်")လဲ့ အဝ်ႏဗွောင်လွေꩻဖေႏ နုဲင်းလ့ယိုဖုံႏသွူဩ။

## ဝီခီပီးဒီးယားဘာႏသာႏ
ဝီခီပီးဒီးယား လိတ်မဲ့ငါယိုနဝ်ꩻ တဲမ်းလွေꩻဖေႏဒျာႏတွမ်ႏ [ပအိုဝ်ႏဘာႏသာႏ](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%95%E1%80%A1%E1%80%AD%E1%80%AF%E1%80%9D%E1%80%BA%E1%82%8F%E1%80%98%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9E%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F "ပအိုဝ်ႏဘာႏသာႏ")သွူဩ။ တယ်ႏကဗွောင်စလွေꩻ ခရိစ်နေင်ႏ ၂၀၂၂ ဗာႏ ဗꩻတွိုႏလွဉ်ယိုခါ အကျောင်ꩻခရာႏလိတ်မူရောမ်ဖြုဲင်ꩻဖုံႏ အဝ်ႏလဲဉ်း [၂၉၀၉](https://blk.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E1%80%90%E1%80%B2%E1%80%B8%E1%80%9D%E1%80%AB%E1%80%B8:%E1%80%85%E1%80%AC%E1%82%8F%E1%80%9B%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%A1%E1%80%84%E1%80%BA%EA%A9%BB%E1%80%96%E1%80%AF%E1%80%B6%E1%82%8F "တဲးဝါး:စာႏရင်ꩻအင်ꩻဖုံႏ") ဗာႏသွူဩ။ တွမ်ႏဘာႏသာႏလင်ဖုံႏ ကတဲမ်းခါꩻဒါႏ ဝီခီပီးဒီးယားဖုံႏလဲ့ နွို့ထွားနွောင်ꩻဒျာႏဝင်ꩻသွူ။ လိတ်မူရောမ်ဖြုဲင်ꩻ အအာသွတ်ꩻ ဝီခီပီးဒီးယားလိတ်မဲ့ငါဖုံႏနဝ်ꩻ အွဉ်ႏနယ်ခါꩻဖေႏ လနဝ်ꩻအတွိုင်ꩻသွူဩ။

मङ्गर, [९ दिसम्बर](https://awa.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%AE%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%AC%E0%A4%B0?action=edit&redlink=1 "दिसम्बर \(पन्ना मौजूद नाई हय\)"), २०२५
|  **[अवधी विकिपीडिया](https://awa.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%85%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%A7%E0%A5%80_%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%AA%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A1%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE "अवधी विकिपीडिया")** मे आपकय [स्वागत](https://awa.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%AA%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A1%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%BE:%E0%A4%96%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%80 "विकिपीडिया:खातिरदारी") हय एक्ठु खुला ज्ञानभंडार, जेहि का केऊ भी [संपादित कइ सकत](https://awa.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%A6:FAQ?action=edit&redlink=1 "मदद:FAQ \(पन्ना मौजूद नाई हय\)") हय। अवधी म **[२,५६२](https://awa.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%96%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B8:Statistics "खास:Statistics")** लेख हँय |  विकिपीडिया सब विषय पय पुख्ता अउर [बइपरय, बदलय अव फिर से बाँटय की ताईं आजाद](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Copyrights "en:Wikipedia:Copyrights") ज्ञानभंडार बनावै कय एक्ठु [कयिउ भाषा कय](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Multilingual%20coordination "en:Wikipedia:Multilingual coordination") योजना होय। ई जेतना होय सकत हय गैर तरफदारी वाली जानकारी फइलावय पय उतारू अहै। सबसे पहिले [अंगरेजी
