  * Поѩтиѥ ⁖ **[съпѫтьникъ](https://cu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D1%8A%D0%BF%D1%AB%D1%82%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D1%8A "Съпѫтьникъ") планитꙑ** ⁖ [нѣмьчьскъ](https://cu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D1%A3%D0%BC%D1%8C%D1%86%D0%B8 "Нѣмьци") астрономъ Їѡаннъ Кєплєръ напрьва въвѣдє ⁙


  * Дєвѧть дєсѧтинъ острова **[Грѣналѧда](https://cu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D1%80%D1%A3%D0%BD%D1%8A%D0%BB%D1%A7%D0%B4%D1%8A "Грѣнълѧдъ")** льдꙗнꙑимь щитомь покрꙑта ѥстъ ⁙


  * [Антарктїцѣ](https://cu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%97%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Антарктїка") **[британьскꙑ сєлѥниꙗ](https://cu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%EA%99%91%D1%81%D1%8A_%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%EA%99%97_%D0%84%D0%B4%D0%BE%D1%83%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%B0 "Мꙑсъ Кралꙗ Єдоуарда")** расъположѥнꙑ сѫтъ ⁙

Article del dia
[World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7")
El [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7"), o WTC 7, és un edifici de [Nova York](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nova_York "Nova York") situat al complex del [World Trade Center](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center "World Trade Center"), al [Baix Manhattan](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manhattan "Manhattan"). El nom _7 World Trade Center_ es refereix a dos edificis: l'estructura original, completada el [1987](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987 "1987") i destruïda l'[11 de setembre](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_de_setembre "11 de setembre") del [2001](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001 "2001"), i l'estructura actual, inaugurada el [2006](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006 "2006"). Els dos edificis els va construir [Larry Silverstein](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Silverstein "Larry Silverstein"), llogater del solar, que és propietat de l'Autoritat Portuària de Nova York i Nova Jersey. [- Vegeu informació sobre la imatge](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fitxer:7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg "Fitxer:7 World Trade Center by David Shankbone.jpg")
## [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7")
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a3/7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg/120px-7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg)](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fitxer:7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg)
El [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7"), o WTC 7, és un edifici de [Nova York](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nova_York "Nova York") situat al complex del [World Trade Center](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center "World Trade Center"), al [Baix Manhattan](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manhattan "Manhattan"). El nom _7 World Trade Center_ es refereix a dos edificis: l'estructura original, completada el [1987](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987 "1987") i destruïda l'[11 de setembre](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_de_setembre "11 de setembre") del [2001](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001 "2001"), i l'estructura actual, inaugurada el [2006](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006 "2006"). Els dos edificis els va construir [Larry Silverstein](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Silverstein "Larry Silverstein"), llogater del solar, que és propietat de l'Autoritat Portuària de Nova York i Nova Jersey. 
  

  * [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/23/Nobel_Pierre_et_Marie_Curie_1.jpg/1700px-Nobel_Pierre_et_Marie_Curie_1.jpg)](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fitxer:Nobel_Pierre_et_Marie_Curie_1.jpg)
Imatge del dia
Diploma del [Premi Nobel de Física](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Premi_Nobel_de_F%C3%ADsica "Premi Nobel de Física") concedit a [Pierre](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pierre_Curie "Pierre Curie") i [Marie Curie](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Curie "Marie Curie") el 1903. [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7")
El [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7"), o WTC 7, és un edifici de [Nova York](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nova_York "Nova York") situat al complex del [World Trade Center](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center "World Trade Center"), al [Baix Manhattan](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manhattan "Manhattan"). El nom _7 World Trade Center_ es refereix a dos edificis: l'estructura original, completada el [1987](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987 "1987") i destruïda l'[11 de setembre](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_de_setembre "11 de setembre") del [2001](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001 "2001"), i l'estructura actual, inaugurada el [2006](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006 "2006"). Els dos edificis els va construir [Larry Silverstein](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Silverstein "Larry Silverstein"), llogater del solar, que és propietat de l'Autoritat Portuària de Nova York i Nova Jersey. [- Vegeu informació sobre la imatge](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fitxer:7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg "Fitxer:7 World Trade Center by David Shankbone.jpg")
## [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7")
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a3/7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg/120px-7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg)](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fitxer:7_World_Trade_Center_by_David_Shankbone.jpg)
El [World Trade Center 7](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center_7 "World Trade Center 7"), o WTC 7, és un edifici de [Nova York](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nova_York "Nova York") situat al complex del [World Trade Center](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Trade_Center "World Trade Center"), al [Baix Manhattan](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manhattan "Manhattan"). El nom _7 World Trade Center_ es refereix a dos edificis: l'estructura original, completada el [1987](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987 "1987") i destruïda l'[11 de setembre](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_de_setembre "11 de setembre") del [2001](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001 "2001"), i l'estructura actual, inaugurada el [2006](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006 "2006"). Els dos edificis els va construir [Larry Silverstein](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Silverstein "Larry Silverstein"), llogater del solar, que és propietat de l'Autoritat Portuària de Nova York i Nova Jersey.

9 de desembre
* * *
La diplomàtica estatunidenca **[Bernadette Meehan](https://ca.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bernadette_Meehan&action=edit&redlink=1 "Bernadette Meehan \(encara no existeix\)")** és elegida nova [CEO](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Executiu_en_cap "Executiu en cap") de la **[Fundació Wikimedia](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fundaci%C3%B3_Wikimedia "Fundació Wikimedia")** , l'organització que manté tècnicament la [Viquipèdia](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viquip%C3%A8dia "Viquipèdia"). 
  

7 de desembre
* * *
El veïnat de **[Gósol](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%B3sol "Gósol")** demana en [referèndum](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Refer%C3%A8ndum "Referèndum") abandonar la [província de Lleida](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prov%C3%ADncia_de_Lleida "Província de Lleida") i incorporar-se a la de [Barcelona](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prov%C3%ADncia_de_Barcelona "Província de Barcelona"), a què pertany la resta de la comarca del **[Berguedà](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bergued%C3%A0 "Berguedà")**. 
  

7 de desembre
* * *
Tretze militars són detinguts a [Cotonou](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cotonou "Cotonou"), **[Benín](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ben%C3%ADn "Benín")** , durant el **[cop d'estat](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cop_d%27estat "Cop d'estat")** fallit contra el govern del president [Patrice Talon](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrice_Talon "Patrice Talon"). 
  

5 de desembre
* * *
**[Magda Añon](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magdalena_A%C3%B1on_Espert "Magdalena Añon Espert")** i **[Francesc Server](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Francesc_Server_Mut "Francesc Server Mut")** comparteixen _ex aequo_ el **[VIII Premi Lletraferit](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Premis_Lletraferit "Premis Lletraferit")**.

[Francesc Boix i Masramon, _Xesco Boix_](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xesco_Boix "Xesco Boix") ([Barcelona](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barcelona "Barcelona"), [3 de febrer](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/3_de_febrer "3 de febrer") de [1946](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1946 "1946") - [Malgrat de Mar](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malgrat_de_Mar "Malgrat de Mar"), [21 de juliol](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/21_de_juliol "21 de juliol") de [1984](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1984 "1984")), fou un músic, animador i cantant català de [folk](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Folk "Folk") i de [cançó](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Can%C3%A7%C3%B3 "Cançó") infantil. [Mario Götze](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mario_G%C3%B6tze "Mario Götze") ([Memmingen](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memmingen "Memmingen"), [Baviera](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baviera "Baviera"), [3 de juny](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/3_de_juny "3 de juny") de [1992](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1992 "1992")) és un [futbolista](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Futbolista "Futbolista") [alemany](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alemanys "Alemanys") que actualment juga de [centrecampista](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centrecampista "Centrecampista") a l'[Eintracht Frankfurt](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eintracht_Frankfurt "Eintracht Frankfurt") i a la [Selecció d'Alemanya](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Selecci%C3%B3_de_futbol_d%27Alemanya "Selecció de futbol d'Alemanya").

Avui fa 5 anys
El [Marroc](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marroc "Marroc") normalitza les relacions diplomàtiques amb [Israel](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel "Israel"), a canvi del reconeixement dels [Estats Units](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Estats_Units_d%27Am%C3%A8rica "Estats Units d'Amèrica") de la sobirania del Marroc sobre el [Sàhara Occidental](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A0hara_Occidental "Sàhara Occidental").
Avui fa 10 anys
Mor [Pepita Llunell](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pepita_Llunell_i_Sanahuja "Pepita Llunell i Sanahuja"), [compositora](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compositora "Compositora"), [cantant](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cantant "Cantant") i [actriu](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Actriu "Actriu") [catalana](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalunya "Catalunya").
Avui fa 150 anys
Mor [Ōtagaki Rengetsu](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%8Ctagaki_Rengetsu "Ōtagaki Rengetsu"), monja [budista](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Budista "Budista") japonesa, poeta, [ceramista](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ceramista "Ceramista"), pintora i experta cal·lígrafa (n. [1791](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/1791 "1791")).
Avui fa 210 anys

Makkokkowé engka **[15.957](https://bug.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mallebbi:Statistik "Mallebbi:Statistik")** lontaraq **[mabbasa Ugiq](https://bug.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basa_Ugiq "Basa Ugiq")** sibawa **14.891** pagguna taccataq
Siamasémaséikiq mai ri Wikipédiya mabbicara ugiq. Narékko engka séddi duwa nawa-nawataq nennia paddissengettaq to pada pattamai sarékkoamengngi iyya _ensiklopedia_ iyyé massing lengkaqi ilalengna.

# Salamaq mattamaq  
---  
**Salamaqkiq mattamaq ri Wikipédiya basa Ugiq** , Wikipédiya iyanaé weddingngi silollongeng tabbukka polé ri alétaq.  
  
Marikiq makkumpuluq sibawa akkumpulangenna Wikipédiyaé sibawa sippada-pada mabbéré iyanarodo paddissengeng ilaleng lontaraq maradéka mabbasa Ugiq.  
  
[Lalokiq laori Panrung](https://bug.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Panrung "Wikipedia:Panrung") ko engka pakkutanammu.  
  
[_You are not an Buginese speaker? Please visit here and introduce yourself!_](https://bug.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Warung_Kopi "Wikipedia:Warung Kopi") 😄  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b8/Text-x-generic_with_pencil-2.svg/40px-Text-x-generic_with_pencil-2.svg.png)  
[[Berkas:231 UBLOHS Or 5475 overzicht Boegi 02.jpg|jmpl|center|300px|La Galigo, [Wikiyapoléng](https://id.wikipedia.org/wiki/s:Indeks:La%20Galigo%20-%20Part%201,%20NBG-Boeg%20188.pdf "id:s:Indeks:La Galigo - Part 1, NBG-Boeg 188.pdf").]]  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cd/HSSamarbete.svg/40px-HSSamarbete.svg.png)  
Wikipédiya deqna jamingngi attentuang salaé.  
Sininna arrokikengngé polé ri Wikipédiyaédé, iyanaritu tanggunjawaqna polé niga-niga rokiwi.  
  
Ingobbi idiq ku maggabung ri gerruq Waqsaqé [Wikimédiya Mangkassaraq](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HdHRO0YfGZf7euWoqC4xXK). Iwajikkengngi idiq pasisseng alétaq ko pura taggabung.

Z Wikipedie, otevřené encyklopedie
[Vítejte ve Wikipedii](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedie:Pr%C5%AFvodce "Wikipedie:Průvodce"),
internetové [encyklopedii](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Encyklopedie "Encyklopedie"), kterou může [upravovat každý](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%A1pov%C4%9Bda:%C3%9Avod "Nápověda:Úvod").  
[Česká Wikipedie](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Cesk%C3%A1_Wikipedie "Česká Wikipedie") má nyní **[581 883](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speci%C3%A1ln%C3%AD:Statistika "Speciální:Statistika")** [článků](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speci%C3%A1ln%C3%AD:Nov%C3%A9_str%C3%A1nky "Speciální:Nové stránky").

[![Pohled na mrakodrapy v části města Downtown](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/57/Concord_Pacific_Master_Plan_Area.jpg/120px-Concord_Pacific_Master_Plan_Area.jpg)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Concord_Pacific_Master_Plan_Area.jpg "Pohled na mrakodrapy v části města Downtown")Pohled na mrakodrapy v části města Downtown
**[Vancouver](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vancouver "Vancouver")** je přístavní město v jihozápadní části [kanadské provincie](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrativn%C3%AD_d%C4%9Blen%C3%AD_Kanady "Administrativní dělení Kanady") [Britská Kolumbie](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Britsk%C3%A1_Kolumbie "Britská Kolumbie"), největší [metropolitní centrum](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metropole "Metropole") v západní Kanadě a [třetí největší v celé Kanadě](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seznam_m%C4%9Bst_v_Kanad%C4%9B "Seznam měst v Kanadě"). Okolo města se rozkládá [Regionální okres Metro Vancouver](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metro_Vancouver "Metro Vancouver"), který náleží do většího celku obecně známého jako [Lower Mainland](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lower_Mainland "Lower Mainland"). Vancouverský [přístav](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C5%99%C3%ADstav "Přístav") vykazuje největší objem přepravy v celé [Severní Americe](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Severn%C3%AD_Amerika "Severní Amerika"). Po Hollywoodu a New Yorku je Vancouver třetím největším centrem filmové produkce v Severní Americe, občas je označovaný jako Hollywood severu. Město také v roce 2010 hostilo [XXI. zimní olympijské hry](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zimn%C3%AD_olympijsk%C3%A9_hry_2010 "Zimní olympijské hry 2010"). 
Vancouver leží v údolí řeky [Fraser](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fraser_\(%C5%99eka\) "Fraser \(řeka\)") u [Tichého oceánu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tich%C3%BD_oce%C3%A1n "Tichý oceán"), mezi úžinou [Strait of Georgia](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strait_of_Georgia "Strait of Georgia") a pohořím [Coast Mountains](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pob%C5%99e%C5%BEn%C3%AD_hory "Pobřežní hory"). Město v 60. letech [19. století](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/19._stolet%C3%AD "19. století") založili přistěhovalci. Rychlým tempem se z malé osady stalo velkoměsto. Po dokončení [Panamského průplavu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panamsk%C3%BD_pr%C5%AFplav "Panamský průplav") přístav nabyl mezinárodního významu. V roce 1986 mělo město 431 147 obyvatel (aglomerace 1,51 milionu) a roku 2006 už 631 486. Město rychle roste a počet obyvatel v metropolitní oblasti dosáhl v roce 2021 hranici 2,6 milionu. 
Vancouver spadá do pacifického časového pásma (UTC-8). Oproti možným očekáváním město Vancouver neleží na ostrově [Vancouver](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vancouver_\(ostrov\) "Vancouver \(ostrov\)"). Obojí nese jméno po kapitánovi [Královského námořnictva](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Britsk%C3%A9_kr%C3%A1lovsk%C3%A9_n%C3%A1mo%C5%99nictvo "Britské královské námořnictvo") [Georgi Vancouverovi](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Vancouver "George Vancouver"), jenž zde v roce [1792](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/1792 "1792") prováděl průzkum. Kromě kanadského Vancouveru existuje i [město stejného jména](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vancouver_\(Washington\) "Vancouver \(Washington\)") v USA ve státě [Washington](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington_\(st%C3%A1t\) "Washington \(stát\)").

  * … architekt **[městských lázní ve Mšeně](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C4%9Bstsk%C3%A9_l%C3%A1zn%C4%9B_M%C5%A1eno "Městské lázně Mšeno")** z roku 1932 zůstává neznámý?

[26. listopadu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/26._listopad "26. listopad") – středa
     [![Čína](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fa/Flag_of_the_People%27s_Republic_of_China.svg/40px-Flag_of_the_People%27s_Republic_of_China.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8C%C3%ADna "Čína")[![Hongkong](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5b/Flag_of_Hong_Kong.svg/40px-Flag_of_Hong_Kong.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hongkong "Hongkong") Při [rozsáhlém požáru bytového komplexu Wang Fuk Court](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Po%C5%BE%C3%A1r_obytn%C3%BDch_budov_Tai_Po "Požár obytných budov Tai Po") v [Hongkongu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hongkong "Hongkong") zemřelo nejméně 146 lidí. 

[20. listopadu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/20._listopad "20. listopad") – čtvrtek
     [![Česko](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cb/Flag_of_the_Czech_Republic.svg/40px-Flag_of_the_Czech_Republic.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Cesko "Česko") Při [železniční nehodě](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%BDelezni%C4%8Dn%C3%AD_nehoda_u_Zlivi "Železniční nehoda u Zlivi") u [Českých Budějovic](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Cesk%C3%A9_Bud%C4%9Bjovice "České Budějovice") bylo zraněno 47 lidí. 

[17. listopadu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/17._listopad "17. listopad") – pondělí
     [![Bangladéš](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f9/Flag_of_Bangladesh.svg/40px-Flag_of_Bangladesh.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banglad%C3%A9%C5%A1 "Bangladéš") Bývalá [bangladéšská](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banglad%C3%A9%C5%A1 "Bangladéš") premiérka [Šajch Hasína Vadžídová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%A0ajch_Has%C3%ADna_Vad%C5%BE%C3%ADdov%C3%A1 "Šajch Hasína Vadžídová") byla v nepřítomnosti odsouzena k [trestu smrti](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trest_smrti "Trest smrti"). 

[4. listopadu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/4._listopad "4. listopad") – úterý
     [![USA](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a4/Flag_of_the_United_States.svg/40px-Flag_of_the_United_States.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spojen%C3%A9_st%C3%A1ty_americk%C3%A9 "USA")[![Kentucky](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8d/Flag_of_Kentucky.svg/40px-Flag_of_Kentucky.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kentucky "Kentucky") Čtrnáct lidí, včetně tříčlenné posádky, zahynulo při [pádu letadla](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Let_UPS_2976 "Let UPS 2976") společnosti [UPS](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/UPS_Airlines "UPS Airlines") na město [Louisville](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louisville "Louisville") v [Kentucky](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kentucky "Kentucky").      [![USA](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a4/Flag_of_the_United_States.svg/40px-Flag_of_the_United_States.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spojen%C3%A9_st%C3%A1ty_americk%C3%A9 "USA") Starostou [New Yorku](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York "New York") byl zvolen [demokrat](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demokratick%C3%A1_strana_\(USA\) "Demokratická strana \(USA\)") [Zohran Mamdani](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zohran_Mamdani "Zohran Mamdani"), [guvernérkami](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guvern%C3%A9r_\(Spojen%C3%A9_st%C3%A1ty_americk%C3%A9\) "Guvernér \(Spojené státy americké\)") států [Virginie](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginie "Virginie") a [New Jersey](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Jersey "New Jersey") byly zvoleny [Abigail Spanbergerová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abigail_Spanbergerov%C3%A1 "Abigail Spanbergerová") a [Mikie Sherrillová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikie_Sherrillov%C3%A1 "Mikie Sherrillová"). 

[1. listopadu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/1._listopad "1. listopad") – sobota
     [![Egypt](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fe/Flag_of_Egypt.svg/40px-Flag_of_Egypt.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egypt "Egypt") Nedaleko [pyramid v Gíze](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%ADzsk%C3%A1_nekropole "Gízská nekropole") bylo oficiálně otevřeno [Velké egyptské muzeum](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Velk%C3%A9_egyptsk%C3%A9_muzeum "Velké egyptské muzeum"), které se zároveň stalo největším muzeem na světě.      [![Tanzanie](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/38/Flag_of_Tanzania.svg/40px-Flag_of_Tanzania.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzanie "Tanzanie") [Tanzanské](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzanie "Tanzanie") všeobecné volby vyhrála vládnoucí [Revoluční strana](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chama_Cha_Mapinduzi "Chama Cha Mapinduzi") vedená prezidentkou [Samiou Suluhu Hassanovou](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samia_Suluhu_Hassanov%C3%A1 "Samia Suluhu Hassanová"). Při [protestech proti volebním nesrovnalostem](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protesty_po_volb%C3%A1ch_v_Tanzanii_2025 "Protesty po volbách v Tanzanii 2025") byly zabity desítky lidí.      [![Česko](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cb/Flag_of_the_Czech_Republic.svg/40px-Flag_of_the_Czech_Republic.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Cesko "Česko") V pražském [Národním divadle](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%A1rodn%C3%AD_divadlo "Národní divadlo") byly předány [Ceny Thálie 2025](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ceny_Th%C3%A1lie_2025 "Ceny Thálie 2025"), za celoživotní mistrovství byli oceněni [Dana Syslová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dana_Syslov%C3%A1 "Dana Syslová"), [Ladislav Frej](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ladislav_Frej "Ladislav Frej"), [Natalie Achaladze Romanová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nat%C3%A1lie_Romanov%C3%A1 "Natálie Romanová"), [Alice Kvasnicová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Alice_Kvasnicov%C3%A1&action=edit&redlink=1 "Alice Kvasnicová \(stránka neexistuje\)"), [Jan Ježek](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jan_Je%C5%BEek "Jan Ježek"), [Lenka Machoninová](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lenka_Machoninov%C3%A1 "Lenka Machoninová") a [Zdena Studenková](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zdena_Studenkov%C3%A1 "Zdena Studenková"). 

[28. října](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/28._%C5%99%C3%ADjen "28. říjen") – úterý
     [![Česko](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cb/Flag_of_the_Czech_Republic.svg/40px-Flag_of_the_Czech_Republic.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Cesko "Česko") Prezident [Petr Pavel](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petr_Pavel "Petr Pavel") udělil či propůjčil [státní vyznamenání](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%98%C3%A1dy,_vyznamen%C3%A1n%C3%AD_a_medaile_%C4%8Ceska "Řády, vyznamenání a medaile Česka") celkem [48 osobnostem](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seznam_osobnost%C3%AD_vyznamenan%C3%BDch_28._%C5%99%C3%ADjna_2025 "Seznam osobností vyznamenaných 28. října 2025"), z nich 36 mužům a 12 ženám.      [![Jamajka](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0a/Flag_of_Jamaica.svg/40px-Flag_of_Jamaica.svg.png)](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamajka "Jamajka") [Hurikán Melissa](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hurik%C3%A1n_Melissa "Hurikán Melissa") zasáhl ostrov [Jamajka](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamajka "Jamajka") s [přívalovými dešti](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C5%99%C3%ADvalov%C3%BD_d%C3%A9%C5%A1%C5%A5 "Přívalový déšť") a větrem dosahujícím 295 kilometrů za hodinu.

  * [1665](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/1665 "1665") – [Druhá anglo-nizozemská válka](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Druh%C3%A1_anglo-nizozemsk%C3%A1_v%C3%A1lka "Druhá anglo-nizozemská válka"): [Michiel de Ruyter](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michiel_de_Ruyter "Michiel de Ruyter") a [Johan de Witt](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johan_de_Witt "Johan de Witt") založili **[Nizozemskou námořní pěchotu](https://cs.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nizozemsk%C3%A1_kr%C3%A1lovsk%C3%A1_n%C3%A1mo%C5%99n%C3%AD_p%C4%9Bchota&action=edit&redlink=1 "Nizozemská královská námořní pěchota \(stránka neexistuje\)")**.

Belgický")** , nástupcem se stal jeho syn **[Leopold II.](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leopold_II._Belgick%C3%BD "Leopold II. Belgický")**
  * [1920](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/1920 "1920") – Vyhlášením **[generální stávky](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prosincov%C3%A1_gener%C3%A1ln%C3%AD_st%C3%A1vka_1920 "Prosincová generální stávka 1920")** vyvrcholil boj mezi demokratickým křídlem [sociální demokracie](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Cesk%C3%A1_strana_soci%C3%A1ln%C4%9B_demokratick%C3%A1 "Česká strana sociálně demokratická") a radikální levicí, který v roce [1921](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/1921 "1921") vedl k založení [KSČ](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komunistick%C3%A1_strana_%C4%8Ceskoslovenska "Komunistická strana Československa").
  * [1945](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/1945 "1945") – **[Alcide De Gasperi](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alcide_De_Gasperi "Alcide De Gasperi")** _(na obrázku)_ se stal [premiérem Itálie](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C5%99edseda_vl%C3%A1dy_It%C3%A1lie "Předseda vlády Itálie").
  * [2005](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/2005 "2005") – Začala vysílat [ruská](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rusko "Rusko") zpravodajská televizní síť **[Russia Today](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/RT_\(televizn%C3%AD_stanice\) "RT \(televizní stanice\)")**.

##  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/bf/ISO_639_Icon_co.svg/60px-ISO_639_Icon_co.svg.png)](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:ISO_639_Icon_co.svg) Aiutate Wikipedia in lingua corsa
[Per aiutà Wikipedia](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Per_aiut%C3%A0_Wikipedia "Wikipedia:Per aiutà Wikipedia") pudete:
  * fà una parti di u [travagliu da fà](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travagliu_da_f%C3%A0 "Travagliu da fà")
  * **Scrive un articulu** , o ancu sè vo truvete un sbagliu, currighjite lu puru[diversità](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Diversit%C3%A0 "Wikipedia:Diversità") face ricchezza. Videte dinù i **[cunsigli per scrive un articulu](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Cunsigli_par_scriva_un_articulu "Wikipedia:Cunsigli par scriva un articulu")**.  
U più simplice per cumincià hè di cumplittà un articulu[articuli da cumplittà](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Articuli_da_cumplitt%C3%A0 "Wikipedia:Articuli da cumplittà"). Si pò dinù traduce un articulu, per esempiu da a wikipedia in [francese](http://fr.wikipedia.org), [talianu](http://it.wikipedia.org), [sicilianu](http://scn.wikipedia.org)...
  * **Incaricà imagini** o fotugrafii. U megliu hè d'incaricà li annantu à [WikiCommons](http://commons.wikimedia.org), parchì pudarani serva dopu à tutti i prugetti Wikimedia. T'avemu bisognu d'una fotugrafia d'ogni paesi, ogni paisolu, ogni munimentu di Corsica, ogni fiore, ogni animale, ogni ogettu anticu, è cetera.
  * in ogni circustanza, ci vole à **rispettà i dritti d'autore** : ùn si ponu cupià quì testi o stratti chì sò prutetti da i dritti d'autore

## Da leghje

## Prugettu di u mese
Sete tutti invitati à participà à u prugettu di 'ssu mese: scrive i **toponimi** di tutte e [cumune di Corsica](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumuna_di_Corsica "Cumuna di Corsica") in wikipedia in lingua corsa. Quelle chì sò dighjà abbastanza cumplette: [Frassetu](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frassetu "Frassetu"), [Ghjunchetu](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghjunchetu "Ghjunchetu"), [Laretu di Tallà](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laretu_di_Tall%C3%A0 "Laretu di Tallà"), [Pedicorti di Gaghju](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedicorti_di_Gaghju "Pedicorti di Gaghju"). Scrivite quì i toponimi di u vostru paese o a vostra cità. [Mudificà](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Pagina_maestra/Prugettu_di_u_mese "Template:Pagina maestra/Prugettu di u mese")
## U pruverbiu di u ghjornu
Hè meghju à travaglià indarnu ca pusà indarnu. [Mudificà](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Pagina_maestra/Pruverbiu "Template:Pagina maestra/Pruverbiu") [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/ca/Lammergeier.jpg/240px-Lammergeier.jpg)](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lammergeier.jpg) L' [altore barbutu](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Altore_barbutu "Altore barbutu") (Gypaetus barbatus) hè un acellu chì face parte di a famiglia di l' Accipitridae. Ci hè pocu dismurfisimu sessuale è a femina hè appena più maiore ch'è u masciu. Pesa da 5 à 7 kilò. U so nome vene da u fattu chì i piumi situate da una parte è di l'altra di u bizzicu li facenu una spezia di barba. Hè ochjigiallu ma i so ochji sò chirchjati di rossu. L'altore barbutu pò campà sin'à quaranta anni. L'altore barbutu sarebbe respunsevule di a morte di u pueta grecu Eschilu, in l'annu 456 nanzi à Cristu. L'acellu averia lasciatu cascà in terra una cuppulata per rompe ni l'osse. L'altore barbutu averia credutu chì u capu scafulatu d'Eschilu fusse una petra. A cuppulata saria cascata annantu à u capu d'Eschilu, chì murì tandu subitamente. Esiste in Africa un antra spezia d'altore barbutu: l'altore barbutu d'Africa(Gypaetus barbatus meridionalis), chì hè appena più chjugu. L' altore barbutu hè prisente in Corsica. A pupulazione seria da 10 à 20 coppii. [Mudificà](https://co.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Pagina_maestra/Articulu_di_a_settimana "Template:Pagina maestra/Articulu di a settimana")

## Pennad ar miz  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3b/COVID-19_Outbreak_World_Map_per_Capita.svg/330px-COVID-19_Outbreak_World_Map_per_Capita.svg.png)](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Restr:COVID-19_Outbreak_World_Map_per_Capita.svg)Red COVID-19 dre ar bed **(30 Meurzh 2020)**  

* ██ > 100 den klañv evit 100 000 annezad
* ██ 10–100 den klañv evit 100 000 annezad
* ██ 1–10 den klañv evit 100 000 annezad
* ██ 0.1–1 den klañv evit 100 000 annezad
* ██ 0.001–0.1 den klañv evit 100 000 annezad
* ██ N'eus den klañv ebet disklêriet/N'eus den ebet
D'ar [1añ a viz Kerzu](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/1a%C3%B1_a_viz_Kerzu "1añ a viz Kerzu") [2019](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019 "2019") e stagas ur [c'hleñved](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kle%C3%B1ved "Kleñved") da redek e kêr [Wuhan](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wuhan "Wuhan"), e [Republik Pobl Sina](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republik_Pobl_Sina "Republik Pobl Sina") : ar c'h**[COVID-19](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19 "COVID-19")**. Ur c'hurunviruz nevez, anvet [SARS-CoV-2](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/SARS-CoV-2 "SARS-CoV-2"), a oa krog da redek dre [Wuhan](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wuhan "Wuhan"), kêr-benn proviñs [Hubei](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hubei "Hubei"). Meur a zen a oa bet tapet gant [tanijenn skevent](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanijenn_skevent "Tanijenn skevent") hep ma vefe sklaer eus pelec'h e teue ar c'hleñved. An holl pareoù implijet a oa chomet diefed. Buan a-walc'h e oa deuet war-wel e oa eus un eskemm den-den evel doare treuzkas. An niver a dud klañv a oa aet buan war gresk betek tizhout milieroù a dud e fin miz Genver 2020. Meur a vro a oa bet tapet gant ar c'hleñved ouzhpenn Sina, en Europa, Norzhamerika ha dreist-holl en Azia. Mare goradur ar c'hleñved (pa vezer kontamet betek ar c'hentañ azonoù) zo etre 2 ha 14 devezh. Gallout a ra un den klañv binimañ tud all pad ma vez klañv met ivez e-pad meur a zevezh ur wech pareet. An azonoù zo lies met an daou azon diazez eo an derzhienn uhel hag ur skuizhder bras. Goude-se e krog kudennoù gant ar reizhiad analañ, kudennoù gant al lounezh, ar reizhiad gwazhiadur. Gellout a reer mervel diwar ar c'hleñved.  (**[muioc'h...](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bedreuziad_COVID-19 "Bedreuziad COVID-19")**)

## Keleier  
---  
**Un tamm sell war red an darvoudoù** Doare an [9 a viz Kerzu](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_a_viz_Kerzu "9 a viz Kerzu") [2025](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025 "2025") ha **[Keleier ar vro](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_e_Breizh "2025 e Breizh")**.  [![Lando Norris e 2024.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/70/2024-08-25_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_4016_by_Stepro_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-2024-08-25_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_4016_by_Stepro_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Restr:2024-08-25_Motorsport,_Formel_1,_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_4016_by_Stepro_\(cropped\).jpg "Lando Norris e 2024.")Lando Norris e 2024.
  * [7 a viz Kerzu](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/7_a_viz_Kerzu "7 a viz Kerzu") : dont a ra ar bleiner saoz ha belgiat [Lando Norris](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lando_Norris "Lando Norris") _(skeudenn)_ da vezañ kampion ar bed [Formulenn 1](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formulenn_1 "Formulenn 1").
  * [29 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/29_a_viz_Du "29 a viz Du") : gant an dour-beuz da-heul glaveier pil e [gevred Azia](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gevred_Azia "Gevred Azia") ez eus lazhet meur a gant den e [Malaysia](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysia "Malaysia") hag [Indonezia](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonezia "Indonezia") ha miliadoù a dud all a rank kuitaat o zi.
  * [27 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/27_a_viz_Du "27 a viz Du") : [taol-stad](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taol-stad "Taol-stad") gant an arme a-enep ar prezidant [Umaro Sissoco Embaló](https://br.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Umaro_Sissoco_Embal%C3%B3&action=edit&redlink=1 "Umaro Sissoco Embaló \(n'eus ket eus ar bajenn-mañ\)") e [Ginea-Bissau](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ginea-Bissau "Ginea-Bissau").
  * [26 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/26_a_viz_Du "26 a viz Du") : gant un [tan-gwall en Hong Kong](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tan-gwall_Tai_Po_e_2025 "Tan-gwall Tai Po e 2025") en ur greizennad skraberioù-oabl ez eus lazhet 128 den ha steuziet ouzhpenn 200.
  * [24 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/24_a_viz_Du "24 a viz Du") : marv ar c'haner ha soner jamaikan [Jimmy Cliff](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Cliff "Jimmy Cliff").
  * [17 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/17_a_viz_Du "17 a viz Du") : [Sheikh Hasina](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sheikh_Hasina "Sheikh Hasina"), bet Kentañ ministrez [Bangladesh](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangladesh "Bangladesh"), zo kondaonet d'ar marv _[in absentia](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/In_absentia "In absentia")_ gant ul lez-varn eus ar vro-hont.
  * [12 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/12_a_viz_Du "12 a viz Du") : digastizet eo ar skrivagner [Boualem Sansal](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boualem_Sansal "Boualem Sansal") en [Aljeria](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aljeria "Aljeria") ha lezet da vont da Alamagn.
  * [10 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_a_viz_Du "10 a viz Du") : deroù an 30vet [Kuzuliadeg war an hin](https://br.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kenemglev_Stern_ar_Broado%C3%B9_Unanet_war_ar_Che%C3%B1chamant_Hin&action=edit&redlink=1 "Kenemglev Stern ar Broadoù Unanet war ar Cheñchamant Hin \(n'eus ket eus ar bajenn-mañ\)") e [Belém](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bel%C3%A9m "Belém"), e [Brazil](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil "Brazil").
  * [5 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/5_a_viz_Du "5 a viz Du") : dilennet eo an demokrat [Zohran Mamdani](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zohran_Mamdani "Zohran Mamdani") da vaer nevez kêr [New York](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York "New York"), e [Stadoù-Unanet Amerika](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stado%C3%B9-Unanet_Amerika "Stadoù-Unanet Amerika").
  * [3 a viz Du](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/3_a_viz_Du "3 a viz Du") : marvet eo [Dick Cheney](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dick_Cheney "Dick Cheney"), bet [Besprezidant Stadoù-Unanet Amerika](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Besprezidant_Stado%C3%B9-Unanet_Amerika "Besprezidant Stadoù-Unanet Amerika") e-pad resped [George W. Bush](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_W._Bush "George W. Bush").

## Keleier ar Wiki  
---  
  * **War gresk** e talc’h ar [Wikipedia](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") brezhonek da vont, tamm-ha-tamm, ha tremen 90 000 pennad zo bremañ. Er 81añ renk emaomp bremañ e-touez ar raktresoù Wikipedia [[1]](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias) evit an niver a bennadoù, etre ar [belaruseg](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belaruseg "Belaruseg") hag ar [malayalameg](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malayalameg "Malayalameg"). Evit gouzout hiroc'h : **[An Deizlevr](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Deizlevr "Wikipedia:Deizlevr")**.
  * E renkadur an holloueziadurioù hervez danvez ar pennadoù emaomp en 84re plas [[2]](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias_by_sample_of_articles), etre an [mirandeg](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mirandeg "Mirandeg") hag [arabeg Egipt](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabeg_Egipt "Arabeg Egipt"). Ne labouromp ket a-walc'h da wellaat ar pennadoù a zo bet boulc'het, hag un toullad pennadoù diazez a vank c’hoazh d’hor Wiki [[3]](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias_by_sample_of_articles/Absent_Articles#br_Brezhoneg), evel [nerzh](https://br.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nerzh&action=edit&redlink=1 "Nerzh \(n'eus ket eus ar bajenn-mañ\)") pe [hormon](https://br.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Hormon&action=edit&redlink=1 "Hormon \(n'eus ket eus ar bajenn-mañ\)") ha meur a hini all c'hoazh. Taolit ur sell ouzh [roll ar pennadoù a ra diouer d’ar Wiki-mañ](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pennado%C3%B9_a_ra_diouer_d%27ar_Wiki-ma%C3%B1 "Wikipedia:Pennadoù a ra diouer d'ar Wiki-mañ"). Gallout a ra pep hini ac’hanomp klask sevel ar pennadoù a vank dimp. Mankout a ra dimp ivez [pennadoù hir](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias_by_sample_of_articles) (n'hon eus nemet [224](https://br.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Dibar:Pajenno%C3%B9Hir&limit=50&offset=200) evit ar mare).
  * **Evit kaozeal** diwar-benn kement tra a denn d'ar Wikipedia brezhonek, gouzout petra zo nevez, reiñ ho soñj, kit bep an amzer d'ober un dro betek **[Tavarn ar wikipedourien](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Kumuniezh/An_davarn "Wikipedia:Kumuniezh/An davarn")**.
  * Taolit ur sell ouzh [**ar pennadoù nevez-voulc'het**](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dibar:Pajenno%C3%B9Nevez "Dibar:PajennoùNevez") gant hor c'henlabourerien ha roit dorn d’o reizhañ, d’o gwellaat, d’o astenn, d’o fonnusaat. Gallout a ra neb a gar degas kemmoù d’ar pennadoù ma vank traoù enno, pe ma'z eus mankoù enno. Ma n’oc’h ket asur eus an doare da ober, sellit ouzh [Skoazell:Penaos kemmañ ur bajenn](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skoazell:Penaos_kemma%C3%B1_ur_bajenn "Skoazell:Penaos kemmañ ur bajenn"), pe c’hoazh ouzh [Wikipedia:Fazioù stankañ](https://br.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Fazio%C3%B9_stanka%C3%B1 "Wikipedia:Fazioù stankañ").
  * E-touez ar raktresoù kar da hini Wikipedia, emañ hini ar [Wikimammenn](https://br.wikisource.org/wiki/Wikimammenn:Degemer "s:Wikimammenn:Degemer"), un dastumad levrioù brezhonek, kuit a wirioù, pe c’hoazh hini ar [Wikeriadur](https://br.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wikeriadur:Degemer "wikt:Wikeriadur:Degemer"). Kit da deurel ur sell outo !

«Википеди» ирĕклĕ энциклопединчи материал
|  [Википедине](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8 "Википеди") килĕрех!  
  
Википеди — тĕрлĕ чĕлхеллĕ [вики](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8 "Вики")-технологипе ĕçлекен ирĕклĕ энциклопеди. [Чăваш уйрăмĕ](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%C4%83%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%88_%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B9%C4%95 "Чăваш Википедийĕ") 2004 çулхи чӳкĕн 22-мĕшĕнче уçăлнă. Ырă кăмăллă мĕнпур çынна хамăр пата Википедире ĕçлеме чĕнетпĕр! Халĕ пирĕн энциклопединче **[58 184](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8:%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Википеди:Статистика")** статья. Кашни хутшăнакан Википедири статьясене [тӳрлетме](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8:%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8C%D1%8F%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5_%D1%82%D3%B3%D1%80%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8_%C3%A7%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BD "Википеди:Статьясене тӳрлетесси çинчен") е çĕнĕрен пуçлама пултарать. Эсир Википедие анлă та тарăн хыпарпа пуянлатасса чун-чĕререн шанатпăр. |

---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/57/%D0%AE%D1%80%D1%96%D0%B9_%D0%86_%D0%9B%D1%8C%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87.png/250px-%D0%AE%D1%80%D1%96%D0%B9_%D0%86_%D0%9B%D1%8C%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87.png)](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D3%B2%D0%BA%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BA:%D0%AE%D1%80%D1%96%D0%B9_%D0%86_%D0%9B%D1%8C%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87.png)[Юрий I Львович](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%AE%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B9_I_%D0%9B%D1%8C%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87?action=edit&redlink=1 "Юрий I Львович \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") королĕн пичет аверсĕ çинче «Regis Rusiae» — _Руç королĕ_ тесе çырнă. **Руç коро́лĕ́** ([лат.](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD_%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BB%D1%85%D0%B8 "Латтин чĕлхи") _Rex Russiae_ е _Rusiae_) — Анăç Европăри вăтам ĕмĕрсенчи документсенче тата нарративлă çăлкуçсенче [вырăс](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%83%C3%A7 "Руç") тытăмçисене асăннă чухне ускурнă титул. Хăшпĕр тытăмçăсене ăна йышăнма сĕннĕ. Çак титула илнĕ пĕртен-пĕр тĕслĕх — [галич-волынь кнеçĕ](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8-%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C_%D0%BA%D0%BD%D0%B5%C3%A7%D0%BB%C4%95%D1%85%C4%95?action=edit&redlink=1 "Галици-Волынь кнеçлĕхĕ \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") [Даниил Галицкий](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8_%D0%94%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B8%D0%BB%C4%95?action=edit&redlink=1 "Галици Даниилĕ \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") (1253 çул). [Александр Филюшкин](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8E%D1%88%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BD_%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80_%D0%98%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B8%D1%87?action=edit&redlink=1 "Филюшкин Александр Ильич \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") каланипе, Руç политикин культуринче çак титул вырнаçанайман, «вырăс историнче тĕлĕнтермĕшлĕ эпизод евĕр ĕмĕлкеленсе иртсе кайнă». Титул, çапах та, [Кăнтăр-Анăç Руçĕнче поляксен влаçне](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8F%D0%BA_%D0%A0%D1%83%C3%A7%C4%95?action=edit&redlink=1 "Поляк Руçĕ \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") çирĕплетнĕ ĕç-пуçра паллă роле вылянă. _[Руç королĕ](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%83%C3%A7_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BB%C4%95 "Руç королĕ")_
* * *
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/10/Sherpa.jpg/330px-Sherpa.jpg)](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D3%B2%D0%BA%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BA:Sherpa.jpg)Шерп килйышĕ. **Ше́рпсем** , пĕр. хисепре **шерп** е **шерпа** ([тиб.](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%B8%D0%B1%D0%B5%D1%82_%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BB%D1%85%D0%B8?action=edit&redlink=1 "Тибет чĕлхи \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") ཤར་བ་, [вайли](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB%D0%B8 "Вайли") shar pa ‘тухăç çыннисем') — Тухăç [Непалри](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B5%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%BB "Непал"), [Джомолунгма](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Джомолунгма") тăвĕ таврашĕнче, çаплах [Индире](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B8 "Инди") пурăнакан халăхлăх. Тăван ячĕ — _шаркхомбо_. Шерпсен чĕлхи — [кангпо](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%BF%D0%BE?action=edit&redlink=1 "Кангпо \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") — [тибет-бирма чĕлхисен](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%B8%D0%B1%D0%B5%D1%82-%D0%B1%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%B0_%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BB%D1%85%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC?action=edit&redlink=1 "Тибет-бирма чĕлхисем \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") кăнтăр турачĕ йышне кĕрет; çапах та ытти Тибет чĕлхисенчен питĕ уйрăлса тăрать. Ытларахăшĕ Непалăн тухăç регионĕсенче пурăнать; хăшпĕррисем анăçарах, Ролвалинг (_Rolwaling_) айлăмĕнче тата [Катмандуран](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%83?action=edit&redlink=1 "Катманду \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") çурçĕререх [Хеламбура](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A5%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B1%D1%83?action=edit&redlink=1 "Хеламбу \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") вырнаçнă. Непалри шерпсен чи авалхи ялĕ — [Тенгбоче](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%B1%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%B5 "Тенгбоче"). Шерпсем — [вăтам ĕмĕрсенче](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%C4%83%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BC_%C4%95%D0%BC%C4%95%D1%80%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Вăтам ĕмĕрсем") [Тĕп Гималай ту хысакĕнчен](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B9 "Гималай") кăнтăралла куçса килнĕ [тибетçĕсен](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%B8%D0%B1%D0%B5%D1%82%C3%A7%C4%95%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Тибетçĕсем") еткерĕсем. _[Шерпсем](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BF%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Шерпсем")…_ _…_ _[Ытти суйласа илнĕ статьясем](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8:%D0%A1%D1%83%D0%B9%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B0_%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BD%C4%95_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8C%D1%8F%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Википеди:Суйласа илнĕ статьясем")_

  * [1425](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1425 "1425") — [Мартин V](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD_V?action=edit&redlink=1 "Мартин V \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") папа [Бельгири](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B3%D0%B8 "Бельги") ватă [Католици Лёван университетне](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8_%D0%9B%D1%83%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%87%C4%95_\(1968_%C3%A7%D1%83%D0%BB%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BD\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Католици Лувен университечĕ \(1968 çулчен\) \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") йĕркелет (_капăрл._)
  * [1824](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1824 "1824") — [Аякучо патĕнче](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%8F%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%87%D0%BE_%D0%BF%D0%B0%D1%82%C4%95%D0%BD%D1%87%D0%B8_%C3%A7%D0%B0%D0%BF%C4%83%C3%A7%D1%83?action=edit&redlink=1 "Аякучо патĕнчи çапăçу \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") [Перу](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%83 "Перу") ирĕклĕхĕшĕн кĕрешекен пăлхавçăсем çĕнтернĕ
  * [1903](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1903 "1903") — [Франци парламенчĕ](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%87%C4%95?action=edit&redlink=1 "Франци парламенчĕ \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") пĕр сасăллă пулса хĕрарăмсене [суйлавсенче сасăлама права парас](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A5%C4%95%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%80%C4%83%D0%BC%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D1%81%D1%83%D0%B9%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B2_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B8?action=edit&redlink=1 "Хĕрарăмсен суйлав прави \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") саккун проектне хирĕçленĕ
  * [1905](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1905 "1905") — [А. Бриан](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B0%D0%BD_%D0%90%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B4?action=edit&redlink=1 "Бриан Аристид \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") инициативипе [Францире](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B8 "Франци") [чиркĕве патшалăхран уйăрас](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%BA%C4%95%D0%B2%D0%B5_%D0%BF%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%88%D0%B0%D0%BB%C4%83%D1%85%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD_%D1%83%D0%B9%D1%80%C4%83%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%B8?action=edit&redlink=1 "Чиркĕве патшалăхран уйрăлни \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") [саккуна йышăннă](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1905%20French%20law%20on%20the%20Separation%20of%20the%20Churches%20and%20the%20State "en:1905 French law on the Separation of the Churches and the State")
  * [1968](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1968 "1968") — [Дуглас Энгелбарт](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D1%83%D0%B3%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%81_%D0%AD%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82?action=edit&redlink=1 "Дуглас Энгелбарт \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") хăйĕн лабораторинче шутласа кăларнă [компьютер шăшипе](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BF%D1%8C%D1%8E%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80_%D1%88%C4%83%D1%88%D0%B8?action=edit&redlink=1 "Компьютер шăши \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") [гипертекста](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D1%82 "Гипертекст") ĕçлеттерсе кăтартнă
  * [1990](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990 "1990") — [Лех Валенса](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%B0_%D0%9B%D0%B5%D1%85?action=edit&redlink=1 "Валенса Лех \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") [Польшăн](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%88%D0%B0 "Польша") пĕрремĕш [пĕтĕм халăх суйланă президенчĕ](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%88%C4%83%D1%80%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82_%D1%81%D1%83%D0%B9%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B2%C4%95_\(1990\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Польшăри президент суйлавĕ \(1990\) \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") пулса тăрать
  * [2005](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/2005 "2005") — [Лондонра](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD "Лондон") эксплуатацирен юлашки [«Рутмастерсене»](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%83%D1%82%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80?action=edit&redlink=1 "Рутмастер \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)") кăларнă
  * [2006](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006 "2006") — [мускав наркологи пульницинчи вут-кăвар тухни](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B2_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8_%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%87%D0%B8_%D0%B2%D1%83%D1%82-%D0%BA%C4%83%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%80_%D1%82%D1%83%D1%85%D0%BD%D0%B8?action=edit&redlink=1 "Мускав наркологи пульницинчи вут-кăвар тухни \(хальлӗхе хатӗрлемен-ха\)"), 45 çын сарăмсăр вилнĕ _[татах...](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D1%88%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%B2,_9 "Раштав, 9")_

**Суйласа илмен. Ку Сирĕн тивĕç!**  
_[Суйласа илнĕ эрне статьисем](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8:%D0%AD%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B5_%C4%95%C3%A7%C4%95%D0%BD_%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B0%D1%87%C4%95%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Википеди:Эрне ĕçĕн кандидачĕсем")_  
|  |  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/8f/Bluebg_rounded2.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/74/PL_Wiki_InM_ikona.svg/40px-PL_Wiki_InM_ikona.svg.png)

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2a/Xylaria_hypoxylon_%28candlestick_fungus%29_location%2C_Val_Sinestra._14-10-2024._%28actm.%29_01.jpg/500px-Xylaria_hypoxylon_%28candlestick_fungus%29_location%2C_Val_Sinestra._14-10-2024._%28actm.%29_01.jpg)](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D3%B2%D0%BA%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BA:Xylaria_hypoxylon_\(candlestick_fungus\)_location,_Val_Sinestra._14-10-2024._\(actm.\)_01.jpg)Гриб Xylaria hypoxylon, Валь-Синестра, Зент, Граубюнден, Швейцария  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/8f/Bluebg_rounded2.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f4/PL_Wiki_CzyWiesz_ikona.svg/40px-PL_Wiki_CzyWiesz_ikona.svg.png)  
_Википедири çĕнĕ статьясенчен:_ [![Brookesia nana](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/62/Kalambaka.jpg/250px-Kalambaka.jpg)](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D3%B2%D0%BA%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%87%C4%95%D0%BA:Kalambaka.jpg "Brookesia nana")Brookesia nana
  * **[Ассасинсем](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Ассасинсем")** хӑйсен тӗллевӗсене пурнӑҫланӑ май уҫҫӑн ҫапӑҫман, вӑрттӑн ӗҫленӗ.
  * **[Хирургилле сиплени](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A5%D0%B8%D1%80%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B5_%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B2 "Хирургилле сиплев")** операци умӗнхи тапхӑртан, операцирен тата операци хыҫҫӑнхи тапхӑртан тӑрать.
  * 2000 ҫулта [Чхаттисгарх](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D1%85%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%85 "Чхаттисгарх") штат валли ҫӗр уйӑриччен **[Мадхья-Прадеш](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%B4%D1%85%D1%8C%D1%8F-%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B5%D1%88 "Мадхья-Прадеш")** Индире лаптӑкпа чи пысӑк штат пулнӑ.
  * **[Чӑваш кӗрешӗвне](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%C4%83%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%88_%D0%BA%C4%95%D1%80%D0%B5%D1%88%C4%95%D0%B2%C4%95 "Чăваш кĕрешĕвĕ")** Раҫҫейри спорт тӗсӗсен йышне кӗртме [Н. В. Фёдоров](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D1%91%D0%B4%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2_%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B9_%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Фёдоров Николай Васильевич") президент пулӑшнӑ.
  * [Ульянов Пётр Лаврентьевич](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%8F%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2_%D0%9F%D1%91%D1%82%D1%80_%D0%9B%D0%B0%D0%B2%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D1%8C%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Ульянов Пётр Лаврентьевич") (1920–1991) математик Сарӑту облаҫӗнчи **[Слепцовка](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BF%D1%86%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Слепцовка")** ялӗнче ҫуралнӑ.
  * Америкӑн Пӗрлешӳллӗ Штачӗсенче ыттисенчен малтан пичетленнӗ **[хӗрарӑм-карикатурист](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%BE%D1%83%D0%B7_%D0%9E'%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB "Роуз О'Нил")** [Кьюпи](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%8C%D1%8E%D0%BF%D0%B8 "Кьюпи") комикспа палӑрнӑ.
  * **[«Викен»](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B5%D0%BD_\(%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%85%D0%B8_%D1%82%D3%91%D1%80%D3%91%D1%85\) "Викен \(авалхи тӑрӑх\)")** ятлӑ тӑрӑхран «Викинг» сӑмах пулнӑ текен верси пур, анчах вӑл йӑнӑш.
  * **[Каламбакӑран](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B1%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Каламбака")** (сӑн ҫинче) ҫурҫӗрелле ту хысакӗсем пур, вӗсен тӑррисем ҫинче Метеора православи мӑнастирӗсем вырнаҫнӑ.
  * **[«Антарктикăри истори»](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BA%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BA%C4%83%D1%80%D0%B8_%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B8 "Антарктикăри истори")** илемлӗ фильма 1958 ҫулта иртнӗ яппунсен антарктика экспедицине тӗпе хурса ӳкернӗ.
  * **[Павел Филонов](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2_%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BB_%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Филонов Павел Николаевич")** вырӑс художникне сума суса 2018 ҫулта Мускаври [пӗр бульвара](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BB_%D0%A4%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2_%D0%B1%D1%83%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%80%C4%95 "Павел Филонов бульварĕ") унӑн ятне панӑ.

_**[Википедире епле ĕçлемеллине](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%9F:%D0%A1%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B0 "ru:ВП:Справка") тĕплĕн Википедин [вырăс уйрăмĕнче](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%8B%D1%80%C4%83%D1%81_%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B9%C4%95 "Вырăс Википедийĕ") ăнлантарса панă.**_ Чăваш Википедине тӳрлетме хăтлăрах пулмашкăн хăвăрăн компьютер çине [чăваш сарăмне](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%C4%83%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%88_%D0%BF%D1%83%D1%81%D0%BA%C4%83%D1%87_%D1%85%C4%83%D0%BC%D0%B8%D0%BD_%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%C4%83%D0%BF%C4%95%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BC "Чăваш пускăч хăмин калăпĕсем") лартмалла. Ăна епле лартмалли пирки [кунта](http://ru.chuvash.org/e/d0a3d181d182d0b0d0bdd0bed0b2d0bad0b020d187d183d0b2d0b0d188d181d0bad0bed0b920d180d0b0d181d0bad0bbd0b0d0b4d0bad0b8) ăнлантарса панă. Çавăн пекех сире Arial Unicode MS е Code2000 шрифчĕ кирлĕ пулĕ, вĕсене Unicode сарăмĕсенче усă курма пулать. Енчен те сирĕн [Windows XP](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_XP "Windows XP") е [Windows 2000](https://cv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_2000 "Windows 2000") операци системи пур пулсан, ĕçлеме питĕ ансат пулĕччĕ. Эхер те сирĕн комьютерăн чăваш сарăмĕ çук пулсан е унпа усă курма меллĕ мар пулсан, хăвăра май текста вырнаçтарма пултаратăр (тĕслĕхрен, ă вырăнне а, ĕ — е, ç — с, ӳ — у çырма пултаратăр), е латин сасă паллисемпе усă курăр. Эсир çырнине ытти хутшăнакансем тӳрлетĕç.

Oddi ar Wicipedia
# Croeso i [Wicipedia](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicipedia "Wicipedia")
y [gwyddoniadur](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gwyddoniadur "Gwyddoniadur") [rhydd](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynnwys_rhydd "Cynnwys rhydd") ac [agored](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicipedia:Cyflwyniad "Wicipedia:Cyflwyniad"),   
gyda [283,841](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arbennig:Statistics "Arbennig:Statistics") o erthyglau [Cymraeg](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cymraeg "Cymraeg")
**A wyddoch chi?** Yn ogystal â darllen y gwyddoniadur, gallwch ein cynorthwyo i'w ddatblygu a'i wella! Gall unrhyw un olygu unrhyw erthygl drwy glicio ar y gair **"Golygu"** ar ei brig. Os nad ydyw'n bodoli eto, gallwch greu un newydd! 
## Pigion
[![William Shakespeare](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a2/Shakespeare.jpg/500px-Shakespeare.jpg)](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delwedd:Shakespeare.jpg "William Shakespeare")William Shakespeare
Bardd a dramodydd [Saesneg](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saesneg "Saesneg") oedd **[William Shakespeare](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Shakespeare "William Shakespeare")** (c. [23 Ebrill](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/23_Ebrill "23 Ebrill") [1564](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1564 "1564") - [23 Ebrill](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/23_Ebrill "23 Ebrill") [1616](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1616 "1616")), a anwyd yn Stratford-upon-Avon, Lloegr. 
Credir iddo fynychu _King Edward VI Grammar School_ lle y byddai wedi dysgu'r rhan fwyaf o'r technegau sydd eu hangen i ysgrifennu. Priododd Anne Hathway, o Stratford a chawsant dri o blant: Hamnet, Judith a Susannah. pan oedd oedd yn 18 mlwydd oed. Does dim llawer o hanes i gael am William Shakespeare yn ystod y [1580au](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1580au "1580au"), felly cyfeirir at y cyfnod hwnnw fel "y blynyddoedd coll". 
Ymhlith ei ddramâu enwocaf y mae: _[Romeo a Juliet](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romeo_a_Juliet "Romeo a Juliet")_ , _[Macbeth](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macbeth_\(drama\) "Macbeth \(drama\)")_ , _[King Lear](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Lear "King Lear")_ , _[Hamlet](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hamlet "Hamlet")_ ac _[Othello](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Othello "Othello")_ [mwy...](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Shakespeare "William Shakespeare")
**[Rhagor o bigion](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicipedia:Pigion "Wicipedia:Pigion")**
## Cymraeg
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/dc/Flag_of_Wales.svg/250px-Flag_of_Wales.svg.png)](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicipedia:Cymraeg "Wicipedia:Cymraeg")
**You don't speak Cymraeg?** Welsh (Cymraeg) is a member of the Celtic family of languages. It is spoken in the western part of Britain known as Wales, as well as in the Chubut Valley, a Welsh immigrant colony in the Patagonia region of Argentina. There are also speakers of Welsh in England, the United States, Australia and other countries throughout the world. Welsh and English are the official languages in Wales. 
**¿No hablas Cymraeg?** El galés (Cymraeg) es un idioma céltico hablado como lengua principal en el País de Gales, región occidental del Reino Unido, y además en Chubut, comunidad de la región de Patagonia en Argentina. Hay gente que habla galés en Inglaterra, en Estados Unidos, en Australia y en otros países del mundo también. Con el inglés, es uno de los dos idiomas oficiales de Gales. 
**Vous ne parlez pas Cymraeg?** Le gallois (Cymraeg) est une langue celtique, parlée au Pays de Galles (Grande-Bretagne) et au val de Chubut en Patagonie, province de l'Argentine. Il y a des gallophones en Angleterre, aux États-Unis et en Australie ainsi qu'en d'autres pays du monde. Avec l'anglais, c'est une des deux langues officielles du Pays de Galles. 
[**Alemannisch, العربية, Bahasa Melayu, Bân-lâm-gú, Brezhoneg, Български, Català, Česky, Dansk, Deutsch, Dolnoserbski, Eesti, English, Español, Esperanto, Euskara, Français, Frysk, Gaeilge, Gàidhlig. Galego, Hornjoserbsce, 한국어, Bahasa Indonesia, Íslenska, Italiano, עברית, Kapampangan, Kölsch...**](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicipedia:Cymraeg "Wicipedia:Cymraeg")
## Ar y dydd hwn
[![Ada Lovelace](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f7/Carpenter_portrait_of_Ada_Lovelace_-_detail.png/120px-Carpenter_portrait_of_Ada_Lovelace_-_detail.png)](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delwedd:Carpenter_portrait_of_Ada_Lovelace_-_detail.png "Ada Lovelace")
Ada Lovelace
**[10 Rhagfyr](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_Rhagfyr "10 Rhagfyr")** : Diwrnod Rhyngwladol **[Hawliau Dynol](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hawliau_dynol "Hawliau dynol")**
  * **[1198](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1198 "1198")** (827 mlynedd yn ôl) – bu farw'r athronydd o [Al-Andalus](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al-Andalus "Al-Andalus") ([Andalucía](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andaluc%C3%ADa "Andalucía") fodern), **[Averroes](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Averroes "Averroes")** (Ibn Rushd)
  * **[1610](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1610 "1610")** (415 mlynedd yn ôl) – dienyddiwyd y merthyr [Catholig](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yr_Eglwys_Gatholig "Yr Eglwys Gatholig") Cymreig **[John Roberts](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Roberts_\(sant\) "John Roberts \(sant\)")** yn [Tyburn](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyburn "Tyburn"), ger [Llundain](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Llundain "Llundain")
  * **[1631](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1631 "1631")** (394 mlynedd yn ôl) – bu farw Syr **[Hugh Myddelton](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugh_Myddelton "Hugh Myddelton")** , [Dinbych](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dinbych "Dinbych"), y gŵr a greodd system ddŵr Llundain
  * **[1815](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1815 "1815")** (210 mlynedd yn ôl) – ganwyd **[Ada Lovelace](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace "Ada Lovelace")** ; ystyrir mai hi oedd y rhaglennydd cyfrifiaduron cyntaf
  * **[1896](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1896 "1896")** (129 mlynedd yn ôl) – bu farw'r cemegydd o [Sweden](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sweden "Sweden") **[Alfred Nobel](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel")** , sylfaenydd [Gwobrau Nobel](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gwobr_Nobel "Gwobr Nobel")
  * **[1948](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/1948 "1948")** (77 mlynedd yn ôl) – mabwysiadwyd **[Datganiad Cyffredinol am Hawliau Dynol](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Datganiad_Cyffredinol_am_Hawliau_Dynol "Datganiad Cyffredinol am Hawliau Dynol")** gan Gyngor Cyffredinol [y Cenhedloedd Unedig](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Y_Cenhedloedd_Unedig "Y Cenhedloedd Unedig")


**[Rhagor o ‘Ar y dydd hwn’](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wicipedia:Ar_y_dydd_hwn/Rhagfyr "Wicipedia:Ar y dydd hwn/Rhagfyr")** – **[Rhestr dyddiau'r flwyddyn](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhestr_dyddiau%27r_flwyddyn "Rhestr dyddiau'r flwyddyn")** – **[Materion cyfoes](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Categori:Materion_cyfoes "Categori:Materion cyfoes")**

## Chwaer brosiectau Wicipedia
Mae [Sefydliad Wikimedia](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sefydliad_Wikimedia "Sefydliad Wikimedia") (_Wikimedia Foundation_) yn darparu nifer o [brosiectau ar-lein rhydd eraill](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Categori:Prosiectau_Wicimedia "Categori:Prosiectau Wicimedia") yn ogystal â Wicipedia, trwy gyfrwng mwy na 280 o ieithoedd. Maent i gyd yn [wicïau](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wici "Wici"), sy'n golygu bod pawb yn cael eu hysgrifennu, eu golygu, a'u darllen. Sefydlwyd Wikimedia yn 2003 gan [Jimmy Wales](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales "Jimmy Wales"), ac fe'i gweinyddir yn [Fflorida](https://cy.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fflorida "Fflorida"). ##  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1b/Jump-to-top_icon.svg/20px-Jump-to-top_icon.svg.png)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Hauptseite#top "Nach oben")Artikel des Tages
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cf/Praxisbeispiel-Dollarabwertung.png/250px-Praxisbeispiel-Dollarabwertung.png)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Datei:Praxisbeispiel-Dollarabwertung.png "Praxisbeispiel Dollarabwertung")
Die **[J-Kurve](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/J-Kurve "J-Kurve")** oder der **J-Kurven-Effekt** ist eine wirtschaftstheoretische Hypothese, die im Zeitverlauf die Auswirkungen einer realen Abwertung der inländischen Währung auf den Außenbeitrag eines Landes in einer offenen Volkswirtschaft beschreibt. Kurzfristig ist der Effekt auf die Leistungsbilanz negativ (Importwert > Exportwert); erst im Zeitverlauf führt eine reale Abwertung der Inlandswährung zu der gewünschten Verbesserung der Leistungsbilanz. Die Kurve trägt ihren Namen aufgrund ihrer Ähnlichkeit zum Buchstaben J. Einen Beweis für die praktische Relevanz des J-Kurven-Effektes stellen die US-amerikanischen Nettoexporte im Zeitraum zwischen 1984 und 1991 dar. Zu Beginn der 80er Jahre kam es in den USA zu einer starken Aufwertung des Dollars und einer sich stark verschlechternden Leistungsbilanz. Obwohl von 1985 auf 1986 eine rapide Abwertung des Dollars und somit eine schnelle Kursverschlechterung erfolgte, verschlechterte sich die Leistungsbilanz weiter. Erst 1987 kam es schließlich zu der erhofften Verbesserung. In der Abbildung ist die Ähnlichkeit der Nettoexporte im Zeitverlauf mit dem Buchstaben J gut zu erkennen. – _[Zum Artikel …](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/J-Kurve "J-Kurve")_

##  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1b/Jump-to-top_icon.svg/20px-Jump-to-top_icon.svg.png)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Hauptseite#top "Nach oben")Was geschah am 10. Dezember?
  * [1625](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/1625 "1625") – [Melchior Barthel](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melchior_Barthel "Melchior Barthel"), deutscher [Bild­hauer](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bildhauerei "Bildhauerei") des [Barock](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barock "Barock") und über­wiegend in [Venedig](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venedig "Venedig") tätig, wird in [Dresden](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dresden "Dresden") geboren.
  * [1725](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/1725 "1725") – [Nicolas Hartsoeker](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicolas_Hartsoeker "Nicolas Hartsoeker"), niederländischer Instru­menten­bauer, Mathe­matiker und Physiker, der auch für einen Beitrag zur [Embryo­logie](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Embryologie "Embryologie") bekannt ist, stirbt in [Utrecht](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Utrecht "Utrecht").
  * [1845](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/1845 "1845") – Der schottische Erfinder [Robert William Thomson](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_William_Thomson "Robert William Thomson") erhält ein [Patent](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patent "Patent") für einen [vulka­nisierten](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vulkanisation "Vulkanisation"), von ihm als „Aerial Wheel“ bezeich­neten [Luftreifen](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reifen "Reifen").
  * [![Farbiges Bild / kolorierte Fotografie des Hochhauses mit Nachbargebäuden](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/45/New_York_World_Building_New_York_City.jpg/120px-New_York_World_Building_New_York_City.jpg)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Datei:New_York_World_Building_New_York_City.jpg "Das New York World Building \(Bildmitte\) in Lower Manhattan, ca. 1900/1905")
[1890](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/1890 "1890") – In Lower Man­hattan wird für einen Zeitungs­verlag das [New York World Building](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_World_Building "New York World Building") (Bild, im Zentrum) fertig­gestellt, mit 94 Me­tern Dach­höhe das erste Gebäude, das die dortige [Trinity Church](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trinity_Church_\(New_York_City\) "Trinity Church \(New York City\)") überragt.
  * [2000](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/2000 "2000") – Bei der [Präsidentschafts­wahl in Rumänien](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pr%C3%A4sidentschaftswahl_in_Rum%C3%A4nien_2000 "Präsidentschaftswahl in Rumänien 2000") setzt sich [Ion Iliescu](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ion_Iliescu "Ion Iliescu"), der elf Jahre zuvor maß­geblich an der Revo­lution gegen [Nicolae Ceaușescu](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicolae_Ceau%C8%99escu "Nicolae Ceaușescu") betei­ligt war, in einer Stich­wahl gegen den Ultra­nationa­listen [Tudor](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corneliu_Vadim_Tudor "Corneliu Vadim Tudor") durch.

##  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1b/Jump-to-top_icon.svg/20px-Jump-to-top_icon.svg.png)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Hauptseite#top "Nach oben")Schon gewusst?
[![Schwarz-weiße Abbildung einer schwarzen Frau mit weißem Tennisoberteil, die einen Pokal in der Hand hält](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6c/Ora_Mae_Washington.png/120px-Ora_Mae_Washington.png)](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Datei:Ora_Mae_Washington.png "Ora Washington \(1939\)")
  * Die Afroamerikanerin [Ora Washington](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ora_Washington "Ora Washington") galt als eine der besten Tennis­spie­lerinnen der 1930er, durfte aber nie gegen weiße Spitzen­spie­lerinnen antreten.
  * Ein Film [Martin Schliesslers](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Martin_Schliessler "Martin Schliessler") gilt als eines der ausführ­lichsten Film­doku­mente einer Berg­besteigung.
  * Trotz Hüttennähe steht auf dem Gipfel des [Hochwieslers](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hochwiesler "Hochwiesler") nie ein Wanderer.
  * In dem Buch _[Mit Männern leben. Überlegungen zum Pelicot-Prozess](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mit_M%C3%A4nnern_leben._%C3%9Cberlegungen_zum_Pelicot-Prozess "Mit Männern leben. Überlegungen zum Pelicot-Prozess")_ analy­siert die Philo­sophin Manon Garcia das Sexualitäts­verständnis von Männern.

ވިކިޕީޑިއާ، މިނިވަން އެކުމާފާނުން
ދިވެހި [ވީކިޕީޑިއާ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A9%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7 "ވީކިޕީޑިއާ") އަށް މަރުޙަބާ،
މި[އެކުމާފާނަކީ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%87%DE%AC%DE%86%DE%AA%DE%89%DE%A7%DE%8A%DE%A7%DE%82%DE%AA "އެކުމާފާނު") ކޮންމެ ބޭފުޅަކަށް ވެސް މިނިވަންކަމާ އެކު އުނިއިތުރު ގެނެވޭނެ އެކުމާފާނެކެވެ.
މިހާތަނަށް ދިވެހިބަހުން ޝާއިޢު ކުރެވިފައިވާ [ލިޔުމުގެ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%9A%DE%A7%DE%87%DE%B0%DE%90%DE%A6:%DE%80%DE%AA%DE%83%DE%A8%DE%80%DE%A7_%DE%9E%DE%A6%DE%8A%DE%B0%DE%99%DE%A7%DE%87%DE%AC%DE%87%DE%B0 "ޚާއްސަ:ހުރިހާ ޞަފްޙާއެއް") ޢަދަދަކީ [3,192](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%9A%DE%A7%DE%87%DE%B0%DE%90%DE%A6:%DE%8C%DE%A6%DE%8A%DE%A7%DE%90%DE%B0%DE%80%DE%A8%DE%90%DE%A7%DE%84%DE%AA "ޚާއްސަ:ތަފާސްހިސާބު") އެވެ.
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e7/Cscr-featured.svg/40px-Cscr-featured.svg.png) މި ހަފްތާ އަށް ހޮވާލެވިފައިވާ ލިޔުން
```
         ފަންވަތް:ހޮވާލެވިފައިވާ ލިޔުން/2025-12-2[](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%8A%DE%A6%DE%82%DE%B0%DE%88%DE%A6%DE%8C%DE%B0:%DE%80%DE%AE%DE%88%DE%A7%DE%8D%DE%AC%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%8A%DE%A6%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%88%DE%A7_%DE%8D%DE%A8%DE%94%DE%AA%DE%82%DE%B0/2025-12-2?action=edit&redlink=1 "ފަންވަތް:ހޮވާލެވިފައިވާ ލިޔުން/2025-12-2 \(މިއީ ހުސް ޞަފްޙާއެކެވެ\)")
```

![X-office-calendar](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f4/PL_Wiki_CzyWiesz_ikona.svg/40px-PL_Wiki_CzyWiesz_ikona.svg.png)ދެނެވަޑައިގަންނަވަމުތޯ؟
```

```

[އަނޫރާ ކުމާރަ ޑިސަނަޔަކަ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Anura_Kumara_Dissanayake_2023_\(cropped\).jpg "ފައިލު:Anura Kumara Dissanayake 2023 \(cropped\).jpg")
އަނޫރާ ކުމާރަ ޑިސަނަޔަކަ
  * **[އަނޫރާ ކުމާރަ ޑިސަނަޔަކަ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%87%DE%A6%DE%82%DE%AB%DE%83%DE%A7_%DE%86%DE%AA%DE%89%DE%A7%DE%83%DE%A6_%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%90%DE%A6%DE%82%DE%A6%DE%94%DE%A6%DE%86%DE%A6?action=edit&redlink=1 "އަނޫރާ ކުމާރަ ޑިސަނަޔަކަ \(މިއީ ހުސް ޞަފްޙާއެކެވެ\)")** (ތަޞްވީރުގައި) [2024ގައި ބޭއްވި ރިޔާސީ އިންތިޙާބުން](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_%DE%87%DE%AE%DE%85%DE%AA%DE%8B%DE%AB%DE%86%DE%A6%DE%83%DE%A6%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%8E%DE%AC_%DE%83%DE%A8%DE%94%DE%A7%DE%90%DE%A9_%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%82%DE%B0%DE%8C%DE%A8%DE%99%DE%A7%DE%84%DE%AA?action=edit&redlink=1 "2024 އޮޅުދޫކަރައިގެ ރިޔާސީ އިންތިޙާބު \(މިއީ ހުސް ޞަފްޙާއެކެވެ\)") ކާމިޔާބުކުރައްވައި، އޮޅުދޫކަރައިގެ ރައީސް ކަމުގެ ހުވާކުރައްވައިފި.
  * ލުބުނާނާއި ސީރިއާގައި ހިޒްބުاللهގެ މެމްބަރުން ބޭނުންކުރާ **އިލެކްޓްރޯނިކް އާލާތްތައް ގޮވައިގެން** 42 މީހުން މަރުވެ އެތައް ހާސް ބަޔަކު ޒަޚަމްވެއްޖެއެވެ.
  * މެދުތެރޭ ޔޫރަޕްގައި **ވަރަށް ބޮޑަށް ފެންބޮޑުވުމުގެ** ސަބަބުން 25 މީހުން މަރުވެ 11 މީހަކު ގެއްލިއްޖެއެވެ.


[**ހިނގަމުންދަނީ**](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%82%DE%AC%DE%83%DE%AA:%DE%89%DE%A8%DE%80%DE%A7%DE%83%DE%AA_%DE%80%DE%A8%DE%82%DE%8E%DE%A6%DE%89%DE%AA%DE%82%DE%B0%DE%8B%DE%A7 "ނެރު:މިހާރު ހިނގަމުންދާ"): 
  * [ރަޝިޔާއިން ޔޫކްރެއިނަށް އަރައިގަތުން](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%83%DE%A6%DE%9D%DE%A8%DE%94%DE%A7%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%82%DE%B0_%DE%94%DE%AB%DE%86%DE%B0%DE%83%DE%AC%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%82%DE%A6%DE%81%DE%B0_%DE%87%DE%A6%DE%83%DE%A6%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%8E%DE%A6%DE%8C%DE%AA%DE%82%DE%B0 "ރަޝިޔާއިން ޔޫކްރެއިނަށް އަރައިގަތުން")
  * [އިސްރާއީލް–ހަމާސް ހަނގުރާމަ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%87%DE%A8%DE%90%DE%B0%DE%83%DE%A7%DE%87%DE%A9%DE%8D%DE%B0%E2%80%93%DE%80%DE%A6%DE%89%DE%A7%DE%90%DE%B0_%DE%80%DE%A6%DE%82%DE%8E%DE%AA%DE%83%DE%A7%DE%89%DE%A6 "އިސްރާއީލް–ހަމާސް ހަނގުރާމަ")
  * [ސޫދާނުގެ ދާޚިލީ ހަނގުރާމަ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%90%DE%AB%DE%8B%DE%A7%DE%82%DE%AA%DE%8E%DE%AC_%DE%8B%DE%A7%DE%9A%DE%A8%DE%8D%DE%A9_%DE%80%DE%A6%DE%82%DE%8E%DE%AA%DE%83%DE%A7%DE%89%DE%A6_\(2023%E2%80%93%DE%89%DE%A8%DE%80%DE%A7%DE%83%DE%AA\) "ސޫދާނުގެ ދާޚިލީ ހަނގުރާމަ \(2023–މިހާރު\)")


![X-office-calendar](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/71/X-office-calendar.svg/40px-X-office-calendar.svg.png) ތާރީޚުގެ ތެރެއިން ޑިސެމްބަރު މަސް
```
          **02 ޑިސެމްބަރު** - 1907[](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1907?action=edit&redlink=1 "1907 \(މިއީ ހުސް ޞަފްޙާއެކެވެ\)") :- މިއަލަނި މިސްކިތުގެ ދެކުނުގައި ހެންވޭރުގެ ކުދިންނަށް ގުރުއާން، ތާނަ، ހިސާބު ދަސްކޮށް ދިނުމަށް މަދަރުސަތުލް އިބްތިދާއިއްޔާގެ ނަމުގައި މަދަރުސާއެއް ހުޅުވުން.
```

| ވިކިޕީޑިއާގެ އެހެން ސަރަހައްދުތައް   
---  
  * **[އެހީ މޭޒު](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7:Help_desk "ވިކިޕީޑިއާ:Help desk")** — ބޭނުންކުރާނެ ގޮތާއި ނުވަތަ އުނި އިތުރުކުރާނެ ގޮތާ ބެހޭ ސުވާލުކުރާ މޭޒު.
  * **[ރެފަރެންސް މޭޒު](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7:Reference_desk "ވިކިޕީޑިއާ:Reference desk")** — ސައިކްލޮޕީޑިކް މައުޟޫޢުތަކާ ބެހޭގޮތުން ދިރާސާ ސުވާލުތައް ކުރުން.
  * **[ވިލެޖް ޕަމްޕް](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7:Village_pump "ވިކިޕީޑިއާ:Village pump")** — ޚުދު ވިކިޕީޑިއާއާ ބެހޭ މަޝްވަރާތަކަށް، ފަންނީ މައްސަލަތަކާއި ބެހޭގޮތުން ސުވާލުތައް ކުރުން.
  * **[ޢާންމު ހޮޅުއަށި](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7:Community_Portal "ވިކިޕީޑިއާ:Community Portal")** — އެޑިޓަރުންނަށް ޚާއްޞަ މަރުކަޒީ ހަބެއް، ވަސީލަތްތަކާއި، ލިންކްތަކާއި، މަސައްކަތާއި، އިޢުލާންތައް ހިމެނޭ ތަނެއް.
  * **[ސައިޓް ޚަބަރު](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7:News "ވިކިޕީޑިއާ:News")** — ވިކިޕީޑިއާ އާއި ވިކިމީޑިއާގެ ފުޅާ ހަރަކާތާ ބެހޭ ޚަބަރުތަކުގެ މަސްދަރުތައް.
  * **[ލޯކަލް އެމްބަސީ](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A8%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%95%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7:Local_Embassy "ވިކިޕީޑިއާ:Local Embassy")** — ދިވެހިބަސް ފިޔަވައި އެހެން ބަސްބަހުން ވިކިޕީޑިއާއާ ގުޅުންހުރި މުއާމަލާތްތަކަށްޓަކައި.

  
ވީކިޕީޑިއާގެ އަޚަވީ މަޝްރޫޢުތައް   
ވީކިޕީޑިއާ އަކީ ލާވިޔަފާރީ މުއައްސަސާއެއް ކަމުގައިވާ، [ވީކިމީޑިއާ ފައުންޑޭޝަން](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/%DE%88%DE%A9%DE%86%DE%A8%DE%89%DE%A9%DE%91%DE%A8%DE%87%DE%A7_%DE%8A%DE%A6%DE%87%DE%AA%DE%82%DE%B0%DE%91%DE%AD%DE%9D%DE%A6%DE%82%DE%B0 "ވީކިމީޑިއާ ފައުންޑޭޝަން") އިން ޤާއިމުކޮށްފައިވާ މިނިވަން އަދި ޢާއްމު އެކުމާފާނެކެވެ. ވީކިމީޑިއާ ފައުންޑޭޝަނުން ދުނިޔޭގެ ތަފާތު އެކި ބަސްބަހުން ލާވިޔަފާރީ ޢުޞޫލުން މަޢުލޫމާތު ފޯރުކޮށް ދިނުމުގެ އެތައް މަޝްރޫޢެއް ހިންގަމުންދެއެވެ.  |  [![ޢާއްމު](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4a/Commons-logo.svg/40px-Commons-logo.svg.png)](https://dv.wikipedia.org/wiki/commons: "ޢާއްމު") |  **[ޢާއްމު](https://commons.wikimedia.org/)**

Nyati siwo woɖe ɖe go
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/40/Jerry_Rawlings_2.jpg/250px-Jerry_Rawlings_2.jpg)](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Jerry_Rawlings_2.jpg)
**Jerry John Rawlings** si wodzi [Masa 22](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masa_22?action=edit&redlink=1 "Masa 22 \(wo me ŋlɔe haɖeke o\)"), [1947](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/1947?action=edit&redlink=1 "1947 \(wo me ŋlɔe haɖeke o\)") me, nye [Ghana](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gana "Gana") asrafomegã, yameʋukula, kple dunyahela si kplɔ dukɔa kpuie le ƒe 1979 me eye emegbe tso ƒe 1981 va se ɖe ƒe 2001 me. Exɔ ŋgɔ na asrafowo ƒe dziɖuɖu vaseɖe ƒe 1993 me eye emegbe wòwɔ dɔ zi eve abe Ghana ƒe dukplɔla si woti le demokrasimɔ nu ene. Eyae nye kplɔla si nɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi didi wu le Ghana ƒe ŋutinya me, eye wòɖu dukɔa dzi ƒe 19 sɔŋ. Etrɔ megbe le Adeɛmekpɔxe 12, 2020 me.
[Xlẽ yi edzi le afisia...](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerry_Rawlings "Jerry Rawlings")

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png)
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7e/HSbra2.svg/40px-HSbra2.svg.png)
Nyati nyuiwo
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/19/Flag_of_Ghana.svg/250px-Flag_of_Ghana.svg.png)](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Flag_of_Ghana.svg)
**Gana** nye [Afrika](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afrika "Afrika") dukɔwo dometɔ ɖeka. Ele [Afrika ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afrika_%C6%92e_%C9%A3eto%C9%96o%C6%92e?action=edit&redlink=1 "Afrika ƒe ɣetoɖoƒe \(wo me ŋlɔe haɖeke o\)") lɔƒo. Gana do liƒo kple [Togo](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Togo "Togo") kple, [Nyiɖu Ƒuta](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyi%C9%96u_%C6%91uta "Nyiɖu Ƒuta") kpakple [Burkina Faso](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_Faso "Burkina Faso"). Aƒu si woyɔna be _[Gulf of Guinea](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gulf_of_Guinea?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gulf of Guinea \(wo me ŋlɔe haɖeke o\)")_ la le eƒe anyiehe lɔƒo. Eƒe dukɔmenɔlawo ƒe xexlẽme ɖo 32,833,031 lɔƒo (2016). Woɖo Gana tso _Gold Coast_ kpakple _British Togoland_ si nɔ Fransetɔwo ƒe dziɖuɖu te la ƒe kpekpe me. Gana dukɔa xɔ dokuisinɔnɔ tso Eŋlisiawo gbɔ le Tedoxe 6 dzi, le ƒe 1957 me. Gana ƒe fiadzue nye [Accra](https://ee.wikipedia.org/wiki/Accra "Accra").
