## Artigo destacado  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c9/Otakuthon_2014-_Creeper_%2815006627906%29.jpg/250px-Otakuthon_2014-_Creeper_%2815006627906%29.jpg)](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ficheiro:Otakuthon_2014-_Creeper_\(15006627906\).jpg) _**[Minecraft](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minecraft "Minecraft")**_ é un [videoxogo](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Videoxogo "Videoxogo") de [mundo aberto](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Videoxogo_de_mundo_aberto "Videoxogo de mundo aberto") tipo _[sandbox](https://gl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Videoxogo_sandbox&action=edit&redlink=1 "Videoxogo sandbox \(a páxina aínda non existe\)")_ creado orixinalmente polo deseñador e programador [sueco](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suecia "Suecia") [Markus "Notch" Persson](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markus_Persson "Markus Persson") e desenvolvido e publicado posteriormente pola empresa fundada por el, [Mojang](https://gl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Mojang&action=edit&redlink=1 "Mojang \(a páxina aínda non existe\)").  Os aspectos creativos e de construción de _Minecraft_ permítenlles ós xogadores construír elementos a partir de cubos con diversas texturas nun mundo en [3D](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gr%C3%A1ficos_3D_por_ordenador "Gráficos 3D por ordenador") [xerado por procedementos](https://gl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Xeraci%C3%B3n_por_procedementos&action=edit&redlink=1 "Xeración por procedementos \(a páxina aínda non existe\)"). Outras actividades do xogo inclúen a exploración, a recolección de recursos, a confección de obxectos e o combate. Dispón de varios modos de xogo, incluíndo un [modo de supervivencia](https://gl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Videoxogo_de_supervivencia&action=edit&redlink=1 "Videoxogo de supervivencia \(a páxina aínda non existe\)") no que o xogador debe conseguir recursos para construír o mundo de xogo e manter a súa saúde, un [modo creativo](https://gl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Videoxogo_creativo&action=edit&redlink=1 "Videoxogo creativo \(a páxina aínda non existe\)") no que os recursos son ilimitados e o xogador ten a capacidade de voar, un modo de aventuras que permite xogar niveis e mapas creados por outros xogadores e un modo espectador no que os xogadores poden voar e observar o mundo pero sen interactuar con el. A versión para [PC](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/PC "PC") do xogo destaca pola súa comunidade de _[modding](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mod_\(videoxogos\) "Mod \(videoxogos\)")_. _[Outros artigos destacados](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Artigo_destacado "Wikipedia:Artigo destacado") • [Artigos de calidade](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Artigos_de_calidade "Wikipedia:Artigos de calidade")_  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/83/Blue-bg_rounded.svg/500px-Blue-bg_rounded.svg.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f4/HSGalicia.png/40px-HSGalicia.png)  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cc/Ricardo_Courtier_%28A_Coru%C3%B1a%2C_1863_%E2%80%93_Ourense%2C_1922%29.jpg/250px-Ricardo_Courtier_%28A_Coru%C3%B1a%2C_1863_%E2%80%93_Ourense%2C_1922%29.jpg)](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ficheiro:Ricardo_Courtier_\(A_Coru%C3%B1a,_1863_%E2%80%93_Ourense,_1922\).jpg) **[Ricardo Courtier](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ricardo_Courtier "Ricardo Courtier")** , nado na [Coruña](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Coru%C3%B1a "A Coruña") o [10 de marzo](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_de_marzo "10 de marzo") de [1865](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1865 "1865") e finado en [Ourense](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ourense "Ourense") o [10 de decembro](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_de_decembro "10 de decembro") de [1922](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1922 "1922"), foi un [músico](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%BAsico,_m%C3%BAsica "Músico, música") e [compositor](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Composici%C3%B3n_musical "Composición musical") [galego](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galicia "Galicia"). Nado nunha familia de músicos, é considerado o membro máis salientable da terceira xeración de músicos da saga Courtier. Logo de finalizar a súa formación instalouse na [Pobra de Trives](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Pobra_de_Trives "A Pobra de Trives"), onde foi director da [banda de música](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banda_de_m%C3%BAsica "Banda de música"). Foi precisamente nesta vila [ourensá](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provincia_de_Ourense "Provincia de Ourense") onde desenvolveu unha intensa labor fundando diversas agrupacións e compoñendo obras que serían interpretadas por estas. Posteriormente trasladouse coa súa familia á cidade de Ourense, onde residiu ata o seu falecemento, e onde foi director da Banda de Música Municipal. A súa obra salienta pola influencia da [música tradicional galega](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%BAsica_tradicional_galega "Música tradicional galega"), con harmonías sinxelas e formas típicas da [música popular](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%BAsica_popular "Música popular"). Ademais do seu labor como compositor, Ricardo Courtier realizou arranxos para as distintas agrupacións que liderou.  _[Outros artigos destacados sobre Galicia](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sobre_Galicia "Wikipedia:Sobre Galicia") • [O mes de decembro na cultura popular galega](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decembro_na_cultura_popular_galega "Decembro na cultura popular galega")_  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/83/Blue-bg_rounded.svg/500px-Blue-bg_rounded.svg.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/89/Datum09.svg/40px-Datum09.svg.png)  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/24/Pablo_Iglesias%2C_de_Compa%C3%B1y.jpg/120px-Pablo_Iglesias%2C_de_Compa%C3%B1y.jpg)](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pablo_Iglesias "Pablo Iglesias")
  * [1706](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1706 "1706"), morre [Pedro II de Bragança](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pedro_II_de_Portugal "Pedro II de Portugal"), rei de [Portugal](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portugal "Portugal"), alcumado _O Pacífico_.
  * [1925](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1925 "1925"), morre [Pablo Iglesias](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pablo_Iglesias_Posse "Pablo Iglesias Posse") (na imaxe), fundador do [PSOE](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/PSOE "PSOE") e da [UGT](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/UGT "UGT") (n. en [Ferrol](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferrol "Ferrol") en [1850](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1850 "1850")).
  * [1931](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1931 "1931"), apróbase nas [Cortes](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cortes_Xerais "Cortes Xerais") a [Constitución](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constituci%C3%B3n "Constitución") da [Segunda República Española](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Segunda_Rep%C3%BAblica_Espa%C3%B1ola "Segunda República Española").
  * [1936](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1936 "1936"), son fusilados na [Coruña](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Coru%C3%B1a "A Coruña") os [mártires de Brens](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%A1rtires_de_Brens "Mártires de Brens").
  * [1985](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1985 "1985"), na [Arxentina](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arxentina "Arxentina") dítase [sentenza](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sentenza "Sentenza") condenatoria no [Xuízo ás Xuntas Militares](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xu%C3%ADzo_%C3%A1s_Xuntas "Xuízo ás Xuntas").
  * [1989](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1989 "1989"), morre [Dolores Ibárruri](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dolores_Ib%C3%A1rruri "Dolores Ibárruri") "A Pasionaria", dirixente do [PCE](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Partido_Comunista_de_Espa%C3%B1a "Partido Comunista de España"), nada en [1895](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/1895 "1895").

A [Wikipedia](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") é unha enciclopedia universal en liña [multilingüe](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias/gl "m:List of Wikipedias/gl"), colaborativa e gratuíta. O propósito da Wikipedia é fornecer un contido [libre](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Dereitos_de_autor%C3%ADa "Wikipedia:Dereitos de autoría"), [obxectivo](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Punto_de_vista_neutral "Wikipedia:Punto de vista neutral") e [verificable](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verificabilidade "Wikipedia:Verificabilidade") que todas as persoas poidan editar e mellorar.  O proxecto está baseado en [cinco principios](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Cinco_piares "Wikipedia:Cinco piares") básicos, todo o contido está dispoñible baixo a licenza [Creative Commons BY-SA](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/deed.pt) e pode ser copiado e reutilizado baixo esta mesma licenza._[Benvida](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Benvida "Wikipedia:Benvida") • [Índice da Axuda](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Axuda "Wikipedia:Axuda")_

## Comunidade  
De acordo coas [nosas estatísticas](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Especial:Estat%C3%ADsticas "Especial:Estatísticas"), temos un total de 161 580 contas de usuario rexistradas na Galipedia, e entre elas 529 estiveron activas durante o último mes. Todas as persoas que editan a Galipedia son voluntarias, integrando unha comunidade colaborativa e coordinando os esforzos por medio de [proxectos temáticos](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikiproxecto "Wikipedia:Wikiproxecto") e diversos [espazos de conversa](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:A_Taberna "Wikipedia:A Taberna")._[Portal da comunidade](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Portal_da_comunidade "Wikipedia:Portal da comunidade") • [Políticas e normas](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pol%C3%ADticas_e_normas "Wikipedia:Políticas e normas")_

De Vouiquipèdia, l’enciclopèdia abada.
Benvegnua sus la [Vouiquipèdia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia "Vouiquipèdia") arpetana
L’encicllopèdia [libra](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Citacion_et_reus%C3%A2jo_du_contegnu_de_Vouiquip%C3%A8dia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Citacion et reusâjo du contegnu de Vouiquipèdia \(pâge inègzistenta\)") et gratuita que châcun pôt mèlyorar.
**[5 815](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sp%C3%A8ci%C3%A2l:Statistiques "Spèciâl:Statistiques")** articllos en [lengoua arpetana](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arpetan "Arpetan"), més de 62 milyons en [326 lengoues](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Liste%20des%20Wikip%C3%A9dias "meta:Liste des Wikipédias").
**[Vèrsion](https://frp.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Re%C3%A7ua_princip%C3%A2la) [enfatâbla](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enfat%C3%A2blo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Enfatâblo \(pâge inègzistenta\)")**.
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0d/Francoprovencal-Geo-Map-1.jpg)](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fichi%C3%A9r:Francoprovencal-Geo-Map-1.jpg)L’**arpetan** est na [lengoua](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengoua "Lengoua") [romana](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengoues_romanes "Lengoues romanes"). Son cârro lengouistico d’ora (l’**[Arpetania](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arpetania "Arpetania")**) s’èpate dessus três Ètats[France](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/France "France"), la [Suisse](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suisse "Suisse") et pués l’[Étalie](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89talie "Étalie").  
---  
[Vouiquipèdia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia "Vouiquipèdia") est un projèt d’encicllopèdia colèctiva en legne, univèrsâla, multilengoua et que fonccione sus lo principo du [vouiqui](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiqui "Vouiqui"). Cél projèt vise a semondre un contegnu librament rempleyâblo, netro et pués controlâblo, que châcun pôt changiér et mèlyorar. Vouiquipèdia est dèfenia per des [principos fondators](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Principos_fondators "Vouiquipèdia:Principos fondators"). Son contegnu est desot (fr) [licence Creative Commons BY-SA](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/deed.fr). Pôt étre [copiyê et rempleyê desot la méma licence](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Citacion_et_reus%C3%A2jo_du_contegnu_de_Vouiquip%C3%A8dia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Citacion et reusâjo du contegnu de Vouiquipèdia \(pâge inègzistenta\)"), desot resèrva de nen rèspèctar les condicions. Vouiquipèdia aprovisione tôs sos contegnus gratuitament, sen recllâma, et pués sen recorir a l’èxplouètacion de les balyês a sè de sos utilisators. Los rèdactors des articllos de Vouiquipèdia sont bènèvolos. Coordonont lors èfôrts u méten d’una comunôtât colaborativa, sen dirigent. | Enqu’houé, [Vouiquipèdia en arpetan](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia_en_arpetan "Vouiquipèdia en arpetan") compte  
---  
[5 815](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sp%C3%A8ci%C3%A2l:Statistiques "Spèciâl:Statistiques")  
articllos |  [30](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sp%C3%A8ci%C3%A2l:Usanci%C3%A9rs_actifs "Spèciâl:Usanciérs actifs")  
contributors encartâs actifs  
Châcun pôt d’abôrd publeyér de contegnu en legne, a condicion de rèspèctar les règlles èssencièles betâyes en place per la [Fondacion Wikimedia](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use/fr "wmf:Terms of Use/fr") et per la comunôtât[controlabilitât du contegnu](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Controlabilit%C3%A2t?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Controlabilitât \(pâge inègzistenta\)"), l’[admissibilitât des articllos](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Crit%C3%A8ros_d%E2%80%99admissibilit%C3%A2t_des_articllos?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Critèros d’admissibilitât des articllos \(pâge inègzistenta\)") et pués [gouardar na bôna façon](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:R%C3%A8glles_d%E2%80%99us%C3%A2jo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Règlles d’usâjo \(pâge inègzistenta\)"). Un mouél de pâges d’éde sont a voutra disposicion, notament por [fâre un articllo](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89de:Coment_f%C3%A2re_un_articllo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Éde:Coment fâre un articllo \(pâge inègzistenta\)"), [changiér un articllo](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89de:Coment_changi%C3%A9r_na_p%C3%A2ge?action=edit&redlink=1 "Éde:Coment changiér na pâge \(pâge inègzistenta\)") ou ben [rapondre n’émâge](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89de:Rapondre_n%E2%80%99%C3%A9m%C3%A2ge?action=edit&redlink=1 "Éde:Rapondre n’émâge \(pâge inègzistenta\)"). Éte pas sus lo balant de [posar na quèstion](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89de:Posar_na_qu%C3%A8stion "Éde:Posar na quèstion") por étre édiê dedens voutros premiérs pâs, notament dedens yon des [projèts tèmaticos](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Proj%C3%A8t:Re%C3%A7ua "Vouiquipèdia:Projèt:Reçua") ou ben dedens difèrents [èspâços de discussion](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Avenua_des_cabar%C3%A8ts_et_bistrots?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Avenua des cabarèts et bistrots \(pâge inègzistenta\)"). Les [pâges de discussion](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89de:Discussion?action=edit&redlink=1 "Éde:Discussion \(pâge inègzistenta\)") sèrvont a centralisar les rèfllèccions et les remârques que pèrmètont de mèlyorar los articllos. |  **[Ressôrses por emmodar](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89de:Emmodar?action=edit&redlink=1 "Éde:Emmodar \(pâge inègzistenta\)")**

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8e/Gaius_Cornelius_Tacitus.jpg/250px-Gaius_Cornelius_Tacitus.jpg)](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fichi%C3%A9r:Gaius_Cornelius_Tacitus.jpg) _Portrèt fictif de Tacito_ du comencement du XXémo **Tacito** [[ta.ˈsi.to]](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfab%C3%A8t_fon%C3%A8tico_ent%C3%A8rnacion%C3%A2l "Alfabèt fonètico entèrnacionâl") (_Pūblĭus Cornēlĭus Tăcĭtus Cæ(cīna Pætus)_ [[ˈpuː.bli.us kor.ˈneː.li.us ˈta.ki.tus kae̯.ˈkiː.na ˈpae̯.tus]](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfab%C3%A8t_fon%C3%A8tico_ent%C3%A8rnacion%C3%A2l "Alfabèt fonètico entèrnacionâl") en [latin](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latin "Latin")), vegnu u mondo entre-mié los ans [54](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/54?action=edit&redlink=1 "54 \(pâge inègzistenta\)") et [58](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/58?action=edit&redlink=1 "58 \(pâge inègzistenta\)") en [Gôla narbonêsa](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%B4la_narbon%C3%AAsa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gôla narbonêsa \(pâge inègzistenta\)") et môrt vers [120](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/120?action=edit&redlink=1 "120 \(pâge inègzistenta\)") ap. J.-C. dens ‘n endrêt encognu de l’[Empiro romen](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empiro_romen?action=edit&redlink=1 "Empiro romen \(pâge inègzistenta\)"), ére ‘n [historien](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Historien "Historien"), [filosofo](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filosofo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Filosofo \(pâge inègzistenta\)") et [cossiôl](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cossi%C3%B4l_\(Roma_antica\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cossiôl \(Roma antica\) \(pâge inègzistenta\)") qu’il at ben reussi coment [sènator](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A8nat_romen?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sènat romen \(pâge inègzistenta\)") [romen](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roma_antica?action=edit&redlink=1 "Roma antica \(pâge inègzistenta\)") dens la hiôta administracion empèriâla. Coment son ami [Plinio lo Joueno](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plinio_lo_Joueno "Plinio lo Joueno"), il ére un grant [orior](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orior?action=edit&redlink=1 "Orior \(pâge inègzistenta\)") brilyent et renomâ, et pués il ére asse-ben un grant [ècriven](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%88criven "Ècriven") pendent son vivent que ses três ôvres les ples importantes sont los _[Anâls](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/An%C3%A2ls_\(Tacito\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Anâls \(Tacito\) \(pâge inègzistenta\)")_ , la _[Via d’Agricola](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_vita_Agricolae?action=edit&redlink=1 "De vita Agricolae \(pâge inègzistenta\)")_ et les _[Histouères](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Histou%C3%A8res_\(Tacito\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Histouères \(Tacito\) \(pâge inègzistenta\)")_ , cronica du temps des quatro emperors [julio-gllôdiens](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julio-Gll%C3%B4diens?action=edit&redlink=1 "Julio-Gllôdiens \(pâge inègzistenta\)") aprés [Ôgusto](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%94gusto "Ôgusto"). _[Liére la suita](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tacito "Tacito")_ [Changiér](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Lumi%C3%A9re_dessus%E2%80%A6 "Vouiquipèdia:Lumiére dessus…")

_(veré dèfenicion 5 032_ [Changiér • Vêre les émâges](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:%C3%89m%C3%A2ge_du_jorn "Vouiquipèdia:Émâge du jorn")  
---  
[Novèles](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouiquip%C3%A8dia:Port%C3%A2l:Nov%C3%A8les?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vouiquipèdia:Portâl:Novèles \(pâge inègzistenta\)") [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/56/Further_European_Union_Enlargement.svg/250px-Further_European_Union_Enlargement.svg.png)](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fichi%C3%A9r:Further_European_Union_Enlargement.svg)L’ _**Union eropèèna**_ et los payis candidats presents et passâs.
  * [17 de dècembro](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/17_de_d%C3%A8cembro "17 de dècembro")**[u Tchad](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/R%C3%A8ferendon_constitucion%C3%A2l_tchadien_de_2023?action=edit&redlink=1 "Rèferendon constitucionâl tchadien de 2023 \(pâge inègzistenta\)")** et **[u Chili](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/R%C3%A8ferendon_constitucion%C3%A2l_chilien_de_2023?action=edit&redlink=1 "Rèferendon constitucionâl chilien de 2023 \(pâge inègzistenta\)")** et **[èlèccions lègislatives devanciêes](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%88l%C3%A8ccions_l%C3%A8gislatives_s%C3%A8rbes_de_2023?action=edit&redlink=1 "Èlèccions lègislatives sèrbes de 2023 \(pâge inègzistenta\)")** en [Sèrbia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A8rbia "Sèrbia").
  * [14 de dècembro](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/14_de_d%C3%A8cembro "14 de dècembro")[Consèly eropèen](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cons%C3%A8ly_erop%C3%A8en?action=edit&redlink=1 "Consèly eropèen \(pâge inègzistenta\)") balye lo fuè vèrd a l’uvèrtura de les [nègociacions d’adhèsion](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agrantissement_a_vegnir_de_l%E2%80%99Union_erop%C3%A8%C3%A8na?action=edit&redlink=1 "Agrantissement a vegnir de l’Union eropèèna \(pâge inègzistenta\)") a l’[Union eropèèna](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Union_erop%C3%A8%C3%A8na "Union eropèèna") avouéc **[l’Ucrèna](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proc%C3%A8dura_d%E2%80%99adh%C3%A8sion_de_l%E2%80%99Ucr%C3%A8na_a_l%E2%80%99Union_erop%C3%A8%C3%A8na "Procèdura d’adhèsion de l’Ucrèna a l’Union eropèèna")** et **[la Mordavia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proc%C3%A8dura_d%E2%80%99adh%C3%A8sion_de_la_Mordavia_a_l%E2%80%99Union_erop%C3%A8%C3%A8na?action=edit&redlink=1 "Procèdura d’adhèsion de la Mordavia a l’Union eropèèna \(pâge inègzistenta\)")** et pués acôrde lo [statut de candidat](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agrantissement_a_vegnir_de_l%E2%80%99Union_erop%C3%A8%C3%A8na?action=edit&redlink=1#Candidats "Agrantissement a vegnir de l’Union eropèèna \(pâge inègzistenta\)") a **[la Jorgia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proc%C3%A8dura_d%E2%80%99adh%C3%A8sion_de_la_Jorgia_a_l%E2%80%99Union_erop%C3%A8%C3%A8na "Procèdura d’adhèsion de la Jorgia a l’Union eropèèna")** _(mapa)_.
  * [11 de dècembro](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_de_d%C3%A8cembro "11 de dècembro")**[Donald Tusk](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Tusk "Donald Tusk")** est èliesu [prèsident du Consèly ux ministros de Pologne](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pr%C3%A8sident_du_Cons%C3%A8ly_ux_ministros_de_Pologne?action=edit&redlink=1 "Prèsident du Consèly ux ministros de Pologne \(pâge inègzistenta\)"), doux mês aprés les [èlèccions parlamentères](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%88l%C3%A8ccions_parlament%C3%A8res_polon%C3%A8ses_de_2023?action=edit&redlink=1 "Èlèccions parlamentères polonèses de 2023 \(pâge inègzistenta\)").
  * [24 de fevriér](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/24_de_fevri%C3%A9r "24 de fevriér")[Russia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russia "Russia") lance n’**[ofensiva militèra](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Env%C3%A2sion_de_l%E2%80%99Ucr%C3%A8na_per_la_Russia_en_2022 "Envâsion de l’Ucrèna per la Russia en 2022")** contre l’[Ucrèna](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ucr%C3%A8na "Ucrèna").
  * [21 de fevriér](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/21_de_fevri%C3%A9r "21 de fevriér")[Cort constitucionâla](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cort_constitucion%C3%A2la_\(Colombia\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cort constitucionâla \(Colombia\) \(pâge inègzistenta\)") **[lègalise l’avortament](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avortament_en_Colombia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Avortament en Colombia \(pâge inègzistenta\)")** en [Colombia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colombia "Colombia").

Més de novèles**[dessus Vouiquinovèles](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/n:Accueil "fr:n:Accueil")** [Calendriér du 9 de dècembro](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_de_d%C3%A8cembro "9 de dècembro")[Cronologia 2025](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025?action=edit&redlink=1 "2025 \(pâge inègzistenta\)") [Changiér](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mod%C3%A8lo:Re%C3%A7ua_nov%C3%A8les "Modèlo:Reçua novèles")  
---  
  * [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/45/Balt%C5%B3_gentys_12-as_am%C5%BEius.svg/250px-Balt%C5%B3_gentys_12-as_am%C5%BEius.svg.png)](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fichi%C3%A9r:Balt%C5%B3_gentys_12-as_am%C5%BEius.svg)Los _**poplos baltos**_ u [XIIémo](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/XII%C3%A9mo_si%C3%A8cllo?action=edit&redlink=1 "XIIémo siècllo \(pâge inègzistenta\)").Los premiérs **[Prussiens](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prussiens "Prussiens")** érant [baltos](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baltos "Baltos") _(mapa)_.
  * **[Margarèta d’Yueng](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margar%C3%A8ta_d%E2%80%99Yueng "Margarèta d’Yueng")** est la premiére ècriven de tèxtos en [lengoua liyonêse](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arpetan "Arpetan").
  * Los **habitents de[Sent-Treviér](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sent-Trevi%C3%A9r_\(Domba\) "Sent-Treviér \(Domba\)")** en [Domba](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domba "Domba") s’apèlont _los Utinjouès_ en [patouès dombisto](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dombisto "Dombisto").
  * **[Julo Cèsâr](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julo_C%C3%A8s%C3%A2r "Julo Cèsâr")** est l’ôtor d’un [trètâ](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tr%C3%A8t%C3%A2_\(lit%C3%A8ratura\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Trètâ \(litèratura\) \(pâge inègzistenta\)") de [gramère](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gram%C3%A8re?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gramère \(pâge inègzistenta\)") sus l’[analogia](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Analogia?action=edit&redlink=1#Gram%C3%A8re_et_lengouistica "Analogia \(pâge inègzistenta\)").
  * **[Vers-chiéz-los-Rês](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vers-chi%C3%A9z-los-R%C3%AAs "Vers-chiéz-los-Rês")** est lo nom en [patouès vôdouès](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%B4dou%C3%A8s "Vôdouès") de [Villars-Burquin](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Villars-Burquin "fr:Villars-Burquin").
  * Lo **[quatro-èpiéces](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quatro-%C3%A8pi%C3%A9ces?action=edit&redlink=1 "Quatro-èpiéces \(pâge inègzistenta\)")** pôt asse-ben vegnir d’una solèta èpiéce que d’un mouél.
  * L’**[ELS](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enstitut_de_la_Lengoua_Savoy%C3%A2rda "Enstitut de la Lengoua Savoyârda")** est n’associacion [franco](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/France "France")-[savoyârda](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savou%C3%A8 "Savouè") que vôt promovêr et difusar la [lengoua savoyârda](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savoy%C3%A2rd "Savoyârd"), na variètât de l’[arpetan](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arpetan "Arpetan") prègiêe en [Savouè](https://frp.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savou%C3%A8 "Savouè").

O Uicipeid
**Fàilte gu[Uicipeid](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uicipeid "Uicipeid") na Gàidhlig – an [leabhar-eòlais](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leabhar-e%C3%B2lais "Leabhar-eòlais") a tha fosgailte do dhuine sam bith!**
Thòisich sinn anns [an t-Sultain](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/An_t-Sultain "An t-Sultain"), [2003](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/2003 "2003"), agus tha sinn a-nis ag obair air **[16,019](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B2nraichte:Statistics "Sònraichte:Statistics")** [aistidhean](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uicipeid:D%C3%A8_tha_ann_an_aiste "Uicipeid:Dè tha ann an aiste") anns a’ [Ghàidhlig](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%A0idhlig "Gàidhlig").
[Aistidhean Matha agus na Naidheachdan](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aistidhean_matha_agus_naidheachdan "Aistidhean matha agus naidheachdan") · [Roinnean-seòrsa](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B2nraichte:Categories "Sònraichte:Categories") · [Na h-Aistidhean Gu Lèir](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B2nraichte:AllPages "Sònraichte:AllPages")
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5d/Crystal_Clear_app_wp.png/60px-Crystal_Clear_app_wp.png)](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faidhle:Crystal_Clear_app_wp.png) Mu Uicipeid
  * Seo Uicipeid na Gàidhlig. Ann an uicipeidean bidh iomadh neach ag obair ri chèile airson leabhar mòr-eòlais a sgrìobhadh ann an iomadh cànan.
  * Tha **16,019** duilleagan san Uicipeid seo. Tha a h-uile tè dhiubh [saor ri cleachdadh](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uicipeid:Ro-r%C3%A0dh "Uicipeid:Ro-ràdh").
  * _Dè th' ann an Uicipeid?:_ Faic an **[ro-ràdh](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uicipeid:Ro-r%C3%A0dh "Uicipeid:Ro-ràdh")** airson barrachd fios mu bhun-stèidh Uicipeid.
  * [Poileasaidhean](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uicipeid:Poileasaidhean_na_h-Uicipeid "Uicipeid:Poileasaidhean na h-Uicipeid") na h-Uicipeid
  * [Stadastaireachd](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B2nraichte:Statistics "Sònraichte:Statistics")

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/17/Wikimedal.png/40px-Wikimedal.png)](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faidhle:Wikimedal.png) Artagail taghta [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e5/TUT-Ausstellung_FFM_2012_47_%287117819557%29.jpg/250px-TUT-Ausstellung_FFM_2012_47_%287117819557%29.jpg)](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faidhle:TUT-Ausstellung_FFM_2012_47_\(7117819557\).jpg)Tutanmhamun:  
aghaidh òirBha **Tutankhamun** 'na phàraoh ann an 18mh rìoghrachas na h-[Èipheit](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/An_%C3%88ipheit "An Èipheit"). Bha e a’ riaghladh mu thuaiream eadar 1332 agus 1323 RC rè linn ann an eachdraidh na h-Èipheit air a bheil an Rìoghachd Ùr (no Linn na h-Impireachd Ùr uaireannan). On a chaidh a lorg, canar **Rìgh Tut** ris gu tric. Bha ainm tùsail, **Tutankhaten** , a’ ciallachadh "dealbh beò Aten agus tha Tutankhamun a’ ciallachadh "dealbh beò Amun". Ann an dealbh-sgrìobhadh na h-Èipheite, sgrìobhar ainm mar Amen-tut-ankh a ghnàth an cois gnàthas an luchd-sgrìobhaidh a chuireadh ainm dè aig toiseach abairt mar urram dhan dia. Dh'fhaoidte gur esan an neach air a bheil _Nibhurrereya_ ann an litrichean Amarna agus tha deagh-choltas gur esan Rìgh Rathotis 18mh rìoghrachas na h-Èipheit a bha a’ riaghlaidh, a-rèir an eachdraidhe Manetho, fad naoidh bliadhna, faid a tha a-rèir an tionndaidh dhen _Epitome_ aig Manetho a sgrìobh Flavius Josephus. Chaidh tuama Tutankhamun a lorg le Howard Carter agus Iarla Chaernarfon ann an 1922 agus leis gun robh e cha mhòr gun mhilleadh, ’s e naidheachd mhòr a bha ann air feadh an t-saoghail. Dhùisg e ùidh am measg nan daoine san Èipheit àrsaidh a-rithist agus tha aghaidh-choimheach Tutankhamun (ri fhaicinn ann an Taigh-tasgaidh na h-Èipheit) ainmeil air feadh an t-saoghail fhathast. Chaidh buill-ealain às an tuam a thaisbeanadh dhan phoball air feadh an t-saoghail thairis air na bliadhnaichean. Chaidh rannsachadh DNA a dhèanamh air agus sheall an rannsachadh sa Ghearran 2010 gur esan mac Akhenaten (mumaidh KV55). Bu mhumaidh KV35YL (is chan eil fhios dè an t-ainm a bha oirre) an dà chuid piuthair agus bean Akhenaten. A dh’aindeoin sin, tha cinnt gur ise am mumaidh air a bheil a’ Bhaintighearna Òg a chaidh a lorg san tuama KV35. A chionn ’s gun do chaochail grunnan dhe na daoine a rannsaich tuama Tutankhamun air dòigh caran "annasach", tha cuid am measg an t-sluaigh dhen bheachd gun do chaochail iad ri linn mallachd nam phàraoh. [...leugh an corr](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tutankhamun "Tutankhamun") |  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f1/System-index-search.svg/60px-System-index-search.svg.png)](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faidhle:System-index-search.svg) San latha an-diugh  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ef/Malcolm_IV%2C_King_of_Scotland%2C_charter_to_Kelso_Abbey%2C_1159%2C_initial_%28crop_Malcolm_IV%29.jpg/120px-Malcolm_IV%2C_King_of_Scotland%2C_charter_to_Kelso_Abbey%2C_1159%2C_initial_%28crop_Malcolm_IV%29.jpg)](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faidhle:Malcolm_IV,_King_of_Scotland,_charter_to_Kelso_Abbey,_1159,_initial_\(crop_Malcolm_IV\).jpg)Maol Chaluim IV'S e [9 an Dùbhlachd](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_an_D%C3%B9bhlachd "9 an Dùbhlachd") an 343mh latha dhen bhliadhna (344mh ann am bliadhna-leum). 
  * [1165](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1165 "1165") – Chaochail _Maol Chaluim IV_ agus thòisich [Uilleam I](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uilleam_I_na_h-Alba "Uilleam I na h-Alba") mar Rìgh na h-Alba.
  * [1565](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1565 "1565") – Chaochail [Pàpa Pius IV](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C3%A0pa_Pius_IV "Pàpa Pius IV").
  * [1669](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1669 "1669") – Chaochail [Pàpa Clemens IX](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C3%A0pa_Clemens_IX "Pàpa Clemens IX").
  * [1868](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1868 "1868") – Rugadh [Fritz Haber](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fritz_Haber "Fritz Haber"), ceimigear Gearmailteach.
  * [1919](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1919 "1919") – Rugadh [William Nunn Lipscomb](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Nunn_Lipscomb "William Nunn Lipscomb"), ceimigear] às na Stàitean Aonaichte.
  * [1937](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1937 "1937") – Chaochail [Gustaf Dalén](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gustaf_Dal%C3%A9n "Gustaf Dalén"), eòlaiche-fiosaig às an t-Suain.

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f2/HILLGIALLO_puntointerrogativo.png/60px-HILLGIALLO_puntointerrogativo.png)](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faidhle:HILLGIALLO_puntointerrogativo.png) An robh fhios agaibh? B' e bàrd Gàidhlig agus pìobaire a bh' ann an **Iain Eairdsidh MacAsgaill** no **Bàrd Bheàrnaraigh** ([19 Gearran](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/19_an_Gearran "19 an Gearran") [1898](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1898 "1898") — [4 Ògmhios](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/4_an_t-%C3%92gmhios "4 an t-Ògmhios") [1934](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/1934 "1934")). B' ann à [Beàrnaraigh na Hearadh](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Be%C3%A0rnaraigh_na_Hearadh "Beàrnaraigh na Hearadh") a bha e. B' e mac Dhòmhnaill MhicAsgaill agus Anna Mhoireasdan a bh' ann. Bha piuthar aige, Effie. Bha aon bhràthair, Alexander, aige a chaidh ainmeachadh air a chlach-uaighe. Chaidh e do Sgoil Bheàrnaraigh eadar 1903 agus 1912. Ann an 1911, bha e agus a phiuthar Effie a' fuireach còmhla ri pàrantan am màthar, Calum agus Effie Moireasdan aig Croit 3, Borbh.  Nuair a dh'fhàg e sgoil, thòisich e ag obair mar chìobair agus chuir e seachad bliadhna ag obair do Chalum MacLeòid aig Sandhill. Liostaig e sna _Cameron Highlanders_ an uair sin. Anns a' [Chiad Chogadh](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/An_Cogadh_M%C3%B2r "An Cogadh Mòr"), b' e pìobaire a bh' ann agus còmhla ri pìobairean eile sheòl e an rathad a-steach dhan chath aig Loos, [an Fhraing](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/An_Fhraing "An Fhraing") san t-Sultain 1915...[leugh an corr](https://gd.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iain_Eairdsidh_MacAsgaill "Iain Eairdsidh MacAsgaill")

###  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/30/Nuvola_filesystems_services.svg/40px-Nuvola_filesystems_services.svg.png)सुमानाचो लेख / Sumanacho lekh

[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/ac/Sonia_Shirsat%2C_the_Fado_singer_from_Goa_1.jpg/250px-Sonia_Shirsat%2C_the_Fado_singer_from_Goa_1.jpg)](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AB%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%B2:Sonia_Shirsat,_the_Fado_singer_from_Goa_1.jpg) **Sonia Shirsat** (सोनिया शिरसाट, z. 1980, Ponda) ek [Bharotantli](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bharot "Bharot") Fado gavpi. Ti [Gõychi](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%B5y "Gõy"), jem 1961 vorsa meren ek [Purtugez](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portugal "Portugal") vosahot asli ani atam Bharotachem ek rajio zavn asa. Tika "Jogantli Gõychea songitachi Rajdut" mhonn pachartat ani tinnem sonvsar bhor, Bharotant ani chodd korun Gõyantlea sonskrutik ani songitachea suvalleamni kariokrom keleat. Ti 13 vegllea bhasamni gaita. ([Anik vach... / आनिक वाच ...](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sonia_Shirsat "Sonia Shirsat"))   
  
###  ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6b/Nuvola_2.0%2B_Drawing.svg/40px-Nuvola_2.0%2B_Drawing.svg.png)सुमानाचें चित्र / Sumanachem chitr
| ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/33/Wikibar.png)  
---|---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f0/Trains_await_a_crossing_at_the_Thivim_Railway_Station_in_Goa%2C_India._3.jpg/500px-Trains_await_a_crossing_at_the_Thivim_Railway_Station_in_Goa%2C_India._3.jpg)](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%AB%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%AF%E0%A4%B2:Trains_await_a_crossing_at_the_Thivim_Railway_Station_in_Goa,_India._3.jpg) Gaddeo [Thivi](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%A5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B5%E0%A5%80 "थिवी") isttisnar ekamekak olanddunk ravtat. Vorsachea xevottak ani novea vorsachea survatek lok hea bhonvddekaranchea rajeant gordi kortat. गाडयो [थिवी](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%A5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B5%E0%A5%80 "थिवी") थाण्यार एकामेकाक ओलांडूंक रावतात. वर्साच्या शेवटाक आनी नव्या वर्साच्या सुरवातेक लोक ह्या भोंवडेकारांच्या राज्यांत गर्दी करतात. ಗಾಡ್ಯೋ [ಥಿವೀ](https://gom.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%A5%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B5%E0%A5%80 "थिवी") ಥಾಣ್ಯಾರ್ ಏಕಾಮೇಕಾಕ್ ಓಲಾಂಡೂಂಕ್ ರಾವ್ತಾತ್. ವರ್ಸಾಚ್ಯಾ ಶೆವಟಾಕ್ ಆನಿ ನವ್ಯಾ ವರ್ಸಾಚ್ಯಾ ಸುರ್ವಾತೇಕ್ ಲೋಕ್ ಹೇಂ ಭೊಂವ್ಡೇಕಾರಾಂಚ್ಯಾ ರಾಜ್ಯಾಂತ್ ಗರ್ದೀ ಕರ್ತಾತ್. Chitr: [Frederick Noronha](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Fredericknoronha "commons:User:Fredericknoronha")  
चित्र: [फ्रेड्रिक नोरोन्या](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Fredericknoronha "commons:User:Fredericknoronha")

𐍅𐌹𐌻𐌾𐌰𐌵𐌿𐌼𐌰 𐍃𐌹𐌾𐌰𐌹𐌸 𐌰𐌽𐌰 𐌿𐍃𐌼𐌴𐍂𐌾𐌰 𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌹𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌼𐌼𐌰 [𐍅𐌹𐌺𐌹𐍀𐌰𐌹𐌳𐌾𐍉𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8D%85%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%80%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%B3%F0%90%8C%BE%F0%90%8C%B0 "𐍅𐌹𐌺𐌹𐍀𐌰𐌹𐌳𐌾𐌰"), 𐌸𐍉𐍃 𐍆𐍂𐍉𐌳𐌰𐌱𐍉𐌺𐍉𐍃 𐌰𐌽𐌰 𐌲𐌰𐌽𐌰𐍄𐌾𐌰, 𐌸𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹 𐌰𐌻𐌻𐌰𐌹 𐌼𐌰𐌲𐌿𐌽 𐌲𐌰𐍅𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌺𐌾𐌰𐌽 𐍃𐌰𐌼𐌰𐌽𐌰. 𐍃𐍉 𐍅𐌹𐌺𐌹𐍀𐌰𐌹𐌳𐌾𐌰 𐌹𐌽 [𐍂𐌰𐌶𐌳𐌰𐌹 𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌹𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌹](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B2%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%84%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B6%F0%90%8C%B3%F0%90%8C%B0 "𐌲𐌿𐍄𐍂𐌰𐌶𐌳𐌰") 𐌽𐌿 **[984](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Statistics "Special:Statistics")** ([𐍃𐌰𐌹𐍈 𐌻𐌰𐌿𐌱𐌰𐌽𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%B3%F0%90%8D%89%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83 "Special:𐌰𐌻𐌻𐍃𐍃𐌴𐌹𐌳𐍉𐌽𐍃")) 𐌻𐌰𐌿𐌱𐌰𐌽𐍃 𐌷𐌰𐌱𐌰𐌹𐌸.

  * 𐌰𐌾𐌽𐍃𐍄𐌰𐌾𐌽 𐍈𐌰𐍂𐌾𐍉𐌷 𐌽𐌰𐌷𐍄 •𐌹• 𐍈𐌴𐌹𐌻𐍉𐍃 𐍃𐌰𐌹𐍃𐌻𐌴𐍀?

[𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8D%83 "𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃") **𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃** 𐍅𐌰𐍃 𐍃𐌰 𐍆𐍂𐌿𐌼𐌰 [𐌸𐌹𐌿𐌳𐌰𐌽𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B8%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8C%B3%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83 "𐌸𐌹𐌿𐌳𐌰𐌽𐍃") [𐍅𐌹𐍃𐌹𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌰𐌽𐌴](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8D%85%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%B2%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%84%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83 "𐍅𐌹𐍃𐌹𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌰𐌽𐍃") 𐌼𐌹𐌸𐌸𐌰𐌽𐌴𐌹 𐌾𐌴𐍂𐌰 (395 - 410). 𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃 𐍆𐍂𐌰𐌷𐌰𐌽𐌸 [𐍂𐌿𐌼𐌰](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8C%BC%F0%90%8C%B0 "𐍂𐌿𐌼𐌰") 𐌹𐌽 𐌾𐌴𐍂𐌰 410, 𐌰𐌽𐌰𐍃𐍄𐍉𐌳𐌾𐌰𐌽𐌳𐍃 𐌸𐌰𐌽𐌰 𐌳𐌰𐌿𐌸𐌿 [𐍂𐌿𐌼𐍉𐌽𐌹𐍃𐌺𐌹𐍃 𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐌾𐌹𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8C%BC%F0%90%8D%89%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%BA_%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8C%B9 "𐍂𐌿𐌼𐍉𐌽𐌹𐍃𐌺 𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐌹").  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1e/Alaric_entering_Athens.jpg/250px-Alaric_entering_Athens.jpg)](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8D%86%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8C%B0:Alaric_entering_Athens.jpg)𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃 𐌹𐌽 𐌰𐌸𐌰𐌹𐌽𐌰 𐌹𐌽𐌽𐌲𐌰𐌻𐌴𐌹𐌸𐌰𐌽𐌳𐍃 𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃 𐌳𐍂𐌰𐌿𐌲 𐌹𐌽 𐍂𐌿𐌼𐍉𐌽𐌹𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌼𐌼𐌰 𐌷𐌰𐍂𐌾𐌰.  𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃 𐌲𐌰𐌱𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌰𐌽𐍃 𐍅𐌰𐍂𐌸 𐌹𐌽 𐌾𐌴𐍂𐌰 370 𐌰𐌽𐌰 𐌷𐌿𐌻𐌼 𐌹𐌽 𐍂𐍉𐌼𐌰𐌽𐌾𐌰𐌹. 𐌰𐍄𐍄𐌰 𐍃𐌴𐌹𐌽𐍃 𐍅𐌰𐍃, 𐌰𐍆𐌰𐍂 [𐌹𐍉𐍂𐌳𐌰𐌽𐌽𐌴](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B9%CC%88%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B3%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83 "𐌹̈𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌳𐌰𐌽𐌴𐌹𐍃"), 𐌲𐌰𐍂𐌳𐌹𐍃 𐌸𐌹𐌿𐌳𐌰𐌽𐌴. 𐍃𐍅𐌰 𐌲𐌰𐌱𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌰𐌽𐍃 𐍅𐌰𐍂𐌸, 𐍆𐌹𐌻𐌿 𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌰𐌽𐌴 𐌸𐌻𐌹𐌿𐌷𐌰𐌽𐌳𐌰𐌽𐍃 𐍆𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌰 [𐌷𐌿𐌽𐌰𐌼](https://got.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%F0%90%8C%B7%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83&action=edit&redlink=1 "𐌷𐌿𐌽𐌰𐌽𐍃 \(𐌻𐌰𐌿𐍆𐍃 𐌽𐌹𐍃𐍄\)") 𐌹𐌽𐌽𐌲𐌰𐌻𐌹𐌸𐌿𐌽 𐌹𐌽 𐍂𐌿𐌼𐍉𐌽𐌹𐍃𐌺 𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐌹 𐌸𐌰𐍄𐌴𐌹 𐌱𐌰𐌿𐌰𐌹𐌽𐌰 𐌾𐌰𐌹𐌽𐌰𐍂 𐌰𐍂𐌽𐌹𐌱𐌰. 𐌼𐌹𐌸𐌸𐌰𐌽𐌴𐌹 𐍆𐌹𐌳𐍅𐍉𐍂𐌳𐌰 𐌾𐌴𐍂𐌰𐌷𐌿𐌽𐌳 𐌱𐍂𐌿𐌷𐍄𐌰 𐍂𐌿𐌼𐍉𐌽𐌹𐍃𐌺 𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐌹 "_foederati"_ 𐌰𐌹𐌸𐌸𐌰𐌿 "𐍆𐍂𐌰𐌼𐌰𐌸𐌾𐌰𐌹 𐌲𐌰𐌳𐍂𐌰𐌿𐌷𐍄𐍉𐍃". 𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌹𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌹 𐌲𐌰𐌳𐍂𐌰𐌿𐌷𐍄𐍉𐍃 𐍅𐌴𐍃𐌿𐌽 𐍂𐌰𐌹𐌷𐍄𐌹𐍃 "_foederati"_ 𐌾𐌰𐌷 𐌳𐍂𐌰𐌿𐌷𐍄𐌹𐌽𐍉𐌳𐌴𐌳𐌿𐌽 𐍆𐌰𐌿𐍂 𐍂𐌿𐌼𐍉𐌽𐌹𐍃𐌺 𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐌹..

**𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌿𐌽𐌾𐌰 𐍅𐌰𐌿𐍂𐍃𐍄𐍅𐌰:** **[𐌱𐍉𐌺𐌰𐌻𐌴𐌹𐍃𐌴𐌹](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B7%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B0:%F0%90%8C%B1%F0%90%8D%89%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9 "𐌷𐌰𐌽𐍃𐌰:𐌱𐍉𐌺𐌰𐌻𐌴𐌹𐍃𐌴𐌹")** | **[𐍃𐌰𐌲𐌲𐍅𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B7%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B0:%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B2%F0%90%8C%B2%F0%90%8D%85%F0%90%8D%83 "𐌷𐌰𐌽𐍃𐌰:𐍃𐌰𐌲𐌲𐍅𐍃")** | **[𐍆𐌰𐌹𐍂𐍅𐌴𐌹𐍄𐌻](https://got.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%F0%90%8C%B7%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B0:%F0%90%8D%86%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8D%85%F0%90%8C%B4%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%84%F0%90%8C%BB&action=edit&redlink=1 "𐌷𐌰𐌽𐍃𐌰:𐍆𐌰𐌹𐍂𐍅𐌴𐌹𐍄𐌻 \(𐌻𐌰𐌿𐍆𐍃 𐌽𐌹𐍃𐍄\)")** | [𐌻𐌹𐌿𐌸𐌰𐍂𐌾𐍉𐍃](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/%F0%90%8C%B7%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%B0:%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8C%B8%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%BE%F0%90%8D%89%F0%90%8D%83 "𐌷𐌰𐌽𐍃𐌰:𐌻𐌹𐌿𐌸𐌰𐍂𐌾𐍉𐍃")

Download this font:[Ulfilas (by Robert Pfeffer)](http://www.fontspace.com/robert-pfeffer/ulfilas).** **Don't speak Gothic?[Gothic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gothic_language "en:Gothic language") is an ancient East Germanic language spoken during the Dark Ages in Ukraine, Spain, Italy, and Aquitaine. It is the oldest Germanic language which we have a lot of knowledge of, and its vocabulary is highly similar to that of [Old English](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_English "en:Old English"). It is mostly known through a translation of the Bible made in the 4th century by Wulfila, but there are other writings in Gothic, such as a calendar, some records of financial transactions, and an explanation of the Bible known as the "[Skeireins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Skeireins "en:Skeireins")". Gothic is no longer spoken, and it has no descendants, but it can still be seen in Spanish, with words like "ganso" (goose), and in "Bagme Bloma", a poem by J.R.R. Tolkien written in a reconstructed form of Gothic.** **Gothic is written in an alphabet of its own. You will find fonts[here](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8D%85%F0%90%8C%B0_%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%86%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B1%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83_%F0%90%8C%B2%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%84%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%BA_%F0%90%8C%B1%F0%90%8D%89%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B1%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B3 "Wikipedia:𐍃𐍅𐌰 𐌿𐍆𐌰𐍂𐌱𐌰𐌹𐍂𐌹𐍃 𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌹𐍃𐌺 𐌱𐍉𐌺𐌰𐌱𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌳"), keyboard help [here](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%F0%90%8C%B2%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%84%F0%90%8C%B9%F0%90%8D%83%F0%90%8C%BA_%F0%90%8C%B1%F0%90%8D%89%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%B1%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B3 "Wikipedia:𐌲𐌿𐍄𐌹𐍃𐌺 𐌱𐍉𐌺𐌰𐌱𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌳"), and transliteration rules [here](https://got.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BB%F0%90%8C%BE%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BA%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8C%BD%F0%90%8C%BE%F0%90%8C%B0_%F0%90%8D%85%F0%90%8C%B0%F0%90%8C%BF%F0%90%8D%82%F0%90%8C%B3%F0%90%8C%B0 "Wikipedia:𐌰𐌻𐌾𐌰𐌺𐌿𐌽𐌾𐌰 𐍅𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌳𐌰").**

વિકિપીડિયામાંથી
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/80/Wikipedia-logo-v2.svg/120px-Wikipedia-logo-v2.svg.png) [૯ ડિસેમ્બર](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%B8%E0%AB%87%E0%AA%AE%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%AC%E0%AA%B0_%E0%AB%AF "ડિસેમ્બર ૯") ૨૦૨૫   
[મંગળવાર](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%AE%E0%AA%82%E0%AA%97%E0%AA%B3%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B0 "મંગળવાર") **શુભ સંધ્યા**  
[વિકિપીડિયા](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE "વિકિપીડિયા") પર તમારું સ્વાગત છે. વિકિપીડિયા [મુક્ત](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE:%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B6%E0%AA%A8%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%A7%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B0 "વિકિપીડિયા:પ્રકાશનાધિકાર") વિશ્વકોશ છે જેમાં [બધા લખી શકે છે](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE:%E0%AA%B8%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%97%E0%AA%A4 "વિકિપીડિયા:સ્વાગત").  આ ગુજરાતી આવૃત્તિ છે જેની શરૂઆત જુલાઈ ૨૦૦૪માં થઈ. અત્યાર સુધીમાં અહીં **[૩૦,૭૨૮](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%B6%E0%AB%87%E0%AA%B7:%E0%AA%86%E0%AA%82%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%95%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%AE%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B9%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%A4%E0%AB%80 "વિશેષ:આંકડાકીયમાહિતી")** લેખો લખાઈ ચુક્યા છે.  | જે તે મૂળાક્ષરથી શરૂ થતા બધાં જ લેખો જોવા માટે તેના પર ક્લિક કરો

# **આ માસનો ઉમદા લેખ**  
---  
_**[ગીર રાષ્ટ્રીય ઉદ્યાન અને અભયારણ્ય](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%97%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%B0_%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B7%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%9F%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B0%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%AF_%E0%AA%89%E0%AA%A6%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%A8_%E0%AA%85%E0%AA%A8%E0%AB%87_%E0%AA%85%E0%AA%AD%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%A3%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%AF "ગીર રાષ્ટ્રીય ઉદ્યાન અને અભયારણ્ય")** એ પૃથ્વી પર દુર્લભ એવા એશીયાઈ સિંહો (Asiatic Lions)નું એકમાત્ર નિવાસસ્થાન છે._ [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b2/Asiatic_Lion_Male.jpg/250px-Asiatic_Lion_Male.jpg)](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%9A%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%A4%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B0:Asiatic_Lion_Male.jpg) **ગીર રાષ્ટ્રીય ઉદ્યાન અને ગીર અભયારણ્ય** (જે "ગીરનું જંગલ" કે "સાસણ-ગીર" તરીકે પણ ઓળખાય છે તે) [ગુજરાતમાં](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%97%E0%AB%81%E0%AA%9C%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%A4 "ગુજરાત") આવેલું જંગલ અને વન્યજીવન અભયારણ્ય છે. તેની સ્થાપના ૧૯૬૫માં કરવામાં આવી હતી, તે કુલ ૧૪૧૨ ચો.કી.મી. (૨૫૮ ચો.કી.મી. રાષ્ટ્રીય ઉદ્યાન અને ૧૧૫૩ ચો.કી.મી. અભયારણ્ય)ના વિસ્તારમાં ફેલાયેલ છે આ ઉપરાંત પાણીયા અને મિતિયાળા અભયારણ્ય પણ ગીરના જ ભાગ ગણવામાં આવે છે જેનો આ આંકડામાં સમાવેશ કરેલો નથી. આ ઉદ્યાન [વેરાવળથી](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AB%87%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%B3 "વેરાવળ") લગભગ ૪૩ કી.મી. ઈશાન (ઉત્તર-પૂર્વ)માં આવેલું છે. આ [એશિયાઇ સિંહો](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B8%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%82%E0%AA%B9 "સિંહ") (_Panthera leo persica_)નું એકમાત્ર રહેઠાણ છે અને [એશિયાના](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%8F%E0%AA%B6%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE "એશિયા") અતિમહત્વનાં રક્ષિત વિસ્તાર તરીકે ધ્યાને લેવાયેલ છે. ગીરનું જીવપરિસ્થિતિક તંત્ર ([ecosystem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ecosystem "en:ecosystem")), તેની વિવિધ વનસ્પતિ અને પ્રાણીસૃષ્ટિ સાથે, સરકારી વન વિભાગ, વન્યજીવન કાર્યકર્તાઓ અને સ્વૈચ્છીક સામાજીક સંસ્થાઓના સખત પ્રયત્નો દ્વારા રક્ષાયેલું છે. [જુનાગઢના](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%9C%E0%AB%81%E0%AA%A8%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%97%E0%AA%A2 "જુનાગઢ") નવાબ દ્વારા સને ૧૯૦૦ની શરૂઆતથી ગીરનો જંગલ વિસ્તાર અને તેનાં [સિંહોને](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B8%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%82%E0%AA%B9 "સિંહ") "રક્ષિત" જાહેર કરાયેલા. આ પહેલ સિંહોનાં રક્ષણમાં ખુબ મદદરૂપ બની કે જેની વસ્તી શિકારની પ્રવૃતીને કારણે ત્યારે ફક્ત ૧૫ જેટલી જ રહી ગઇ હતી.      (**[આગળ વાંચો...](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%97%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%B0_%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B7%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%9F%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B0%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%AF_%E0%AA%89%E0%AA%A6%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%A8_%E0%AA%85%E0%AA%A8%E0%AB%87_%E0%AA%85%E0%AA%AD%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%A3%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%AF "ગીર રાષ્ટ્રીય ઉદ્યાન અને અભયારણ્ય")**) અથવા [બધા ઉમદા લેખો](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B6%E0%AB%8D%E0%AA%B0%E0%AB%87%E0%AA%A3%E0%AB%80:%E0%AA%89%E0%AA%AE%E0%AA%A6%E0%AA%BE_%E0%AA%B2%E0%AB%87%E0%AA%96 "શ્રેણી:ઉમદા લેખ") જોઈ જુઓ.

# **[ગુજરાતી](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%97%E0%AB%81%E0%AA%9C%E0%AA%B0%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%A4%E0%AB%80 "ગુજરાતી") ([યુનિકોડ](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%AF%E0%AB%81%E0%AA%A8%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AB%8B%E0%AA%A1 "યુનિકોડ")) લેખન-ભાષાંતર સહાયતા**  
---  
  * ગુજરાતીમાં કેવી રીતે ટાઇપ કરવું તે અંગેની માહિતી અંગ્રેજી વિકિપીડિયાનાં [ભારતીય લિપિનો કમ્પ્યુટર પર ઉપયોગ કરવાનાં પૃષ્ઠ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Enabling%20complex%20text%20support%20for%20Indic%20scripts "en:Wikipedia:Enabling complex text support for Indic scripts") પર આપેલી છે.
  * અન્ય વિકિપીડિયન સ્વયંસેવકો સાથે વાત કરવા Libera.chat પર #wikipedia-gu અને #wikimedia-in ચૅનલ પર જાઓ.
  * યુનિકોડમાં ગુજરાતી અક્ષરોના ગણ માટે યુનિકોડ સંસ્થાની વેબસાઈટ પર [આ દસ્તાવેજ](https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0A80.pdf) જુઓ.

# **વિકિપીડિયા અન્ય**  
---  
  * **[ચોતરો](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE:%E0%AA%9A%E0%AB%8B%E0%AA%A4%E0%AA%B0%E0%AB%8B "વિકિપીડિયા:ચોતરો")** — વિકિપીડિયા વિષયે વાતચીત કરવા.
  * **[સમાજ મુખપૃષ્ઠ](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE:Community_Portal "વિકિપીડિયા:Community Portal")** — બુલેટિન બોર્ડ, પરિયોજનાઓ, સ્રોત અને વિકિપીડિયાનાં બહોળા કાર્યક્ષેત્રને આવરી લેતી પ્રવૃત્તિઓ.
  * **[સાઇટ સમાચાર](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE:%E0%AA%B8%E0%AA%AE%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%9A%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B0 "વિકિપીડિયા:સમાચાર")** — વિકિપીડિયા અને વિકિમીડિયા ફાઉન્ડેશન પરનાં લેખ, સમાચાર અને પ્રેસ નોંધો, પ્રચાર-પ્રસાર કાર્યક્રમોના અહેવાલ.
  * **[દૂતાવાસ](https://gu.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%95%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AA%E0%AB%80%E0%AA%A1%E0%AA%BF%E0%AA%AF%E0%AA%BE:%E0%AA%A6%E0%AB%82%E0%AA%A4%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B5%E0%AA%BE%E0%AA%B8 "વિકિપીડિયા:દૂતાવાસ")** — ગુજરાતી સિવાયની અન્ય ભાષાઓમાં વિકિપીડિયા સંલગ્ન સંવાદ માટે.

Kuatiarogue Poravopyre
[![Vikipetã ra'anga tee.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/80/Wikipedia-logo-v2.svg/120px-Wikipedia-logo-v2.svg.png)](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ta'%C3%A3nga:Wikipedia-v2-logo.svg "Vikipetã ra'anga tee.")Vikipetã ra'anga tee.
**[Vikipetã](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipet%C3%A3 "Vikipetã")** ha'e opaite tembikuaa hekosãsóva renda [Internet](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet "Internet") rupive ha iñe'ẽ heta, opa tekove ikatu ohai térã omoambue [iñapopyme'ẽnguéra](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apopyme'%E1%BA%BD "Apopyme'ẽ"). Upe Aty Viruremimono'õ'ỹ Wikimedia oisãmbyhy ha omboguata Vikipetãme. Oguerekove amo 37 sua kuatiarogue 287 [ñe'ẽme](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91e'%E1%BA%BD "Ñe'ẽ") (oĩ avei ñe'ẽ ava ojapo, [esperanto](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esperanto "Esperanto") guáicha, oĩ avei umi ñe'ẽ ava te'ýi tee pegua, [kechuañe'ẽ](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kechua%C3%B1e'%E1%BA%BD "Kechuañe'ẽ") guáicha, ha [avañe'ẽme](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ava%C3%B1e'%E1%BA%BD "Avañe'ẽ"), ha upe ñe'ẽ noñeñe'ẽvéima, [latinañe'ẽ](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latina%C3%B1e'%E1%BA%BD "Latinañe'ẽ") guáicha ha ambuéva). Imarandu hekosãso, upe he'ise oimeraẽ tapicha ikatu omoambue, ohaijey ha oipuru oipotaháicha pe marandu, ojapóramo he'iháicha Vikipetã rekorãnguéra, imarandu oĩgui tekorã poguýpe ha'éva [GNU/FDL](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNU_General_Public_License?action=edit&redlink=1 "GNU General Public License \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") ha [Creative Commons](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creative_Commons?action=edit&redlink=1 "Creative Commons \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") Attribution-ShareAlike (CC-by-SA) 3.0. Oñepyrũ [15 jasyteĩ](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/15_jasyte%C4%A9 "15 jasyteĩ") ary [2001](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001 "2001") jave, oñemopyenda pe ypykatu hérava _[wiki](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiki?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wiki \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")_ rupive ([Haguáii ñe'ẽgui](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hagu%C3%A1ii_%C3%B1e'%E1%BA%BD?action=edit&redlink=1 "Haguáii ñe'ẽ \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") _wiki-wiki_ = "pya'e", "akuã", "pojava").
Ko tembiporu [wiki](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiki?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wiki \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") he'ise kuatiarogue aty _[web](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Wide_Web "World Wide Web")_ pegua oguereko marandu opaichagua ha opavave ikatu omoambue ha ohaive hesekuéra umi [ñanduti kundahára](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91anduti_kundah%C3%A1ra "Ñanduti kundahára") rupive, ha'éva [Mozilla Firefox](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mozilla_Firefox "Mozilla Firefox"), [Google Chrome](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Chrome "Google Chrome"), [Internet Explorer](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet_Explorer "Internet Explorer"), [Netscape](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netscape?action=edit&redlink=1 "Netscape \(ndaipóri ko togue\)"), [Opera](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opera_\(kundah%C3%A1ra\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Opera \(kundahára\) \(ndaipóri ko togue\)"), [Safari](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Safari_\(kundah%C3%A1ra\)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Safari \(kundahára\) \(ndaipóri ko togue\)"), térã tembiporu oimeraẽva ohechakuaáva umi kuatiarogue orekóva [HTML](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTML?action=edit&redlink=1 "HTML \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") ha ta'anga. Kóva hína peteĩ mba'e tuicháva omoingoéva Vikipetã umi [ñe'ẽryrupavẽ](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91e'%E1%BA%BDryrupav%E1%BA%BD "Ñe'ẽryrupavẽ") ambuévagui: tapicha oimeraẽva oikekuaáva [Internet](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet "Internet")-pe ikatu ohaijey ha omoambue kuatiaroguekuéra, ha oimeraẽ omoñe'ẽva ikatu oipytyvõ kuatiarogue jehaípe.

Ojehuvaꞌekue 9 jasypakõi jave
[![Batalla de Ayacucho](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2b/Battle_of_Ayacucho.jpg/250px-Battle_of_Ayacucho.jpg)](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ta'%C3%A3nga:Battle_of_Ayacucho.jpg "Batalla de Ayacucho")Batalla de Ayacucho
  * **[1641](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/1641?action=edit&redlink=1 "1641 \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")**.— Omano **[Anton van Dyck](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anton_van_Dyck?action=edit&redlink=1 "Anton van Dyck \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")** , [moha'angahára](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91embosa%E2%80%99y "Ñembosa’y") [Véyhika](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%A9yhika "Véyhika") pegua.
  * **[1824](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/1824?action=edit&redlink=1 "1824 \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")**.— Ojehu pe **[Ayacucho ñorairõ](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayacucho_%C3%B1orair%C3%B5?action=edit&redlink=1 "Ayacucho ñorairõ \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")** (_ta'angápe_), ñorairõ paha ohekáva sãso oipe'a hag̃ua Amérika Epáña poguýgui.
  * **[1909](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/1909 "1909")**.— Heñói **[Douglas Fairbanks Jr.](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Douglas_Fairbanks_Jr.?action=edit&redlink=1 "Douglas Fairbanks Jr. \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")** , [ñoha'ãngahára](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91oha'%C3%A3ngah%C3%A1ra "Ñoha'ãngahára") ha ñorairõhára [Tetãvore Joapykuéra](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tet%C3%A3vore_Joapyku%C3%A9ra "Tetãvore Joapykuéra") pegua.
  * **[1980](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/1980 "1980")**.— Omano **[Maneco Galeano](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maneco_Galeano "Maneco Galeano")** , [atõihára](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pupoty "Pupoty") [Paraguái](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paragu%C3%A1i "Paraguái") pegua


Reikuaápa...
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/83/Sir_Isaac_Newton_%281643-1727%29.jpg/250px-Sir_Isaac_Newton_%281643-1727%29.jpg)](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_Newton)[](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ta'%C3%A3nga:Sir_Isaac_Newton_\(1643-1727\).jpg)
… karai **[Isaac Newton](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_Newton "Isaac Newton")** (_taꞌangápe_), herakuãite peteĩ tembikuaatyhára katupyryvéva ramo, oñemoarandu avei pe [alkímia](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alk%C3%ADmia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Alkímia \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") rehe ha oguereko hógape heta aranduka oñe'ẽva alkímia rehegua.
... **[Ary 2022 Paraguái Jepapa](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ary_2022_Paragu%C3%A1i_Jepapa "Ary 2022 Paraguái Jepapa")** marandúicha, [Paraguái](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paragu%C3%A1i "Paraguái")﻿pe oĩ 6 ﻿109 ﻿644 ava?
… ikatu jahecha ñande resa añónte rupive pe _**[Thiomargarita magnifica](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thiomargarita_magnifica?action=edit&redlink=1 "Thiomargarita magnifica \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")**_ , techa mbotuichaha jeporuꞌỹre, upéva hína pe [vaytéria](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vakyt%C3%A9ria "Vakytéria") ituichavéva.
… saary XIX jave, karai **[Simón Bolívar](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim%C3%B3n_Bol%C3%ADvar "Simón Bolívar")** gui oiko irundy tetã mburuvicha ramo [Ñembyamérika](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91embyam%C3%A9rika "Ñembyamérika")﻿pe?
… ára [14 jasyapy](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/14_jasyapy "14 jasyapy") jave, ojegueromanduꞌa **[Pi (π) ára](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pi_\(%CF%80\)_%C3%A1ra?action=edit&redlink=1 "Pi \(π\) ára \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")** , ojoguaitégui mbaꞌéichapa ojehai [papapy π](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papapy_%CF%80 "Papapy π") (3,14) ha ojehai pe arange amo [Amérika Retãvore Joajukuéra](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tet%C3%A3vore_Joapyku%C3%A9ra "Tetãvore Joapykuéra")﻿pe (3/14).
… **[Poyvi Paraguái](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poyvi_Paragu%C3%A1i "Poyvi Paraguái")** ijojahaꞌỹ haꞌanga mokõivagui, tenondépe heꞌíva "_República del Paraguay_ " ([pálma](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C3%A1lma?action=edit&redlink=1 "Pálma \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") ha [taruma](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taruma?action=edit&redlink=1 "Taruma \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") ojejokuáva iguýpe, peteĩ mbyja saꞌyju mimbíva apuꞌa hovy mbytépe), hapykuépe heꞌíva "_Paz y Justicia_ " ("Pyꞌaguapy ha Tekojoja") peteĩ leõ ha peteĩ _gorro frigio_.
Vikipetã rehegua
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/bd/Wikipedia-logo-v2-bw.svg/120px-Wikipedia-logo-v2-bw.svg.png)](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ta'%C3%A3nga:Wikipedia-logo-v2-bw.svg)
[Vikipetã](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipet%C3%A3 "Vikipetã") ha'e tembiapo ohekáva jajapo hag̃ua oñondivepa peteĩ [ñe'ẽryrupavẽ](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%91e'%E1%BA%BDryrupav%E1%BA%BD "Ñe'ẽryrupavẽ") iñe'ẽ hetáva, opavavéva ikatu ohai ha oñemoarandu hese, oñemopyendáva _[internet](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet "Internet")_ -pe _[wiki](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiki?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wiki \(ndaipóri ko togue\)")_ rembiporu rupive. Ko'ápe, roipota rejuhukuaaha opaite tembikuaa hekosãsóva, upéva he'ise marandu ndaijapúiva, ikatu jaikuaa moõguipa oúva, ha ikatúva oñemoambue térã ojehai jey. Ko tembiapo oguata umi [tekorã ombohapéva](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipet%C3%A3:5_%C3%B1embohapeha?action=edit&redlink=1 "Vikipetã:5 ñembohapeha \(ndaipóri ko togue\)") rupive ha opa imarandu oñemyasãi [Creative Commons BY-SA](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/deed.pt) rupive ha upe rupi ikatu ojepuru ojepotaháicha imarandu, oĩramo [tekorã jepururã](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Terms%20of%20Use/gn "wmf:Terms of Use/gn") guýpe. Nde avei ikatu ohai ha omoambue Vikipetã marandu, [reike va'erãnte](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mba'ech%C4%A9ch%C4%A9:Entrar "Mba'echĩchĩ:Entrar") nde réra reheve ha remba'apo va'erã umi tekorã tenondeguáva, ha'éva "jahai va'erã mba'e ikatúva jaikuaa porãite iñañeteha" ha "marandu imba'eguasúva opavavépe".
Opa umi ohaíva ha omba'apóva ko'ápe oipytyvõ potahápe kyre'ỹ ha oñembyaty oñondive peteĩ aty oñepytyvõvape, tendota'ỹva, oiporavo ha omba'apo joáva. Ndahasýi reñepyrũ hag̃ua, rehaikuaa avañe'ẽme ha reporandu va'erãnte pe ndereikuaáiva. Iporãite ñañemongetávo, upéicha ñamba'apo porãve ha ituichavéta ko ñane rembiapo.
[Ore rekoha](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipet%C3%A3:Tekohapegua "Vikipetã:Tekohapegua") • [Pytyvorã](https://gn.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pytyv%C3%B5:Pytyv%C3%B5h%C3%A1ra "Pytyvõ:Pytyvõhára")

Na wayuukana koumainshii Wajiirapünaa, pasanain sünain tü mmapa'akalüirua [Kolompia](https://guc.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kolompia "Kolompia") otta müsia [Wenesuweera](https://guc.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wenesuweera "Wenesuweera"). Tü nanüikika shia tü wayuunaikikalü. | Wikipeetia süka wayuunaiki süpülajatü akotchajaa tü nakuwa'ipaka na wayuukana sünain ashajuushin shia süpüla kottuinjatüin otta süpüla ne'rüinjatüin na tepichikana mapa.

Asibetin la de la Bɔlega za'a asibetin kãtɛ. Bala la nɛra san bi'ira gee kiŋɛ asibetin bibesi la puan ti dɔgeta duma la baŋɛ ti ba ta'am tibɛ, ba ni ta'asɛ e basɛ la bilam. Bala la nɛreba zo'e zo'e yi'iri di la dɔgekatin...[Kãalɛ zo'e zo'e](https://gur.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bolgatanga_Regional_Hospital "Bolgatanga Regional Hospital")[Zina Daarɛ Wa garɛ](https://gur.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipiidiya:Featured_Articles&action=edit&redlink=1 "Wikipiidiya:Featured Articles \(pɛgerɛ la ka boe\)") ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7e/HSbra2.svg/40px-HSbra2.svg.png) Zina Gɔŋɔ La Ama [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/29/Upper_East_Fork_Patrol_Cabin.jpg/250px-Upper_East_Fork_Patrol_Cabin.jpg)](https://gur.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faali:Upper_East_Fork_Patrol_Cabin.jpg)Bolgatanga Senior High School **Bɔlegataŋa kɔmbibesi sukuu katɛ 'Bolgatanga Senior High School (BIG BOSS)** bo la [Upper East Region](https://gur.wikipedia.org/wiki/Upper_East_Region "Upper East Region"), Ghana. Bɔlegataŋa kɔmbibesi sukuu katɛ la deti ti ba wi'ira ti 'Bolgatanga Senior High School (BIG BOSS)' la, dela kɔmbibesi sukuu katɛ wia daana ti a bɔna upper east. Bɔlegataŋa kɔmbibesi sukuu katɛ la yuum pɔsɛ la '15 October, 1970'. Sukuu la yuum pɔsɛ mɛ la kɔma piyopɔi la ba nuu. Pa'aleba yuum dela pia la ayima deti Mr. Bayala C. J. Yibrul dɛna sukuu la zuo daana 'first Heamaster'. Pa'aleba sɛba n yuum kiŋɛ sukuu ba'asɛ dee bɔna bini pa'ala dela batã deti sɛba n yuum suŋeri ba me nyaa dɛna banii.[[Bolgatanga Senior High School|......[Kãalɛ zo'e zo'e](https://gur.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bolgatanga_Senior_High_School "Bolgatanga Senior High School")]][Zina Daarɛ Wa garɛ](https://gur.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipiidiya:Good_Articles&action=edit&redlink=1 "Wikipiidiya:Good Articles \(pɛgerɛ la ka boe\)") ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Bluebg_rounded.png) ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/7c/Book_red%3B_question_marks.svg/40px-Book_red%3B_question_marks.svg.png) Fum Mi Ti ....? Ka mɛ yuun dela ka sɔ/ ba bi kiima. Ka sɔ/ba la yuun te'ele ki la kalam de gee la ka Ma ma'a ti ka yuum bisera n ti ka yuun ta zo'e kutɛ.
  * **[Ghana](https://gur.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana")** Gaana dela suma'asum tiŋa bɔna Afirika wa la timpaberɛ wa za'an waabi puan. Gaana tiŋa wa yuum bo la solemiisi nu'usi ti ba sɔna tiŋa bisera. La yuum ta paɛ la saŋa ti Gaana nɛreba yuum waɛ isege ze'ele ba nama Zuo zɛbɛ nyaŋɛ solemiisi la dee nyaa to'e tiŋa ti la nyaa dɛna Gaana duma meŋa tiŋa ti ba sɔna bisera. Ba yuum nyaŋɛ zɛbɛ to'e tiŋa wa la 1957?

[Tuladu tulawoto](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Tuladu_tulawoto "Wikipedia:Tuladu tulawoto") | [Tomimbihu Wikipedia](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Tomimbihu "Wikipedia:Tomimbihu")  
---|---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/71/COLLECTIE_TROPENMUSEUM_%27Tandako%27_danseressen_te_Gorontalo_Noord-Celebes_TMnr_10003469.jpg/250px-COLLECTIE_TROPENMUSEUM_%27Tandako%27_danseressen_te_Gorontalo_Noord-Celebes_TMnr_10003469.jpg)](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berkas:COLLECTIE_TROPENMUSEUM_'Tandako'_danseressen_te_Gorontalo_Noord-Celebes_TMnr_10003469.jpg) **Tanggomo** yito tala tuwawu tradisi lo'u motombīlu to Hulontalo, mohulitayi wungguli u yilowali to masa yilalu mayi. Tanggomo momuwato wungguli u yilowali, wawu wungguli boyito ma tombīluwoliyo mayi motoyunuto monto bungo sambe pulitiyo. Lahu lo tanggomo mohīhede wolo lahu uwēwo odelo lohidu, wawu o rima to bahasa lo lahuliyo. Tuwango tanggomo yito wungguli u banari yilowali, pīlu, wawu mowali olo wungguli u pilohutu lo ta motanggomo. Tanggomo lonto tahe tanggomo, ma'analiyo molanggomo, wonu to delomo bahasa Indonesia, tanggomo yito artiliyo tampung. Tanggomo u yito menampung meyalo tuwa-tuwango wungguli u yilowali. Ta hemotombilu tanggomo tangguliyo Ta Motanggomo meyalo Patanggomo.  **([Po'ombuta mobaca...](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanggomo "Tanggomo"))** |  Wikipedia yito tuwawu lo ensiklopedia u pereyi tuladulo, boli'olo, meyalo popotayadulo. Masatiya Wikipedia lo bahasa Hulontalo ma otuwa **[14.913](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spesial:Statistik "Spesial:Statistik")** tuladu, wawu ma **[7.799](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spesial:Statistik "Spesial:Statistik")** ta loluladu. Dulo ito moluladu to delomo [Wikipedia bahasa Hulontalo](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_bahasa_Hulontalo "Wikipedia bahasa Hulontalo"). Toduwōlo ode mongodula'a wawu mongowutato tā motota motombilu wawu moluladu bahasa lo Hulontalo, mongohi mayi tuladu u mopiyohu. Wonu yi'o ma lohutu akun, toduwolo **[tumuwoto teeya](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spesial:TumuwotoTaOhu'uwo "Spesial:TumuwotoTaOhu'uwo")** , wonu diipo, mowali **[mohutu akun teeya](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spesial:MohutuAkun "Spesial:MohutuAkun")**. Mohutu tulade bohu, tepuwa to delomo kotak botiya.

[Dulahe botiya](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_Desember "9 Desember") to delomo sojara | Poroyek Uwewoliyo  
---|---  
**[9 Desember](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_Desember "9 Desember")** : [Hari Kemerdekaan](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daftar_hari_kemerdekaan_nasional?action=edit&redlink=1 "Daftar hari kemerdekaan nasional \(halaman dipōluwo\)") di **[Tanzania](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzania?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tanzania \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** ([1961](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1961?action=edit&redlink=1 "1961 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")); **[Hari Angkatan Bersenjata](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hari_Angkatan_Bersenjata?action=edit&redlink=1#Peru "Hari Angkatan Bersenjata \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** di Peru ([1824](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1824?action=edit&redlink=1 "1824 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")) [![{{{title}}}](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/42/Lech_walesa_prezydent_RP.gif/120px-Lech_walesa_prezydent_RP.gif)](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berkas:Lech_walesa_prezydent_RP.gif "Lech Wałęsa")  
[Lech Wałęsa](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lech_Wa%C5%82%C4%99sa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lech Wałęsa \(halaman dipōluwo\)")
  * **[1946](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1946?action=edit&redlink=1 "1946 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** - **[Peradilan Dokter](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peradilan_Dokter?action=edit&redlink=1 "Peradilan Dokter \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** dimulai untuk mengadili para dokter yang dituduh terlibat dalam [eksperimen manusia Nazi](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eksperimen_manusia_Nazi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Eksperimen manusia Nazi \(halaman dipōluwo\)") selama [Perang Dunia II](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perang_Dunia_II?action=edit&redlink=1 "Perang Dunia II \(halaman dipōluwo\)").
  * **[1961](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1961?action=edit&redlink=1 "1961 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** - **[Tanganyika](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanganyika?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tanganyika \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** merdeka dari [Britania Raya](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Britania_Raya?action=edit&redlink=1 "Britania Raya \(halaman dipōluwo\)") sebelum menjadi bagian dari [Tanzania](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzania?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tanzania \(halaman dipōluwo\)") tiga tahun kemudian.
  * **[1979](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1979?action=edit&redlink=1 "1979 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** - Sebuah komisi ilmuwan bentukan [Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Organisasi_Kesehatan_Dunia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia \(halaman dipōluwo\)") memastikan bahwa **[variola](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variola?action=edit&redlink=1 "Variola \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** telah diberantas, membuatnya sebagai [penyakit menular](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penyakit_menular?action=edit&redlink=1 "Penyakit menular \(halaman dipōluwo\)") pertama yang berhasil dibasmi seluruhnya dari alam.
  * **[1987](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987?action=edit&redlink=1 "1987 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** - Gerakan **[intifadhah](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intifadhah_Pertama?action=edit&redlink=1 "Intifadhah Pertama \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** dimulai untuk pertama kali di [Jalur Gaza](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jalur_Gaza?action=edit&redlink=1 "Jalur Gaza \(halaman dipōluwo\)") dan [Tepi Barat](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tepi_Barat?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tepi Barat \(halaman dipōluwo\)").
  * **[1990](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990?action=edit&redlink=1 "1990 \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** - **[Lech Wałęsa](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lech_Wa%C5%82%C4%99sa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lech Wałęsa \(halaman dipōluwo\)")** menjadi presiden [Polandia](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polandia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Polandia \(halaman dipōluwo\)") yang pertama dipilih secara langsung melalui [pemilu](https://gor.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pemilu?action=edit&redlink=1 "Pemilu \(halaman dipōluwo\)").

## Aaj ke khaas lekh  
---  
[![Hereford Jahaaj](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/hif/thumb/a/a8/HerefordShip.jpg/120px-HerefordShip.jpg)](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/file:HerefordShip.jpg "Hereford Jahaaj") **Hereford** 14th jahaaj rahaa jisme gimitya log ke lae ke [India](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/India "India") se [Fiji](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiji "Fiji") lawa gais rahaa. Iske baad ii jahaaj dui aur dafe Fiji aais. Ii jahaaj 1510 ton garrhu aur loha ke banaa, paal waala jahaaj rahaa jiske 1869 me Glasgow ke J. Elder & Company, Merchant Shipping Company of London khatir banais rahaa. Suruu me iske [New Zealand](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Zealand "New Zealand") nawa immigrant logan ke lae jaae khaatir kaam me lawa gais rahaa. 1882 me ii jahaaj ke Nourse Line kharid liis aur iske West Indies girmitya logan ke lae jaae khatir kaam me lawa gais. Ii jahaaj Fiji pahila dafe [24 April](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/24_April "24 April") [1888](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1888 "1888") ke 539 girmitya logan ke lae ke, duusra dafe [15 June](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/15_June "15 June") [1892](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1892 "1892") ke 479 girmitya logan ke lae ke aur tiisra dafe, [28 June](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/28_June "28 June") [1894](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1894 "1894") ke, 511 girmitya logan ke lae ke aais. 1898 me Hereford ke Norway ke ek Company ke bech dewa giais aur 1907 me ii Argentina ke nangich ek chattan pe charr ke duub gais. **([aur...](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hereford_I "Hereford I"))**  
## Aap janta hai...  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e4/Cakobau%2C_died_February_1883%2C_photograph_by_Francis_H._Dufty.jpg/120px-Cakobau%2C_died_February_1883%2C_photograph_by_Francis_H._Dufty.jpg)](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/file:Seruepenisacakobau.jpg)Ratu Cakobau
  * [1875](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1875 "1875") ke **[measles epidemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Measles "w:Measles")** , jisme 20% Kaiviti logan mar gae rahin, ke Fiji me failae waala, Ratu Cakobau aur uske dui larrka logan rahin jon ki March 1875 me Sydney se ghuum ke lauta rahin.
  * [1879](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1879 "1879") se lae ke [1916](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1916 "1916") tak, 42 jahaaj, 87 trip me 60,553 **[girmitya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian%20indenture%20system "w:Indian indenture system")** logan ke lae ke Fiji se aais rahaa. Isme se 45,439 log Calcutta se aur 15,114 log Madras se jahaaj me charrhin rahaa.
  * Fiji ke Legislative Council ke pahila Hindustani member **[Badri Maharaj](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Badri_Maharaj "Badri Maharaj")** rahaa, jiske Governor nominate karis rahaa aur jon 1917 - 1923 aur 1926 - 1929 tak Council ke member rahaa.
  * Fiji me pahila football competition **[Nasau Park](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasau_Park "Nasau Park")** , **[Levuka](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levuka_\(town\),_Fiji "Levuka \(town\), Fiji")** me [1924](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1924 "1924") me, Cession ke golden jublee celebrate kare ke time, chhe Kaiviti team ke biich me Ricarnie Cup khatir, khela gais rahaa.
  * Fiji ke Hindustani ke army me join kare ke khatir, [1934](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1934 "1934") me **[Indian Platoon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian%20Platoon%20\(Fiji\) "w:Indian Platoon \(Fiji\)")** banawa gais rahaa lekin iske [1940](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/1940 "1940") me disband kar dewa gais rahaa.
  * Royal Air Force ke khatir fighter plane kharide ke khatir, 1943 me ek Fighter Fund suruu karaa gais rahaa, aur ii paisa se nau fighter aur paanch bomber kharida gais rahaa. Ek fighter ke naam **Fiji Indian Fighter** rahaa.
  * Fiji Trade Union Congress se pahile **[Ami Chandra](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ami_Chandra "Ami Chandra")** , 1950s me Fiji Industrial Workers Congress suruu karis rahaa.
  * **[Fiji ke 1997 ke constitution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constitution%20of%20Fiji "w:Constitution of Fiji")** me English aur Kaiviti ke saathe Hindustani ke Fiji ke official language banawa gais rahaa.

## Taaja khabar  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/dd/Biman_Prasad_2023.jpg/120px-Biman_Prasad_2023.jpg)](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/file:Biman_Prasad_2023.jpg)Biman Prasad
  * [29 October](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/29_October "29 October") - [Fiji](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiji "Fiji") ke Deputy Prime Minister aur Minister of Finance, **[Biman Prasad](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biman_Prasad "Biman Prasad")** rsign kar dis kaaheki uske FICAC corruption ke khaatir charge karis hae.
  * [22 June](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/22_June "22 June") - [United States](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States "United States") ke Air Force aur Navy, [Iran](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iran "Iran") ke tiin nuclear facilities ke attack karis.
  * [21 April](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/21_April "21 April") - **[Pope Francis](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Francis "Pope Francis")** ke maut Vatican City me bhais rahaa.
  * [30 March](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/30_March "30 March") - Ek **7.7 magnitude bhukamp** ke kaaran [Myanmar](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myanmar "Myanmar") aur [Thailand](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thailand "Thailand") me 2,000 log ke maut hoe gais.
  * [19 February](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/19_February "19 February") - **[Toronto](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toronto "Toronto") Airport** me **Delta Air Lines** ke plane, utarte ke samay ulut gais lekin sab passengers bach gain
  * [16 February](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/16_February "16 February") - **78 British Academy Film Awards** me, _**Conclave**_ ke chaar award milaa.
  * [29 December](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/29_December "29 December") - **[Jimmy Carter](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Carter "Jimmy Carter")** , [America](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/America "America") ke 39th President, ke maut Plains, [Georgia](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georgia "Georgia") me bhais.

## Aaj se sau saal pahile, 1925 me...  
  * Ii saal, [Fiji](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiji "Fiji") me 64,963 bigha jamiin me ganna boya gais rahaa, jisme se 33,679 bigha (52%) CSR bois rahaa, 4,446 bigha (7%) ke Goraa kisaan boy rahin, 6,905 bigha (10%), ke CSR ke asaami log boy rahin aur 19,933 bigha (31%) ke Hindustani contractors boy rahin.
  * Ii saal, Fiji me Hindustani ke birth rate 33.14 per thousand rahaa, jab ki Kaiviti ke birth rate of 32.29 per thousand rahaa, lekin Hindustani ke death rate 7.25 per thousand rahaa, jab ki Kaiviti death rate of 22.75 per thousand rahaa
  * Ii saal Fiji me khaali 174 Hindustani saadi ke register karaa gais rahaa, jab ki 857 Kaiviti saadi ke register karaa gais rahaa.
  * Saal ke end me, Fiji ke abaadi 169,667 rahaa, jisme se 88,431 Kaiviti rahin aur 68,136 Hindustani rahin. Iske matlab hae ki ii saal Fiji me 3,956 aur Kaiviti aur aur 7,502 aur Hindustani rahin agar iske April 1921 ke census se compare karaa jaae.
  * Britain ke sarkar ii nischay karis ki Fiji ke election common roll pe nai hoe sake, kaaheki ii Deed of Cession ke against rahii.
  * [9 May](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_May "9 May") – Fiji me ek typhoid ke epidemic faelaa, jisme tiin Goraa log ke maut bhais. Kuchh Hindustani log bhi aspataal me bharti rahin, lekin Kaiviti log pe koi asar nai rahaa. [Indian Reform League](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Reform_League "Indian Reform League"),volunteer nurses ke provide karis rahaa.
  * [9 July](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/9_July "9 July") - **Guru Dutt** , [Hindi](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hindi "Hindi") film actor, ke janam Bangalore, [India](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/India "India") me bhais rahaa.

**Pahile waala saal:[1908](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1908 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1908")[1909](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1909 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1909")[1910](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1910 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1910")[1911](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1911 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1911")****[1912](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1912 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1912")****[1913](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1913 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1913")****[1914](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1914 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1914")****[1915](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1915 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1915")****[1916](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1916 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1916")****[1917](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1917 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1917")****[1920](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1920 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1920")** _**[1921](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1921 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1921")****[1923](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1923 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1923")****[1924](https://hif.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sau_saal_pahile/1924 "Wikipedia:Sau saal pahile/1924")**_
