## 
Хорошая статья 
[Нилова Пустынь](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C_\(%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82\) "Нилова Пустынь \(курорт\)")
[![Нилова Пустынь](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/84/%D0%9A%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82_%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C.jpg/250px-%D0%9A%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82_%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C.jpg)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%D0%9A%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82_%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C.jpg?uselang=ru "Нилова Пустынь")Нилова Пустынь
**[Ни́лова Пу́стынь](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C_\(%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82\) "Нилова Пустынь \(курорт\)")** ([бур.](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8F%D1%82%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D1%8F%D0%B7%D1%8B%D0%BA "Бурятский язык") Халуун аршаан — «Горячий источник») — [бальнеологический](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82 "Бальнеологический курорт") и климатический курорт местного значения [России](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%8F "Россия"), находящийся в посёлке [Ниловка](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B0_\(%D0%91%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%8F\) "Ниловка \(Бурятия\)") [Тункинского района](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BE%D0%BD "Тункинский район") [Республики Бурятии](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%8F "Бурятия") на южных [отрогах](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D1%82%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B3 "Отрог") [Восточного Саяна](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9_%D0%A1%D0%B0%D1%8F%D0%BD "Восточный Саян") на выходе вод Нилова источника. В состав курорта входит [автономное учреждение](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B2%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B5_%D1%83%D1%87%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5 "Автономное учреждение") «Курортная бальнеологическая лечебница „Нилова Пустынь“» и восемь [пансионатов](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82 "Пансионат"). 
Основными лечебными факторами курорта являются [климат](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%8F "Климатотерапия") и не питьевая [слаборадиоактивная](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%B0%D0%BA%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B2%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9_%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%B4 "Радиоактивный распад") [термальная](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9_%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA "Геотермальный источник") [минеральная вода](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B0 "Минеральная вода"), содержащая [радон](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD "Радон"). На курорте для лечения пациентов применяются бальнеологические процедуры, [иглорефлексотерапия](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BA%D1%83%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B0 "Акупунктура") и [гирудотерапия](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B8%D1%80%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%8F "Гирудотерапия"), при помощи которых лечат заболевания [кожи](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%B6%D0%B0 "Кожа"), [суставов](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%B2 "Сустав"), [опорно-двигательного аппарата](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%BE-%D0%B4%D0%B2%D0%B8%D0%B3%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Опорно-двигательная система"), [нервной системы](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B2%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Нервная система"), [гинекологических](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%8F "Гинекология"), [сосудистых](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B5_%D1%81%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%83%D0%B4%D1%8B "Кровеносные сосуды"), [урологических](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%8F "Урология"), [интоксикационных](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F "Интоксикация") заболеваний. [Радоновые ванны](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8B%D0%B5_%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BD%D1%8B "Радоновые ванны") оказывают обезболивающее и противоаллергическое действие, стимулируют [обмен веществ](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B1%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%BD_%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%89%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2 "Обмен веществ"), нормализуют функции [эндокринных желёз](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%AD%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B5_%D0%B6%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B7%D1%8B "Эндокринные железы") и деятельность [центральной нервной системы](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A6%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B2%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Центральная нервная система"). 
До официального открытия Нилова источника, среди местных жителей — [эвенков](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%AD%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B8 "Эвенки") и [бурят](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%83%D1%80%D1%8F%D1%82%D1%8B "Буряты"), он считался священным местом, возле него были построены [обо](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B1%D0%BE "Обо") и проводились [буддийские](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BC "Буддизм") [религиозные обряды](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B1%D1%80%D1%8F%D0%B4 "Обряд"). Как курортная местность Нилова Пустынь известна с 1840 года, когда по приказу [генерал-губернатора](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB-%D0%B3%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80 "Генерал-губернатор") [Восточной Сибири](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%A1%D0%B8%D0%B1%D0%B8%D1%80%D1%8C "Восточная Сибирь") [В. Я. Руперта](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D1%83%D0%BF%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%82,_%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BC_%D0%AF%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Руперт, Вильгельм Яковлевич") были проведены исследования источника и началось развитие курорта на месте выхода вод. Начиная с 1845 года курорт перешёл в ведение [православной церкви](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%86%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%8C "Православная церковь"), где [архиепископ](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%80%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%B5%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BF "Архиепископ") [Иркутска](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D1%80%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%82%D1%81%D0%BA "Иркутск") и [Нерчинска](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA "Нерчинск") [Нил](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB_\(%D0%98%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87\) "Нил \(Исакович\)") основал Ниловский мужской [пустынь](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C "Пустынь"), освящённый во имя [преподобного](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9 "Преподобный") [Нила Столбенского](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB_%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9 "Нил Столобенский"), в честь которого курорт носит своё название. В 1917 году Нилова Пустынь была [национализирована](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F "Национализация"). После [распада СССР](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%B4_%D0%A1%D0%A1%D0%A1%D0%A0 "Распад СССР") [АУ](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%B2%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B5_%D1%83%D1%87%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5 "Автономное учреждение") КБЛ «Нилова Пустынь» находится на балансе [Тункинского района](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BE%D0%BD "Тункинский район"). 
  * [Читать](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0_%D0%9F%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%BD%D1%8C_\(%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%82\) "Нилова Пустынь \(курорт\)")
  * [Все 5059 хороших статей](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%8F:%D0%A5%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%88%D0%B8%D0%B5_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8C%D0%B8 "Википедия:Хорошие статьи")

Титульный лист первого издания \(1617\)")Странствия Персилеса и Сихизмунды. Титульный лист первого издания (1617)
  * [Автор](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%81,_%D0%9C%D0%B8%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C_%D0%B4%D0%B5 "Сервантес, Мигель де") «[Дон Кихота](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%BE%D0%BD_%D0%9A%D0%B8%D1%85%D0%BE%D1%82_\(%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD\) "Дон Кихот \(роман\)")» считал своей лучшей книгой **[другой роман](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%9F%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%B0_%D0%B8_%D0%A1%D0%B8%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%8B "Странствия Персилеса и Сихизмунды")** _( на илл.)_.
  * Если компьютерную графику тестировали на «[чайнике из Юты](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA_%D0%B8%D0%B7_%D0%AE%D1%82%D1%8B "Чайник из Юты")», то [ИИ-видео](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B2%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9_%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%81%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9_%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82 "Генеративный искусственный интеллект") — на **[Уилле Смите](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A3%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BB_%D0%A1%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%82_%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82_%D1%81%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B5%D1%82%D1%82%D0%B8 "Уилл Смит ест спагетти")**.
  * У [предшественника Шекспира](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BB%D0%BE,_%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%84%D0%B5%D1%80 "Марло, Кристофер") была только одна **[сильная женщина](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0,_%D1%86%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B0_%D0%9A%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%84%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Дидона, царица Карфагена")**.
  * Одна из самых расточительных стран допускала создание олимпийских медалей **[из отходов](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%AD%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B5_%D0%BE%D1%82%D1%85%D0%BE%D0%B4%D1%8B_%D0%B2_%D0%AF%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B8 "Электронные отходы в Японии")**.

[![«Святая Русь»](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/25/Nesterov_SaintRussia.JPG/120px-Nesterov_SaintRussia.JPG)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nesterov_SaintRussia.JPG?uselang=ru "«Святая Русь»")«Святая Русь»
  * Обсуждение покупки **[картины для императорского музея](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%B2%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%A0%D1%83%D1%81%D1%8C_\(%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%9D%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B0\) "Святая Русь \(картина Нестерова\)")** _( на илл.)_ было настолько бурным, что у [одного из спорщиков](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%83%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B6%D0%B8,_%D0%90%D1%80%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%BF_%D0%98%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Куинджи, Архип Иванович") хлынула кровь из носа и горла.
  * **[Советник](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%BA%D1%83,_%D0%9A%D0%B0%D1%86%D1%83%D1%85%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE "Оку, Кацухико")** японского посольства в Лондоне, погибший в [Ираке](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BA "Ирак"), был посмертно произведён в [послы](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BB "Посол").
  * Антиохийский православный **[патриарх](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%B3%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B9_III_%D0%90%D1%82%D1%8B%D0%B9%D1%8F "Игнатий III Атыйя")** [каялся](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5_%D0%B2_%D1%85%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B5 "Покаяние в христианстве") перед Католической церковью в грехе убийства своего **[соперника](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%BB_IV_%D0%94%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%81 "Кирилл IV Даббас")**.
  * Отсутствие музыкального образования не помешало **[историку](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D1%83%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80,_%D0%90%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D0%95%D0%B2%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Гутор, Анатолий Евгеньевич")** -[сувороведу](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D1%83%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2,_%D0%90%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80_%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Суворов, Александр Васильевич") руководить факультетом в [Московской консерватории](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8_%D0%9F._%D0%98._%D0%A7%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE "Московская государственная консерватория имени П. И. Чайковского").

[![Румынский чимпой, Мунтения, 1965](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1b/Europeana.eu-09102-_RMAH_117921_NL-de40cb1fbf35db4750d96c176586ea81.jpg/120px-Europeana.eu-09102-_RMAH_117921_NL-de40cb1fbf35db4750d96c176586ea81.jpg)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Europeana.eu-09102-_RMAH_117921_NL-de40cb1fbf35db4750d96c176586ea81.jpg?uselang=ru "Румынский чимпой, Мунтения, 1965")Румынский чимпой, Мунтения, 1965
  * [Бела Барток](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BA,_%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B0 "Барток, Бела") имитировал на фортепиано звучание [волынки](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%8B%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Волынка"), вдохновившись тем, как румынскому **[чимпою](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B9 "Чимпой")** _( на илл.)_ подражают народная скрипка и пастушеский [флуер](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%BB%D1%83%D0%B5%D1%80 "Флуер").
  * Второй поставленный в СССР **[конный памятник](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%BC%D1%8F%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA_%D0%90%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B4%D1%8B_%D0%98%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%83 "Памятник Амангельды Иманову")** посвящён [предводителю](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B4%D1%8B_%D0%98%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2 "Амангельды Иманов") [казахского восстания](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B5_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5_\(1916%E2%80%941917\) "Тургайское восстание \(1916—1917\)") против царских властей.
  * [Акционер строительной компании](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%8E%D0%BD%D0%BE-%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%8F,_%D0%A4%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BF%D0%BF_%D0%96%D0%B0%D0%BD "Бюно-Варилья, Филипп Жан") от лица [чужой страны](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B0 "Панама") заключил **[международный договор](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%80_%D0%A5%D0%B5%D1%8F_%E2%80%94_%D0%91%D1%8E%D0%BD%D0%BE-%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%B8 "Договор Хея — Бюно-Варильи")** с целью возместить убытки.
  * Единственным, кто пытался обеспечить женщинам право присутствовать на **[обедах беллетристов](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%B4%D1%8B_%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2 "Обеды беллетристов")** , был [Василий Немирович-Данченко](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87-%D0%94%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BA%D0%BE,_%D0%92%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D0%98%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Немирович-Данченко, Василий Иванович").

Актуальные темы
    [война на Ближнем Востоке](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%91%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B6%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%BC_%D0%92%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%B5_\(%D1%81_2023\) "Война на Ближнем Востоке \(с 2023\)")      [вторжение России на Украину](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B6%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5_%D0%A0%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%B8_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%A3%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%83_\(%D1%81_2022\) "Вторжение России на Украину \(с 2022\)") ([декабрь](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A5%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%B2%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B6%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%A0%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8%D0%B8_%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%A3%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%83_\(%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B1%D1%80%D1%8C_2025\) "Хронология вторжения России на Украину \(декабрь 2025\)"))     [гражданская война в Судане](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D1%80%D0%B5%D1%82%D1%8C%D1%8F_%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B6%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B2_%D0%A1%D1%83%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B5 "Третья гражданская война в Судане")     [тарифные войны США](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%84%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%B2%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B9_%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%BC%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%B8_%D0%A2%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%BF%D0%B0 "Тарифная политика второй администрации Трампа")     [чемпионат мира по гандболу среди женщин](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BF%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82_%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%83_%D1%81%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8_%D0%B6%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%89%D0%B8%D0%BD_2025 "Чемпионат мира по гандболу среди женщин 2025")
[![Ландо Норрис](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0b/2024-08-25_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_3968_by_Stepro_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-2024-08-25_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_3968_by_Stepro_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2024-08-25_Motorsport,_Formel_1,_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_3968_by_Stepro_\(cropped\).jpg?uselang=ru "Ландо Норрис")Ландо Норрис
  * Впервые за 27 лет команда **«[Макларен](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B0%D0%BA%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BD_\(%D0%B0%D0%B2%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%87%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B0\) "Макларен \(автогоночная команда\)")»** одержала победу как в личном (**[Ландо Норрис](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%BE_%D0%9D%D0%BE%D1%80%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81 "Ландо Норрис")** _( на илл.)_), так и в командном зачёте [«Формулы-1»](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%BB%D0%B0-1 "Формула-1").
  * В [Бенине](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BD "Бенин") произошла **[попытка военного переворота](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BE%D0%BF%D1%8B%D1%82%D0%BA%D0%B0_%D0%B2%D0%BE%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE_%D0%BF%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%B2_%D0%91%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B5_\(2025\) "Попытка военного переворота в Бенине \(2025\)")**.
  * **[Себастьен Ожье](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%B6%D1%8C%D0%B5,_%D0%A1%D0%B5%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8C%D0%B5%D0%BD "Ожье, Себастьен")** **[стал](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BF%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82_%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B8_2025 "Чемпионат мира по ралли 2025")** [чемпионом мира по ралли](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A7%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%BF%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82_%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B0_%D0%BF%D0%BE_%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BB%D0%B8 "Чемпионат мира по ралли") в девятый раз, повторив рекорд [Себастьена Лёба](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D1%91%D0%B1,_%D0%A1%D0%B5%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D1%8C%D0%B5%D0%BD "Лёб, Себастьен") по числу титулов.
  * Жертвами циклонов **[«Дитва»](https://ru.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%A6%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD_%C2%AB%D0%94%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B0%C2%BB&action=edit&redlink=1 "Циклон «Дитва» \(страница отсутствует\)")[[англ.]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclone_Ditwah "en:Cyclone Ditwah")** и **[«Сеньяр»](https://ru.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%D0%A6%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD_%C2%AB%D0%A1%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C%D1%8F%D1%80%C2%BB&action=edit&redlink=1 "Циклон «Сеньяр» \(страница отсутствует\)")[[англ.]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclone_Senyar "en:Cyclone Senyar")** в Азии стали более 1600 человек.
  * Глава [офиса президента Украины](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D1%84%D0%B8%D1%81_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B0_%D0%A3%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%8B "Офис президента Украины") **[Андрей Ермак](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%95%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%BA,_%D0%90%D0%BD%D0%B4%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B9_%D0%91%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Ермак, Андрей Борисович")** ушёл в отставку на фоне вызвавшего широкий резонанс [антикоррупционного расследования](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D0%BF%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F_%C2%AB%D0%9C%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B0%D1%81%C2%BB "Операция «Мидас»").
  * Из-за повреждений стартового комплекса на **[площадке 31](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%BB%D0%BE%D1%89%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%BA%D0%B0_31 "Площадка 31")** на [космодроме](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B4%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BC "Космодром") **«[Байконур](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%83%D1%80 "Байконур")»** [Россия](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A0%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%8F "Россия") впервые с 1961 года не сможет отправлять в космос людей.



[Недавно умершие](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%BA_%D1%83%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80%D1%88%D0%B8%D1%85_%D0%B2_2025_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4%D1%83 "Список умерших в 2025 году")
    [Иэн Дуглас-Гамильтон](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D1%83%D0%B3%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%81-%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BD,_%D0%98%D1%8D%D0%BD "Дуглас-Гамильтон, Иэн")     [Мартин Парр](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%80,_%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD "Парр, Мартин")     [Вячеслав Криштофович](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%88%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%84%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87,_%D0%92%D1%8F%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B2_%D0%A1%D0%B8%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Криштофович, Вячеслав Сигизмундович")     [Фрэнк Гери](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D1%80%D1%8D%D0%BD%D0%BA_%D0%93%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8 "Фрэнк Гери")     [Сергей Дубинин](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BD,_%D0%A1%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B5%D0%B9_%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%BD%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%87 "Дубинин, Сергей Константинович")     [Кэри-Хироюки Тагава](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A2%D0%B0%D0%B3%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0,_%D0%9A%D1%8D%D1%80%D0%B8-%D0%A5%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%BE%D1%8E%D0%BA%D0%B8 "Тагава, Кэри-Хироюки")

## 
В этот день 
[10 декабря](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%B1%D1%80%D1%8F "10 декабря")
[![Портрет короля Эдуарда VIII, 1930-е](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/cb/King_Edward_VIII_portrait.webp/250px-King_Edward_VIII_portrait.webp.png)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:King_Edward_VIII_portrait.webp?uselang=ru "Портрет короля Эдуарда VIII, 1930-е")Портрет короля Эдуарда VIII, 1930-е
[День прав человека](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%94%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2_%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B0 "День прав человека")
  * [1508](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1508_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1508 год") — для борьбы с [Венецией](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%80%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Венецианская республика") организована [Камбрейская лига](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B9%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B9_%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B3%D0%B8#%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B9%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B3%D0%B0_\(1508%E2%80%941510\) "Война Камбрейской лиги").
  * [1520](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1520_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1520 год") — [Мартин Лютер](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9B%D1%8E%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80,_%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%BD "Лютер, Мартин") публично сжёг папскую буллу _[Exsurge Domine](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exsurge_Domine "Exsurge Domine")_.
  * [1901](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1901_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1901 год") — присуждены первые [Нобелевские премии](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9D%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B2%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%8F "Нобелевская премия").
  * [1930](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1930_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1930 год") — французские власти на полвека запретили показ фильма [Луиса Бунюэля](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%91%D1%83%D0%BD%D1%8C%D1%8E%D1%8D%D0%BB%D1%8C,_%D0%9B%D1%83%D0%B8%D1%81 "Буньюэль, Луис") «[Золотой век](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%97%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B9_%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BA_\(%D1%84%D0%B8%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BC,_1930\) "Золотой век \(фильм, 1930\)")».
  * [1936](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1936_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1936 год") — [Эдуард VIII](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%AD%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4_VIII "Эдуард VIII") _( на илл.)_ первым из английских монархов добровольно [отрёкся от престола](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9E%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B5%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5_%D0%AD%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%B0_VIII "Отречение Эдуарда VIII").
  * [1948](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1948_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1948 год") — [Генеральная Ассамблея ООН](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%90%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%8F_%D0%9E%D0%9E%D0%9D "Генеральная Ассамблея ООН") приняла [Всеобщую декларацию прав человека](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%92%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2_%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BA%D0%B0 "Всеобщая декларация прав человека").
  * [1993](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1993_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1993 год") — вышла компьютерная игра _[Doom](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doom_\(%D0%B8%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B0,_1993\) "Doom \(игра, 1993\)")_.
  * [1997](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/1997_%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4 "1997 год") — [столица Казахстана](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A1%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B0_%D0%A0%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B0%D1%85%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD "Столица Республики Казахстан") [перенесена](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BE%D1%81_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%86%D1%8B_%D0%9A%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B0%D1%85%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0_%D0%B2_%D0%90%D0%BA%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BB%D1%83 "Перенос столицы Казахстана в Акмолу") в город [Акмола](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%90%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B0 "Астана") (Астана).

## 
Совместная работа недели
Приглашаем всех желающих принять участие в работе над статьями о **[произведениях Фридриха Дюрренматта](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD:%D0%94%D1%8E%D1%80%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%82 "Шаблон:Дюрренматт")** и о **[лауреатах премии Джерарда Койпера](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%8F_%D0%94%D0%B6%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B4%D0%B0_%D0%9A%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BF%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0 "Премия Джерарда Койпера")**. 
  * {{[Дюрренматт](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%BD:%D0%94%D1%8E%D1%80%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%82 "Шаблон:Дюрренматт")}}


  * _Примите также участие в[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/ru/thumb/6/62/Gzhel_ball_wiki.png/20px-Gzhel_ball_wiki.png)](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB:Gzhel_ball_wiki.png) «**[XVII Обобщающей тематической неделе](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9F%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%82:%D0%A2%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8F/XVII_%D0%9E%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B0%D1%8E%D1%89%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8F "Проект:Тематическая неделя/XVII Обобщающая неделя")** »_.

## Родственные проекты Викимедиа
Википедия расположена на серверах [Фонда Викимедиа](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A4%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%B4_%D0%92%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B0 "Фонд Викимедиа") — некоммерческой организации, также обеспечивающей работу ряда других проектов

O tagata o Mexico e [gagana spaniolo](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gagana_spaniolo "Gagana spaniolo"). O le taulaga o Mexico o [Mexico Siti](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexico_Siti "Mexico Siti"). E fiafia tagata mai Mexico i ta'aloga pea foi Pi'iga ma isi fo'i ta'aloga. E pea tutusa le tel'e o Mexico ia tuinisalagi. E pea fo'i 106,682,500 tagata le nonofo i le nu'u le i lenei vaiaimi nei.[.........](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexico "Mexico")  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d7/Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png) I isi gagana

Wikipedia (Gagana Pasefika ma Amerika): [Gagana Maori](https://mi.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "mi:") · [Gagana Hawai'i](https://haw.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "haw:") · [Gagana Toga](https://to.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "to:") · [Gagana Tok Pisin](https://tpi.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "tpi:") · [Dorerin Naoero](https://na.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "na:") · [Gagana Tahiti](https://ty.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ty:") · [Gagana Bislama](https://bi.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "bi:") · [Gagana Viti](https://fj.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "fj:") · [Gagana Tuvalu](https://incubator.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wp/tvl/Main%20Page "incubator:Wp/tvl/Main Page") · [Gagana Chamorro](https://ch.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ch:") · [Gagana Quechua](https://qu.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "qu:") · [Gagana Cheyenne](https://chy.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "chy:") · [Gagana Aymara](https://ay.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ay:") · [Gagana To'elauan](https://incubator.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wp/tkl "incubator:Wp/tkl") Wikipidiya (+ 100 000 itūlau): [Fa'aperetania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "en:") · [Fa'asiamani](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "de:") · [Fa'afarani](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "fr:") · [Fa'apolani](https://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "pl:") · [Fa'aitaliani](https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "it:") · [Fa'aiapani](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ja:") · [Fa'asipaniolo](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "es:") · [Fa'anetelani](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "nl:") · [Fa'a Potukale](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "pt:") · [Fa'a Lusia](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ru:") ·

|  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/65/WikiLetra.png/40px-WikiLetra.png)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:WikiLetra.png) [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d7/Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png) ‘E te lē iloa ‘ea?   
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/ae/Manono_Island.jpg/250px-Manono_Island.jpg)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Manono_Island.jpg)
  * O **[Manono](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manono "Manono")** o le motu i [Sāmoa](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C4%81moa "Sāmoa") e tu i le va o [Upolu](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Upolu "Upolu") ma [Savai'i](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Savai'i "Savai'i"). E 889 tagata e nonofo i **Manono**. A fa'apea e fia malaga i Manono, e o tagata i va'a laiti mai Mulifanua. Na faiina le malo se fasotaiga tau telefoni i Manono ma eletise 24 tula o le vaiaso.
  * 'O le **[Iunivesitē Aoao o Sāmoa](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iunivesit%C4%93_Aoao_o_Samoa "Iunivesitē Aoao o Samoa")** , e tū i le 'Papaigalagala' i Vaivase, Apia i Sāmoa. E to'atele tupulaga mai le Pasefika 'ua ā'o'oga ai i lenei Iunivesite. Na fa'atūina lenei Iunivesite i lalo o le pūlega fa'apalemia a le afioga ia Tofilau Eti Alesana. 'O se tōfā loloto lea na fa'ataunu'uina ai lenei fa'amoemoe, ma tula'i mai ai se Iunivesite a Samoa lava ia.
  * 'O le **['Inisinia](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/'Inisinia "'Inisinia")** 'o se tagata atamai i mea tau tekonolosi e fau ai masini po'o fausaga tetele e pei o alalaupapa, ala tetele fa'apea ma vāega 'ese'ese o le soifua e mana'omia ai se masini po'o se meafaitino e fesoasoani ai i le fa'afaigofie o le olaga o le tagata.
  * 'O le **[Lakapī](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lakapi "Lakapi")** 'o se ta'aloga e fiafia tele i ai tagata Sāmoa. 'O lenei ta'aloga, 'ua 'avea ma ta'aloga e naunau 'i ai ma to'a'aga 'i ai tupulaga tama i [Sāmoa](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C4%81moa "Sāmoa"). 'O le isi mea e sili ona tāua, 'ua ta'uta'ua ai fo'i le atunu'u o Sāmoa 'ona 'o lana 'aulakapī e fa'aigoa o le Manu Sāmoa.

  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8f/W-circle.svg/40px-W-circle.svg.png)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:W-circle.svg) [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d7/Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Wikibar-alpha-8bit.png) Faʻatomuaga  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/ad/2009-07-20_wpy_07.JPG/250px-2009-07-20_wpy_07.JPG)](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:2009-07-20_wpy_07.JPG) 'O lenei nofoaga 'ua fa'atautaia mo tagata e tautatala i le **[Gagana Sāmoa](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gagana_S%C4%81moa "Gagana Sāmoa") [Wikipedia](https://sm.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia")** po'o tagata fo'i 'olo'o fia a'oa'oina le gagana Sāmoa. 'Afai e loloto lou mālamalama i le Gagana Sāmoa, e mafai lava ona 'e suia isi 'upu ma feasoasoani i le fa'a'upuina ma le teuteuga o matā'upu e fa'atalanoaina i totonu o lenei nofoaga po'o le potu. Mo se fa'amatalaga i le fa'atinoina o le Wikipedia,po'o le poroketi Wikipedia va'ai le nofoaga po'o le potu [www.wikipedia.org](https://www.wikipedia.org/) Fa'amolemole va'ai 'upu lanumūmū, 'olo'o mana'omia ai lau fesoasoani mo sau fa'amatalaga (po'o se fa'aliliuga fo'i) o nei matā'upu.

## විශේෂාංග ලිපිය  
---  
|  [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/42/Zahntempel_Kandy.jpg/120px-Zahntempel_Kandy.jpg)](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%9C%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80:Zahntempel_Kandy.jpg) **[ශ්‍රී දළදා මාලිගාව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%81%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%93_%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%85%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "ශ්‍රී දළදා මාලිගාව")** යනු [බුදුරජාණන් වහන්සේගේ ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B6%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%A2%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%AB%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%84%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%9A "බුදුරජාණන් වහන්සේ") වම් දන්තධාතූන් වහන්සේ වර්තමානයේ තැන්පත් කර ඇති [මාළිගාවයි](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%85%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%85%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%8F "දළදා මාළිගා"). වර්තමාන දළදා මාළිගාව ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ [මහනුවර](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%84%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%BB "මහනුවර") නගරයේ පිහිටා ඇත. [උඩරට රාජ්‍යය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%8B%E0%B6%A9%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%A7_%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%A2%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BA%E0%B6%BA "උඩරට රාජ්‍යය") සමයේ (1592 සිට 1815) මෙය පිහිටා තිබුණේ එවකට පැවති [රාජකීය මාලිගා සංකීර්ණය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%99%E0%B6%82%E0%B6%9A%E0%B6%A9%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%BD_%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%A2%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%BA_%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%92%E0%B7%81%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%BA "සෙංකඩගල රාජකීය පරිශ්‍රය") තුළය. ශ්‍රී දළදා මාලිගාව මුල්වරට ගොඩනගනු ලැබුයේ [පළමුවන විමලධර්මසූරිය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%85%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%B1_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B8%E0%B6%BD%E0%B6%B0%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%96%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA_%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%A2 "පළමුවන විමලධර්මසූරිය රජ")(1592-1604) රජතුමා විසිනි. එතුමා ඉදිකළ මාලිගාව පෘතුගීසි ආක්‍රමණික‍යෝ විනාශ කළහ. දැනට දක්නට ලැබෙන පැරණි දෙමහල් වැඩසිටින මාලිගාව ඉදිකරනු ලැබ ඇත්තේ [ශ්‍රී වීරපරාක්‍රම නරේන්ද්‍රසිංහ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%81%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%93_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%BB_%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%B8_%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%9A%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%82%E0%B7%84_%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%A2 "ශ්‍රී වීර පරාක්‍රම නරේන්ද්‍රසිංහ රජ")(1707 - 1739) රජතුමාය. ඉන්පසු රජ පැමිණි නායක්කර් වංශික ද්‍රවිඩ රජවරු පවා ශ්‍රී දළදා මාලිගාව වැඩි දියුණු කොට ආරක්ෂා කළහ.  දළදා මාලිගාව පිහිටා ඇති [මහනුවර](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%84%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%BB "මහනුවර") නගරයම [යුනෙස්කෝව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%9D "යුනෙස්කෝ") විසින් ලෝක උරුමයක් ලෙස නම් කර ඇත. සියම් නිකායේ [මල්වතු](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B8%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%94_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%BA "මල්වතු විහාරය") හෝ [අස්ගිරි](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%85%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%92_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%BA "අස්ගිරි විහාරය") යන දෙපාර්ශවයේ ස්වාමීන් වහන්සේලා දිනපතාම දළදා වහන්සේට පූජා සත්කාර කරති. මෙම පූජාව (තේවාව) දිනකට තුන් වරක් (පාන්දර, දවල් සහ සවස) පවත්වයි බදාදා දිනවල විශේෂ පූජාවක් ලෙස නානුමුර මංගල්‍යය පවත්වයි. (**[තව දුරටත්...](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%81%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%93_%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%85%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "ශ්‍රී දළදා මාලිගාව")**)  තෝරාගත් ලිපි: [පසුගිය සතිය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA/17 "විකිපීඩියා:තෝරාගත් ලිපිය/17") – [මීළඟ සතිය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA/19 "විකිපීඩියා:තෝරාගත් ලිපිය/19") **[තෝම්බුව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA "විකිපීඩියා:තෝරාගත් ලිපිය")** – **[විද්‍යුත් තැපෑල මගින්](https://lists.wikimedia.org/postorius/lists/daily-article-l.lists.wikimedia.org/ "mail:daily-article-l")** – **[තෝරාගත් ලිපි...](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%92 "විකිපීඩියා:තෝරාගත් ලිපි")**  
---  
## ඔබ දැන සිටියාද...  
_විකිපීඩියාවෙහි නවතම තොරතුරු වලින්:_ [![වෙන්වීමෙන් පසු සේවා මොඩියුලය](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fe/Apollo_13_Service_Module_%28lossless_crop%29.jpg/120px-Apollo_13_Service_Module_%28lossless_crop%29.jpg)](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%9C%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80:Apollo_13_Service_Module_\(lossless_crop\).jpg "වෙන්වීමෙන් පසු සේවා මොඩියුලය")වෙන්වීමෙන් පසු සේවා මොඩියුලය
* ...**[ඇපලෝ 13](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%87%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%9D_13 "ඇපලෝ 13")** මෙහෙයුම අතරතුර [සේවා මොඩියුලයේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B0%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%B1_%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%84_%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%9A%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%9C%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%BD%E0%B6%BA "විධාන සහ සේවා මොඩියුලය") වූ පිපිරීමක් _(සේයාරුව)_ හේතුවෙන් [සඳ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%B3 "සඳ") මත ගොඩබෑම නවතා දැමීමට සිදු වූ බවත්, ගගනගාමීන් තිදෙනා ආරක්ෂිතව පෘථිවියට ගෙන ඒම සඳහා එහි චන්ද්‍ර මොඩියුලය ජීවිතාරක්ෂක බෝට්ටුවක් ලෙස භාවිතා කළ බව? 
* ...**[ලිනස් ටොවල්ඩ්ස්ට](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%9C%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A "ලිනස් ටොවල්ඩ්ස්")** නම තබා ඇත්තේ පීනට්ස් කාටූනයේ එන ලිනස් චරිතය අනුසාරයෙන් බව? 
* ... **[ග්‍රෙගරි දිනදසුන](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%99%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%92_%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%B1 "ග්‍රෙගරි දිනදසුන")** යනු ජාත්‍යන්තර වශයෙන් පිළිගැනුනු සිවිල් දින දසුනයි. ‍ලොව බොහෝ රටවල් මෙය රටේ සම්මත දින දසුන ලෙස භාවිතා කරයි. 
* ... **[මතකය (ස්මෘතිය)](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B8%E0%B6%AD%E0%B6%9A%E0%B6%BA_\(%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%98%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA\) "මතකය \(ස්මෘතිය\)")** යනු ජීවියෙකු තුළ තොරතුරු ගබඩා කිරීමට, රඳවා ගැනීමට සහ ඉන්පසුව එම තොරතුරු නැවත එළි දැක්වීමට ඇති හැකියාවයි.

* ... [සංඛ්‍යාංක සම්ප්‍රේෂණයේදී](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%82%E0%B6%9B%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%82%E0%B6%9A_%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%9A%E0%B7%82%E0%B6%AB%E0%B6%BA "සංඛ්‍යාංක සම්ප්‍රේෂණය"), [**බීටු දෝෂ** ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B6%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%94_%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%9D%E0%B7%82_%E0%B6%85%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B6%BA "බීටු දෝෂ අනුපාතිකය") සංඛ්‍යාව යනු [සන්නිවේදන නාලිකාවක්](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%92%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%9A%E0%B6%AF%E0%B6%B1_%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "සන්නිවේදන නාලිකාව") ඔස්සේ දත්ත ප්‍රවාහයක් යැවුනු පසුව ප්‍රතිග්‍රාහණය වන බීටු අතුරින්, ඝෝෂාව, නිරෝධනය, කුරූපණය හෝ බීටු සමමුහූර්තකරණ දෝෂ නිසාවෙන් විවිර්තනය වන්නාවූ බීටු සංඛ්‍යාව වෙයි.  **[තෝම්බුව](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Recent_additions "en:Wikipedia:Recent additions")** – **[නව ලිපියක් අරඹන්න](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:Your_first_article "විකිපීඩියා:Your first article")** – **[ලිපියක් ඉදිරිපත් කරන්න](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92_%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9A%E0%B6%A0%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%A1%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80:%E0%B6%94%E0%B6%B6_%E0%B6%AF%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%AF "සැකිලි සාකච්ඡාව:ඔබ දන්නවාද")**

## පුවත් බිඳක්  
---  
[![දිට්වා සුළි කුණාටුව](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6d/An_image_of_Cyclone_Ditwah_reaching_high_intensity.png/250px-An_image_of_Cyclone_Ditwah_reaching_high_intensity.png)](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%9C%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80:An_image_of_Cyclone_Ditwah_reaching_high_intensity.png "දිට්වා සුළි කුණාටුව")දිට්වා සුළි කුණාටුව
  * **[දිට්වා සුළි කුණාටුව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%85%E0%B7%92_%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%AB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80 "දිට්වා සුළි කුණාටුව")** _(චන්ද්‍රිකා සේයාරුව)_ හේතුවෙන් ඇති වූ ගංවතුර සහ නායයෑම් නිසා [ශ්‍රී ලංකාව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%81%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%93_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B6%82%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "ශ්‍රී ලංකාව") සහ [ඉන්දියාව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%89%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "ඉන්දියාව") පුරා අවම වශයෙන් පුද්ගලයින් 485 දෙනෙකු ජීවිතක්ෂයට පත්වෙයි.
  * [බංග්ලාදේශ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%82%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%9A%E0%B7%81%E0%B6%BA "බංග්ලාදේශය") ජාත්‍යන්තර අපරාධ විනිශ්චය සභාව විසින් හිටපු අගමැතිනි [ෂෙයික් හසීනා](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%82%E0%B7%99%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8F "ෂෙයික් හසීනා") මනුෂ්‍යත්වයට එරෙහි අපරාධ සම්බන්ධයෙන් **[වරදකරු කර මරණ දඬුවම නියම කරයි](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%82%E0%B7%99%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%A7_%E0%B6%91%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%92_%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%94_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B7%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%BA "ෂෙයික් හසීනාට එරෙහි නඩු විභාගය")**.
  * [පුළුල් ලෙස පැතිරුණු විරෝධතා](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%9A%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD_%E0%B6%89%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%99%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%92_%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%B0%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8F "2025 නේපාල ඉසෙඩ් පරම්පරාවෙහි විරෝධතා") වලින් පසුව, [නේපාලයේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%9A%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD%E0%B6%BA "නේපාලය") [අන්තර්කාලීන අගමැතිවරිය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%9A%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%92_%E0%B6%85%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F "නේපාලයෙහි අග්‍රාමාත්‍යවරයා") ලෙස හිටපු අගවිනිසුරු **[සුෂිලා කාර්කි](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%82%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92 "සුෂිලා කාර්කි")** පත් කරයි.
  * [එක්සත් ජනපදයේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%85%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%99%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%91%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%A2%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%AF%E0%B6%BA "අමෙරිකා එක්සත් ජනපදය") [යූටාහි](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%96%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%8F "යූටා") පැවති උත්සවයක දී දේශපාලන ක්‍රියාකාරික **[චාලි කර්ක්](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%A0%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%92_%E0%B6%9A%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8A "චාලි කර්ක්")** වෙඩි තබා ඝාතනය කරයි.

## අතීතයේ අද වැනි දිනෙක ...  
**[දෙසැම්බර් 9](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A_9 "දෙසැම්බර් 9")** : **[ටැන්සානියාවේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "ටැන්සානියාව")** [නිදහස් දිනය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%A2%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A_%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%84%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B1_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%92%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80 "ජාතික නිදහස් දින ලැයිස්තුව") ([1961](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/1961 "1961"));  [![ගුවන් අනතුර](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/71/TC_810_Debris.jpg/250px-TC_810_Debris.jpg)](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%9C%E0%B7%9C%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80:TC_810_Debris.jpg "ගුවන් අනතුර")ගුවන් අනතුර
  * 1905 – **[ප්‍රංශය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B6%82%E0%B7%81%E0%B6%BA "ප්‍රංශය")** අනාගමික රාජ්‍යයක් බවට පත්වෙයි.
  * [1917](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/1917 "1917") – **[පළමු ලෝක යුද්ධය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%85%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%94_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%9A_%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B0%E0%B6%BA "පළමු ලෝක යුද්ධය")** : [රුමේනියා රාජධානිය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%9A%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "රුමේනියාව") සහ [මධ්‍ය බලවතුන්](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B8%E0%B6%B0%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BA_%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A "මධ්‍ය බලවතුන්") අතර සටන් විරාමයක් අත්සන් කරයි.
  * [1950](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/1950 "1950") – **[ලංකා රාජකීය නාවික හමුදාව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%81%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%93_%E0%B6%BD%E0%B6%82%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A_%E0%B7%84%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "ශ්‍රී ලංකා නාවික හමුදාව")** පිහිටුවනු ලැබෙයි.
  * [1956](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/1956 "1956") – **[කැනඩාවේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "කැනඩාව")** බ්‍රිටිෂ් කොලොම්බියා පළතේ හෝප් ප්‍රදේශයේදී සිදුවූ ගුවන් අනතුරකින් _(සේයාරුව)_ පුද්ගලයින් 56 දෙනෙකු ජීවිතක්ෂයට පත්වෙයි.
  * [1987](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987 "1987") – [මයික්‍රොසොෆ්ට්](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B8%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%8A%E2%80%8D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%9C%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%9C%E0%B7%86%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%8A "මයික්‍රොසොෆ්ට්") සමාගම **[වින්ඩෝස් 2.0](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%9D%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%8A_2.0 "වින්ඩෝස් 2.0")** තාක්ෂණය දියත් කරයි.
  * [2016](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/2016 "2016") – **[නයිජීරියාවේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%A2%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F%E0%B7%80 "නයිජීරියාව")** අඩමාව ප්‍රාන්තයේ මඩගලි ප්‍රදේශයේදී සිදුවූ බෝම්බ ප්‍රහාරයකින් පුද්ගලයින් 57 දෙනෙකු ජීවිතක්ෂයට පත්ව තවත් 177 දෙනෙකු තුවාල ලැබෙයි.

තවත් සිදුවීම්: [දෙසැම්බර් 8](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A_8 "දෙසැම්බර් 8") – **[දෙසැම්බර් 9](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A_9 "දෙසැම්බර් 9")** – [දෙසැම්බර් 10](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A_10 "දෙසැම්බර් 10") **[ලේඛනාගාරය](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8F%E0%B6%9C%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%82%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A%E0%B7%83%E0%B6%BB/December "විකිපීඩියා:තෝරාගත් සංවත්සර/December")** – **[විද්‍යුත් තැපෑලෙන්](https://lists.wikimedia.org/postorius/lists/daily-article-l.lists.wikimedia.org/ "mail:daily-article-l")** – **තවත් සංවත්සර...** දැන් වේලාව [2025](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025 "2025") [දෙසැම්බර් 9](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%99%E0%B7%83%E0%B7%90%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%B6%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A_9 "දෙසැම්බර් 9") ([UTC](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTC "UTC")) – [මෙම පිටුව ප්‍රතිපූරණය කරන්න](https://si.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%8A_%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%A7%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80&action=purge)

  * **[නිර්දේශ කවුළුව](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%B1%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BB%E0%B7%8A%E0%B6%AF%E0%B7%9A%E0%B7%81_%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%94%E0%B6%BD%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80 "විකිපීඩියා:නිර්දේශ කවුලුව")** – විකිපීඩියා ස්වෙච්ඡා දායකයන් විසින් පුළුල් විෂය පරාසයක ඔබගේ ප්‍රශ්න නිරාකරණය කෙරෙයි.
  * **[අඩවි පුවත්](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%94%E0%B7%80%E0%B6%AD%E0%B7%8A "විකිපීඩියා:පුවත්")** – විකිපීඩියාව හා විකිමාධ්‍ය පදනම පිළිබඳ, නිවේදන, යාවත්කාලකිරීම්, ලිපි සහ මාධ්‍ය නිවේදන.
  * **[කෝපි කඩේ](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F:%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%9D%E0%B6%B4%E0%B7%92_%E0%B6%9A%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%9A "විකිපීඩියා:කෝපි කඩේ")** – තාක්‍ෂණික විෂය කරුණු හා ප්‍රතිපත්ති සම්බන්ධ ‍දෑ ඇතුළුව, විකිපීඩියා හා සම්බන්ධ සාකච්ඡා සඳහා.


විකිපීඩියාවෙහි සත්කාරකත්වය සපයන්නේ ලාභ නොපතන සංවිධානයක් වන [විකිමීඩියා පදනම](https://si.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B7%80%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%9A%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%B8%E0%B7%93%E0%B6%A9%E0%B7%92%E0%B6%BA%E0%B7%8F_%E0%B6%B4%E0%B6%AF%E0%B6%B1%E0%B6%B8 "විකිමීඩියා පදනම") විසිනි. මෙම සංවිධානය විසින් වෙනත් සහෝදර [ව්‍යාපෘති](https://wikimediafoundation.org/wiki/Our_projects) රැසකටද සත්කාරකත්වය ලබාදෙයි. 
සිංහල බසින් පවතින ව්‍යාපෘතිවල සිංහල මුල් පිටුව වෙතද අනෙකුත් ව්‍යාපෘතිවල ඉංග්‍රීසි මුල් පිටුව වෙතද සබැඳි පහත දැක්වේ.

**Utmärkt artikel**
[![Den vita heta centralstjärnan ZZ Leporis, som är en pulserande variabel i Spirografnebulosan \(IC 418\).](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6b/Spirograph_Nebula_-_Hubble_1999.jpg/250px-Spirograph_Nebula_-_Hubble_1999.jpg)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Spirograph_Nebula_-_Hubble_1999.jpg "Den vita heta centralstjärnan ZZ Leporis, som är en pulserande variabel i Spirografnebulosan \(IC 418\).")
**[Variabla stjärnor](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variabel_stj%C3%A4rna "Variabel stjärna")** , eller **variabler** , är [stjärnor](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stj%C3%A4rna "Stjärna") vars ljusstyrka varierar över tid. Mer än 400 000 variabler är kända. Vår egen [sol](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solen "Solen") är variabel, med ett energiutflöde som varierar med 0,1 procent över den 11-åriga [solfläckscykeln](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variationer_av_solaktiviteten "Variationer av solaktiviteten"). De flesta stjärnor kan troligen klassas som variabla vid en tillräckligt noggrann mätning. 
De mest extrema variabla stjärnorna är [supernovorna](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supernova "Supernova") som kan öka i ljusstyrka med 100 miljoner gånger. 
De variabla stjärnorna klassificeras i olika typer utifrån variationernas orsak. De viktigaste huvudgrupperna är pulserande variabler, eruptiva och kataklysmiska variabler, förmörkelsevariabler och roterande variabler. [► **Läs mer**](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variabel_stj%C3%A4rna "Variabel stjärna")

**Dagens datum**
[![Nobelfesten hålls i Stockholms stadshus på kvällen denna dag.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fa/Stockholm-city-hall.jpg/250px-Stockholm-city-hall.jpg)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stockholm-city-hall.jpg "Nobelfesten hålls i Stockholms stadshus på kvällen denna dag.")
**[10 december](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_december "10 december")**
**[Nobeldagen](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobeldagen "Nobeldagen")** (_se bild_), **[Internationella dagen för mänskliga rättigheter](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internationella_dagen_f%C3%B6r_m%C3%A4nskliga_r%C3%A4ttigheter "Internationella dagen för mänskliga rättigheter")**
Namnsdag: [Malin](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malin "Malin"), [Malena](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malena "Malena") (Sverige) **•** [Judit](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judit "Judit"), Jutta (finlandssvenska) 
Denna dag i historien: 
  * **[1317](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1317 "1317")** – [Sveriges kung](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lista_%C3%B6ver_Sveriges_regenter "Lista över Sveriges regenter") [Birger Magnusson](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birger_Magnusson "Birger Magnusson") firar **[Nyköpings gästabud](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyk%C3%B6pings_g%C3%A4stabud "Nyköpings gästabud")** med sina bröder [hertigarna](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hertig "Hertig") [Erik](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erik_Magnusson_\(hertig\) "Erik Magnusson \(hertig\)") och [Valdemar](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valdemar_Magnusson "Valdemar Magnusson"). Festen får ett abrupt slut på natten den [11:e](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_december "11 december"), då de båda hertigarna fängslas och spärras in i en fängelsehåla i [slottet](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyk%C3%B6pingshus "Nyköpingshus").
  * **[1815](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1815 "1815")** – **[Ada Lovelace](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace "Ada Lovelace")** , ansedd som historiens första [datorprogrammerare](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Programmering "Programmering"), föds.
  * **[1868](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1868 "1868")** – Utanför [parlamentshuset](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Westminsterpalatset "Westminsterpalatset") i [London](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/London "London") installeras världens första **[trafikljus](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trafiksignal "Trafiksignal")**.
  * **[1896](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1896 "1896")** – [Industrimannen](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrimagnat "Industrimagnat"), [uppfinnaren](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uppfinning "Uppfinning") och [donatorn](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobelpriset "Nobelpriset") **[Alfred Nobel](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel")** avlider.
  * **[1901](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1901 "1901")** – **[Nobelpriset](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobelpriset "Nobelpriset")** delas ut för första gången, på årsdagen av [testatorn](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Testamente "Testamente") [Alfred Nobels](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel") död [1896](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1896 "1896").
  * **[1948](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1948 "1948")** – [FN:s generalförsamling](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/FN:s_generalf%C3%B6rsamling "FN:s generalförsamling") antar **[deklarationen om de mänskliga rättigheterna](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/FN:s_deklaration_om_de_m%C3%A4nskliga_r%C3%A4ttigheterna "FN:s deklaration om de mänskliga rättigheterna")**.
  * **[1967](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1967 "1967")** – Den amerikanske [soulsångaren](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soulmusik "Soulmusik") **[Otis Redding](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otis_Redding "Otis Redding")** omkommer i en flygolycka.
  * **[1983](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/1983 "1983")** – [Demokratin](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demokrati "Demokrati") återinförs i [Argentina](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentina "Argentina") i och med **[Raúl Alfonsíns](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ra%C3%BAl_Alfons%C3%ADn "Raúl Alfonsín")** tillträde som [landets demokratiskt valde president](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentinas_president "Argentinas president").

**Dagens skandinaviska artikel**
[![I vinterlekene i 1924, 1928, 1936 og 1948 ble det arrangert militært patruljeløp, en forløper til moderne skiskyting.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/00/Biathlon_pictogram.svg/250px-Biathlon_pictogram.svg.png)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Biathlon_pictogram.svg "I vinterlekene i 1924, 1928, 1936 og 1948 ble det arrangert militært patruljeløp, en forløper til moderne skiskyting.")
**[Liste over olympiske medaljevinnere i skiskyting](https://no.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_over_olympiske_medaljevinnere_i_skiskyting "no:Liste over olympiske medaljevinnere i skiskyting")** begynner i 1960, da skiskyting første gang kom på programmet under vinter-OL i Squaw Valley med én øvelse, 20 km for menn. I 1968 kom stafett med på programmet. Kvinnene kom med først under vinter-OL 1992. 
Mestvinnende utøvere er Ole Einar Bjørndalen (N) og Darja Domratsjeva (BLR). _[► Les mer her.](https://no.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_over_olympiske_medaljevinnere_i_skiskyting "no:Liste over olympiske medaljevinnere i skiskyting")_

**Aktuella händelser**

  * **[Musikhjälpen 2025](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musikhj%C3%A4lpen "Musikhjälpen")** , med årets tema: "Alla barn har rätt att gå i skolan", insamlar rekordsumman 74 601 867 kronor. (_7 december_)
  * **[Lina Wolff](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lina_Wolff "Lina Wolff")** , **[Bea Uusma](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bea_Uusma "Bea Uusma")** och **[Fabian Göranson](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fabian_G%C3%B6ranson "Fabian Göranson")** tilldelas [Augustpriset](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Augustpriset "Augustpriset"). (_24 november_)
  * **[David Åhman](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_%C3%85hman "David Åhman")** och **[Jonatan Hellvig](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonatan_Hellvig "Jonatan Hellvig")** besegrar [Jacob Hölting Nilsson](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jacob_H%C3%B6lting_Nilsson "Jacob Hölting Nilsson") och [Elmer Andersson](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elmer_Andersson "Elmer Andersson") i finalen av [VM i beachvolleyboll](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%C3%A4rldsm%C3%A4sterskapen_i_beachvolleyboll_2025_\(herrar\) "Världsmästerskapen i beachvolleyboll 2025 \(herrar\)") och Sverige tar därmed både guld och silver. (_23 november_)
  * Tre personer omkommer under en **[bussolycka](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bussolyckan_vid_Tekniska_h%C3%B6gskolan "Bussolyckan vid Tekniska högskolan")** vid bussterminalen [Tekniska högskolan](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tekniska_h%C3%B6gskolan_\(tunnelbanestation\) "Tekniska högskolan \(tunnelbanestation\)") i [Stockholm](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stockholm "Stockholm"). (_14 november_)
  * **[Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elisabeth_Thand_Ringqvist "Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist")** _(se bild)_ [väljs](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centerpartiets_partiledarval_2025_\(november\) "Centerpartiets partiledarval 2025 \(november\)") till ny partiledare för [Centerpartiet](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centerpartiet "Centerpartiet"). (_13 november_)

## முதற்பக்கக் கட்டுரைகள்  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b8/Dionysius_I_of_Syracuse.jpg/250px-Dionysius_I_of_Syracuse.jpg)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D:Dionysius_I_of_Syracuse.jpg) **[முதலாம் தியோனீசியசு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%82%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81 "சிரக்கூசாவின் முதலாம் தியோனீசியசு")** (அண். கி.மு. 432–367 ) என்பவர் [பண்டைய கிரேக்க](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "பண்டைக் கிரேக்கம்") சர்வாதிகாரி ஆவார். இவர் சிசிலியில் உள்ள [சிரக்கூசாவின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%82%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BE,_%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF "சிரக்கூசா, சிசிலி") ஆட்சியாளராக இருந்தார். மேற்கு கிரேக்க குடியேற்றங்களில் சிரக்கூசா நகர அரசை மிகவும் சக்திவாய்ந்த ஒன்றாக சிசிலியிலிருந்து இத்தாலி வரை பரவிய பேரரசாக மாற்றினார். இந்தப் பேரரசு பெயரளவில் ஒரு அரசியலமைப்பு உள்ள குடியரசாக இருந்தாலும், உண்மையில் இது முடியாட்சியாக இருந்த முதல் கிரேக்க பேரரசு ஆகும். இதில் தியோனீசியஸ் [பேரரசர் அலெக்சாந்தருக்கும்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D "பேரரசர் அலெக்சாந்தர்") [அகஸ்டசின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D "அகஸ்ட்டஸ்") சாதனைகளுக்கும் முன்மாதிரியாக இருந்தார். இவர் தனது வாழ்நாளில் தெய்வீக மரியாதைகளைப் பெற்ற முதல் கிரேக்க ஆட்சியாளர்களில் ஒருவராக இருந்து பிற்கால ஆட்சியாளர்களுக்கு ஒரு தவறான முன்னுதாரணமாக இருந்தார். இவர் மிக மோசமான, கொடூரமான, பழிவாங்கும் சர்வாதிகாரிகளுக்கு ஒரு எடுத்துக்காட்டாக பழங்காலத்தில் கருதப்பட்டார். **[மேலும்...](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%82%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81 "சிரக்கூசாவின் முதலாம் தியோனீசியசு")** **[மேலும் கட்டுரைகள்...](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE:%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D "விக்கிப்பீடியா:முதற்பக்கக் கட்டுரைகள்")**  
## இன்றைய நாளில்...  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8f/EM_smallpox%2C_grown_via_tissue%2C_isolate_by_centrifuge.jpg/120px-EM_smallpox%2C_grown_via_tissue%2C_isolate_by_centrifuge.jpg)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D:EM_smallpox,_grown_via_tissue,_isolate_by_centrifuge.jpg) **[திசம்பர் 9](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_9 "திசம்பர் 9")** : [தான்சானியா](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE "தான்சானியா") - விடுதலை நாள் ([1961](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1961 "1961")) 
  * [1905](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1905 "1905") – [பிரான்சில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D "பிரான்ஸ்") அரசையும் [கிறித்தவத்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "கிறிஸ்தவம்") தேவாலயங்களையும் பிரிக்கும் சட்டமூலம் கொண்டுவரப்பட்டது.
  * [1917](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1917 "1917") – [எருசலேம் போர் (1917)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%8E%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_\(1917\) "எருசலேம் போர் \(1917\)"): [பிரித்தானியர்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE "பிரித்தானியா") [பாலத்தீனத்தின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "பாலஸ்தீனம்") [எருசலேம்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%8E%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "எருசலேம்") நகரைக் கைப்பற்றினர்.
  * [1940](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1940 "1940") – [இரண்டாம் உலகப் போர்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%89%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D "இரண்டாம் உலகப் போர்"): [காம்ப்பசு நடவடிக்கை](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81_%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%88 "காம்ப்பசு நடவடிக்கை"): [பிரித்தானிய](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%90%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "ஐக்கிய இராச்சியம்"), மற்றும் [இந்தியப்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE "இந்தியா") படைகள் [இத்தாலியப்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF "இத்தாலி") படையினரை [எகிப்தில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%8E%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81 "எகிப்து") தாக்கினர்.
  * [1946](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1946 "1946") – [இந்திய அரசியலமைப்பை](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81 "இந்திய அரசியலமைப்பு") வரைய [இந்திய அரசியலமைப்பு நிர்ணய மன்றம்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81_%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A3%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "இந்திய அரசியலமைப்பு நிர்ணய மன்றம்") முதல் தடவையாகக் கூடியது.
  * [1948](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1948 "1948") – [இனப்படுகொலை உடன்பாடு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8A%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%88_%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%88_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81,_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8A%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9_%E0%AE%89%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%88 "இனப்படுகொலை குற்றத்தை தடுப்பது, தண்டிப்பது தொடர்பான உடன்படிக்கை") [ஐநா அவையில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%90%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%BE "ஐநா") ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளப்பட்டது.
  * [1979](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1979 "1979") – **[பெரியம்மை](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%88 "பெரியம்மை") [தீ நுண்மம்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%80_%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "தீ நுண்மம்")** (படம்) முற்றாக அழிக்கப்பட்டு விட்டதாக [உலக சுகாதார அமைப்பு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%89%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%95_%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B0_%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81 "உலக சுகாதார அமைப்பு") அறிவித்தது. மனித உயிர் கொல்லி நோயொன்று முற்றாக அழிக்கப்பட்டது இதுவே முதலாவதாகும்.
  * [2016](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/2016 "2016") – வடகிழக்கு [நைஜீரியாவில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%9C%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE "நைஜீரியா") சந்தை ஒன்றில் பள்ளி மாணவிகள் இருவர் [நடத்திய தற்கொலைத் தாக்குதலில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8A%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D "மடகாலித் தற்கொலைத் தாக்குதல்கள்") 57 பேர் கொல்லப்பட்டனர், 177 பேர் காயமடைந்தனர்.

**[வெ. தட்சிணாமூர்த்தி](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AF%86._%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A3%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%82%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF "வெ. தட்சிணாமூர்த்தி")** (பி. [1919](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1919 "1919")) **·** **[மதுரை சோமு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%88_%E0%AE%8E%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D._%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "மதுரை எஸ். சோமசுந்தரம்")** (இ. [1989](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/1989 "1989")) **·** **[சு. வில்வரத்தினம்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81._%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "சு. வில்வரத்தினம்")** (இ. [2006](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/2006 "2006"))  
அண்மைய நாட்கள்: [திசம்பர் 8](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_8 "திசம்பர் 8") – [திசம்பர் 10](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_10 "திசம்பர் 10") – [திசம்பர் 11](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_11 "திசம்பர் 11") **[தொகுப்பு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE:%E0%AE%86%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81_%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%B5%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D "விக்கிப்பீடியா:ஆண்டு நிறைவுகள்/திசம்பர்")**
