## செய்திகளில் [![இற்றைப்படுத்து](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6e/Reload_page.png/20px-Reload_page.png)](http://ta.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D&action=purge "இற்றைப்படுத்து")  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f5/Shigeru_Ishiba_and_Sanae_Takaichi_20241211_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-Shigeru_Ishiba_and_Sanae_Takaichi_20241211_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D:Shigeru_Ishiba_and_Sanae_Takaichi_20241211_\(cropped\).jpg)
  * பழம்பெரும் நடிகையும், பரதநாட்டியக் கலைஞருமான **[குமாரி கமலா](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF_%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BE "குமாரி கமலா")** தனது 91-ஆவது அகவையில் [கலிபோர்னியாவில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE "கலிபோர்னியா") காலமானார்.
  * இந்தியத் தலைநகர் [தில்லியில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF "தில்லி") இடம்பெற்ற **[தானுந்துக் குண்டுவெடிப்பில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B5%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81 "2025 தில்லி தானுந்துக் குண்டுவெடிப்பு")** 13 பேர் கொல்லப்பட்டனர், 20 பேர்களுக்கும் அதிகமானோர் காயமடைந்தனர்.
  * [சப்பானின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D "சப்பான்") முதலாவது பெண் பிரதமராக **[சனே தகைச்சி](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%87_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF "சனே தகைச்சி")** (படம்) [நாடாளுமன்றத்தினால்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "சப்பானிய நாடாளுமன்றம்") தெரிவு செய்யப்பட்டார்.
  * [மடகாசுகரில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D "மடகாசுகர்") மக்கள் ஆர்ப்பாட்டங்கள், மற்றும் இராணுவ சதிப்புரட்சியைத் தொடர்ந்து **[ஆண்ட்ரி ராசொய்லினா](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%86%E0%AE%A3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF_%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%8A%E0%AE%AF%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%BE "ஆண்ட்ரி ராசொய்லினா")** நாட்டை விட்டு வெளியேறியதை அடுத்து, மைக்கேல் ரந்திரியானிரினா நாட்டின் புதிய அரசுத்தலைவரானார்.

அண்மைய இறப்புகள்: **[செ. இராசதுரை](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE_%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%88 "செல்லையா இராசதுரை") • [ஏ. வி. எம். சரவணன்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%8E%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D._%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%A3%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D_\(%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B3%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D\) "எம். சரவணன் \(திரைப்படத் தயாரிப்பாளர்\)") • [குமாரி கமலா](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF_%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BE "குமாரி கமலா")** தொடர் நிகழ்வுகள்: [இசுரேல்-அமாசு போர்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D-%E0%AE%B9%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B8%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D "இசுரேல்-ஹமாஸ் போர்") • [பிற நிகழ்வுகள்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE:%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81_%E0%AE%A8%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B5%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D "விக்கிப்பீடியா:நடப்பு நிகழ்வுகள்")  
## உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா?  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3c/Yin_and_Yang_symbol.svg/120px-Yin_and_Yang_symbol.svg.png)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D:Yin_and_Yang_symbol.svg)
  * மரபுவழி சீன மெய்யியலில், **[யின் யாங்கு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%99%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81 "யின் யாங்கு")** (படம்) என்பது வாழ்வில் இரவும் பகலும், எதிரும் புதிரும், எதிா்மறையும் நோ்மறையும் எப்படி ஒன்றையொன்று இயற்கையிலேயே சாா்ந்துள்ளது என்பதையும் எப்படி ஒன்றிலிருந்து மற்றொன்று துலங்கும் என்பதை விளக்கும் இரட்டைத் தத்துவம் ஆகும்.
  * **[அசோகர் கல்வெட்டுக்கள்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%8B%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B5%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D "அசோகர் கல்வெட்டுக்கள்")** வட இந்தியாவிலும் பாக்கித்தானிலும் [பௌத்தத்தின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8C%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "பௌத்தம்") முதல் உறுதியான வரலாற்றுச் சான்றுகளாகும்.
  * [இசுலாமிய சமயத்தில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "இசுலாம்") **[குலா](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%BE "குலா")** எனப்படுவது கணவனுடன் சேர்ந்து வாழ மனைவிக்கு விருப்பம் இல்லாவிட்டால், மனைவி கணவனைத் [திருமண முறிவு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%A3_%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B5%E0%AF%81 "திருமண முறிவு") செய்வது ஆகும்.
  * **[மலேசிய அரசியலமைப்பு திருத்தச் சட்டம் 2022](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D_2022 "மலேசிய அரசியலமைப்பு திருத்தம் 2022")** என்பது [சபா](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE "சபா"), [சரவாக்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D "சரவாக்") மாநிலங்களைத் [தீபகற்ப மலேசியாவுடன்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA_%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE "தீபகற்ப மலேசியா") சமமான பங்காளிகளாக நிலைநிறுத்த இயற்றப்பட்ட சட்டத் திருத்தமாகும்.
  * **[இலங்கா பொடி](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%99%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BE_%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8A%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF "இலங்கா பொடி")** என்பது மேற்கு ஒடிசாவின் சுபர்ணபூர் மாவட்டத்தில் கொண்டாடப்படும் ஒரு திருவிழா. [இராவணனின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%A3%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D "இராவணன்") பெரிய உருவ பொம்மையை தீயிட்டுக் கொளுத்துவது இந்நிகழ்வின் சிறப்பு ஆகும்.
  * **[சைக்சு–பிக்கோ ஒப்பந்தம்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E2%80%93%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8B_%E0%AE%92%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "சைக்சு–பிக்கோ ஒப்பந்தம்")** 1916 இல் ஐக்கிய இராச்சியம், பிரான்சு ஆகிய நாடுகளுக்கிடையேயான ஓர் இரகசிய ஒப்பந்தமாகும். உருசியா, இத்தாலி ஆகியவற்றின் ஒப்புதலுடன், முதலாம் உலகப் போரில் [உதுமானியப் பேரரசு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%89%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81 "உதுமானியப் பேரரசு") வீழ்ச்சி அடைந்தால் அதன் மாகாணங்களை எவ்வாறு தங்களுக்குள் பிரித்துக் கொள்ளலாம் என்பதை இவ்வொப்பந்தம் வரையறுக்கிறது.

**[தொகுப்பு](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE:%E0%AE%89%E0%AE%99%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BE/%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "விக்கிப்பீடியா:உங்களுக்குத் தெரியுமா/காப்பகம்")**  
| 
## பங்களிப்பாளர் அறிமுகம்  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6a/User_Neechalkaran_introducing_himself_to_other%27s_at_Day0_of_TTT2019.jpg/250px-User_Neechalkaran_introducing_himself_to_other%27s_at_Day0_of_TTT2019.jpg)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D:User_Neechalkaran_introducing_himself_to_other%27s_at_Day0_of_TTT2019.jpg) **[நீச்சல்காரன்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D:Neechalkaran "பயனர்:Neechalkaran")** , [மதுரையைச்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%88 "மதுரை") சேர்ந்த [இயற்பியல்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%B1%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%8D "இயற்பியல்") பட்டதாரி. 2010 முதல் விக்கிப்பீடியாவில் [தமிழ்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B4%E0%AF%8D "தமிழ்"), [ஆங்கிலம்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%86%E0%AE%99%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "ஆங்கிலம்"), [இந்தி](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%A8%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%BF "இந்தி") முதலிய மொழிகளில் பங்களித்துவருகிறார். இதுவரை தமிழில் 174 புதிய கட்டுரைகளைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளார். வார்ப்புருக்களின் ஆக்கத்திலும், மொழிபெயர்ப்பிலும் அவ்வப்போது பங்களித்துள்ளார். [தமிழ்க் கணிமையில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B4%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%A3%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%88 "தமிழ்க் கணிமை") ஆர்வமுடைய இவர் சந்திப்பிழை திருத்தி, சொற்பிழை திருத்தி முதலிய கருவிகளை உருவாக்கி உள்ளார். விக்கித் திட்டங்களுக்கான பல்வேறு [கருவிகளையும்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D:Neechalkaran/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D "பயனர்:Neechalkaran/துடுப்புகள்"), ஜாவாஸ்கிரிப்ட் நிரல்களையும் உருவாக்கியுள்ளார். சில துப்புரவுப் பணிகள் செய்யவும், [புள்ளிவிவரங்கள்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE:%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B3%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%B3%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%B0%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "விக்கிப்பீடியா:புள்ளிவிவரம்") சேகரிக்கவும் இவரின் [தானியங்கி](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D:NeechalBOT "பயனர்:NeechalBOT") பயன்படுகிறது. **[மேலும் சில பங்களிப்பாளர்கள்...](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%80%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE:%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%99%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%B3%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B3%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%85%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "விக்கிப்பீடியா:பங்களிப்பாளர் அறிமுகம்")**  
|  [![செம்பழுப்புத் தலைப்பஞ்சுருட்டான்](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fc/Chestnut-headed_bee-eater_%28Merops_leschenaulti%29_Yala.jpg/330px-Chestnut-headed_bee-eater_%28Merops_leschenaulti%29_Yala.jpg)](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D:Chestnut-headed_bee-eater_\(Merops_leschenaulti\)_Yala.jpg "செம்பழுப்புத் தலைப்பஞ்சுருட்டான்") |  **[செம்பழுப்புத் தலைப்பஞ்சுருட்டான்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%86%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%B4%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%8D_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%B2%E0%AF%88%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9E%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D "செம்பழுப்புத் தலைப்பஞ்சுருட்டான்")** (_Merops leschenaulti_) என்பது [மெரோபிடே](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%9E%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%B0%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%A9%E0%AF%8D_\(%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D\) "பஞ்சுருட்டான் \(குடும்பம்\)") என்ற தேனீ-உண்ணி குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த ஒரு பறவையாகும், இது இந்தியா, வங்காளதேசம், இலங்கை முதல் தென்கிழக்கு ஆசியா முழுவதும் இந்தோனேசியா வரை பரவியுள்ளது. இது 18–20 செ.மீ நீளமும் 26–33 கிராம் எடையும் கொண்டது, இவற்றின் பாலினங்கள் தோற்றத்தில் ஒத்தவை. இது பல வண்ணப் பறவை, நெற்றி, கழுத்து போன்ற பாகங்கள் [கசுக்கொட்டை](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%95%E0%AE%9A%E0%AF%81%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%8A%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%9F%E0%AF%88 "கசுகொட்டை") நிறமாகவும், ஏனைய பாகங்கள் பச்சை, மஞ்சள், கருப்பு, நீல நிறமாகவும் இருக்கும். இது முக்கியமாக பூச்சிகளை, குறிப்பாக தேனீக்கள், குளவிகளை உண்ணும். இப்புகைப்படம் [இலங்கையின்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%87%E0%AE%B2%E0%AE%99%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%95%E0%AF%88 "இலங்கை") [யால தேசிய வனத்தில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%AF%E0%AE%BE%E0%AE%B2_%E0%AE%A4%E0%AF%87%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%AF_%E0%AE%B5%E0%AE%A9%E0%AE%AE%E0%AF%8D "யால தேசிய வனம்") விக்கிப்பீடியா மொழிகள்
  
இந்த விக்கிப்பீடியா [தமிழில்](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%A4%E0%AE%AE%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B4%E0%AF%8D "தமிழ்") எழுதப்பட்டுள்ளது. 2003-இல் தொடங்கப்பட்டது, தற்போது [1,79,014](https://ta.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%AE%9A%E0%AE%BF%E0%AE%B1%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%8D%E0%AE%AA%E0%AF%81:Statistics "சிறப்பு:Statistics") கட்டுரைகள் உள்ளன. மேலும் பல விக்கிப்பீடியாக்கள் உள்ளன; அவற்றுள் மிகப்பெரியன கீழே பட்டியலிடப்பட்டுள்ளன. 
  * 10,00,000 கட்டுரைகளுக்கு மேல்: [English](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "en:") **·** [Deutsch](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "de:") **·** [español](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "es:") **·** [français](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "fr:") **·** [italiano](https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "it:") **·** [Nederlands](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "nl:") **·** [日本語](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ja:") **·** [polski](https://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "pl:") **·** [русский](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ru:") **·** [svenska](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "sv:") **·** [Tiếng Việt](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "vi:")
  * 2,50,000 கட்டுரைகளுக்கு மேல்: [العربية](https://ar.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ar:") **·** [Bahasa Indonesia](https://id.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "id:") **·** [Bahasa Melayu](https://ms.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ms:") **·** [català](https://ca.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ca:") **·** [čeština](https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "cs:") **·** [euskara](https://eu.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "eu:") **·** [فارسی](https://fa.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "fa:") **·** [한국어](https://ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ko:") **·** [magyar](https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "hu:") **·** [norsk](https://no.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "no:") **·** [português](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "pt:") **·** [română](https://ro.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "ro:") **·** [српски / srpski](https://sr.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "sr:") **·** [srpskohrvatski / српскохрватски](https://sh.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "sh:") **·** [suomi](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "fi:") **·** [Türkçe](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "tr:") **·** [українська](https://uk.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "uk:") **·** [中文](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "zh:")
  * 50,000 கட்டுரைகளுக்கு மேல்: [bosanski](https://bs.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "bs:") **·** [български](https://bg.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "bg:") **·** [dansk](https://da.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "da:") **·** [eesti](https://et.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "et:") **·** [Ελληνικά](https://el.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "el:") **·** [Simple English](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "simple:") **·** [Esperanto](https://eo.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "eo:") **·** [galego](https://gl.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "gl:") **·** [עברית](https://he.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "he:") **·** [hrvatski](https://hr.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "hr:") **·** [latviešu](https://lv.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "lv:") **·** [lietuvių](https://lt.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "lt:") **·** [norsk nynorsk](https://nn.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "nn:") **·** [slovenčina](https://sk.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "sk:") **·** [slovenščina](https://sl.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "sl:") **·** [ไทย](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/ "th:")

[![ทีมผู้พัฒนาเดอะลาสต์ออฟอัสบางส่วน](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/58/The_Last_of_Us_development_team%2C_GDCA_2014_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-The_Last_of_Us_development_team%2C_GDCA_2014_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%8C:The_Last_of_Us_development_team,_GDCA_2014_\(cropped\).jpg "ทีมผู้พัฒนาเดอะลาสต์ออฟอัสบางส่วน")ทีมผู้พัฒนา _[เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA "เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส")_ บางส่วน _**[เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA "เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส")**_ เป็น[เกมแอ็กชันผจญภัย](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%9C%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%8D%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%A2 "เกมแอ็กชันผจญภัย")[สยองขวัญเอาชีวิตรอด](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%8D%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%94 "สยองขวัญเอาชีวิตรอด") พัฒนาโดย[นอตีด็อก](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%94%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%81 "นอตีด็อก") และจัดจำหน่ายโดย[โซนี่คอมพิวเตอร์เอ็นเตอร์เทนเมนต์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C "โซนี่คอมพิวเตอร์เอ็นเตอร์เทนเมนต์") ผู้เล่นได้ควบคุม[โจเอล](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%88%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A5_\(%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA\) "โจเอล \(เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส\)") ผู้ลักลอบขนของที่ได้รับภารกิจในการคุ้มกัน[เอลลี](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B5_\(%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA\) "เอลลี \(เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส\)") เด็กสาววัยรุ่น ข้ามประเทศสหรัฐอเมริกา[หลังเกิดเหตุการณ์หายนะ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%93%E0%B9%8C%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%93%E0%B9%8C "บันเทิงคดีพยากรณ์และหลังพยากรณ์") เกมดำเนินในมุมมองบุคคลที่สาม โดยใช้ปืน อาวุธดัดแปลง และ[การลอบเร้น](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9A%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%99 "เกมลอบเร้น") เพื่อรับมือกับมนุษย์ที่เป็นศัตรูและสิ่งมีชีวิต[กินเนื้อคน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B5 "ซอมบี")ที่ติดเชื้อจาก[เห็ดรา](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AB%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B2 "เห็ดรา")กลายพันธุ์ เกมยังมี[โหมดผู้เล่นหลายคนออนไลน์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%9C%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%99 "วิดีโอเกมหลายผู้เล่น")ที่รองรับผู้เล่นสูงสุด 8 คน ในรูปแบบการเล่นร่วมมือหรือแข่งขันกัน  [เกมเริ่มพัฒนา](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%92%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B2%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA "การพัฒนาเดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส")ในปี 2009 หลังวางจำหน่าย _[อันชาร์ทิด 2: อะมังทีฟส์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%94_2:_%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%8C "อันชาร์ทิด 2: อะมังทีฟส์")_ ซึ่งเป็นผลงานก่อนหน้าของ[นอตีด็อก](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%94%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%81 "นอตีด็อก") โดยสตูดิโอได้แบ่งทีมออกเป็นสองกลุ่ม ทีมหนึ่งพัฒนา _เดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส_ ขณะที่อีกทีมดูแล _[อันชาร์ทิด 3: เดรกส์ดีเซปชัน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%94_3:_%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99 "อันชาร์ทิด 3: เดรกส์ดีเซปชัน")_[ทรอย เบเกอร์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A2_%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9A%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C "ทรอย เบเกอร์") และ[แอชลีย์ จอห์นสัน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2%E0%B9%8C_%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AB%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99 "แอชลีย์ จอห์นสัน") รับบทเป็นโจเอลและเอลลีตามลำดับ ผ่านการพากย์เสียงและเทคโนโลยีจับการเคลื่อนไหว และพัฒนาตัวละครและเนื้อเรื่องร่วมกับนีล ดรักแมนน์ ผู้อำนวยการฝ่ายสร้างสรรค์ แกนหลักเป็นเรื่องความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างโจเอลกับเอลลี [ดนตรีประกอบ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA "ดนตรีของเดอะลาสต์ออฟอัส")ของเกมแต่งและบรรเลงโดย[กุสตาโบ ซานตาโอลายา](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B2%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%9A_%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B2%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B2 "กุสตาโบ ซานตาโอลายา") **[รายชื่อบทความแนะนำ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B3/%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%94 "วิกิพีเดีย:บทความแนะนำ/รายชื่อทั้งหมด") ([พ.ศ. 2567](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B3/%E0%B8%9E.%E0%B8%A8._2567 "วิกิพีเดีย:บทความแนะนำ/พ.ศ. 2567") ⋅ [พ.ศ. 2568](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B3/%E0%B8%9E.%E0%B8%A8._2568 "วิกิพีเดีย:บทความแนะนำ/พ.ศ. 2568"))** – **[โครงการบทความแนะนำ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B3 "วิกิพีเดีย:บทความแนะนำ")**  
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1b/Wikibar2.png)รู้ไหมว่า...     _เรื่องน่าสนใจจาก[บทความล่าสุดและเพิ่งปรับปรุง](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2 "วิกิพีเดีย:รู้ไหมว่า")ของวิกิพีเดีย_ [![ตำแหน่งและลักษณะของเนื้องอกลำไส้ใหญ่ตัวอย่างสองจุด](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/12/Blausen_0246_ColorectalCancer.png/250px-Blausen_0246_ColorectalCancer.png)](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%8C:Blausen_0246_ColorectalCancer.png "ตำแหน่งและลักษณะของเนื้องอกลำไส้ใหญ่ตัวอย่างสองจุด")ตำแหน่งและลักษณะของ[เนื้องอกลำไส้ใหญ่](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B0%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B3%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%8D%E0%B9%88 "มะเร็งลำไส้ใหญ่")ตัวอย่างสองจุด  
  * ...**[มะเร็งลำไส้ใหญ่](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B0%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B3%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%8D%E0%B9%88 "มะเร็งลำไส้ใหญ่")** _(ในภาพ)_ เกิดได้จากหลายปัจจัย เช่น รูปแบบการดำเนินชีวิตและอายุที่มากขึ้น รวมทั้งโรคลำไส้อักเสบเรื้อรังและความผิดปกติทางพันธุกรรมด้วย ปัจจัยเสี่ยงรวมถึงอาหารการกิน [โรคอ้วน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%99 "โรคอ้วน") [การสูบบุหรี่](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88 "การสูบบุหรี่") และการขาด[การออกกำลังกาย](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B3%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A2 "การออกกำลังกาย") อาหารที่เพิ่มความเสี่ยง ได้แก่ [เนื้อแดง](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B7%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%87 "เนื้อแดง") [เนื้อแปรรูป](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B7%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%9B "เนื้อแปรรูป") และเครื่องดื่ม[แอลกอฮอล์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AE%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%8C "แอลกอฮอล์")
  * ...การนำเสนอ**[จักรพรรดิเซิร์กซีสที่ 1](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B4%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88_1 "จักรพรรดิเซิร์กซีสที่ 1")** ของกรีกและโรมันส่วนใหญ่เป็นไปในเชิงลบ บทละคร "The Persians" ที่แสดงในกรุง[เอเธนส์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%8C "เอเธนส์")เมื่อ 472 ปีก่อน ค.ศ. หลังจากที่พระองค์ทรงบุกรุกรานกรีซเพียงเจ็ดปี นำเสนอเซิร์กซีสในลักษณะเหมือนผู้หญิงที่ท้ายสุดนำไปสู่หายนะ ส่วนที่นำเสนอในผลงาน _Histories_ ของ[เฮอรอโดทัส](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AE%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%AA "เฮอรอโดทัส")อาจถือได้ว่ามีความละเอียดอ่อนและน่าเศร้า เมื่อเทียบกับการถูกใส่ร้ายป้ายสีที่พระองค์ได้รับจาก[อเล็กซานเดอร์มหาราช](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%87%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%8A "อเล็กซานเดอร์มหาราช")
  * ...**[วินาศกรรม 11 กันยายน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A8%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%A1_11_%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%99 "วินาศกรรม 11 กันยายน")** ส่งผลกระทบหลายประการ รวมถึงการแสดงออกความรักชาติที่เพิ่มขึ้น ทฤษฎีสมคบคิดเรื่อง 9/11 ความวิตกกังวลระดับชาติที่เพิ่มขึ้นเกี่ยวกับการเดินทางด้วยสายการบินเชิงพาณิชย์ และอาชญากรรมจากความเกลียดชังมุสลิมที่เพิ่มขึ้นเกือบสิบเท่าใน ค.ศ. 2001 โดยต่อมายังคง "สูงกว่าอัตราก่อน 9/11 ประมาณห้าเท่า" **[เรื่องที่ผ่านมา](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2 "วิกิพีเดีย:รู้ไหมว่า")** – **[สร้างบทความใหม่](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%93 "วิกิพีเดีย:บทความแรกของคุณ")** – **[เสนอบทความ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2 "วิกิพีเดีย:รู้ไหมว่า/เสนอรู้ไหมว่า")**

---  
[![อัคคีภัยในที่พักเขตไต้โป้ว](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/df/Buildings_of_Taipo_apartment_fires.jpg/250px-Buildings_of_Taipo_apartment_fires.jpg)](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%9F%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%8C:Buildings_of_Taipo_apartment_fires.jpg "อัคคีภัยในที่พักเขตไต้โป้ว")อัคคีภัยในที่พักเขตไต้โป้ว
  * **[ซีเกมส์](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%8C_2025 "ซีเกมส์ 2025")** เริ่มต้นขึ้นแล้ว ใน[กรุงเทพมหานคร](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%87%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A3 "กรุงเทพมหานคร") และ[จังหวัดชลบุรี](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B5 "จังหวัดชลบุรี") ประเทศไทย
  * **[เพลิงไหม้กลุ่มอาคารชุด](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%A2%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%81%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%95%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%9B%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%A7 "อัคคีภัยในที่พักเขตไต้โป้ว")** _(ในภาพ)_ ในฮ่องกง ส่งผลให้มีผู้เสียชีวิตมากกว่า 100 ราย
  * มีผู้เสียชีวิตมากกว่า 100 รายจาก**[อุทกภัยในภาคใต้ของประเทศไทย](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%A2%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A8%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A2%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A8%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B2%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2_%E0%B8%9E.%E0%B8%A8._2568 "อุทกภัยในประเทศไทยและประเทศมาเลเซีย พ.ศ. 2568")** ซึ่งส่งผลกระทบหนักที่[อำเภอหาดใหญ่](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B3%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%94%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%8D%E0%B9%88 "อำเภอหาดใหญ่") [จังหวัดสงขลา](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%82%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B2 "จังหวัดสงขลา")
  * **[เจมส์ ดี. วัตสัน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%88%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%8C_%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5._%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99 "เจมส์ ดี. วัตสัน")** นักชีววิทยาโมเลกุลชาวอเมริกัน ผู้ร่วมค้นพบ[โครงสร้างของดีเอ็นเอ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%B9%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81 "เกลียวคู่กรดนิวคลีอิก") เสียชีวิตในวัย 97 ปี
  * มีผู้เสียชีวิต 14 รายจาก**[ยูพีเอสแอร์ไลน์ เที่ยวบินที่ 2976](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%8C_%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88_2976 "ยูพีเอสแอร์ไลน์ เที่ยวบินที่ 2976")** ซึ่งตกภายหลังขึ้นบินจาก[ท่าอากาศยานนานาชาติลุยส์วิลล์ มูฮัมหมัด อาลี](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%97%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A8%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%8C_%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%AE%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%94_%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B5 "ท่าอากาศยานนานาชาติลุยส์วิลล์ มูฮัมหมัด อาลี")ใน[รัฐเคนทักกี](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%90%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B5 "รัฐเคนทักกี") [สหรัฐอเมริกา](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%90%E0%B8%AD%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2 "สหรัฐอเมริกา")ได้ไม่นาน

  * [พ.ศ. 2540](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%9E.%E0%B8%A8._2540 "พ.ศ. 2540") (ค.ศ. 1997) – **[พิธีสารเกียวโต](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%95 "พิธีสารเกียวโต")** หนึ่งใน[อนุสัญญาสหประชาชาติว่าด้วยการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%8D%E0%B8%8D%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%94%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A8 "อนุสัญญาสหประชาชาติว่าด้วยการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศ")เพื่อรับมือกับ[ภาวะโลกร้อน](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A0%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B0%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%99 "ภาวะโลกร้อน") เริ่มเปิดให้ลงนามใน[เกียวโต](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%82%E0%B8%95 "เกียวโต") ประเทศญี่ปุ่น
  * [พ.ศ. 2541](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%9E.%E0%B8%A8._2541 "พ.ศ. 2541") (ค.ศ. 1998) – **[การบินไทย เที่ยวบินที่ 261](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A2_%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%88_261 "การบินไทย เที่ยวบินที่ 261")** ประสบอุบัติเหตุระหว่างลงจอดที่[ท่าอากาศยานสุราษฎร์ธานี](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%97%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A8%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A9%E0%B8%8E%E0%B8%A3%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B5 "ท่าอากาศยานสุราษฎร์ธานี") มีผู้เสียชีวิต 101 คน

ดูเพิ่ม: [10 ธันวาคม](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1 "10 ธันวาคม") – **[11 ธันวาคม](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/11_%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1 "11 ธันวาคม")** – [12 ธันวาคม](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/12_%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1 "12 ธันวาคม") **[จดหมายเหตุ](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9E%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%A2:%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%95/%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1 "วิกิพีเดีย:วันนี้ในอดีต/ธันวาคม")** – **[รายชื่อบทความวันนี้ในอดีต](https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%8A%E0%B8%B7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B5%E0%B9%89%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B5%E0%B8%95 "รายชื่อบทความวันนี้ในอดีต")**

## Napiling artikulo
[![Si Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck noong 2019.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6b/Jigme_Khesar_Namgyel_Wangchuck_at_the_Enthronement_of_Naruhito.jpg/250px-Jigme_Khesar_Namgyel_Wangchuck_at_the_Enthronement_of_Naruhito.jpg)](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talaksan:Jigme_Khesar_Namgyel_Wangchuck_at_the_Enthronement_of_Naruhito.jpg "Si Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck noong 2019.")Si Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck noong 2019.
Si **[Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jigme_Khesar_Namgyel_Wangchuck "Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck")** ([Dzongkha](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikang_Dzongkha "Wikang Dzongkha"): འཇིགས་མེད་གེ་སར་རྣམ་རྒྱལ་དབང་ཕྱུག་, Wylie: _jigs med ge sar rnam rgyal dbang phyug_ ; ipinanganak noong Pebrero 21, 1980) ay ang ikalimang Druk Gyalpo (Dzongkha: Haring Dragon) ng [Kaharian ng Bhutan](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhutan "Bhutan") at puno ng Angkan ng Wangchuck (dinastiyang Wangchuck). Siya ang kasalukuyang pinakabatang monarka at [puno ng estado](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Puno_ng_estado "Puno ng estado"). Naluklok siya sa trono noong Disyembre 6, 2006 matapos magbitiw ang kanyang ama, ang ikaapat at dating Haring Dragon ng Bhutan na si Jigme Singye Wangchuck. Naganap ang pampublikong seremonya ng koronasyon noong Nobyembre 6, 2008, ang taon na minarkahan ang ika-100 ng [monarkiya](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monarkiya "Monarkiya") ng Bhutan. Kaugnay ng pamilya, panganay si Khesar ng kanyang ama at ng ikatlong asawa ng kanyang ama na si Reynang (Ashi) Tshering Yangdon. Mayroon siyang mga nakababatang kapatid na babae at lalaki, gayundin, may apat na kapatid na babae sa labas at tatlong kapatid na lalaki sa labas. Asawa niya si Jestun Pema, ang Druk Gyaltsuen (Dzongkha: Reynang Dragon) ng Bhutan. Mayroon silang dalawang anak, ang mga prinsipeng sina Jigme Namgyel Wangchuck at Jigme Ugyen Wangchuck. Pagkatapos tapusin ang kanyang pag-aaral sa mababa at mataas na paaralan sa Bhutan, nag-aral si Khesar sa ibang bansa sa Akademiyang Phillips (Andover), Akademiyang Cushing at Dalubhasaang Wheaton sa [Massachusetts](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massachusetts "Massachusetts"), [Mga Nagkakaisang Estado](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Estados_Unidos "Estados Unidos"), bago magtapos sa Dalubhasaang Magdalen, Pamantasan ng Oxford, [Mga Nagkakaisang Kaharian](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom"), kung saan nakumpleto niya ang Programang Ugnayang Panlabas at MPhil sa Politika. Nakapaglakbay siya sa mga iba't ibang bansa, opisyal na kumakatawan ng Bhutan sa mga iba't ibang kaganapan at may aktibong gampanin sa mga pangkultura, pang-edukasyon at pang-ekonomiyang organisasyon.

## Napiling larawan
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0c/Sally_Ride_%281984%29.jpg/330px-Sally_Ride_%281984%29.jpg)](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talaksan:Sally_Ride_\(1984\).jpg)
Si **[Sally Kristen Ride](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sally_Ride "Sally Ride")** (Mayo 26, 1951 – Hulyo 23, 2012) ay isang Amerikanong [astronauta](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astronaut "Astronaut") at [pisiko](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pisiko "Pisiko"). Ipinanganak sa [Los Angeles](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles"), sumali siya sa [NASA](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA") noong 1978, at noong 1983 naging unang babaeng Amerikano at pangatlong babae na lumipad sa [kalawakan](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalawakan "Kalawakan"), pagkatapos ng mga [kosmonauta](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astronaut "Astronaut") na sina [Valentina Tereshkova](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valentina_Tereshkova "Valentina Tereshkova") noong 1963 at Svetlana Savitskaya noong 1982. Siya ang pinakabatang Amerikanong astronauta na lumipad sa kalawakan, na nagawa ito sa edad na 32. 
_May-akda ng larawan:[NASA](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA")_

## Patungkol
Ang [Wikipedia](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") ay isang proyektong _online_ na ensiklopedya na panlahat, nakasulat sa maraming wika, at pinagtutulungan ang paggawa ng mga artikulo sa prinsipyong [wiki](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiki "Wiki"). Naglalayon ang proyektong ito na mag-alok ng mga [nilalaman na malayang muling magagamit](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malayang_nilalaman "Malayang nilalaman"), walang pinapanigan, at napapatunayan, na maaring baguhin at mapabuti ninuman. Nakikilala ang Wikipedia sa pamamagitan ng mga [naitatag na prinsipyo](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Limang_haligi "Wikipedia:Limang haligi"). Nakalisensiya ang nilalaman nito sa ilalim ng [_Creative Commons BY-SA_](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0). Maari itong kopyahin at muling gamitin sa ilalim ng parehong lisensiya, na sumasailalim sa paggalang sa mga kondisyon. Ibinbigay ng Wikipedia ang mga nilalaman nito ng walang bayad, walang patalastas, at hindi nagsasamantala sa paggamit ng personal na datos ng mga gumagamit nito. 
Mga boluntaryo ang nag-aambag o patnugot ng mga artikulo sa Wikipedia. Nakikipag-ugnayan sila sa isa't isa tungkol sa kanilang mga pagsisikap sa loob ng pamayanang nagtutulungan at walang pinuno. 
Sa ngayon, mayroon ang [Wikipediang Tagalog](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipediang_Tagalog "Wikipediang Tagalog") na:   
---  
[48,811](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natatangi:Mga_estadistika "Natatangi:Mga estadistika")  
artikulo  |  [337](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natatangi:Masisiglang_mga_Tagagamit "Natatangi:Masisiglang mga Tagagamit")  
aktibong tagapag-ambag  
Maaring maglathala ng _online_ na nilalaman ang kahit sino basta't sundin nila ang mga pangunahing alintuntuning itinakda ng [Pundasyong Wikimedia](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use/tl "wmf:Terms of Use/tl") at ng pamayanan; halimbawa, [pagpapatunay ng nilalaman](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pagpapatunay "Wikipedia:Pagpapatunay"), [notabilidad](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Notabilidad "Wikipedia:Notabilidad"), at [pagkamagalang](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Pagkamagalang "Wikipedia:Pagkamagalang"). 
Maraming mga pahinang pantulong ang mababasa mo, partikular sa [paglikha ng artikulo](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Salamangkero_ng_artikulo "Wikipedia:Salamangkero ng artikulo"), [pagbago ng artikulo](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Paano_baguhin_ang_isang_pahina "Wikipedia:Paano baguhin ang isang pahina") o [pagpasok ng litrato](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Paglalagay_ng_mga_larawan "Wikipedia:Paglalagay ng mga larawan"). Huwag mag-atubiling [magtanong](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Magtanong "Wikipedia:Magtanong") para sa iyong unang mga hakbang, partikular sa isa sa mga [proyektong tematiko](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:WikiProyekto "Wikipedia:WikiProyekto") o sa iba't ibang espasyo para sa mga usapan 
Ginagamit ang mga [pahinang usapan](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulong:Paggamit_ng_pahina_ng_usapan "Tulong:Paggamit ng pahina ng usapan") upang isentralisado ang mga naiisip at kumento para mapabuti ang isang partikular na artikulo o pahina. Mayroon din sentrong _portal_ o puntahan ng pamayanan, ang [Kapihan](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:KAPE "Wikipedia:KAPE"), kung saan puwedeng pag-usapan ang pangkalahatang alalahanin sa pamayanang Wikipediang Tagalog. [Pindutin ito upang magtanong o maghayag ng iyong naiisip para mapabuti pa ang Wikipediang Tagalog](https://tl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Usapang_Wikipedia:Kapihan&action=edit&section=new). 
**[Babasahin para sa mga baguhan](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulong:Pagsisimula "Tulong:Pagsisimula")**
## Kaganapan
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/07/Alex_Eala_%282024_US_Open%29_02_%28cropped%29.jpg/120px-Alex_Eala_%282024_US_Open%29_02_%28cropped%29.jpg)](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talaksan:Alex_Eala_\(2024_US_Open\)_02_\(cropped\).jpg)
  * Agad na pinapalitan ng [Malacañang](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaca%C3%B1ang "Malacañang") ang Heneral na Pulis na si [**Nicolas Torre III**](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicolas_Torre "Nicolas Torre") bilang hepe ng [Pambansang Pulisya ng Pilipinas](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pambansang_Pulisya_ng_Pilipinas "Pambansang Pulisya ng Pilipinas") (PNP), ayon sa dokumentong nilagdaan ni [Kalihim Tagapagpaganap](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalihim_Tagapagpaganap "Kalihim Tagapagpaganap") [Lucas Bersamin](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucas_Bersamin "Lucas Bersamin").
  * Sa [tenis](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tenis "Tenis"), naging unang manlalarong Pilipino si **[Alexandra Eala](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexandra_Eala "Alexandra Eala")** (_nakalarawan_) na nakapanalo sa isang _main draw match_ (laban sa pangunahing paligsahan) sa isang _Grand Slam_ (Pambihirang Tropeo) sa _Open Era_ (Panahong Bukas) matapos talunin ang taga-[Dinamarka](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dinamarka "Dinamarka") na si Clara Tauson sa unang rawmd ng 2025 _US Open_ – torneong singles ng mga Kababaihan.
  * Nagpahayag si Mayor [Vico Sotto](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vico_Sotto "Vico Sotto") ng [Pasig](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pasig "Pasig") sa isang paskil sa [Facebook](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Facebook "Facebook") ng pagdududa sa mga midyang nagbibigay ng plataporma sa mag-asawang Discaya, na inaakusahan ng pakikinabang sa mga **pumalyang proyekto sa kontrol ng[baha](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baha "Baha")**, sa pamamagitan ng pagbabahagi ng _screenshot_ ng kanilang panayam kina [Korina Sanchez](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Korina_Sanchez "Korina Sanchez") at [Julius Babao](https://tl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julius_Babao "Julius Babao"). Bilang tugon, ipinagtanggol ng mga beteranong mamamahayag ang kanilang ulat at iginiit na isinagawa ang mga panayam para sa interes ng publiko at hindi bilang bayad na promosyon.

Long Wikipedia
[Wikipedia](https://tpi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") long [Tok Pisin](https://tpi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tok_Pisin "Tok Pisin")  
---  
**Wikipedia** emi olsem traipela buk igat planti toksave insait long planti samting - long [Tok Inglis](https://tpi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tok_Inglis "Tok Inglis"), nem bilong dispela kain buk emi _encyclopedia_. Tasol dispela savebuk emi stap long intanet yet, na tu emi fri - yu inap senisim yu yet, raitim ol nupela pes, na tu yu inap kisim ol samting yu raitim long hia na yusim long narapela hap gen.  Wikipedia long Tok Pisin igat **1,406** pes nau. [Haus bilong toktok](https://tpi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Haus_bilong_toktok "Wikipedia:Haus bilong toktok")

## King blong Tonga i dai pinis
Praim Minista blong Tonga, itokaut pinis olsem, King blong Tonga na man husat ibin bringim Demokrasi igo long kantri, King George Tupou the fifth,i dai pinis. King Tupou the fifth krismas blong en 63 ibin dai aste long Hong Kong.Yangpla brata blong en ibin stap wantem em taem emi bin dai. King Tupou ino bin marit na brata blong en, Crown Prince, bai kisim ples blong en na kamap olsem nupla King. Niusmeri long Nukua'lofa, Monalisa Palu, ibin tokim Redio Australia, olsem King Tupou ibin wanpla man husat ibin kamapim ol gutpla senis long kantri. [Redio Australia](http://www.radioaustralia.net.au/tokpisin/2012-03-19/king-blong-tonga-i-dai-pinis/427272)  
---|---

#  [Vikipedi](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipedi "Vikipedi")'ye [hoş geldiniz](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipedi:Ho%C5%9F_geldiniz "Vikipedi:Hoş geldiniz")!

|  [Haftanın seçkin maddesi](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipedi:Se%C3%A7kin_maddeler "Vikipedi:Seçkin maddeler")  
---  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1c/Hande_Yener_Harbiye_2015_-_2.JPG/120px-Hande_Yener_Harbiye_2015_-_2.JPG)](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dosya:Hande_Yener_Harbiye_2015_-_2.JPG) **_[Apayrı](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apayr%C4%B1 "Apayrı")_ ,** Türk şarkıcı [Hande Yener](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hande_Yener "Hande Yener")'in dördüncü stüdyo albümüdür. 6 Ocak 2006'da [Erol Köse Production](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erol_K%C3%B6se_Production "Erol Köse Production") tarafından yayımlandı. İlk albümleriyle dinleyicilerinin ve müzik yazarlarının aklında kendisine ait bir müzik tarzı oluşturan şarkıcı, üçüncü albümü _[Aşk Kadın Ruhundan Anlamıyor](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/A%C5%9Fk_Kad%C4%B1n_Ruhundan_Anlam%C4%B1yor "Aşk Kadın Ruhundan Anlamıyor")_ 'un (2004) ardından mevcut işlerini sorgulayarak müzikal anlamda çeşitli huzursuzluklar yaşadı. Şarkılarıyla ilgili yaşadığı memnuniyetsizlik önceki işlerinden farklı bir söz ve müzik tarzına yönelmesine yol açtı. Daha önce birkaç şarkıda çalıştığı [Erdem Kınay](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Erdem_K%C4%B1nay "Erdem Kınay") ve [Mete Özgencil](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mete_%C3%96zgencil "Mete Özgencil") ile bu albümünün büyük bir kısmını hazırladı ve bu müzisyenler albümün gelişiminde belirgin bir rol oynadı. Genel anlamda bir [dans-pop](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dans-pop "Dans-pop") ve [house](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_m%C3%BCzik "House müzik") albümü olan _Apayrı_ 'da şarkıdan şarkıya farklılık gösteren [funk](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Funk "Funk"), [R&B](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%87a%C4%9Fda%C5%9F_R%26B "Çağdaş R&B"), [rock](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rock_m%C3%BCzik "Rock müzik") ve [synthpop](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synthpop "Synthpop") gibi çeşitli tarzlar yer aldı. 1980'lerde [ABD](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amerika_Birle%C5%9Fik_Devletleri "Amerika Birleşik Devletleri") ve [Avrupa](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avrupa "Avrupa")'da popüler olan [dans müziği](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dans_m%C3%BCzi%C4%9Fi "Dans müziği") tarzlarından ilham alan çalışma özellikle de [Madonna](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madonna "Madonna"), [Kylie Minogue](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kylie_Minogue "Kylie Minogue") ve [Robbie Williams](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robbie_Williams "Robbie Williams")'ın müziklerinin etkisinde hazırlandı. ([**Devamı...**](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apayr%C4%B1 "Apayrı")) 
  * **[Arşiv](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipedi:Haftan%C4%B1n_se%C3%A7kin_maddesi "Vikipedi:Haftanın seçkin maddesi")**
  * **[Daha fazla seçkin madde](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipedi:Se%C3%A7kin_maddeler "Vikipedi:Seçkin maddeler")**

  
[Günün kaliteli maddesi](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vikipedi:Kaliteli_maddeler "Vikipedi:Kaliteli maddeler")  
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c5/Lady_Gaga_Vancouver_1.jpg/120px-Lady_Gaga_Vancouver_1.jpg)](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dosya:Lady_Gaga_Vancouver_1.jpg) **"[Speechless](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speechless_\(Lady_Gaga_%C5%9Fark%C4%B1s%C4%B1\) "Speechless \(Lady Gaga şarkısı\)")"**, Amerikalı şarkıcı [Lady Gaga](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Gaga "Lady Gaga")'nın üçüncü EP'si _[The Fame Monster](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Fame_Monster "The Fame Monster")_ 'dan bir şarkıdır. Gaga şarkıyı babası Joseph Germanotta'yı aort kapağının tedavisi için açık kalp ameliyatı olmaya ikna etmek ve genç hayranlarına ailelerinin değerini bilmelerini anımsatmak amacıyla yazdı. "Speechless", Gaga'nın "Ölüm Canavarı Korkusu" hakkındadır. 1970'lerin [rock müziği](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rock_m%C3%BCzik "Rock müzik") esintili [balad](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balad "Balad"), eleştirmenlerden karışık geri dönüşler aldı. [Queen](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Queen "Queen")'den izler taşımasından ve içtenliğinden dolayı övülürken "sahte göründüğü" için eleştirildi. "Speechless", [_Billboard_ Hot 100](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Hot_100 "Billboard Hot 100") listesine 12 Aralık 2009 tarihinde doksan dördüncü sıradan giriş yaptı. Gaga, şarkıyı canlı olarak [2010 Grammy Ödülleri](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_Grammy_%C3%96d%C3%BClleri "2010 Grammy Ödülleri"), [2009 Amerikan Müzik Ödülleri](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amerikan_M%C3%BCzik_%C3%96d%C3%BClleri "Amerikan Müzik Ödülleri"), [2009 Royal Variety Performance](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Variety_Performance "Royal Variety Performance") ve [The Monster Ball Tour](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Monster_Ball_Tour "The Monster Ball Tour")'da söyledi. ([**Devamı...**](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speechless_\(Lady_Gaga_%C5%9Fark%C4%B1s%C4%B1\) "Speechless \(Lady Gaga şarkısı\)"))

## [Bài viết chọn lọc](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%C3%A0i_vi%E1%BA%BFt_ch%E1%BB%8Dn_l%E1%BB%8Dc "Wikipedia:Bài viết chọn lọc")
[![Swift biểu diễn "Shake It Off" tại the 1989 World Tour \(2015\)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4d/Taylor_Swift_112_%2818119055110%29.jpg/330px-Taylor_Swift_112_%2818119055110%29.jpg)](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%E1%BA%ADp_tin:Taylor_Swift_112_\(18119055110\).jpg "Swift biểu diễn "Shake It Off" tại the 1989 World Tour \(2015\)")
"**[Shake It Off](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Off "Shake It Off")** " là một bài hát của nữ [ca sĩ kiêm nhạc sĩ sáng tác bài hát](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ca_s%C4%A9_ki%C3%AAm_s%C3%A1ng_t%C3%A1c_nh%E1%BA%A1c "Ca sĩ kiêm sáng tác nhạc") người Mỹ [Taylor Swift](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift "Taylor Swift") và cũng là [đĩa đơn mở đường](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lead_single "Lead single") cho [album phòng thu](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Album_ph%C3%B2ng_thu "Album phòng thu") thứ năm của cô _[1989](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/1989_\(album\) "1989 \(album\)")_. Swift đã viết lời và soạn giai điệu cho bài hát cùng với các nhà sản xuất [Max Martin](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Martin "Max Martin") và [Shellback](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shellback_\(nh%C3%A0_s%E1%BA%A3n_xu%E1%BA%A5t_thu_%C3%A2m\) "Shellback \(nhà sản xuất thu âm\)"). Quá trình sáng tác "Shake It Off" bắt nguồn từ việc truyền thông luôn luôn soi mói dòm ngó hình tượng của Swift, và nội dung lời bài hát cho thấy nữ ca sĩ "tỉnh bơ" trước những lời chê bai chỉ trích của truyền thông và những người ghét bỏ. Về mặt nhạc lý, "Shake It Off" là một sản phẩm [dance-pop](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dance-pop "Dance-pop") sôi động có sử dụng phần nhịp trống loop, một đoạn âm thanh kèn [saxophone](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saxophone "Saxophone") và đoạn bridge lấy nhịp bằng tiếng vỗ tay. [ **[Đọc tiếp](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Off "Shake It Off")** ]

## [Bài viết tốt](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%C3%A0i_vi%E1%BA%BFt_t%E1%BB%91t "Wikipedia:Bài viết tốt")
**[Vụ 47.800 đồng](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%E1%BB%A5_47.800_%C4%91%E1%BB%93ng "Vụ 47.800 đồng")** là tên gọi được báo chí và truyền thông [Việt Nam](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vi%E1%BB%87t_Nam "Việt Nam") dùng để nói về việc hai nữ sinh 10 tuổi vì bị nghi lấy cắp 47.800 [đồng](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90%E1%BB%93ng_\(%C4%91%C6%A1n_v%E1%BB%8B_ti%E1%BB%81n_t%E1%BB%87\) "Đồng \(đơn vị tiền tệ\)") quỹ lớp nên hiệu trưởng trường tiểu học An Hiệp 2 cùng [Tổng phụ trách Đội](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90%E1%BB%99i_Thi%E1%BA%BFu_ni%C3%AAn_Ti%E1%BB%81n_phong_H%E1%BB%93_Ch%C3%AD_Minh "Đội Thiếu niên Tiền phong Hồ Chí Minh") đã dẫn cả hai em lên công an xã [An Hiệp](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/An_Hi%E1%BB%87p,_Ch%C3%A2u_Th%C3%A0nh_\(%C4%90%E1%BB%93ng_Th%C3%A1p\) "An Hiệp, Châu Thành \(Đồng Tháp\)"), huyện [Châu Thành](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2u_Th%C3%A0nh_\(huy%E1%BB%87n_%C4%90%E1%BB%93ng_Th%C3%A1p\) "Châu Thành \(huyện Đồng Tháp\)"), tỉnh [Đồng Tháp](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90%E1%BB%93ng_Th%C3%A1p "Đồng Tháp") để điều tra ngày 14 tháng 3 năm 2007. Huỳnh Thị Ngọc Trâm, một trong hai học sinh tiểu học bị công an ép cung, sau khi về nhà đã trở nên điên loạn. Em bị chẩn đoán mắc bệnh [sang chấn tâm lý](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%E1%BA%A5n_th%C6%B0%C6%A1ng_t%C3%A2m_l%C3%BD "Chấn thương tâm lý"), phải điều trị lâu dài và không thể đi học trở lại. [ **[Đọc tiếp](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/V%E1%BB%A5_47.800_%C4%91%E1%BB%93ng "Vụ 47.800 đồng")** ]

## [Danh sách chọn lọc](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Danh_s%C3%A1ch_ch%E1%BB%8Dn_l%E1%BB%8Dc "Wikipedia:Danh sách chọn lọc")
[![S. e. caesia \(Vương quốc Anh\), phân loài thuộc nhóm S. e. caesia](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/9d/Sitta_europaea_-Kent%2C_England-8.jpg/330px-Sitta_europaea_-Kent%2C_England-8.jpg)](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%E1%BA%ADp_tin:Sitta_europaea_-Kent,_England-8.jpg "S. e. caesia \(Vương quốc Anh\), phân loài thuộc nhóm S. e. caesia")
**[Trèo cây Á Âu](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danh_s%C3%A1ch_ph%C3%A2n_lo%C3%A0i_tr%C3%A8o_c%C3%A2y_%C3%81_%C3%82u "Danh sách phân loài trèo cây Á Âu")** (_Sitta europaea_) là một loài chim [dạng sẻ](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%E1%BB%99_S%E1%BA%BB "Bộ Sẻ") nhỏ được tìm thấy trên khắp châu Á ôn đới và châu Âu. Loài trèo cây này có hơn 20 [phân loài](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ph%C3%A2n_lo%C3%A0i "Phân loài"), nhưng con số chính xác phụ thuộc vào sự khác biệt nhỏ giữa các quần thể được đánh giá. Bài viết này tuân theo _Cẩm nang về các loài chim còn tồn tại trên thế giới_ (_Handbook of the Birds of the World Alive_) năm 2013, vốn có nhiều phân loài được công nhận hơn so với tài liệu _Các loài Bạc má, Trèo cây và Đuôi cứng_ (_Tits, Nuthatches and Treecreepers_) năm 1996. Với sự tương đồng giữa các phân loài theo địa lý của trèo cây Á Âu, ranh giới phân loài có phần không rõ ràng, mặc dù chưa đến một nửa số phân loài hiện nay được công nhận so với năm 1967. Các [đơn vị phân loại](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90%C6%A1n_v%E1%BB%8B_ph%C3%A2n_lo%E1%BA%A1i "Đơn vị phân loại") của trèo cây Á Âu có thể được chia thành ba nhóm chính: nhóm _S. e. caesia_ ở châu Âu, Bắc Phi và Trung Đông, nhóm _S. e. europaea_ ở Scandinavia, Nga, Nhật Bản và miền bắc Trung Quốc và nhóm _S. e. sinensis_ ở miền nam và đông Trung Quốc và Đài Loan. [ **[Đọc tiếp](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danh_s%C3%A1ch_ph%C3%A2n_lo%C3%A0i_tr%C3%A8o_c%C3%A2y_%C3%81_%C3%82u "Danh sách phân loài trèo cây Á Âu")** ]

## [Bạn có biết](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%E1%BA%A1n_c%C3%B3_bi%E1%BA%BFt "Wikipedia:Bạn có biết")
[![Khất thực trong Phật giáo](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/30/Pindapata_Sri_Lanka_2566.jpg/330px-Pindapata_Sri_Lanka_2566.jpg)](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%E1%BA%ADp_tin:Pindapata_Sri_Lanka_2566.jpg "Khất thực trong Phật giáo")
  * …gắn liền với đời sống **[khất thực](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kh%E1%BA%A5t_th%E1%BB%B1c_trong_Ph%E1%BA%ADt_gi%C3%A1o "Khất thực trong Phật giáo")** , các tăng sĩ [Phật giáo Nguyên thủy](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ph%E1%BA%ADt_gi%C3%A1o_Nguy%C3%AAn_th%E1%BB%A7y "Phật giáo Nguyên thủy") thường tuân thủ lề lối chỉ ăn một bữa duy nhất trong ngày và không được thọ thực sau [giờ Ngọ](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ng%E1%BB%8D "Ngọ")?
  * …**[một áp phích quảng bá](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tranh_c%C3%A3i_t%E1%BA%A1i_%C4%90%E1%BA%A1i_h%E1%BB%99i_Th%E1%BB%83_thao_%C4%90%C3%B4ng_Nam_%C3%81_2025#L%E1%BB%97i_thi%E1%BA%BFt_k%E1%BA%BF_%C3%A1p_ph%C3%ADch "Tranh cãi tại Đại hội Thể thao Đông Nam Á 2025")** cho [Đại hội Thể thao Đông Nam Á 2025](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90%E1%BA%A1i_h%E1%BB%99i_Th%E1%BB%83_thao_%C4%90%C3%B4ng_Nam_%C3%81_2025 "Đại hội Thể thao Đông Nam Á 2025") đã gây tranh cãi với nhiều chi tiết lỗi nghi do sử dụng công cụ tạo ảnh bằng [trí tuệ nhân tạo](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tr%C3%AD_tu%E1%BB%87_nh%C3%A2n_t%E1%BA%A1o "Trí tuệ nhân tạo")?
  * …trong năm 2025, lần đầu tiên ngành khí tượng Việt Nam ghi nhận [20 con sông trên cả nước](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%B4ng_Vi%E1%BB%87t_Nam "Sông Việt Nam") **[cùng xuất hiện lũ đặc biệt lớn và lũ lịch sử](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C5%A9_l%E1%BB%A5t_Vi%E1%BB%87t_Nam_2025 "Lũ lụt Việt Nam 2025")**?
  * …bài hát "**[Purple Haze](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purple_Haze "Purple Haze")** " được nhạc sĩ, nghệ sĩ guitar [Jimi Hendrix](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimi_Hendrix "Jimi Hendrix") sáng tác khi ông "đang mơ đi bộ dưới đáy biển"?


_Từ những[bài viết mới](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90%E1%BA%B7c_bi%E1%BB%87t:Trang_m%E1%BB%9Bi "Đặc biệt:Trang mới") của Wikipedia_
  * [Lưu trữ](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%E1%BA%A1n_c%C3%B3_bi%E1%BA%BFt/2025 "Wikipedia:Bạn có biết/2025")
  * [Bắt đầu viết bài mới](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%C3%A0i_vi%E1%BA%BFt_%C4%91%E1%BA%A7u_ti%C3%AAn_c%E1%BB%A7a_b%E1%BA%A1n "Wikipedia:Bài viết đầu tiên của bạn")
  * [Cập nhật](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Th%E1%BA%A3o_lu%E1%BA%ADn_Wikipedia:B%E1%BA%A1n_c%C3%B3_bi%E1%BA%BFt/2025/Tu%E1%BA%A7n_51 "Thảo luận Wikipedia:Bạn có biết/2025/Tuần 51")


## [Ngày này năm xưa](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Ng%C3%A0y_n%C3%A0y_n%C4%83m_x%C6%B0a "Wikipedia:Ngày này năm xưa")
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2b/John_Hay_signs_Treaty_of_Paris%2C_1899.JPG/330px-John_Hay_signs_Treaty_of_Paris%2C_1899.JPG)](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%E1%BA%ADp_tin:John_Hay_signs_Treaty_of_Paris,_1899.JPG)
**[10 tháng 12](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/10_th%C3%A1ng_12 "10 tháng 12")** : **[Ngày Nhân quyền Quốc tế](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ng%C3%A0y_Nh%C3%A2n_quy%E1%BB%81n_Qu%E1%BB%91c_t%E1%BA%BF "Ngày Nhân quyền Quốc tế")** , ngày Hiến pháp tại Thái Lan; ngày **[Alfred Nobel](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel")** tại Thụy Điển. 
  * [1867](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/1867 "1867") – Nhà lãnh đạo phong trào chống đối [Mạc Phủ Tokugawa](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%E1%BA%A1c_Ph%E1%BB%A7_Tokugawa "Mạc Phủ Tokugawa") **[Sakamoto Ryōma](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakamoto_Ry%C5%8Dma "Sakamoto Ryōma")** bị ám sát tại [Kyoto](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyoto "Kyoto").
  * [1898](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/1898 "1898") – [Chiến tranh Tây Ban Nha–Mỹ](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chi%E1%BA%BFn_tranh_T%C3%A2y_Ban_Nha-M%E1%BB%B9 "Chiến tranh Tây Ban Nha-Mỹ") chính thức kết thúc bằng **[Hiệp ước Paris](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hi%E1%BB%87p_%C4%91%E1%BB%8Bnh_Paris_\(1898\) "Hiệp định Paris \(1898\)")** _(hình)_ , Tây Ban Nha giao [Cuba](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuba "Cuba"), nhượng [Guam](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guam "Guam"), Philippines, và [Puerto Rico](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Puerto_Rico "Puerto Rico") cho Hoa Kỳ.
  * [1901](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/1901 "1901") – Các **[Giải Nobel](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gi%E1%BA%A3i_Nobel "Giải Nobel")** được trao lần đầu tiên, đúng 5 năm sau cái chết của nhà sáng lập giải thưởng là nhà hóa học người Thụy Điển [Alfred Nobel](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel").


  * [1982](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/1982 "1982") – **[Công ước Liên Hiệp Quốc về Luật biển](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%B4ng_%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Bc_Li%C3%AAn_Hi%E1%BB%87p_Qu%E1%BB%91c_v%E1%BB%81_Lu%E1%BA%ADt_bi%E1%BB%83n "Công ước Liên Hiệp Quốc về Luật biển")** được ký kết tại [Jamaica](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamaica "Jamaica") sau mười năm thương thảo.
  * [1989](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/1989 "1989") – Trong các cuộc **[tuần hành công cộng](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A1ch_m%E1%BA%A1ng_D%C3%A2n_ch%E1%BB%A7_M%C3%B4ng_C%E1%BB%95_1990 "Cách mạng Dân chủ Mông Cổ 1990")** ủng hộ dân chủ đầu tiên trong nước, [Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsakhiagiin_Elbegdorj "Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj") tuyên bố thành lập Liên hiệp Dân chủ Mông Cổ.


  * [Lưu trữ](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Ng%C3%A0y_n%C3%A0y_n%C4%83m_x%C6%B0a "Wikipedia:Ngày này năm xưa")
  * [Cập nhật](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Ng%C3%A0y_n%C3%A0y_n%C4%83m_x%C6%B0a/12/10 "Wikipedia:Ngày này năm xưa/12/10")
  * [Danh sách ngày kỷ niệm lịch sử](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danh_s%C3%A1ch_ng%C3%A0y_k%E1%BB%B7_ni%E1%BB%87m_l%E1%BB%8Bch_s%E1%BB%AD "Danh sách ngày kỷ niệm lịch sử")

Tham gia Wikipedia
**[Wikipedia](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Gi%E1%BB%9Bi_thi%E1%BB%87u "Wikipedia:Giới thiệu")** là dự án bách khoa toàn thư [mở](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Quy%E1%BB%81n_t%C3%A1c_gi%E1%BA%A3 "Wikipedia:Quyền tác giả"), [đa ngôn ngữ](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Phi%C3%AAn_b%E1%BA%A3n_ng%C3%B4n_ng%E1%BB%AF "Wikipedia:Phiên bản ngôn ngữ") mà [mọi người](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Ai_vi%E1%BA%BFt_Wikipedia%3F "Wikipedia:Ai viết Wikipedia?") đều có thể tham gia đóng góp. Mục tiêu của Wikipedia là xây dựng một bách khoa toàn thư hoàn chỉnh, chính xác và trung lập. 
Sự phát triển của Wikipedia tiếng Việt phụ thuộc vào sự tham gia của bạn. Dù là [tạo một bài mới](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:B%C3%A0i_vi%E1%BA%BFt_%C4%91%E1%BA%A7u_ti%C3%AAn_c%E1%BB%A7a_b%E1%BA%A1n "Wikipedia:Bài viết đầu tiên của bạn"), [thêm nội dung](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tr%E1%BB%A3_gi%C3%BAp:S%E1%BB%ADa_%C4%91%E1%BB%95i "Trợ giúp:Sửa đổi"), sửa lỗi chính tả hay bổ sung hình ảnh minh họa, thì bạn cũng đã góp phần xây dựng để Wikipedia tiếng Việt ngày một phát triển. 
[Tham gia](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Ch%C3%A0o_m%E1%BB%ABng_ng%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Di_m%E1%BB%9Bi_%C4%91%E1%BA%BFn "Wikipedia:Chào mừng người mới đến")
  * [Quản lý Wikipedia](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Qu%E1%BA%A3n_l%C3%BD_Wikipedia "Wikipedia:Quản lý Wikipedia")
  * [Liên hệ bảo quản viên](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Tin_nh%E1%BA%AFn_cho_b%E1%BA%A3o_qu%E1%BA%A3n_vi%C3%AAn "Wikipedia:Tin nhắn cho bảo quản viên")

## [維基百科](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%B6%AD%E5%9F%BA%E7%99%BE%E7%A7%91 "維基百科")
海納百川 有容乃大  
[人人都寫得](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E4%BB%8B%E7%B4%B9 "Wikipedia:介紹")嘅自由百科
**有[148,279](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:%E7%B5%B1%E8%A8%88 "Special:統計") 篇文章**
[文藝](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:%E6%96%87%E8%97%9D "Portal:文藝")
[地理](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:%E5%9C%B0%E7%90%86 "Portal:地理")
[數學](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:%E6%95%B8%E5%AD%B8 "Portal:數學")
[人物](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9 "Portal:人物")
[歷史](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:%E6%AD%B7%E5%8F%B2 "Portal:歷史")
**[全部](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Browse "Portal:Browse")**
**[是日正文](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E6%98%AF%E6%97%A5%E6%AD%A3%E6%96%87 "Wikipedia:是日正文")**
[![一隻黑猩猩嘅腦](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/14/Chimp_Brain_in_a_jar.jpg/250px-Chimp_Brain_in_a_jar.jpg)](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Chimp_Brain_in_a_jar.jpg "一隻黑猩猩嘅腦")一隻黑猩猩嘅腦
**[腦](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%85%A6 "腦")** 係一隻[動物](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8B%95%E7%89%A9 "動物")嘅[神經系統](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%A5%9E%E7%B6%93%E7%B3%BB%E7%B5%B1 "神經系統")嘅中樞。[脊椎動物](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%84%8A%E6%A4%8E%E5%8B%95%E7%89%A9 "脊椎動物")冚唪唥都有腦，[無脊椎動物](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%84%A1%E8%84%8A%E6%A4%8E%E5%8B%95%E7%89%A9 "無脊椎動物")大部份都有腦，淨係得一啲好原始好簡單嘅動物－好似係[白蚱](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%99%BD%E8%9A%B1 "白蚱")同[海星](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%B5%B7%E6%98%9F "海星")噉－會有神經系統但冇腦。喺[人](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%BA%BA "人")等嘅[脊椎動物](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%84%8A%E6%A4%8E%E5%8B%95%E7%89%A9 "脊椎動物")當中，腦生喺個[頭](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%A0%AD "頭")嗰度，俾硬淨嘅[頭殼](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%A0%AD%E6%AE%BC "頭殼")包實保護，會近[眼](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%9C%BC "眼")[耳](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%80%B3 "耳")[口](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8F%A3 "口")[鼻](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%BC%BB "鼻")呢啲[感覺器官](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%84%9F%E8%A6%BA%E5%99%A8%E5%AE%98 "感覺器官")，而喺功能上，腦扮演咗身體嘅[資訊](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B3%87%E8%A8%8A "資訊")處理中心：一啲基本嘅[反射動作](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8F%8D%E5%B0%84%E5%8B%95%E4%BD%9C "反射動作")（指一啲[進化](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%80%B2%E5%8C%96 "進化")嚟快速保護身體嘅簡單動作，例如係「見到有物件飛向自己對眼就即刻合埋眼」）可以由[脊椎](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%84%8A%E6%A4%8E "脊椎")或者[周邊](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%91%A8%E9%82%8A%E7%A5%9E%E7%B6%93%E7%B3%BB%E7%B5%B1 "周邊神經系統")神經構造直接處理，不過比較複雜嘅身體控制就要靠個腦－腦會無時無刻係噉整合由感官同體內收到嘅資訊，然後產生[訊號](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%A8%8A%E8%99%9F "訊號")，佈滿身體嘅[神經線](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%A5%9E%E7%B6%93%E7%B7%9A "神經線")會將呢啲訊號帶去身體各部，等腦能夠掌控身體啲[肌肉](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%82%8C%E8%82%89 "肌肉")郁動同[荷爾蒙](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%8D%B7%E7%88%BE%E8%92%99 "荷爾蒙")分泌等嘅重要[生理](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%94%9F%E7%90%86 "生理")活動。 
腦嘅[複雜度](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%A4%87%E9%9B%9C%E5%BA%A6 "複雜度")同[智能](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD "智能")息息相關：人腦齋係塊[大腦皮層](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A7%E8%85%A6%E7%9A%AE%E5%B1%A4 "大腦皮層")（指腦最外面嗰浸）就經已有成 150 至 330 億粒互相緊密連繫嘅[神經細胞](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%A5%9E%E7%B6%93%E7%B4%B0%E8%83%9E "神經細胞")咁滯，無論神經細胞數量定神經細胞之間嘅連繫緊密度都係[地球](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%9C%B0%E7%90%83 "地球")上嘅動物之冠－相比之下，（例如）[貓](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B2%93 "貓")成個腦加埋都係得嗰 7 億幾粒神經細胞；人腦嘅高複雜度令人能夠做高階嘅[思考](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%80%9D%E8%80%83 "思考")等嘅[認知功能](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%AA%8D%E7%9F%A5%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD "認知功能")，因而具有地球動物當中最高嘅智能。 
[神經科學](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%A5%9E%E7%B6%93%E7%A7%91%E5%AD%B8 "神經科學")同[心理學](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BF%83%E7%90%86%E5%AD%B8 "心理學")等嘅[認知科學](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%AA%8D%E7%9F%A5%E7%A7%91%E5%AD%B8 "認知科學")領域會對腦進行研究：廿一世紀初嘅認知科學一般同意[心腦同一論](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BF%83%E8%85%A6%E5%90%8C%E4%B8%80%E8%AB%96 "心腦同一論")，主張腦就係[心靈](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BF%83%E9%9D%88 "心靈")嘅所在，會當正腦係一部[生物](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%94%9F%E7%89%A9 "生物")版嘅[電腦](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%9B%BB%E8%85%A6 "電腦")噉－呢啲領域嘅[科學家](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%A7%91%E5%AD%B8%E5%AE%B6 "科學家")普遍認為，腦同數碼電腦一樣會由外界吸收資訊、儲起啲資訊同埋處理啲資訊，分別只不過係腦用神經電流機制表示同處理資訊，數碼電腦用嘅就係[電子](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%9B%BB%E5%AD%90%E5%AD%B8 "電子學")機制；基於呢個諗法而搞嘅認知科學研究喺廿世紀取得咗相當嘅成功，而且[人工神經網絡](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E7%A5%9E%E7%B6%93%E7%B6%B2%E7%B5%A1 "人工神經網絡")等嘅諗頭仲啟發咗 [AI](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD "人工智能") 上嘅突破。 (**[成篇文章……](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%85%A6 "腦")**) 
以前嘅正文： [向量空間](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%90%91%E9%87%8F%E7%A9%BA%E9%96%93 "向量空間") – [密碼學](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%AF%86%E7%A2%BC%E5%AD%B8 "密碼學") – [奇幻](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%87%E5%B9%BB "奇幻")

  * ...漢字同韓字都係**[方塊字](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%96%B9%E5%A1%8A%E5%AD%97 "方塊字")** (方塊圖) ，但後者屬於[字母系統](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%AD%97%E6%AF%8D%E7%B3%BB%E7%B5%B1 "字母系統")，每隻符號都表示緊元音或者輔音？
  * ...**[優獸大都會2](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%84%AA%E7%8D%B8%E5%A4%A7%E9%83%BD%E6%9C%832 "優獸大都會2")** 喺開畫第一周嘅票房係全部[動畫電影](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%8B%95%E7%95%AB%E9%9B%BB%E5%BD%B1 "動畫電影")入面最高？
  * ...近呢幾年，遊戲設計界掀起咗**[黃色油漆論戰](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%BB%83%E8%89%B2%E6%B2%B9%E6%BC%86%E8%AB%96%E6%88%B0 "黃色油漆論戰")** ，詏緊[關卡](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%81%8A%E6%88%B2%E9%97%9C%E5%8D%A1 "遊戲關卡")入便嘅路牌同其他提示物要設計得有幾明顯？
  * ...**[資訊轟炸](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%B3%87%E8%A8%8A%E8%BD%9F%E7%82%B8 "資訊轟炸")** 嘅概念講到，自閉症譜系人士成日都會大談自己有興趣嘅嘢，忽視其他人係咪有興趣聽？
  * ...喺猶太教同基督教中，[上帝](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%8A%E5%B8%9D "上帝")就係一切**[善](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%96%84 "善")** 嘅最終來源？
  * ...**[和諧粉彩](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%92%8C%E8%AB%A7%E7%B2%89%E5%BD%A9 "和諧粉彩")** 係一種透過[手指](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%89%8B%E6%8C%87 "手指")同[粉彩](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E7%B2%89%E5%BD%A9 "粉彩")創作，以達到心靈療癒、釋放[壓力](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BF%83%E7%90%86%E5%A3%93%E5%8A%9B "心理壓力")同[情緒](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%83%85%E7%B7%92 "情緒")嘅[藝術](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%97%9D%E8%A1%93 "藝術")形式？
  * ...由寫作嘅角度睇，**[對立角色](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%B0%8D%E7%AB%8B%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2 "對立角色")** 通常會係[奸角](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%B8%E8%A7%92 "奸角")，但係都唔一定？
  * ...**[心理物理學](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%BF%83%E7%90%86%E7%89%A9%E7%90%86%E5%AD%B8 "心理物理學")** 嘅實驗做法，可以用嚟探究人類[感知](https://zh-yue.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%84%9F%E7%9F%A5 "感知")能力嘅極限？
